policy.workflow: word + POS + current Chinese meaning -> original sentence + zh-Hant-TW translation -> basic quality check

a.en: A good question can lead to a much deeper discussion.
a.zh: 一個好問題可以引導出更深入的討論。

a.m..en: The school library opens at nine a.m. on weekdays.
a.m..zh: 學校圖書館平日上午九點開門。

abandon.en: The team decided to abandon the original plan after the first test failed.
abandon.zh: 第一次測試失敗後，團隊決定放棄原先的計畫。

abbreviate.en: Writers often abbreviate long terms after introducing them clearly.
abbreviate.zh: 作者在清楚介紹長術語後，常會使用縮寫。

abide.en: All students must abide by the rules of the laboratory.
abide.zh: 所有學生都必須遵守實驗室規則。

ability.en: Regular practice can improve your ability to understand difficult texts.
ability.zh: 規律練習可以提升你理解困難文章的能力。

able.en: She was able to finish the assignment before dinner.
able.zh: 她能夠在晚餐前完成作業。

abnormal.en: The doctor noticed an abnormal pattern in the test results.
abnormal.zh: 醫師注意到檢查結果中有異常的模式。

aboard.en: Everyone was safely aboard the train before it left the station.
aboard.zh: 火車離站前，每個人都已安全上車。

abolish.en: The city plans to abolish an outdated rule next year.
abolish.zh: 市政府計畫明年廢除一項過時規定。

aboriginal.en: The museum introduced aboriginal art from several regions of Taiwan.
aboriginal.zh: 博物館介紹了來自台灣數個地區的原住民藝術。

abortion.en: The textbook discussed abortion as a complex social and medical issue.
abortion.zh: 課本將墮胎作為一項複雜的社會與醫療議題來討論。

abound.en: Wildflowers abound in the valley during the warm spring months.
abound.zh: 溫暖的春季裡，山谷中遍布野花。

about.en: The class watched a short film about ocean pollution.
about.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋污染的短片。

above.en: The temperature stayed above thirty degrees throughout the afternoon.
above.zh: 整個下午氣溫都維持在三十度以上。

abroad.en: He hopes to study abroad after graduating from high school.
abroad.zh: 他希望高中畢業後到國外留學。

abrupt.en: The abrupt change in weather forced the team to return early.
abrupt.zh: 天氣突然改變，迫使隊伍提早返回。

absence.en: Her absence from class was explained by a note from home.
absence.zh: 她缺席課堂的原因由家長的說明紙條交代。

absent.en: Two students were absent because they were attending a competition.
absent.zh: 兩名學生因參加比賽而缺席。

absolute.en: There is no absolute rule that works perfectly in every situation.
absolute.zh: 沒有任何絕對規則能在每種情況下都完美適用。

absorb.en: Dark surfaces absorb more heat from sunlight than light ones.
absorb.zh: 深色表面比淺色表面吸收更多陽光熱能。

abstract.en: The teacher used a diagram to explain an abstract scientific concept.
abstract.zh: 老師用圖表解釋一個抽象的科學概念。

abstraction.en: The painting uses abstraction rather than realistic detail to express emotion.
abstraction.zh: 這幅畫以抽象手法而非寫實細節來表達情感。

absurd.en: The rumor sounded absurd because it had no reliable evidence.
absurd.zh: 那個謠言聽起來很荒謬，因為沒有可靠證據。

abundance.en: The region is known for its abundance of fresh fruit.
abundance.zh: 這個地區以盛產新鮮水果聞名。

abundant.en: The region has abundant rainfall during the summer months.
abundant.zh: 這個地區夏季有充沛的降雨。

abuse.en: The campaign teaches students how to recognize and report online abuse.
abuse.zh: 這項活動教導學生如何辨識並通報網路上的不當侵害。

academic.en: Good time management can improve academic performance throughout the semester.
academic.zh: 良好的時間管理能提升整學期的學業表現。

academy.en: He joined a summer academy that focused on science and engineering.
academy.zh: 他參加了一個以科學與工程為主的暑期學院課程。

accelerate.en: Better equipment can accelerate the process without reducing accuracy.
accelerate.zh: 更好的設備可以加快流程，同時不降低準確度。

accent.en: Her English accent changed slightly after living overseas for years.
accent.zh: 她在海外生活多年後，英語口音有些改變。

accept.en: She decided to accept the invitation after checking her schedule.
accept.zh: 她確認行程後決定接受邀請。

acceptable.en: The teacher explained what level of evidence was acceptable for the report.
acceptable.zh: 老師說明了報告可接受的證據標準。

acceptance.en: The new policy gained wide acceptance among students and teachers.
acceptance.zh: 這項新政策獲得學生與教師的廣泛接受。

access.en: Students can access the online library from home with their school accounts.
access.zh: 學生可以用學校帳號在家存取線上圖書館。

accessible.en: The new website makes school information more accessible to students.
accessible.zh: 新網站讓學生更容易取得學校資訊。

accessory.en: This small accessory lets the camera connect to a larger screen.
accessory.zh: 這個小配件可以讓相機連接到較大的螢幕。

accident.en: The accident caused traffic delays near the station this morning.
accident.zh: 這起事故今天早上造成車站附近交通延誤。

accidental.en: The discovery was accidental, but it led to an important experiment.
accidental.zh: 這項發現是偶然的，卻促成了一個重要實驗。

acclaim.en: The young scientist received acclaim for her clear and useful research.
acclaim.zh: 這位年輕科學家因清楚且實用的研究受到讚揚。

accommodate.en: The new schedule can accommodate students with different club activities.
accommodate.zh: 新的時程可以配合參加不同社團活動的學生。

accommodation.en: The exchange program provides accommodation for students near the school.
accommodation.zh: 交換計畫為學生提供學校附近的住宿。

accompany.en: A short explanation should accompany each chart in the report.
accompany.zh: 報告中的每張圖表都應附上一段簡短說明。

accomplish.en: Careful planning helped the group accomplish its goal before the deadline.
accomplish.zh: 仔細規劃幫助小組在截止日前完成目標。

accomplishment.en: Finishing the difficult project gave her a strong sense of accomplishment.
accomplishment.zh: 完成這項困難的專題讓她很有成就感。

accord.en: The two groups reached an accord after several hours of discussion.
accord.zh: 兩個團體經過數小時討論後達成協議。

accordance.en: The experiment was conducted in accordance with the safety guidelines.
accordance.zh: 這項實驗依照安全規範進行。

accordingly.en: The weather forecast changed, so we adjusted our schedule accordingly.
accordingly.zh: 天氣預報改變，因此我們也相應調整了行程。

account.en: You need an account to save your progress on the website.
account.zh: 你需要一個帳號才能在網站上儲存進度。

accountable.en: Team leaders are accountable for keeping the project on schedule.
accountable.zh: 團隊領導者有責任讓專案依進度進行。

accountant.en: The accountant checked the records carefully before preparing the report.
accountant.zh: 會計人員在準備報告前仔細檢查了紀錄。

accounting.en: She became interested in accounting after taking a business course.
accounting.zh: 她修讀商業課程後開始對會計感興趣。

accumulate.en: Small errors can accumulate if the data are not checked regularly.
accumulate.zh: 如果沒有定期檢查資料，小錯誤可能會逐漸累積。

accumulation.en: The accumulation of plastic waste has become a serious environmental problem.
accumulation.zh: 塑膠垃圾的累積已成為嚴重的環境問題。

accuracy.en: The researchers repeated the test to improve the accuracy of their measurements.
accuracy.zh: 研究人員重複測試，以提高測量的準確度。

accurate.en: Accurate measurements are essential when comparing the two experiments.
accurate.zh: 比較兩個實驗時，精確的測量非常重要。

accusation.en: The accusation was investigated before any decision was made.
accusation.zh: 在做出任何決定前，相關指控先接受了調查。

accuse.en: It is unfair to accuse someone without enough evidence.
accuse.zh: 在沒有足夠證據的情況下指控他人是不公平的。

accustom.en: It may take time to accustom yourself to a new schedule.
accustom.zh: 你可能需要一些時間讓自己適應新的作息。

ache.en: My shoulders began to ache after carrying the heavy bag all day.
ache.zh: 背著沉重的包包一整天後，我的肩膀開始痠痛。

achieve.en: Students can achieve better results by reviewing mistakes carefully.
achieve.zh: 學生仔細檢討錯誤後，可以取得更好的成果。

achievement.en: Finishing the project on time was a major achievement for the team.
achievement.zh: 準時完成專題對這個團隊來說是一項重大成就。

acid.en: The experiment showed how acid reacts with certain types of metal.
acid.zh: 實驗展示酸如何與某些種類的金屬反應。

acknowledge.en: The report should acknowledge the limits of the experiment.
acknowledge.zh: 這份報告應該承認實驗的限制。

acknowledgement.en: Her acknowledgement of the team's effort encouraged everyone to continue.
acknowledgement.zh: 她對團隊努力的肯定鼓勵大家繼續前進。

acne.en: Many teenagers experience acne, especially during periods of hormonal change.
acne.zh: 許多青少年會長青春痘，尤其在荷爾蒙變化期間。

acquaint.en: The orientation will acquaint new students with the school's main facilities.
acquaint.zh: 新生說明會會讓新生熟悉學校的主要設施。

acquaintance.en: I met an old acquaintance while visiting the night market.
acquaintance.zh: 我逛夜市時遇到一位舊識。

acquire.en: Students acquire new vocabulary through regular reading and practice.
acquire.zh: 學生透過規律閱讀與練習習得新字彙。

acquisition.en: Language acquisition usually requires both exposure and repeated practice.
acquisition.zh: 語言習得通常需要接觸與反覆練習。

acre.en: The farm includes an acre of land beside the river.
acre.zh: 這座農場包含河邊的一英畝土地。

across.en: A new bridge was built across the river last year.
across.zh: 去年河上新建了一座橋。

act.en: We should act quickly when a serious problem is discovered.
act.zh: 發現嚴重問題時，我們應該迅速採取行動。

action.en: The school took action to reduce plastic waste on campus.
action.zh: 學校採取行動減少校園內的塑膠垃圾。

active.en: Staying active can help students maintain both energy and focus.
active.zh: 保持活動量能幫助學生維持體力與專注。

activist.en: The young activist spoke calmly about protecting the local river.
activist.zh: 那位年輕倡議者冷靜談論保護當地河川的重要性。

activity.en: This classroom activity requires students to work in small groups.
activity.zh: 這項課堂活動需要學生分小組合作。

actor.en: The actor practiced the difficult scene several times before filming.
actor.zh: 這位演員在拍攝前把困難的場景練習了好幾次。

actress.en: The actress gave an interview about her latest film project.
actress.zh: 這位女演員接受訪問，談到她最新的電影計畫。

actual.en: The actual cost was lower than the original estimate.
actual.zh: 實際成本比原先估計的低。

acute.en: The report describes an acute shortage of clean water after the storm.
acute.zh: 報告描述暴風雨後潔淨水源嚴重短缺的情況。

ad.en: The online ad clearly lists the price and main features.
ad.zh: 這則網路廣告清楚列出價格和主要功能。

adapt.en: Students must adapt their study plans when their schedules change.
adapt.zh: 當行程改變時，學生必須調整讀書計畫。

adaptation.en: The bird's thick feathers are an adaptation to the cold climate.
adaptation.zh: 這種鳥厚實的羽毛是適應寒冷氣候的特徵。

add.en: Please add your name to the list before leaving.
add.zh: 離開前請把你的名字加到名單上。

addict.en: The documentary follows a former addict who now supports recovery programs.
addict.zh: 這部紀錄片記錄一位曾成癮、如今協助復原計畫的人。

addiction.en: Health classes explain how addiction can affect daily choices and relationships.
addiction.zh: 健康課程說明成癮如何影響日常選擇與人際關係。

addition.en: The new library is a useful addition to the school campus.
addition.zh: 新圖書館是校園中很實用的新設施。

additional.en: The teacher provided additional examples to make the idea clearer.
additional.zh: 老師提供更多例子，讓這個觀念更清楚。

address.en: The speech will address several problems facing young people today.
address.zh: 這場演講將討論現今年輕人面臨的幾個問題。

adequate.en: The classroom has adequate lighting for reading and group work.
adequate.zh: 這間教室有足夠的照明供閱讀與小組活動使用。

adjust.en: You may need to adjust the plan after receiving feedback.
adjust.zh: 收到回饋後，你可能需要調整計畫。

adjustment.en: A small adjustment to the schedule solved the timing problem.
adjustment.zh: 對行程做一點調整就解決了時間安排問題。

administer.en: Teachers administer the survey during the final ten minutes of class.
administer.zh: 老師在下課前最後十分鐘進行這份問卷。

administrate.en: School staff administrate the program according to clear written guidelines.
administrate.zh: 校方人員依照明確的書面規範管理這項計畫。

administration.en: The school administration announced the new policy on Monday morning.
administration.zh: 校方在星期一早上宣布了新政策。

administrative.en: The office handles administrative tasks such as forms and scheduling.
administrative.zh: 這間辦公室處理表格與排程等行政工作。

administrator.en: The administrator reviewed the schedule before approving the school event.
administrator.zh: 行政人員在核准校內活動前檢查了時程。

admirable.en: Her admirable patience helped the group solve the difficult problem.
admirable.zh: 她令人敬佩的耐心幫助小組解決難題。

admiral.en: The history lesson described how an admiral organized the fleet.
admiral.zh: 歷史課介紹一位海軍上將如何組織艦隊。

admiration.en: The audience showed admiration for the student's careful research.
admiration.zh: 觀眾對那位學生細心的研究表達讚賞。

admire.en: Many students admire her patience and willingness to help others.
admire.zh: 許多學生欣賞她的耐心與樂於助人的態度。

admission.en: Admission to the museum is free for students on Fridays.
admission.zh: 學生星期五可免費進入博物館。

admit.en: He was willing to admit his mistake and correct it.
admit.zh: 他願意承認自己的錯誤並加以改正。

adolescence.en: Many habits formed during adolescence can continue into adulthood.
adolescence.zh: 許多在青春期形成的習慣可能延續到成年。

adolescent.en: The program helps each adolescent develop better study habits.
adolescent.zh: 這項計畫幫助每位青少年培養更好的讀書習慣。

adopt.en: The school plans to adopt a new online learning system.
adopt.zh: 學校計畫採用新的線上學習系統。

adore.en: My younger cousin seems to adore every book about space.
adore.zh: 我年幼的表弟似乎很喜愛每一本太空主題的書。

adult.en: Each adult in the group was responsible for two younger students.
adult.zh: 小組中的每位成年人都負責照顧兩名年幼學生。

advance.en: Technology continues to advance rapidly in many fields.
advance.zh: 科技在許多領域持續快速進步。

advanced.en: The course introduces advanced topics after students master the basics.
advanced.zh: 學生掌握基礎後，這門課會介紹較進階的主題。

advantage.en: One advantage of online learning is greater flexibility in scheduling.
advantage.zh: 線上學習的一項優點是時間安排更有彈性。

adventure.en: The class trip became an unforgettable adventure for everyone involved.
adventure.zh: 這趟班級旅行成為大家難忘的冒險。

adverse.en: Heavy rain had an adverse effect on the outdoor experiment.
adverse.zh: 大雨對戶外實驗造成了不利影響。

advertise.en: The club used posters to advertise its new weekend event.
advertise.zh: 社團用海報宣傳新的週末活動。

advertisement.en: The advertisement used bright images to attract young customers.
advertisement.zh: 這則廣告使用鮮明圖片吸引年輕顧客。

advice.en: Her teacher gave useful advice about preparing for the exam.
advice.zh: 老師給了她一些準備考試的實用建議。

advise.en: Teachers often advise students to review a little every day.
advise.zh: 老師常建議學生每天複習一點。

adviser.en: The club adviser helped students organize the charity event safely.
adviser.zh: 社團指導老師協助學生安全籌辦公益活動。

advisor.en: Her academic advisor suggested several courses that matched her interests.
advisor.zh: 她的學業顧問推薦了幾門符合她興趣的課程。

advisory.en: The school issued an advisory about heavy rain expected tomorrow.
advisory.zh: 學校發布了明天可能有豪雨的提醒。

advocate.en: Many teachers advocate regular reading as a way to improve vocabulary.
advocate.zh: 許多老師提倡規律閱讀來提升字彙量。

aesthetic.en: The designer balanced practical needs with the room's aesthetic appeal.
aesthetic.zh: 設計師兼顧實用需求與房間的美感。

affair.en: The committee is responsible for student affair planning and campus events.
affair.zh: 這個委員會負責學生事務規劃與校園活動。

affect.en: Lack of sleep can affect both memory and concentration.
affect.zh: 睡眠不足會影響記憶力和專注力。

affection.en: The child showed affection for the dog by gently petting it.
affection.zh: 孩子輕輕撫摸小狗，表達對牠的喜愛。

affectionate.en: The affectionate dog greeted every family member at the door.
affectionate.zh: 那隻親人的狗在門口迎接每位家人。

affiliate.en: The museum will affiliate with several schools for the science program.
affiliate.zh: 博物館將與幾所學校合作推動科學計畫。

affirm.en: The survey results affirm the importance of regular reading practice.
affirm.zh: 調查結果證實規律閱讀練習的重要性。

afford.en: The school found a cheaper option that everyone could afford.
afford.zh: 學校找到了一個大家都負擔得起的較便宜方案。

afraid.en: She was afraid of speaking at first but became more confident.
afraid.zh: 她一開始害怕上台說話，但後來變得更有自信。

after.en: We discussed the results after everyone finished the experiment.
after.zh: 每個人完成實驗後，我們一起討論結果。

afternoon.en: The class will meet again tomorrow afternoon in the library.
afternoon.zh: 全班明天下午會在圖書館再次集合。

afterward.en: We finished the presentation and talked about the experience afterward.
afterward.zh: 我們完成報告後，又聊了聊這次經驗。

afterwards.en: We finished the experiment first and cleaned the tables afterwards.
afterwards.zh: 我們先完成實驗，之後再清理桌面。

again.en: Please read the question again before choosing your final answer.
again.zh: 選擇最後答案前，請再讀一次題目。

against.en: The team played against a strong opponent in the final match.
against.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中對上一個強勁的對手。

age.en: People of every age can benefit from regular exercise.
age.zh: 各個年齡層的人都能從規律運動中受益。

agency.en: The government agency released a report on air quality.
agency.zh: 政府機關發布了一份空氣品質報告。

agenda.en: The first item on today's agenda is the class project.
agenda.zh: 今天議程的第一項是班級專題。

agent.en: The travel agent helped us compare several flight options.
agent.zh: 旅行社人員幫我們比較了幾個航班選項。

aggression.en: The lesson examined how stress can sometimes increase verbal aggression.
aggression.zh: 課程探討壓力有時如何增加言語上的攻擊性。

aggressive.en: The company used an aggressive marketing strategy to enter the new market.
aggressive.zh: 這家公司採取積極的行銷策略進入新市場。

ago.en: We first visited this museum two years ago.
ago.zh: 我們兩年前第一次參觀這座博物館。

agony.en: Waiting for the final results felt like agony to the nervous team.
agony.zh: 等待最終結果對緊張的團隊而言十分煎熬。

agree.en: Most students agree that clear instructions make assignments easier.
agree.zh: 大多數學生都同意清楚的說明會讓作業更容易完成。

agreeable.en: The mild weather made the afternoon walk especially agreeable.
agreeable.zh: 溫和的天氣讓下午的散步格外舒適。

agreement.en: The two groups finally reached an agreement after a long discussion.
agreement.zh: 兩組人在長時間討論後終於達成共識。

agricultural.en: The region is known for agricultural products such as rice and tea.
agricultural.zh: 這個地區以稻米和茶等農產品聞名。

agriculture.en: Modern agriculture often uses technology to reduce water consumption.
agriculture.zh: 現代農業常利用科技來減少用水量。

ahead.en: Planning ahead can reduce stress before a busy week.
ahead.zh: 提前規劃可以減少忙碌一週前的壓力。

aid.en: The new software was designed to aid students with their research.
aid.zh: 這套新軟體是為了協助學生進行研究而設計的。

aim.en: Our main aim is to improve reading speed without losing accuracy.
aim.zh: 我們的主要目標是在不失準確度的情況下提升閱讀速度。

air.en: Fresh air entered the room when we opened the windows.
air.zh: 我們打開窗戶後，新鮮空氣進入房間。

aircraft.en: The aircraft landed safely despite the strong wind.
aircraft.zh: 儘管風很強，飛機仍安全降落。

airline.en: The airline announced a delay because of bad weather.
airline.zh: 航空公司因天候不佳宣布班機延誤。

airplane.en: The airplane landed safely despite the strong wind near the airport.
airplane.zh: 儘管機場附近風勢強勁，飛機仍安全降落。

airport.en: The bus leaves for the airport every thirty minutes.
airport.zh: 這班公車每三十分鐘開往機場一次。

airtight.en: Store the sample in an airtight container before the next test.
airtight.zh: 下次測試前，請把樣本放在密封容器中。

airway.en: The medical diagram shows how air moves through the airway.
airway.zh: 醫學圖示顯示空氣如何通過呼吸道。

aisle.en: Please keep the aisle clear so everyone can leave easily.
aisle.zh: 請保持走道暢通，讓大家能順利離開。

alarm.en: The fire alarm rang during our afternoon class.
alarm.zh: 下午上課時火警警報響了。

album.en: She showed us a photo album from her trip to Japan.
album.zh: 她給我們看了她去日本旅行的相簿。

alcohol.en: The science class discussed how alcohol affects the human body.
alcohol.zh: 自然科課堂討論了酒精如何影響人體。

alert.en: The warning sign should alert visitors to the slippery floor ahead.
alert.zh: 警告標誌應提醒訪客前方地板濕滑。

algebra.en: We used algebra to express the relationship between the two variables.
algebra.zh: 我們用代數表示兩個變數之間的關係。

alien.en: The novel imagines an alien society living on a distant planet.
alien.zh: 這本小說想像一個生活在遙遠星球上的外星社會。

alienate.en: Harsh criticism can alienate teammates instead of improving cooperation.
alienate.zh: 嚴厲批評可能疏遠隊友，而不是改善合作。

align.en: The team will align its goals with the new project schedule.
align.zh: 團隊會讓目標與新的專案時程一致。

alike.en: The two designs look alike, but they work in different ways.
alike.zh: 這兩個設計看起來相似，但運作方式不同。

alive.en: The small plant was still alive after several days without rain.
alive.zh: 這株小植物在好幾天沒下雨後仍然活著。

all.en: All students must submit the form before Friday afternoon.
all.zh: 所有學生都必須在星期五下午前交表格。

allege.en: The article does not allege wrongdoing without reliable evidence.
allege.zh: 這篇文章不會在沒有可靠證據的情況下指控不當行為。

allergic.en: She is allergic to peanuts, so she checks food labels carefully.
allergic.zh: 她對花生過敏，因此會仔細查看食品標示。

allergy.en: His pollen allergy becomes worse during certain weeks of spring.
allergy.zh: 他的花粉過敏在春季某些週特別嚴重。

alley.en: The small café sits at the end of a quiet alley.
alley.zh: 那家小咖啡館位在一條安靜巷子的盡頭。

alliance.en: The two clubs formed an alliance to organize the school festival.
alliance.zh: 兩個社團組成合作聯盟，共同籌辦校慶活動。

alligator.en: The wildlife center teaches visitors how an alligator lives in wetlands.
alligator.zh: 野生動物中心向訪客介紹短吻鱷如何生活在濕地。

allocate.en: Teachers allocate extra time to topics that students find difficult.
allocate.zh: 老師會把額外時間分配給學生覺得困難的主題。

allow.en: The teacher will allow extra time for students who need it.
allow.zh: 老師會允許有需要的學生多一些時間。

allowance.en: Her monthly allowance is divided between savings and daily expenses.
allowance.zh: 她每月的零用錢分成儲蓄與日常花費。

ally.en: A supportive classmate can be a valuable ally during group work.
ally.zh: 在小組活動中，支持你的同學可以是重要夥伴。

almond.en: She added one almond to each small bag of trail mix.
almond.zh: 她在每小包綜合堅果中放入一顆杏仁。

almost.en: We almost missed the train because of heavy traffic.
almost.zh: 因為交通壅塞，我們差點錯過火車。

alone.en: She prefers to study alone when preparing for difficult tests.
alone.zh: 準備困難考試時，她比較喜歡獨自讀書。

along.en: We walked along the river after finishing lunch.
along.zh: 吃完午餐後，我們沿著河邊散步。

alongside.en: Students worked alongside local volunteers during the cleanup activity.
alongside.zh: 學生在清潔活動中與當地志工一起工作。

aloud.en: The teacher asked each student to read one sentence aloud.
aloud.zh: 老師請每位學生大聲朗讀一句話。

alphabet.en: Children usually learn the alphabet before they begin reading simple words.
alphabet.zh: 孩子通常先學字母表，才開始閱讀簡單單字。

already.en: I had already finished the report before the meeting began.
already.zh: 會議開始前，我就已經完成報告了。

also.en: The course teaches grammar and also includes speaking practice.
also.zh: 這門課教授文法，也包含口說練習。

alter.en: A small change in temperature can alter the experiment results.
alter.zh: 溫度的小幅變化可能改變實驗結果。

alternate.en: The teacher asked the two groups to alternate between reading and discussion.
alternate.zh: 老師請兩組輪流進行閱讀與討論。

alternative.en: We need an alternative plan in case the weather gets worse.
alternative.zh: 如果天氣惡化，我們需要另一套備用方案。

although.en: Although the task was difficult, the group finished it on time.
although.zh: 雖然任務很困難，小組仍準時完成。

altitude.en: The temperature usually drops as altitude increases in the mountains.
altitude.zh: 在山區，海拔升高時氣溫通常會下降。

altogether.en: There were altogether thirty students in the final round.
altogether.zh: 決賽總共有三十名學生。

aluminum.en: The experiment compared aluminum with steel under the same conditions.
aluminum.zh: 這項實驗比較鋁與鋼在相同條件下的表現。

always.en: She always checks her work carefully before turning it in.
always.zh: 她交作業前總是會仔細檢查。

am.en: I am ready to present our research to the class today.
am.zh: 我今天已準備好向全班報告研究成果。

amateur.en: The amateur photographer won a prize in the local contest.
amateur.zh: 這位業餘攝影師在地方比賽中獲獎。

amaze.en: The clear night sky can amaze visitors from large cities.
amaze.zh: 清澈的夜空常讓來自大城市的遊客感到驚奇。

amazement.en: The students watched in amazement as the model began to move.
amazement.zh: 學生驚訝地看著模型開始移動。

ambassador.en: The ambassador spoke to students about international cooperation and culture.
ambassador.zh: 大使向學生談到國際合作與文化。

ambiguity.en: The teacher revised the question to remove unnecessary ambiguity.
ambiguity.zh: 老師修改題目以消除不必要的模糊之處。

ambiguous.en: The ambiguous instruction caused several groups to interpret the task differently.
ambiguous.zh: 模糊的指示讓幾個小組對任務有不同解讀。

ambition.en: Her ambition is to become a researcher in environmental science.
ambition.zh: 她的志向是成為環境科學研究員。

ambitious.en: The students proposed an ambitious plan to reduce campus waste.
ambitious.zh: 學生提出了一項雄心勃勃的校園減廢計畫。

ambulance.en: An ambulance arrived within minutes after the accident was reported.
ambulance.zh: 事故通報後幾分鐘內救護車就到了。

amend.en: The committee may amend the rule after reviewing student feedback.
amend.zh: 委員會在檢視學生回饋後可能會修改規定。

amid.en: Amid the noise, she remained focused on finishing the experiment.
amid.zh: 在嘈雜聲中，她仍專心完成實驗。

amidst.en: Amidst the noise, she remained focused on finishing her notes.
amidst.zh: 在嘈雜聲中，她仍專心完成筆記。

among.en: The teacher divided the work among four small groups.
among.zh: 老師把工作分給四個小組。

amount.en: A small amount of daily practice can make a difference.
amount.zh: 每天少量練習也能帶來改變。

ample.en: The library provides ample space for quiet reading after school.
ample.zh: 圖書館提供充足空間讓學生放學後安靜閱讀。

amplify.en: A microphone can amplify a speaker's voice in a large hall.
amplify.zh: 麥克風可以在大型禮堂中放大講者的聲音。

amuse.en: The funny story managed to amuse everyone in the room.
amuse.zh: 那個有趣的故事逗樂了房間裡的每個人。

amusement.en: The park provides simple amusement for families with young children.
amusement.zh: 這座公園為有幼兒的家庭提供簡單的娛樂活動。

an.en: She packed an extra notebook in case someone forgot one.
an.zh: 她多帶了一本筆記本，以防有人忘了帶。

analogy.en: The teacher used an analogy to explain the difficult concept.
analogy.zh: 老師用類比來解釋這個困難概念。

analysis.en: The report includes a detailed analysis of the survey results.
analysis.zh: 這份報告包含對問卷結果的詳細分析。

analyst.en: The analyst compared several years of data before drawing conclusions.
analyst.zh: 分析師比較多年資料後才下結論。

analytical.en: An analytical approach can reveal patterns that are easy to miss.
analytical.zh: 分析式的方法能揭示容易被忽略的規律。

analyze.en: Students analyze the data before writing their final conclusion.
analyze.zh: 學生在撰寫最後結論前先分析資料。

ancestor.en: The exhibition explains how one ancestor can connect many family branches.
ancestor.zh: 展覽說明一位祖先如何連結許多家族分支。

anchor.en: The boat dropped its anchor before the students began observing marine life.
anchor.zh: 船隻拋下錨後，學生才開始觀察海洋生物。

ancient.en: The museum displays tools used by people in ancient times.
ancient.zh: 博物館展示古代人們使用的工具。

and.en: We compared the advantages and disadvantages before making a choice.
and.zh: 我們在做選擇前比較了優點和缺點。

angel.en: The painting shows an angel above a peaceful countryside scene.
angel.zh: 這幅畫描繪一位天使在寧靜鄉村景色上方。

anger.en: He took a moment to calm his anger before replying.
anger.zh: 他先花一點時間平復怒氣再回應。

angle.en: The camera was placed at a different angle for the second photo.
angle.zh: 第二張照片把相機放在不同角度拍攝。

angry.en: She felt angry because the decision seemed unfair.
angry.zh: 她因為覺得這個決定不公平而生氣。

animal.en: Each animal in the habitat plays a role in the ecosystem.
animal.zh: 棲地中的每種動物都在生態系中扮演角色。

animate.en: The software can animate simple drawings for a class presentation.
animate.zh: 這套軟體可以讓簡單圖畫動起來，用於課堂簡報。

ankle.en: He injured his ankle while playing basketball after school.
ankle.zh: 他放學後打籃球時傷到了腳踝。

anniversary.en: The school celebrated its fiftieth anniversary with a history exhibition.
anniversary.zh: 學校以歷史展覽慶祝創校五十週年。

announce.en: The school will announce the contest results on Friday.
announce.zh: 學校會在星期五公布比賽結果。

announcement.en: The school made an announcement about the new class schedule.
announcement.zh: 學校發布了關於新課表的公告。

annoy.en: Repeated phone notifications can annoy people who are trying to study.
annoy.zh: 不斷出現的手機通知會打擾正在讀書的人。

annoyance.en: The repeated noise became an annoyance during the quiet reading period.
annoyance.zh: 反覆的噪音在安靜閱讀時間成了困擾。

annual.en: The school holds an annual science fair every spring.
annual.zh: 學校每年春天舉辦一次科展。

anonymous.en: The survey remained anonymous so students could answer freely.
anonymous.zh: 這份問卷採匿名方式，讓學生可以自由作答。

another.en: We need another example before the idea becomes completely clear.
another.zh: 我們還需要另一個例子，這個概念才會完全清楚。

answer.en: Please explain how you reached your answer to the question.
answer.zh: 請說明你是如何得到這題答案的。

ant.en: An ant can carry objects much heavier than its own body.
ant.zh: 螞蟻能搬運比自己身體重很多的物體。

anthem.en: The choir practiced the school anthem before the opening ceremony.
anthem.zh: 合唱團在開幕典禮前練習校歌。

antibiotic.en: The health lesson explained why an antibiotic should be used appropriately.
antibiotic.zh: 健康課說明抗生素為何應被適當使用。

anticipate.en: The team tried to anticipate possible problems before launching the project.
anticipate.zh: 團隊在啟動專案前試著預想可能發生的問題。

anticipation.en: Students waited with anticipation for the science competition results.
anticipation.zh: 學生滿懷期待地等候科學競賽結果。

antique.en: The museum displayed an antique clock behind protective glass.
antique.zh: 博物館把一座古董鐘展示在防護玻璃後方。

antonym.en: The teacher asked students to find an antonym for each adjective.
antonym.zh: 老師請學生為每個形容詞找出反義詞。

anxiety.en: Good preparation can reduce anxiety before an important presentation.
anxiety.zh: 充分準備可以減少重要報告前的焦慮。

anxious.en: She felt anxious before the interview but prepared carefully.
anxious.zh: 她面試前感到焦慮，但仍仔細準備。

any.en: Please ask if you have any questions about the assignment.
any.zh: 如果你對作業有任何問題，請提出來。

anybody.en: Anybody can join the club if they are interested in science.
anybody.zh: 任何對科學有興趣的人都可以加入這個社團。

anyhow.en: The weather was poor, but we enjoyed the trip anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 雖然天氣不好，我們還是很享受這趟旅行。

anyone.en: Anyone who finishes early may begin the next activity.
anyone.zh: 任何提早完成的人都可以開始下一個活動。

anyplace.en: You can study anyplace that is quiet and free from distractions.
anyplace.zh: 你可以在任何安靜且不受干擾的地方讀書。

anything.en: Please ask if there is anything you do not understand.
anything.zh: 如果有任何不懂的地方，請提出來。

anytime.en: You may review the online lesson anytime before Friday evening.
anytime.zh: 你可以在週五晚上前的任何時間複習線上課程。

anyway.en: The weather was poor, but we enjoyed the trip anyway.
anyway.zh: 天氣雖然不好，但我們還是很享受這趟旅行。

anywhere.en: With online materials, students can study almost anywhere.
anywhere.zh: 有了線上教材，學生幾乎可以在任何地方讀書。

apart.en: The two desks were placed several meters apart.
apart.zh: 兩張桌子相隔好幾公尺。

apartment.en: Their apartment is within walking distance of the station.
apartment.zh: 他們的公寓離車站走路就能到。

ape.en: The documentary showed an ape using simple tools to reach food.
ape.zh: 紀錄片拍到一隻猿使用簡單工具取得食物。

apologize.en: He decided to apologize after realizing that his comment was unfair.
apologize.zh: 他發現自己的評論不公平後，決定道歉。

apology.en: Her apology helped the two friends resolve their disagreement.
apology.zh: 她的道歉幫助兩位朋友化解了爭執。

apparent.en: It became apparent that the second method was more efficient.
apparent.zh: 很明顯第二種方法更有效率。

appeal.en: The new design may appeal to students who prefer simple layouts.
appeal.zh: 這個新設計可能會吸引喜歡簡潔版面的學生。

appear.en: Several mistakes began to appear when the data was checked closely.
appear.zh: 仔細檢查資料時，開始出現幾個錯誤。

appearance.en: The building's appearance changed greatly after the renovation.
appearance.zh: 這棟建築整修後外觀改變很大。

appetite.en: A long hike can give you a strong appetite.
appetite.zh: 長時間健行會讓你很有食慾。

applaud.en: The audience began to applaud when the performance ended.
applaud.zh: 表演結束時，觀眾開始鼓掌。

applause.en: The performers received warm applause after the final song ended.
applause.zh: 最後一首歌結束後，表演者獲得熱烈掌聲。

apple.en: She packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
apple.zh: 她帶了一顆蘋果和一個三明治當午餐。

appliance.en: Each appliance should be unplugged before the classroom is closed.
appliance.zh: 教室關閉前，每項電器都應拔掉插頭。

applicable.en: The same rule is not applicable to every type of data.
applicable.zh: 同一項規則並不適用於每一種資料。

applicant.en: Each applicant must submit the form before the deadline.
applicant.zh: 每位申請者都必須在截止日前提交表格。

application.en: The scholarship application must be submitted before the end of March.
application.zh: 獎學金申請必須在三月底前送出。

apply.en: Students can apply for the program through the school website.
apply.zh: 學生可以透過學校網站申請這項計畫。

appoint.en: The club will appoint a new leader at next week's meeting.
appoint.zh: 社團會在下週會議任命新的負責人。

appointment.en: She made an appointment with the counselor after school.
appointment.zh: 她約了放學後和輔導老師會談。

appreciate.en: I appreciate the time you spent helping with the project.
appreciate.zh: 我很感謝你花時間協助這項專題。

appreciation.en: The project increased students' appreciation for local history and culture.
appreciation.zh: 這項專題提升學生對地方歷史與文化的欣賞。

apprentice.en: The young apprentice learned basic skills by observing an experienced craftsperson.
apprentice.zh: 年輕學徒透過觀察有經驗的工匠學習基本技能。

approach.en: We tried a different approach when the first method failed.
approach.zh: 第一種方法失敗後，我們改用不同的做法。

appropriate.en: Choose an appropriate example that clearly supports your argument.
appropriate.zh: 請選擇一個能清楚支持論點的適當例子。

approval.en: The plan cannot begin until it receives official approval.
approval.zh: 這項計畫在獲得正式核准前不能開始。

approve.en: The teacher must approve the topic before research begins.
approve.zh: 開始研究前，題目必須先得到老師核准。

approximate.en: The map shows the approximate location of the old railway station.
approximate.zh: 地圖顯示舊火車站的大約位置。

apron.en: She wore an apron to keep her clothes clean during the activity.
apron.zh: 她穿上圍裙，避免活動時弄髒衣服。

apt.en: The example is apt because it directly supports the main idea.
apt.zh: 這個例子很恰當，因為它直接支持主要觀點。

aquarium.en: The aquarium has a large tank filled with colorful reef fish.
aquarium.zh: 水族館有一座裝滿繽紛珊瑚礁魚類的大水槽。

arch.en: A stone arch stands above the entrance to the old building.
arch.zh: 一座石拱門位在老建築入口上方。

archaeology.en: She became interested in archaeology after visiting the ancient ruins.
archaeology.zh: 她參觀古代遺址後開始對考古學產生興趣。

architect.en: The architect designed the building to use more natural light.
architect.zh: 建築師設計這棟建築時增加了自然採光。

architecture.en: The city is famous for its mixture of old and modern architecture.
architecture.zh: 這座城市以新舊建築風格並存而聞名。

archive.en: The school archive contains photographs from more than sixty years ago.
archive.zh: 學校檔案館收藏六十多年前的照片。

area.en: This quiet area of the library is reserved for study.
area.zh: 圖書館這個安靜區域是保留給讀書使用的。

arena.en: The final match attracted a large crowd to the indoor arena.
arena.zh: 決賽吸引大批觀眾前往室內競技場。

argue.en: Students should argue their position with evidence rather than emotion.
argue.zh: 學生應該用證據而非情緒來支持自己的立場。

argument.en: A strong argument needs both clear reasoning and reliable evidence.
argument.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚推理與可靠證據。

arise.en: Unexpected questions may arise during a class discussion.
arise.zh: 課堂討論中可能會出現意料之外的問題。

arithmetic.en: Basic arithmetic helps students check whether an answer is reasonable.
arithmetic.zh: 基本算術能幫助學生檢查答案是否合理。

arm.en: He raised his arm to ask a question during class.

armed.en: The history text describes how armed guards protected the city gate.
armed.zh: 歷史課文描述武裝守衛如何保護城門。

arms.en: The agreement called for both sides to reduce their arms gradually.
arms.zh: 這項協議要求雙方逐步減少武器。

army.en: The history lesson explained how the army defended the city.
army.zh: 歷史課說明軍隊如何保衛這座城市。

around.en: We sat around the table and discussed the project together.
around.zh: 我們圍著桌子坐下，一起討論專題。

arouse.en: The unusual result may arouse curiosity among students in the class.
arouse.zh: 這個不尋常的結果可能引起班上學生的好奇心。

arrange.en: Please arrange the books by topic before returning them to the shelf.
arrange.zh: 請依主題排列書籍後再放回書架。

arrangement.en: The seating arrangement made group discussion easier for everyone.
arrangement.zh: 座位安排讓大家更容易進行小組討論。

array.en: The museum presents an array of tools from different historical periods.
array.zh: 博物館展示來自不同歷史時期的多種工具。

arrest.en: The police made an arrest after reviewing the security video.
arrest.zh: 警方查看監視錄影後進行逮捕。

arrival.en: We checked the arrival time before leaving for the station.
arrival.zh: 出發去車站前，我們先確認了抵達時間。

arrive.en: Please arrive ten minutes early for the school meeting.
arrive.zh: 請提早十分鐘到達學校會議。

arrogant.en: An arrogant attitude can make teamwork much more difficult.
arrogant.zh: 傲慢的態度會讓團隊合作變得更困難。

arrow.en: The arrow on the map shows which direction to walk.
arrow.zh: 地圖上的箭頭顯示應該往哪個方向走。

art.en: The art class visited a gallery to study modern paintings.
art.zh: 美術課去畫廊研究現代畫作。

article.en: The article presents several reasons for protecting local wildlife.
article.zh: 這篇文章提出幾個保護當地野生動物的理由。

articulate.en: She can articulate her ideas clearly during class discussions.
articulate.zh: 她能在課堂討論中清楚表達自己的想法。

artificial.en: Artificial light can affect how some plants grow indoors.
artificial.zh: 人工光線可能影響某些植物在室內的生長。

artist.en: The artist used recycled materials to create the sculpture.
artist.zh: 這位藝術家使用回收材料創作雕塑。

artistic.en: Her artistic skills improved after months of regular practice.
artistic.zh: 經過數月規律練習，她的藝術技巧進步了。

as.en: As the weather improved, more people returned to the park.
as.zh: 隨著天氣好轉，更多人回到公園。

ascend.en: Hikers began to ascend the trail shortly after sunrise.
ascend.zh: 健行者在日出後不久開始沿山徑上升。

ash.en: A thin layer of ash covered the ground after the eruption.
ash.zh: 火山爆發後，地面覆蓋著一層薄薄的火山灰。

ashamed.en: He felt ashamed after realizing that his comment had hurt a friend.
ashamed.zh: 他發現自己的話傷到朋友後感到羞愧。

aside.en: He put the book aside and started writing his notes.
aside.zh: 他把書放到一旁，開始寫筆記。

ask.en: Do not be afraid to ask questions when something is unclear.
ask.zh: 有不清楚的地方時，不要害怕提問。

asleep.en: He was already asleep when the rain began.
asleep.zh: 開始下雨時，他已經睡著了。

aspect.en: The report examines every important aspect of the problem.
aspect.zh: 這份報告檢視了這個問題的每個重要面向。

aspire.en: Many students aspire to improve their English through regular practice.
aspire.zh: 許多學生希望透過規律練習提升英文能力。

aspirin.en: The health article mentions aspirin as a common over-the-counter medicine.
aspirin.zh: 這篇健康文章提到阿斯匹靈是一種常見成藥。

assault.en: The report examined how communities can prevent assault and improve public safety.
assault.zh: 這份報告探討社區如何預防暴力攻擊並提升公共安全。

assemble.en: Students assemble the model carefully before testing its strength.
assemble.zh: 學生在測試模型強度前仔細將它組裝完成。

assembly.en: The school assembly begins at eight thirty tomorrow morning.
assembly.zh: 明天早上八點半舉行全校集會。

assert.en: Writers should not assert a claim without enough supporting evidence.
assert.zh: 作者不應在缺乏充分證據時斷言某項主張。

assess.en: Teachers use several methods to assess student progress fairly.
assess.zh: 老師使用多種方法公平評量學生進步情況。

assessment.en: The final assessment includes both a written test and a presentation.
assessment.zh: 期末評量包含筆試和口頭報告。

asset.en: Clear communication is an important asset in any group project.
asset.zh: 清楚溝通是任何小組專題中的重要優勢。

assign.en: The teacher will assign each group a different research topic.
assign.zh: 老師會分配不同研究主題給每個小組。

assignment.en: The assignment requires students to compare two different viewpoints.
assignment.zh: 這份作業要求學生比較兩種不同觀點。

assist.en: Several volunteers stayed after school to assist with the event.
assist.zh: 幾名志工放學後留下來協助活動。

assistance.en: Please ask for assistance if you cannot use the equipment safely.
assistance.zh: 如果你無法安全操作設備，請尋求協助。

assistant.en: The laboratory assistant prepared the equipment before class.
assistant.zh: 實驗室助理在上課前準備好器材。

associate.en: Many people associate this song with their high school years.
associate.zh: 許多人會把這首歌和高中時期聯想在一起。

association.en: The student association organized a charity event for the community.
association.zh: 學生會為社區舉辦了一場慈善活動。

assume.en: We should not assume the result before checking the evidence.
assume.zh: 在確認證據前，我們不應先假設結果。

assumption.en: The experiment tested the assumption that light affects plant growth.
assumption.zh: 這項實驗測試了光線會影響植物生長的假設。

assurance.en: The clear instructions gave students assurance before the final task.
assurance.zh: 清楚的說明讓學生在最後任務前更有信心。

assure.en: The teacher tried to assure students that the test instructions were clear.
assure.zh: 老師試著讓學生放心，考試說明很清楚。

asthma.en: The school nurse explained how asthma can affect breathing during exercise.
asthma.zh: 校護說明氣喘如何影響運動時的呼吸。

astonish.en: The final score may astonish people who expected a close game.
astonish.zh: 最後比分可能讓原本預期比賽接近的人感到驚訝。

astonishment.en: To everyone's astonishment, the tiny robot completed the course perfectly.
astonishment.zh: 令大家驚訝的是，那台小機器人完美完成了路線。

astray.en: A confusing sign can lead visitors astray inside the large campus.
astray.zh: 不清楚的標示可能讓訪客在大型校園中走錯路。

astronaut.en: The astronaut described daily life aboard the space station.
astronaut.zh: 那位太空人描述在太空站上的日常生活。

astronomer.en: The astronomer used a telescope to observe a distant galaxy.
astronomer.zh: 天文學家使用望遠鏡觀察遙遠星系。

astronomy.en: Our astronomy club meets monthly to observe the night sky.
astronomy.zh: 我們的天文社每月聚會觀察夜空。

at.en: We will meet at the library entrance after school.
at.zh: 放學後我們會在圖書館入口集合。

athlete.en: The athlete trained every morning before going to school.
athlete.zh: 這名運動員每天上學前都會訓練。

athletic.en: The school built a new athletic field beside the gym.
athletic.zh: 學校在體育館旁新建了一座運動場。

athletics.en: The school offers athletics programs for students with different interests.
athletics.zh: 學校提供適合不同興趣學生的田徑運動課程。

atmosphere.en: The café has a quiet atmosphere that is suitable for studying.
atmosphere.zh: 這家咖啡店氣氛安靜，很適合讀書。

atom.en: The diagram shows how an atom is made of smaller particles.
atom.zh: 圖示顯示原子如何由更小的粒子構成。

atomic.en: The lesson introduced atomic structure with a simple visual model.
atomic.zh: 這堂課用簡單視覺模型介紹原子結構。

attach.en: Please attach the file before sending the email.
attach.zh: 寄出電子郵件前請先附上檔案。

attachment.en: Please include the chart as an attachment when you send the report.
attachment.zh: 寄送報告時，請把圖表作為附件一併附上。

attack.en: The article described a cyber attack on a large company.
attack.zh: 這篇文章描述一起針對大型公司的網路攻擊。

attain.en: Regular practice can help students attain a higher level of accuracy.
attain.zh: 規律練習能幫助學生達到更高的準確度。

attainment.en: The certificate recognizes the attainment of a high language level.
attainment.zh: 這張證書認可達到高階語言能力的成就。

attempt.en: Her first attempt was unsuccessful, but she learned from it.
attempt.zh: 她第一次嘗試沒有成功，但她從中學到經驗。

attend.en: More than two hundred students will attend the lecture.
attend.zh: 超過兩百名學生將參加這場講座。

attendance.en: Regular attendance is important for keeping up with the course.
attendance.zh: 規律出席對跟上課程進度很重要。

attendant.en: The flight attendant demonstrated the safety procedure before takeoff.
attendant.zh: 空服員在起飛前示範安全程序。

attention.en: Please pay close attention to the safety instructions.

attic.en: They found an old photo album in the dusty attic.
attic.zh: 他們在滿是灰塵的閣樓找到一本舊相簿。

attitude.en: A positive attitude can make difficult tasks easier to manage.
attitude.zh: 正向的態度能讓困難任務更容易應付。

attorney.en: The article explains how an attorney may advise a client.
attorney.zh: 這篇文章說明律師可能如何提供當事人建議。

attract.en: The colorful poster helped attract more students to the event.
attract.zh: 色彩鮮明的海報幫助吸引更多學生參加活動。

attraction.en: The night market is a popular attraction for visitors to the city.
attraction.zh: 夜市是遊客來這座城市時很受歡迎的景點。

attractive.en: The website uses an attractive layout that is easy to navigate.
attractive.zh: 這個網站使用美觀且容易操作的版面。

attribute.en: Researchers attribute the improvement to regular practice and better feedback.
attribute.zh: 研究人員將這項進步歸因於規律練習與更好的回饋。

auction.en: The charity auction raised money for new library books.
auction.zh: 公益拍賣為添購新的圖書館書籍募得款項。

audience.en: The audience remained quiet while the speaker explained the results.
audience.zh: 講者說明結果時，觀眾保持安靜。

audio.en: The teacher uploaded an audio recording for students to practice listening.
audio.zh: 老師上傳音訊檔，讓學生練習聽力。

audit.en: An independent audit checked whether the records were accurate.
audit.zh: 獨立稽核檢查這些紀錄是否正確。

auditorium.en: The entire grade gathered in the auditorium for the presentation.
auditorium.zh: 全年級學生在禮堂集合參加簡報活動。

aunt.en: My aunt taught me how to cook this traditional dish.
aunt.zh: 我的阿姨教我做這道傳統料理。

authentic.en: The museum displayed an authentic document from the early twentieth century.
authentic.zh: 博物館展示了一份二十世紀初的真實文件。

author.en: The author uses examples to make the main idea easier to understand.
author.zh: 作者用例子讓主要觀點更容易理解。

authority.en: Local authority officials inspected the building after the earthquake.
authority.zh: 地方主管機關人員在地震後檢查了建築物。

authorize.en: Only the teacher can authorize access to the locked equipment room.
authorize.zh: 只有老師能授權進入上鎖的器材室。

auto.en: The magazine has an auto section that reviews new vehicle technology.
auto.zh: 這本雜誌有一個汽車專區，介紹新的車輛科技。

autobiography.en: She read an autobiography written by a famous scientist.
autobiography.zh: 她讀了一本由知名科學家撰寫的自傳。

autograph.en: The author signed an autograph for several students after the talk.
autograph.zh: 演講後，作者為幾位學生簽名。

automatic.en: The doors are automatic and open when someone approaches.
automatic.zh: 這些門是自動的，有人靠近時就會打開。

automobile.en: The museum displays an early automobile from the beginning of the twentieth century.
automobile.zh: 博物館展示了一輛二十世紀初期的早期汽車。

autonomy.en: The project gives students more autonomy in choosing their research topics.
autonomy.zh: 這項專題讓學生在選擇研究主題上有更多自主權。

available.en: The study room is available after four o'clock today.
available.zh: 今天四點後可以使用這間自習室。

avenue.en: We walked down the avenue toward the main train station.
avenue.zh: 我們沿著大道往主要火車站走去。

average.en: The average score increased after students changed their study method.
average.zh: 學生改變讀書方法後，平均分數提高了。

avert.en: Early action can avert a small problem from becoming more serious.
avert.zh: 及早行動可以避免小問題變得更嚴重。

aviation.en: Modern aviation connects distant cities and supports international travel and trade.
aviation.zh: 現代航空連結遙遠城市，也支援國際旅行與貿易。

avoid.en: Check your work carefully to avoid simple mistakes.
avoid.zh: 仔細檢查作業可以避免簡單錯誤。

await.en: Students await the final results after completing the science competition.
await.zh: 學生完成科學競賽後等待最終結果。

awake.en: She stayed awake long enough to finish the final chapter.
awake.zh: 她保持清醒直到讀完最後一章。

awaken.en: Bright morning sunlight can awaken people before their alarm rings.
awaken.zh: 明亮的晨光可能在鬧鐘響前喚醒人們。

award.en: The science club received an award for its environmental project.
award.zh: 科學社因環保專題獲得一項獎項。

aware.en: Students should be aware of how much time they spend online.
aware.zh: 學生應該了解自己花多少時間上網。

away.en: The station is only a few minutes away from the school.
away.zh: 車站離學校只有幾分鐘路程。

awe.en: The enormous night sky filled the young observers with awe.
awe.zh: 廣大的夜空讓年輕觀察者充滿敬畏。

awesome.en: The view from the mountain was awesome after the clouds cleared.
awesome.zh: 雲散後，山上的景色令人驚嘆。

awful.en: The weather was awful, so the outdoor event was canceled.
awful.zh: 天氣很糟，因此戶外活動被取消。

awhile.en: We rested awhile before continuing our walk along the coast.
awhile.zh: 我們休息了一會兒，再繼續沿著海岸散步。

awkward.en: The first conversation felt awkward, but everyone soon became comfortable.
awkward.zh: 第一次交談有些尷尬，但大家很快就自在起來。

baby.en: The baby smiled when she heard her mother's voice.
baby.zh: 寶寶聽到媽媽的聲音時笑了。

bachelor.en: He earned a bachelor degree before applying to graduate school.
bachelor.zh: 他取得學士學位後才申請研究所。

back.en: Please put the books back on the shelf after using them.
back.zh: 用完書後請把它們放回書架。

backbone.en: Trust is the backbone of effective teamwork in difficult projects.
backbone.zh: 信任是困難專案中有效團隊合作的支柱。

background.en: Some background knowledge can make the article easier to understand.
background.zh: 具備一些背景知識能讓這篇文章更容易理解。

backpack.en: She packed a notebook and water bottle in her backpack.
backpack.zh: 她把筆記本和水瓶放進背包。

backward.en: He took one backward step to avoid the moving bicycle.
backward.zh: 他往後退了一步，以避開移動中的腳踏車。

backwards.en: He stepped backwards carefully to avoid touching the wet paint.
backwards.zh: 他小心往後退，以免碰到未乾的油漆。

backyard.en: The family planted several herbs in their small backyard garden.
backyard.zh: 這家人在小小的後院花園種了幾種香草。

bacon.en: The cafe offers eggs, toast, and bacon as a breakfast set.
bacon.zh: 這間咖啡店提供雞蛋、吐司和培根的早餐套餐。

bacteria.en: Some bacteria are helpful and play important roles in digestion.
bacteria.zh: 有些細菌是有益的，並在消化中扮演重要角色。

bad.en: A bad study habit can waste both time and energy.
bad.zh: 不良的讀書習慣會浪費時間和精力。

badge.en: Each volunteer wore a badge showing their name and role.
badge.zh: 每位志工都佩戴寫有姓名和職務的識別證。

badly.en: The road was badly damaged by the heavy rain.

badminton.en: Our class plays badminton in the gym every Friday afternoon.
badminton.zh: 我們班每週五下午都在體育館打羽球。

bag.en: She placed all her books in the bag before leaving.
bag.zh: 她離開前把所有書都放進袋子裡。

baggage.en: Passengers should keep important documents outside their checked baggage.
baggage.zh: 旅客應把重要文件放在托運行李之外。

bait.en: The fisherman placed bait on the hook before casting the line.
bait.zh: 漁夫在拋出釣線前先把餌裝上魚鉤。

bake.en: We will bake bread in the cooking class tomorrow afternoon.
bake.zh: 我們明天下午會在烹飪課烤麵包。

bakery.en: The small bakery opens early to prepare fresh bread each morning.
bakery.zh: 那家小麵包店每天清晨開門準備新鮮麵包。

balance.en: Students need to balance schoolwork, rest, and personal interests.
balance.zh: 學生需要在課業、休息和個人興趣之間取得平衡。

balcony.en: We watched the parade from a balcony above the street.
balcony.zh: 我們從街道上方的陽台觀看遊行。

bald.en: The bald man wore a hat during the sunny afternoon.
bald.zh: 那位禿頭男子在晴朗的下午戴著帽子。

ball.en: The ball rolled across the field and stopped near the fence.
ball.zh: 球滾過球場，最後停在圍欄附近。

ballet.en: She has practiced ballet since she was in elementary school.
ballet.zh: 她從小學起就一直練習芭蕾。

balloon.en: A red balloon floated above the crowd during the festival.
balloon.zh: 節慶期間，一顆紅色氣球飄在群眾上方。

ballot.en: Each student placed a ballot in the box during the class election.
ballot.zh: 班級選舉時，每位學生都把選票投入箱中。

bamboo.en: The garden uses bamboo to create a natural-looking fence.
bamboo.zh: 花園用竹子打造自然風格的圍籬。

ban.en: The city plans to ban smoking in several public areas.
ban.zh: 這座城市計畫禁止在數個公共區域吸菸。

banana.en: She packed a banana and some crackers for the trip.
banana.zh: 她為旅程帶了一根香蕉和一些餅乾。

band.en: The school band practiced every afternoon before the concert.
band.zh: 校樂隊在音樂會前每天午後練習。

bandage.en: The nurse placed a clean bandage over the small cut.
bandage.zh: 護理師在小傷口上貼了一塊乾淨繃帶。

bang.en: We heard a loud bang when the classroom door closed suddenly.
bang.zh: 教室門突然關上時，我們聽到一聲巨響。

bank.en: The bank is located across the street from the post office.

banker.en: The banker explained how interest affects long-term savings.
banker.zh: 銀行員說明利息如何影響長期儲蓄。

bankrupt.en: The article examines why some businesses become bankrupt during recessions.
bankrupt.zh: 這篇文章探討為何有些企業在景氣衰退時破產。

banner.en: Students hung a welcome banner above the entrance to the hall.
banner.zh: 學生在禮堂入口上方掛起歡迎布條。

banquet.en: The school held a banquet to celebrate its anniversary.
banquet.zh: 學校舉辦宴會慶祝校慶。

bar.en: The chart uses each bar to represent one category.
bar.zh: 這張圖表用每一根長條代表一個類別。

barbarian.en: The novel uses the word barbarian to reflect an ancient viewpoint.
barbarian.zh: 這本小說使用野蠻人一詞來反映古代觀點。

barbecue.en: Our class planned a barbecue at the park after the competition.
barbecue.zh: 比賽結束後，我們班計畫在公園烤肉。

barber.en: The barber trimmed his hair before the graduation ceremony.
barber.zh: 理髮師在畢業典禮前幫他修剪頭髮。

bare.en: The tree stood bare after all its leaves had fallen.
bare.zh: 樹葉全落後，那棵樹變得光禿禿的。

barely.en: We barely finished the experiment before the class period ended.
barely.zh: 我們在下課前勉強完成實驗。

bargain.en: The jacket was a bargain because it was heavily discounted.
bargain.zh: 那件外套因為大幅折扣，所以很划算。

bark.en: The rough bark helps protect the tree from minor damage.
bark.zh: 粗糙的樹皮有助於保護樹木免受輕微損傷。

barn.en: The old barn has been turned into a small local museum.
barn.zh: 那座舊穀倉已改建成小型地方博物館。

barrel.en: Rainwater was collected in a large barrel beside the building.
barrel.zh: 雨水被收集在建築旁的一個大桶子裡。

barren.en: The once barren field became green after months of careful planting.
barren.zh: 原本貧瘠的田地經過數月細心種植後變綠了。

barrier.en: A language barrier can make communication difficult for new visitors.
barrier.zh: 語言障礙可能讓新訪客難以溝通。

base.en: The statue stands on a wide stone base.
base.zh: 這座雕像立在寬大的石座上。

baseball.en: We played baseball after school until the sun went down.
baseball.zh: 我們放學後打棒球直到太陽下山。

basement.en: The science equipment is stored safely in the school basement.
basement.zh: 科學器材安全存放在學校地下室。

basic.en: Students should understand the basic rules before starting the activity.
basic.zh: 學生開始活動前應先了解基本規則。

basics.en: The first lesson reviews the basics before introducing harder material.
basics.zh: 第一堂課先複習基礎，再介紹較難內容。

basin.en: Water from the hillside flows into a wide river basin.
basin.zh: 山坡上的水流進一個廣大的河川流域。

basis.en: The team meets on a weekly basis to review progress.
basis.zh: 團隊每週固定開會檢討進度。

basket.en: She placed the fresh vegetables in a large basket.
basket.zh: 她把新鮮蔬菜放進一個大籃子裡。

basketball.en: Our basketball team practices three times a week after school.
basketball.zh: 我們的籃球隊每週放學後練習三次。

bass.en: The song has a strong bass line beneath the main melody.
bass.zh: 這首歌在主旋律下方有明顯的低音線。

bat.en: A bat flew across the sky shortly after sunset.
bat.zh: 日落後不久，一隻蝙蝠飛過天空。

batch.en: The lab tested a new batch of samples this morning.
batch.zh: 實驗室今天早上測試了一批新的樣本。

bath.en: A warm bath helped him relax after the long hike.
bath.zh: 長途健行後，洗個熱水澡讓他放鬆下來。

bathe.en: Visitors should not bathe in the lake during the winter.
bathe.zh: 冬季期間，訪客不應在湖中游泳或沐浴。

bathroom.en: The bathroom is located beside the stairs on the second floor.

batter.en: She mixed the batter carefully before pouring it into the pan.
batter.zh: 她把麵糊仔細攪拌後倒入烤盤。

battery.en: The sensor stopped working because its battery was nearly empty.
battery.zh: 感測器因電池幾乎沒電而停止運作。

battle.en: The history class discussed an important battle from the nineteenth century.
battle.zh: 歷史課討論了十九世紀的一場重要戰役。

bay.en: The research boat crossed the bay early in the morning.

be.en: Please be ready to leave when the final bell rings.
be.zh: 最後一聲鐘響時，請準備好離開。

beach.en: Volunteers collected plastic waste along the beach on Saturday.
beach.zh: 志工星期六沿著海灘撿拾塑膠垃圾。

bead.en: She used a blue bead to mark the center of the pattern.
bead.zh: 她用一顆藍色珠子標記圖案中心。

beam.en: A narrow beam of light passed through the small opening.
beam.zh: 一道細窄光束穿過小開口。

bean.en: The class planted each bean in a small paper cup.
bean.zh: 全班把每顆豆子種在小紙杯裡。

bear.en: A bear was seen near the mountain trail yesterday morning.
bear.zh: 昨天早上有人在山徑附近看到一隻熊。

beard.en: The actor grew a beard for his role in the historical film.
beard.zh: 那位演員為歷史電影中的角色留了鬍鬚。

beast.en: The story describes a mysterious beast living deep in the forest.
beast.zh: 故事描述一隻住在森林深處的神秘野獸。

beat.en: The team managed to beat its strongest opponent in the final.
beat.zh: 這支隊伍成功在決賽中擊敗最強的對手。

beautiful.en: The mountain view was especially beautiful after the rain stopped.

beautify.en: Students planted flowers to beautify the entrance of the school.
beautify.zh: 學生種花來美化學校入口。

beauty.en: The beauty of the lake attracts many visitors every year.
beauty.zh: 這座湖的美景每年吸引許多遊客。

because.en: We stayed indoors because the weather became unsafe outside.
because.zh: 因為戶外天氣變得不安全，我們待在室內。

become.en: Reading regularly can become a natural part of your routine.
become.zh: 規律閱讀可以成為日常生活中自然的一部分。

bed.en: He went to bed early before the important exam.
bed.zh: 重要考試前，他很早就上床睡覺。

bedroom.en: Her bedroom has a desk beside the window.
bedroom.zh: 她的臥室窗邊有一張書桌。

bee.en: A bee landed on the flower beside the garden path.
bee.zh: 一隻蜜蜂停在花園小徑旁的花朵上。

beef.en: The restaurant serves noodles with beef and fresh vegetables.
beef.zh: 這家餐廳供應牛肉和新鮮蔬菜麵。

beep.en: The device makes a short beep when the measurement is complete.
beep.zh: 測量完成時，裝置會發出短促嗶聲。

beetle.en: We found a shiny beetle under a leaf in the garden.
beetle.zh: 我們在花園的一片葉子下找到一隻發亮甲蟲。

before.en: Please review the instructions before beginning the experiment.
before.zh: 開始實驗前請先閱讀說明。

beforehand.en: Please read the instructions beforehand so the activity starts smoothly.
beforehand.zh: 請事先閱讀說明，讓活動能順利開始。

beg.en: The stray dog did not beg for food near the picnic area.
beg.zh: 那隻流浪狗沒有在野餐區附近討食。

beggar.en: The novel portrays a beggar who later becomes a respected teacher.
beggar.zh: 小說描寫一名乞丐後來成為受人尊敬的老師。

begin.en: The meeting will begin as soon as everyone arrives.
begin.zh: 等大家都到齊後，會議就會開始。

beginner.en: This guide is suitable for a beginner learning basic computer skills.
beginner.zh: 這份指南適合學習基本電腦技能的初學者。

behalf.en: She spoke on behalf of the whole class at the ceremony.
behalf.zh: 她在典禮上代表全班發言。

behave.en: Students should behave respectfully during visits to public museums.
behave.zh: 學生參觀公共博物館時應有禮貌地表現。

behavior.en: The study examines how sleep affects classroom behavior.
behavior.zh: 這項研究探討睡眠如何影響課堂行為。

behind.en: The bicycle parking area is behind the main building.
behind.zh: 腳踏車停放區在主建築後方。

being.en: Every living being depends on a suitable environment to survive.
being.zh: 每個生物都依賴合適的環境生存。

belief.en: Her belief in teamwork helped the group stay united.
belief.zh: 她對團隊合作的信念幫助小組保持團結。

believe.en: Many students believe that practice is more useful than memorizing rules.
believe.zh: 許多學生相信練習比死背規則更有用。

bell.en: The bell rang just as the teacher finished speaking.
bell.zh: 老師剛講完時鐘聲正好響起。

belong.en: These books belong on the top shelf of the cabinet.
belong.zh: 這些書應該放在櫃子的最上層架子。

belongings.en: Please keep your belongings with you during the field trip.
belongings.zh: 校外教學期間，請隨身保管個人物品。

beloved.en: The beloved teacher returned to visit the school after retirement.
beloved.zh: 那位深受愛戴的老師退休後回校探訪。

below.en: Write your answer in the space below the question.
below.zh: 請把答案寫在題目下方的空格中。

belt.en: He fastened his seat belt before the car started moving.
belt.zh: 車子開始移動前，他先繫好安全帶。

bench.en: We sat on a bench and watched people pass by.
bench.zh: 我們坐在長椅上看著人們經過。

bend.en: Do not bend the card because the chip may be damaged.
bend.zh: 不要彎折卡片，因為晶片可能會損壞。

beneath.en: A small storage room is located beneath the main staircase.
beneath.zh: 主樓梯下方有一間小儲藏室。

beneficial.en: Short review sessions can be beneficial before a major exam.
beneficial.zh: 大考前進行短時間複習可能很有幫助。

benefit.en: One benefit of exercise is better concentration during study.
benefit.zh: 運動的一項好處是讀書時更能專心。

berry.en: A small red berry appeared on the plant in early summer.
berry.zh: 初夏時，植物上長出一顆小紅莓果。

beside.en: She placed her notebook beside the computer before class began.
beside.zh: 上課前，她把筆記本放在電腦旁。

besides.en: Besides English, he is also studying Japanese this semester.
besides.zh: 除了英文之外，他這學期也在學日文。

best.en: The best solution may depend on the specific situation.
best.zh: 最好的解決方法可能取決於具體情況。

betray.en: Sharing a private message without permission can betray a friend's trust.
betray.zh: 未經允許分享私人訊息可能背叛朋友的信任。

better.en: Students often learn better when they receive clear feedback.
better.zh: 學生在得到清楚回饋時通常學得更好。

between.en: There is a clear difference between the two methods.
between.zh: 這兩種方法之間有明顯差異。

beverage.en: Each student may choose one beverage with lunch.
beverage.zh: 每位學生午餐時可以選擇一種飲料。

beware.en: Visitors should beware of loose stones near the mountain trail.
beware.zh: 遊客應留意山徑附近鬆動的石頭。

beyond.en: The discussion moved beyond the textbook and included real examples.
beyond.zh: 討論超越了課本內容，也加入真實例子。

bias.en: A good survey should reduce bias in its questions.
bias.zh: 好的問卷應降低題目中的偏誤。

bicycle.en: She rides her bicycle to school on sunny days.
bicycle.zh: 天氣晴朗時，她會騎腳踏車上學。

bid.en: The company submitted a bid to build the new community center.
bid.zh: 這家公司提交標案，爭取興建新的社區中心。

big.en: A big project becomes easier when divided into smaller tasks.
big.zh: 大型專題拆成較小任務後會更容易完成。

bike.en: I usually ride my bike to school on sunny days.
bike.zh: 晴天時我通常騎腳踏車上學。

bilateral.en: The report describes a bilateral agreement between the two countries.
bilateral.zh: 報告描述兩國之間的一項雙邊協議。

bill.en: The electricity bill was higher than usual this month.
bill.zh: 這個月的電費帳單比平常高。

billion.en: The company invested nearly one billion dollars in new technology.
billion.zh: 這家公司在新科技上投資了將近十億元。

bin.en: Please put recyclable paper in the blue bin near the door.
bin.zh: 請把可回收紙張放進門邊的藍色回收桶。

bind.en: A clear goal can bind team members together during difficult work.
bind.zh: 明確目標能在困難任務中凝聚團隊成員。

biography.en: I borrowed a biography of a famous inventor from the library.
biography.zh: 我從圖書館借了一本知名發明家的傳記。

biological.en: The course explores biological processes that help plants grow.
biological.zh: 這門課探討幫助植物生長的生物學過程。

biology.en: Biology helps students understand how living things function and interact.
biology.zh: 生物學幫助學生了解生物如何運作與互動。

bird.en: A small bird landed on the classroom window this morning.
bird.zh: 今天早上一隻小鳥停在教室窗邊。

birth.en: The museum record includes the artist's place and date of birth.
birth.zh: 博物館紀錄包含這位藝術家的出生地與出生日期。

biscuit.en: She ate a biscuit with tea during the afternoon break.
biscuit.zh: 下午休息時，她配茶吃了一塊餅乾。

bit.en: The task became a bit easier after we read the example.
bit.zh: 看過範例後，這項任務變得容易了一點。

bite.en: Be careful because some insects may bite when disturbed.
bite.zh: 要小心，有些昆蟲受到干擾時可能會咬人。

bitter.en: The medicine tasted bitter, but it helped reduce the pain.
bitter.zh: 這藥味道很苦，但有助於減輕疼痛。

bizarre.en: The bizarre pattern in the data made the researchers check again.
bizarre.zh: 資料中奇怪的模式讓研究人員再次檢查。

black.en: The teacher wrote the answer on the black board with chalk.
black.zh: 老師用粉筆把答案寫在黑色板面上。

blackboard.en: The teacher drew a simple diagram on the blackboard.
blackboard.zh: 老師在黑板上畫了一張簡單圖解。

blade.en: The machine stops automatically if the blade becomes blocked.
blade.zh: 如果刀片被卡住，機器會自動停止。

blame.en: It is not helpful to blame others without understanding the situation.
blame.zh: 不了解情況就責怪別人並沒有幫助。

blank.en: Leave the space blank if the question does not apply to you.
blank.zh: 如果問題不適用於你，請將該欄留白。

blanket.en: We brought a blanket to sit on during the picnic.
blanket.zh: 野餐時我們帶了一條毯子坐。

blend.en: The artist used soft colors that blend naturally together.
blend.zh: 藝術家使用能自然融合在一起的柔和色彩。

bless.en: They asked the elder to bless the new community center.
bless.zh: 他們請長者為新的社區中心祝福。

blessing.en: Having supportive classmates can be a real blessing during busy weeks.
blessing.zh: 在忙碌的幾週裡，有支持你的同學真是一大福氣。

blind.en: The design includes features that help blind users navigate the website.
blind.zh: 這個設計包含協助視障使用者操作網站的功能。

blink.en: The warning light will blink when the battery is low.
blink.zh: 電量不足時，警示燈會閃爍。

block.en: A fallen branch can block the narrow path after a storm.
block.zh: 暴風雨後，掉落的樹枝可能阻塞狹窄步道。

blood.en: The lesson explained how blood carries oxygen through the body.
blood.zh: 課程說明血液如何把氧氣運送到全身。

bloom.en: These flowers usually bloom during the first weeks of spring.
bloom.zh: 這些花通常在春季最初幾週盛開。

blossom.en: The cherry trees blossom beautifully near the end of March.
blossom.zh: 櫻花樹通常在三月底附近美麗綻放。

blouse.en: She wore a white blouse for the school performance.
blouse.zh: 她在學校表演時穿著白色女襯衫。

blow.en: Strong winds can blow loose objects across the street.
blow.zh: 強風可能把鬆動的物品吹到街上。

blue.en: The blue folder contains all the materials for today's lesson.
blue.zh: 藍色資料夾裡裝著今天課程的所有教材。

blunt.en: The scissors became blunt after years of classroom use.
blunt.zh: 這把剪刀在教室使用多年後變鈍了。

blur.en: Movement can blur a photograph when the shutter is slow.
blur.zh: 快門速度慢時，移動可能讓照片變模糊。

blush.en: He began to blush when everyone praised his presentation.
blush.zh: 當大家稱讚他的簡報時，他開始臉紅。

board.en: The teacher wrote the key points on the board.
board.zh: 老師把重點寫在黑板上。

boast.en: The school can boast a large library and modern science labs.
boast.zh: 這所學校以大型圖書館和現代科學實驗室為傲。

boat.en: The small boat crossed the lake before sunset.
boat.zh: 那艘小船在日落前穿過湖面。

bodily.en: Regular movement supports healthy bodily functions throughout the day.
bodily.zh: 規律活動有助於維持全天健康的身體機能。

body.en: The human body needs enough sleep to recover properly.
body.zh: 人體需要充足睡眠才能好好恢復。

bodyguard.en: The movie shows a bodyguard protecting a visiting public figure.
bodyguard.zh: 電影描寫一名保鑣保護來訪的公眾人物。

boil.en: Please boil the water before using it for the experiment.
boil.zh: 實驗使用這些水之前請先煮沸。

bold.en: Use bold text to make the main heading easier to notice.
bold.zh: 使用粗體文字讓主要標題更容易被看見。

bolt.en: The technician tightened each bolt before testing the machine.
bolt.zh: 技術人員在測試機器前鎖緊每個螺栓。

bond.en: Working together helped the students form a stronger bond.
bond.zh: 一起合作幫助學生建立更緊密的連結。

bone.en: Calcium is important for keeping each bone strong and healthy.
bone.zh: 鈣對維持每根骨頭強健很重要。

bonus.en: Completing the optional challenge earns the team a small bonus.
bonus.zh: 完成選做挑戰可讓團隊獲得一點額外加分。

book.en: I borrowed a book about climate change from the library.
book.zh: 我從圖書館借了一本關於氣候變遷的書。

bookcase.en: The new bookcase holds dictionaries beside the reading area.
bookcase.zh: 新的書櫃在閱讀區旁放置字典。

booklet.en: Each visitor receives a booklet explaining the museum exhibits.
booklet.zh: 每位訪客都會拿到一本介紹博物館展品的小冊子。

bookstore.en: The bookstore near school sells both textbooks and novels.
bookstore.zh: 學校附近的書店同時販售課本與小說。

boom.en: The town experienced a tourism boom after the new railway opened.
boom.zh: 新鐵路開通後，這座城鎮迎來觀光熱潮。

boost.en: Regular review can boost confidence before an important examination.
boost.zh: 規律複習可以在重要考試前提升信心。

boot.en: His muddy boot left a mark near the classroom door.
boot.zh: 他沾滿泥巴的靴子在教室門邊留下痕跡。

booth.en: Our club set up a booth at the school festival.
booth.zh: 我們社團在校慶設置了一個攤位。

border.en: The river forms part of the border between the two regions.
border.zh: 這條河構成兩個地區之間部分邊界。

bore.en: Repeated tasks can bore students if there is no variety.
bore.zh: 如果缺乏變化，重複任務可能讓學生感到無聊。

bored.en: I felt bored while waiting for the delayed bus.
bored.zh: 等誤點公車時，我覺得很無聊。

boredom.en: Short breaks can reduce boredom during a long study session.
boredom.zh: 短暫休息能減少長時間讀書時的無聊感。

boring.en: The lecture was not boring because the speaker used many examples.
boring.zh: 這場演講並不無聊，因為講者用了很多例子。

born.en: She was born in Taiwan but grew up overseas.
born.zh: 她出生在台灣，但在海外長大。

borrow.en: Students may borrow up to five books at one time.
borrow.zh: 學生一次最多可以借五本書。

boss.en: The boss asked the team to finish the report by Friday.
boss.zh: 主管要求團隊在星期五前完成報告。

both.en: Both solutions are possible, but one is much more efficient.
both.zh: 兩種解法都可行，但其中一種有效率得多。

bother.en: Please do not bother other students while they are studying.
bother.zh: 其他學生讀書時請不要打擾他們。

bottle.en: Remember to bring a reusable bottle to reduce plastic waste.
bottle.zh: 記得攜帶可重複使用的水瓶，以減少塑膠垃圾。

bottom.en: The answer key is printed at the bottom of the page.

boulevard.en: The parade moved slowly along the wide boulevard downtown.
boulevard.zh: 遊行沿著市中心寬闊的大道緩慢前進。

bounce.en: The rubber ball can bounce higher on a hard floor.
bounce.zh: 橡膠球在硬地板上可以彈得更高。

bound.en: The final report is bound to include several important revisions.
bound.zh: 最終報告勢必會包含幾項重要修訂。

boundary.en: The river forms a natural boundary between the two districts.
boundary.zh: 這條河形成兩個地區之間的天然界線。

bow.en: The performers took a bow after the audience applauded.
bow.zh: 觀眾鼓掌後，表演者鞠躬致意。

bowl.en: She poured the soup into a large bowl.
bowl.zh: 她把湯倒進一個大碗裡。

bowling.en: Our class tried bowling during the weekend activity.
bowling.zh: 我們班在週末活動中體驗了保齡球。

box.en: Please place the completed forms inside this box.
box.zh: 請把填好的表格放進這個箱子裡。

boxer.en: The boxer trained regularly to improve balance and endurance.
boxer.zh: 那位拳擊手規律訓練以提升平衡與耐力。

boxing.en: The sports article explains basic boxing rules and scoring.
boxing.zh: 這篇體育文章說明拳擊的基本規則與計分方式。

boy.en: The boy raised his hand to answer the teacher's question.
boy.zh: 那個男孩舉手回答老師的問題。

boycott.en: Students discussed how a peaceful boycott can express public disagreement.
boycott.zh: 學生討論和平抵制如何表達公眾的不滿。

brace.en: The engineer added a metal brace to support the weak frame.
brace.zh: 工程師加上金屬支架來支撐較弱的框架。

bracelet.en: She made a bracelet from colorful beads during art class.
bracelet.zh: 她在美術課用彩色珠子做了一條手鍊。

brain.en: Regular sleep helps the brain process and store new information.
brain.zh: 規律睡眠有助於大腦處理和儲存新資訊。

brake.en: Always check the bicycle brake before riding down a steep hill.
brake.zh: 騎下陡坡前務必檢查腳踏車煞車。

branch.en: A bird was resting on a branch above the path.
branch.zh: 一隻鳥停在小徑上方的樹枝上。

brand.en: The company introduced a new brand aimed at younger customers.
brand.zh: 這家公司推出了一個針對年輕顧客的新品牌。

brass.en: The old lamp was made of brass and polished carefully.
brass.zh: 那盞舊燈由黃銅製成，並被仔細拋光。

brave.en: It was brave of her to speak honestly about the problem.
brave.zh: 她勇敢地誠實談論這個問題。

bravery.en: Her bravery helped the group remain calm during the emergency drill.
bravery.zh: 她的勇氣幫助小組在緊急演練中保持冷靜。

bread.en: He bought fresh bread from the bakery before breakfast.
bread.zh: 早餐前他從麵包店買了新鮮麵包。

breadth.en: The course offers impressive breadth across science, history, and literature.
breadth.zh: 這門課在科學、歷史和文學方面涵蓋範圍很廣。

break.en: Remember to take a short break after studying for an hour.
break.zh: 讀書一小時後記得休息一下。

breakdown.en: The mechanic explained the breakdown in simple terms to the driver.
breakdown.zh: 技師用簡單的方式向駕駛解釋故障原因。

breakfast.en: A healthy breakfast can help students concentrate during morning classes.
breakfast.zh: 健康的早餐有助於學生在上午課堂保持專注。

breakthrough.en: The research team announced a breakthrough after years of careful testing.
breakthrough.zh: 研究團隊在多年仔細測試後宣布一項突破。

breakup.en: The breakup of the large ice sheet changed the coastline nearby.
breakup.zh: 大型冰層的碎裂改變了附近的海岸線。

breath.en: She took a deep breath before starting her presentation.
breath.zh: 開始報告前，她深吸了一口氣。

breathe.en: Try to breathe slowly when you begin to feel nervous.
breathe.zh: 開始感到緊張時，試著慢慢呼吸。

breed.en: Farmers breed certain plants for stronger resistance to dry weather.
breed.zh: 農民培育某些植物，使它們更能抵抗乾旱天氣。

breeze.en: A cool breeze entered the classroom through the open windows.
breeze.zh: 一陣涼風吹進開著窗戶的教室。

brick.en: The old library was built with dark red brick walls.
brick.zh: 舊圖書館是用深紅色磚牆建成的。

bride.en: The bride thanked the guests for joining the family celebration.
bride.zh: 新娘感謝賓客參加這場家庭慶祝活動。

bridegroom.en: The bridegroom greeted relatives before the wedding ceremony began.
bridegroom.zh: 新郎在婚禮儀式開始前向親友打招呼。

bridge.en: The new bridge reduced travel time between the two towns.
bridge.zh: 新橋縮短了兩個城鎮之間的交通時間。

brief.en: The teacher gave a brief explanation before the activity began.
brief.zh: 活動開始前，老師做了簡短說明。

briefcase.en: The lawyer placed the documents carefully inside a black briefcase.
briefcase.zh: 律師把文件小心放進黑色公事包。

bright.en: The bright classroom made it easier for students to read.
bright.zh: 明亮的教室讓學生更容易閱讀。

brilliant.en: Her brilliant solution saved the team hours of extra work.
brilliant.zh: 她出色的解決方法替團隊省下好幾小時的額外工作。

bring.en: Please bring your notebook and calculator to tomorrow's class.
bring.zh: 明天上課請帶筆記本和計算機。

brink.en: The company recovered from the brink of serious financial trouble.
brink.zh: 這家公司從嚴重財務困境的邊緣恢復過來。

broad.en: The survey covered a broad range of student opinions.
broad.zh: 這份調查涵蓋了廣泛的學生意見。

broadcast.en: The station will broadcast the final match live tonight.
broadcast.zh: 這家電台今晚將現場轉播決賽。

broaden.en: Reading different genres can broaden your understanding of language and culture.
broaden.zh: 閱讀不同類型的作品可以拓展你對語言與文化的理解。

brochure.en: The museum brochure includes a map and opening hours for visitors.
brochure.zh: 博物館手冊包含地圖和供訪客參考的開放時間。

broil.en: The recipe says to broil the vegetables briefly before serving.
broil.zh: 食譜寫著上桌前要短時間烤一下蔬菜。

broke.en: The old chair broke when too much weight was placed on it.
broke.zh: 舊椅子因承受過多重量而壞掉了。

bronze.en: The athlete received a bronze medal after finishing third overall.
bronze.zh: 這名運動員總排名第三，因此獲得銅牌。

brook.en: A narrow brook runs behind the village during the rainy season.
brook.zh: 雨季時，一條狹窄小溪流過村莊後方。

broom.en: The cleaner used a broom to sweep leaves from the entrance.
broom.zh: 清潔人員用掃把把入口處的落葉掃掉。

broth.en: The soup uses vegetable broth as its main liquid base.
broth.zh: 這道湯以蔬菜高湯作為主要湯底。

brother.en: My brother helped me practice for the English speaking test.
brother.zh: 我哥哥幫我練習英文口說測驗。

brotherhood.en: The club promotes friendship, service, and brotherhood among its members.
brotherhood.zh: 這個社團在成員之間提倡友誼、服務與手足情誼。

brow.en: He wiped the sweat from his brow after the long hike.
brow.zh: 長途健行後，他擦去額頭上的汗。

brown.en: The leaves turned brown after several weeks without rain.
brown.zh: 好幾週沒下雨後，葉子變成褐色。

browse.en: Students can browse the digital catalog before choosing a library book.
browse.zh: 學生可以先瀏覽數位目錄，再選擇圖書館的書。

bruise.en: A small bruise appeared after she bumped into the desk.
bruise.zh: 她撞到桌子後出現一小塊瘀青。

brunch.en: We met for brunch after finishing the morning volunteer activity.
brunch.zh: 完成早上的志工活動後，我們一起吃早午餐。

brush.en: Remember to brush your teeth before going to bed.

brutal.en: The documentary described the brutal winter conditions faced by early explorers.
brutal.zh: 這部紀錄片描述早期探險家面對的嚴酷冬季環境。

bubble.en: A bubble formed on the surface as the water heated.
bubble.zh: 水加熱時，表面形成了一個氣泡。

bucket.en: They filled a bucket with water for cleaning the classroom floor.
bucket.zh: 他們裝了一桶水來清潔教室地板。

bud.en: A small flower bud appeared on the plant in early spring.
bud.zh: 初春時，植物上長出一個小花苞。

budget.en: The student council created a budget for the school festival.
budget.zh: 學生會為校慶活動編列了一份預算。

buffalo.en: The wildlife center teaches visitors how buffalo live in grasslands.
buffalo.zh: 野生動物中心教導訪客水牛如何生活在草原。

buffet.en: The hotel serves a breakfast buffet with many different choices.
buffet.zh: 這間飯店提供有多種選擇的自助式早餐。

bug.en: The programmer fixed a bug that caused the page to freeze.
bug.zh: 程式設計師修正了一個造成網頁卡住的程式錯誤。

build.en: The class worked together to build a simple model bridge.
build.zh: 全班合作製作了一座簡單的橋梁模型。

building.en: The new building has larger classrooms and better ventilation.
building.zh: 新建築有更大的教室和更好的通風。

bulb.en: We replaced the broken light bulb before the presentation started.
bulb.zh: 我們在簡報開始前更換了壞掉的燈泡。

bulk.en: The bulk of the report focuses on environmental changes over time.
bulk.zh: 這份報告的大部分內容聚焦於長期環境變化。

bulky.en: The bulky package was difficult to carry through the narrow doorway.
bulky.zh: 這個笨重包裹很難搬過狹窄的門口。

bull.en: The farm keeps one bull in a separate fenced field.
bull.zh: 農場把一頭公牛養在獨立的圍欄牧場裡。

bulletin.en: The school bulletin lists upcoming events and important reminders for students.
bulletin.zh: 學校公告列出即將到來的活動和重要提醒。

bully.en: Teachers should respond quickly when a bully targets another student.
bully.zh: 當霸凌者針對其他學生時，老師應迅速處理。

bump.en: There is a small bump in the road near the gate.
bump.zh: 大門附近的道路上有一個小凸起。

bun.en: The bakery sells a soft bun filled with sweet red beans.
bun.zh: 這間麵包店販售包著甜紅豆餡的軟麵包。

bunch.en: She placed a bunch of fresh flowers beside the window.
bunch.zh: 她把一束鮮花放在窗邊。

bundle.en: The store offers a bundle of notebooks at a lower price.
bundle.zh: 這家店以較低價格販售一組筆記本。

burden.en: Sharing tasks can reduce the burden on one group member.
burden.zh: 分工可以減輕單一組員的負擔。

bureau.en: The tourism bureau publishes maps and travel information for visitors.
bureau.zh: 觀光局出版地圖與旅遊資訊供訪客使用。

bureaucracy.en: Too much bureaucracy can slow the approval of simple projects.
bureaucracy.zh: 過多官僚程序可能拖慢簡單專案的核准。

bureaucrat.en: The article described how one bureaucrat helped simplify the application process.
bureaucrat.zh: 文章描述一名官員如何協助簡化申請流程。

burger.en: The restaurant added a vegetable burger to its lunch menu.
burger.zh: 這間餐廳在午餐菜單新增了蔬菜漢堡。

burglar.en: The security system can alert residents when a burglar enters.
burglar.zh: 當竊賊闖入時，保全系統可以提醒住戶。

burial.en: The museum exhibit explains ancient burial customs through artifacts and drawings.
burial.zh: 博物館展覽透過文物和圖畫介紹古代埋葬習俗。

burn.en: Dry leaves can burn quickly in hot and windy weather.
burn.zh: 乾燥樹葉在炎熱有風的天氣中很容易燃燒。

burst.en: A water pipe may burst if pressure becomes too high.
burst.zh: 如果壓力過高，水管可能會爆裂。

bury.en: Gardeners bury seeds beneath a thin layer of soil.
bury.zh: 園丁把種子埋在薄薄一層土壤下。

bus.en: We took the bus because the train service was delayed.
bus.zh: 因為火車延誤，我們改搭公車。

bush.en: A small bird built its nest inside the thick bush.
bush.zh: 一隻小鳥把巢築在茂密的灌木裡。

business.en: The class studied how a small business manages its costs.
business.zh: 全班研究小型企業如何管理成本。

businessman.en: The businessman invested in a company that develops clean energy technology.
businessman.zh: 這名商人投資一家開發潔淨能源技術的公司。

busy.en: The library becomes especially busy during the week before exams.
busy.zh: 考試前一週圖書館會特別忙碌。

but.en: The plan sounded simple, but it required careful preparation.
but.zh: 這個計畫聽起來簡單，但需要仔細準備。

butcher.en: The butcher prepared the order before the market opened.
butcher.zh: 肉販在市場開門前準備好訂單。

butter.en: She spread a little butter on the warm toast.
butter.zh: 她在溫熱吐司上抹了一點奶油。

butterfly.en: A colorful butterfly landed on a flower beside the trail.
butterfly.zh: 一隻色彩鮮豔的蝴蝶停在步道旁的花上。

button.en: Press the green button to save your changes.
button.zh: 按下綠色按鈕以儲存變更。

buy.en: We decided to buy the cheaper model after comparing the features.
buy.zh: 比較功能後，我們決定購買較便宜的型號。

buzz.en: We heard the buzz of insects near the garden pond.
buzz.zh: 我們在花園池塘附近聽見昆蟲嗡嗡聲。

by.en: Please finish the assignment by Friday afternoon.
by.zh: 請在星期五下午前完成作業。

bypass.en: The new road will bypass the crowded town center during rush hour.
bypass.zh: 新道路會在尖峰時段繞過擁擠的市中心。

cab.en: They took a cab from the station to the hotel.
cab.zh: 他們從車站搭計程車到飯店。

cabbage.en: The farmer grows cabbage and other vegetables during the cool season.
cabbage.zh: 農夫在涼爽季節種植高麗菜和其他蔬菜。

cabin.en: The hikers stayed in a small cabin near the forest.
cabin.zh: 健行者住在森林附近的一間小木屋。

cabinet.en: The teacher stored art supplies inside the locked cabinet.
cabinet.zh: 老師把美術用品放在上鎖的櫃子裡。

cable.en: Check that the cable is connected firmly before starting the computer.
cable.zh: 啟動電腦前，請確認電線已牢固連接。

cafe.en: The small cafe near campus is quiet in the morning.
cafe.zh: 校園附近的小咖啡店早上很安靜。

cafeteria.en: Students gathered in the cafeteria during the lunch break.
cafeteria.zh: 午休時，學生聚集在自助餐廳。

caffeine.en: The health lesson explained how caffeine can affect sleep patterns.
caffeine.zh: 健康課說明咖啡因可能如何影響睡眠模式。

cage.en: The injured bird rested in a cage until it recovered.
cage.zh: 受傷的小鳥在籠子裡休養直到康復。

cake.en: She baked a chocolate cake for her friend's birthday.
cake.zh: 她為朋友生日烤了一個巧克力蛋糕。

calcium.en: The science textbook explains why calcium is important for bones.
calcium.zh: 科學課本說明鈣為什麼對骨骼很重要。

calculate.en: Students calculate the average by adding all scores and dividing by the number of tests.
calculate.zh: 學生把所有分數相加，再除以考試次數來計算平均。

calculation.en: Please check your calculation before writing the final answer.
calculation.zh: 寫下最後答案前，請先檢查你的計算。

calculator.en: Students may use a calculator for this part of the test.
calculator.zh: 學生可以在這部分測驗使用計算機。

calendar.en: I wrote the exam date on my calendar so I would not forget.
calendar.zh: 我把考試日期寫在行事曆上，以免忘記。

call.en: Please call the office if you cannot attend the meeting.
call.zh: 如果你無法參加會議，請打電話到辦公室。

calligraphy.en: The art club practices Chinese calligraphy every Wednesday after school.
calligraphy.zh: 美術社每週三放學後練習中文書法。

calm.en: A calm environment can make it easier to focus on difficult tasks.
calm.zh: 平靜的環境能讓人更容易專注於困難的任務。

calorie.en: The nutrition label shows the calorie value of each serving.
calorie.zh: 營養標示顯示每份食物的熱量數值。

camel.en: A camel can travel long distances across dry desert areas.
camel.zh: 駱駝可以在乾燥沙漠地區長途行走。

camera.en: The camera captured clear images of the night sky.
camera.zh: 這台相機拍下了清晰的夜空影像。

camp.en: The students stayed at a science camp during summer vacation.
camp.zh: 學生暑假期間參加了科學營。

campaign.en: The school started a campaign to reduce single-use plastic on campus.
campaign.zh: 學校發起活動，希望減少校園內的一次性塑膠用品。

campus.en: Visitors must wear identification while walking around the campus.
campus.zh: 訪客在校園內活動時必須佩戴識別證。

can.en: Regular practice can make difficult vocabulary easier to remember.
can.zh: 規律練習可以讓困難單字更容易記住。

canal.en: The historic canal once carried goods between the two towns.
canal.zh: 這條歷史運河過去曾在兩座城鎮間運送貨物。

cancel.en: The school may cancel the event if the storm becomes stronger.
cancel.zh: 如果暴風雨變強，學校可能取消活動。

cancer.en: The article explains how early screening can help detect cancer.
cancer.zh: 這篇文章說明早期篩檢如何幫助發現癌症。

candidate.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the class election.
candidate.zh: 每位候選人在班級選舉前都發表了簡短演說。

candle.en: A single candle provided soft light during the power outage.
candle.zh: 停電期間，一根蠟燭提供了柔和光線。

cane.en: The elderly visitor used a cane while walking through the museum.
cane.zh: 年長訪客參觀博物館時使用手杖行走。

canoe.en: We rented a canoe and paddled slowly across the quiet lake.
canoe.zh: 我們租了一艘獨木舟，慢慢划過平靜的湖面。

canvas.en: The artist stretched a clean canvas across the wooden frame.
canvas.zh: 藝術家把乾淨的畫布繃在木框上。

canyon.en: The river carved a deep canyon through the rocky landscape.
canyon.zh: 河流在岩石地形中切割出一道深峽谷。

cap.en: He wore a blue cap to protect his face from sunlight.
cap.zh: 他戴著藍色帽子，避免陽光直射臉部。

capability.en: The new software has the capability to process large data sets quickly.
capability.zh: 這套新軟體具備快速處理大型資料集的能力。

capable.en: The device is capable of storing thousands of short text files.
capable.zh: 這個裝置能夠儲存數千個短文字檔。

capacity.en: The hall has enough capacity for all graduating students and families.
capacity.zh: 這座禮堂的容量足以容納所有畢業生與家人。

cape.en: Strong winds swept across the cape beside the open sea.
cape.zh: 強風吹過臨近外海的岬角。

capital.en: Taipei is the capital of Taiwan and an important transportation center.
capital.zh: 台北是台灣的首都，也是重要的交通中心。

capitalism.en: The class compared capitalism with several other economic systems.
capitalism.zh: 全班比較資本主義與其他幾種經濟制度。

capitalist.en: A capitalist economy usually allows private ownership of many businesses.
capitalist.zh: 資本主義經濟通常允許許多企業由私人擁有。

capsule.en: The medicine came in a small capsule that was easy to swallow.
capsule.zh: 這種藥裝在一顆容易吞嚥的小膠囊裡。

captain.en: The captain encouraged the team after they lost the first game.
captain.zh: 球隊輸掉第一場比賽後，隊長鼓勵了大家。

caption.en: Each photograph needs a short caption explaining what it shows.
caption.zh: 每張照片都需要一段簡短說明文字來解釋內容。

captive.en: The rescued bird was kept captive only until it recovered.
captive.zh: 獲救的鳥只在康復前暫時被圈養。

captivity.en: The animal was returned to the wild after years in captivity.
captivity.zh: 這隻動物在被圈養多年後回到野外。
