capture.en: The camera can capture clear images even in low light.
capture.zh: 這台相機即使在低光環境中也能拍出清楚影像。

car.en: We left the car at home and took the train instead.
car.zh: 我們把車留在家裡，改搭火車。

carbon.en: Trees absorb carbon from the atmosphere as they grow.
carbon.zh: 樹木在生長時會從大氣中吸收碳。

card.en: Each student received a card with a different discussion question.
card.zh: 每位學生都拿到一張寫有不同討論題目的卡片。

cardboard.en: The students built a model bridge from thick cardboard and glue.
cardboard.zh: 學生用厚紙板和膠水做了一座模型橋。

cardinal.en: Safety is a cardinal principle in every laboratory activity.
cardinal.zh: 安全是每項實驗室活動中的重要基本原則。

care.en: Students should take care when handling glass equipment in the laboratory.
care.zh: 學生在實驗室操作玻璃器材時應小心。

career.en: She attended a workshop to learn more about possible career choices.
career.zh: 她參加講座來了解更多可能的職涯選擇。

carefree.en: The children enjoyed a carefree afternoon playing games in the park.
carefree.zh: 孩子們在公園玩遊戲，度過一個無憂無慮的下午。

careful.en: Be careful when carrying glass equipment across the laboratory.
careful.zh: 在實驗室搬運玻璃器材時要小心。

caretaker.en: The school caretaker checks the classrooms after everyone leaves.
caretaker.zh: 學校管理員會在大家離開後檢查教室。

cargo.en: The ship carried cargo between several ports along the coast.
cargo.zh: 這艘船在沿岸幾個港口之間運送貨物。

carnival.en: The town holds a colorful carnival at the end of summer.
carnival.zh: 這座城鎮在夏末舉辦一場繽紛的嘉年華。

carpenter.en: The carpenter measured the wooden boards before cutting them carefully.
carpenter.zh: 木匠在仔細切割木板前先量好尺寸。

carpet.en: A thick carpet covered the floor of the reading room.
carpet.zh: 閱讀室的地板上鋪著一張厚地毯。

carriage.en: The museum displays an old carriage once used for local travel.
carriage.zh: 博物館展示一輛過去用於地方交通的舊馬車。

carrier.en: The airline is a major carrier serving several Asian cities.
carrier.zh: 這家航空公司是服務多個亞洲城市的主要承運業者。

carrot.en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the vegetable soup.
carrot.zh: 她切了一根紅蘿蔔加入蔬菜湯中。

carry.en: This backpack can carry a laptop and several heavy books.
carry.zh: 這個背包可以裝一台筆電和好幾本厚書。

cart.en: The worker pushed a cart filled with books across the hallway.
cart.zh: 工作人員推著裝滿書的推車穿過走廊。

carton.en: Please place the empty carton in the recycling container.
carton.zh: 請把空紙盒放進回收容器。

cartoon.en: The cartoon explains the science idea with simple drawings and humor.
cartoon.zh: 這部卡通用簡單圖畫與幽默解釋科學概念。

carve.en: The artist used small tools to carve patterns into the wood.
carve.zh: 藝術家用小工具在木頭上雕刻圖案。

case.en: In this case, waiting for more information is the safest choice.
case.zh: 在這種情況下，等待更多資訊是最安全的選擇。

cash.en: The small shop accepts both cash and electronic payments.
cash.zh: 這家小店同時接受現金和電子支付。

cashier.en: The cashier gave us a receipt after we paid for lunch.
cashier.zh: 我們付完午餐費後，收銀員給了收據。

casino.en: The former casino building has been converted into a public museum.
casino.zh: 原本的賭場建築已改建成公共博物館。

cast.en: The director announced the final cast for the school play.
cast.zh: 導演公布了校園戲劇的最終演員名單。

castle.en: The ancient castle stands on a hill above the river.
castle.zh: 這座古老城堡矗立在河流上方的山丘上。

casual.en: The meeting had a casual atmosphere despite the serious topic.
casual.zh: 儘管主題嚴肅，會議氣氛仍相當輕鬆。

casualty.en: Emergency planning aims to reduce every possible casualty during disasters.
casualty.zh: 緊急應變規劃旨在降低災害中的人員傷亡。

cat.en: The cat slept quietly under the chair during the afternoon.
cat.zh: 那隻貓下午安靜地睡在椅子下。

catalogue.en: The library catalogue helps students find books by title or author.
catalogue.zh: 圖書館目錄能幫助學生依書名或作者查找書籍。

catastrophe.en: Careful preparation can reduce the damage caused by a natural catastrophe.
catastrophe.zh: 充分準備可以降低自然災難造成的損害。

catch.en: We ran to catch the last bus home.
catch.zh: 我們跑去趕最後一班回家的公車。

category.en: Place each item into the correct category before continuing.
category.zh: 繼續之前，請把每個項目放入正確類別。

cater.en: The workshop will cater to students with different levels of experience.
cater.zh: 這場工作坊會照顧不同經驗程度學生的需求。

caterpillar.en: A green caterpillar slowly crossed the leaf in the garden.
caterpillar.zh: 一隻綠色毛毛蟲慢慢爬過花園裡的葉子。

cathedral.en: Visitors admired the cathedral for its tall windows and stone arches.
cathedral.zh: 遊客欣賞這座大教堂高聳的窗戶與石拱門。

cattle.en: The farmer moved the cattle to a field with fresh grass.
cattle.zh: 農夫把牛群移到有新鮮青草的田地。

cause.en: Lack of sleep can cause students to lose concentration in class.
cause.zh: 睡眠不足可能造成學生上課時失去專注力。

caution.en: The teacher urged caution when students handled the glass equipment.
caution.zh: 老師提醒學生操作玻璃器材時要小心。

cautious.en: Researchers were cautious when interpreting the limited amount of data.
cautious.zh: 研究人員在解讀有限資料時非常謹慎。

cave.en: The explorers entered the cave with lamps and safety helmets.
cave.zh: 探險者戴著安全帽並帶著燈進入洞穴。

cavity.en: The dentist found a small cavity during the routine examination.
cavity.zh: 牙醫在例行檢查時發現一個小蛀洞。

cease.en: The rain began to cease shortly before the outdoor event.
cease.zh: 戶外活動開始前不久，雨勢開始停止。

ceiling.en: A small fan was installed in the ceiling above the desk.
ceiling.zh: 書桌上方的天花板裝了一台小風扇。

celebrate.en: The class will celebrate the end of the semester with a small party.
celebrate.zh: 全班會用一場小聚會慶祝學期結束。

celebration.en: The graduation celebration included music, speeches, and student performances.
celebration.zh: 畢業慶祝活動包含音樂、演說和學生表演。

celebrity.en: The article examines how a celebrity can influence public attention.
celebrity.zh: 這篇文章探討名人如何影響大眾注意力。

celery.en: She chopped celery into small pieces for the salad.
celery.zh: 她把芹菜切成小塊加入沙拉。

cell.en: Each cell in the sample was examined under a microscope.
cell.zh: 樣本中的每個細胞都在顯微鏡下接受觀察。

cellphone.en: Students should silence each cellphone before the presentation begins.
cellphone.zh: 簡報開始前，學生應把每支手機調成靜音。

cellular.en: The lesson explains how cellular structures support basic life functions.
cellular.zh: 這堂課說明細胞結構如何支持基本生命功能。

celsius.en: The temperature reached thirty degrees celsius by early afternoon.
celsius.zh: 下午較早時氣溫就達到攝氏三十度。

cement.en: Workers used cement to secure the posts along the walkway.
cement.zh: 工人用水泥固定步道旁的柱子。

cemetery.en: The old cemetery contains graves from several generations of residents.
cemetery.zh: 這座老墓園有好幾代居民的墓地。

census.en: The national census collects information about population size and households.
census.zh: 全國人口普查會蒐集人口規模與家戶資料。

cent.en: The price increased by only one cent this week.
cent.zh: 這個價格本週只增加了一分錢。

center.en: The community center offers free study space on weekends.
center.zh: 社區中心週末提供免費自習空間。

centimeter.en: The plant grew nearly one centimeter during the observation period.
centimeter.zh: 這株植物在觀察期間長高了將近一公分。

central.en: The library is located in the central part of the campus.
central.zh: 圖書館位於校園中央區域。

century.en: This building has stood here for more than a century.
century.zh: 這棟建築已在這裡矗立超過一個世紀。

ceramic.en: The museum displayed a ceramic bowl made hundreds of years ago.
ceramic.zh: 博物館展示一只數百年前製作的陶碗。

cereal.en: He ate a bowl of cereal before leaving for school.
cereal.zh: 他上學前吃了一碗早餐穀片。

ceremony.en: The award ceremony will begin immediately after the final performance.
ceremony.zh: 頒獎典禮會在最後一場表演後立刻開始。

certain.en: We need certain information before making the final decision.
certain.zh: 在做最後決定前，我們需要一些特定資訊。

certainty.en: We cannot predict the result with complete certainty yet.
certainty.zh: 我們目前還無法完全確定地預測結果。

certificate.en: Each participant received a certificate after completing the training course.
certificate.zh: 每位參與者完成訓練課程後都收到一張證書。

certify.en: An independent inspector will certify that the equipment meets safety standards.
certify.zh: 獨立檢查員會證明設備符合安全標準。

chain.en: A long chain connected the gate to the metal post.
chain.zh: 一條長鏈條把大門連接到金屬柱上。

chair.en: Please move your chair closer to the table before we begin.
chair.zh: 開始前請把椅子移近桌子。

chairman.en: The chairman opened the meeting with a brief introduction.
chairman.zh: 主席用簡短介紹為會議揭開序幕。

chairperson.en: The chairperson opened the meeting and introduced the first speaker.
chairperson.zh: 主席宣布會議開始並介紹第一位講者。

chairwoman.en: The chairwoman invited each member to share a brief opinion.
chairwoman.zh: 女主席邀請每位成員簡短分享意見。

chalk.en: The teacher used chalk to draw a diagram on the board.
chalk.zh: 老師用粉筆在黑板上畫了一張圖。

challenge.en: Learning to manage time is an important challenge for many students.
challenge.zh: 學會管理時間是許多學生的重要挑戰。

chamber.en: The experiment took place inside a sealed chamber with controlled temperature.
chamber.zh: 實驗在一個可控制溫度的密閉室內進行。

champion.en: The defending champion trained carefully before the final competition.
champion.zh: 衛冕冠軍在決賽前認真訓練。

championship.en: Our school team reached the championship after winning five matches.
championship.zh: 校隊贏得五場比賽後晉級冠軍賽。

chance.en: This activity gives students a chance to practice speaking English.
chance.zh: 這項活動給學生練習說英文的機會。

change.en: A small change in study habits can produce better results.
change.zh: 讀書習慣的小改變可能帶來更好的成果。

channel.en: The school uses an online channel to share important announcements.
channel.zh: 學校使用線上頻道發布重要公告。

chant.en: The crowd began a cheerful chant during the school sports event.
chant.zh: 群眾在校內運動活動中開始歡樂地齊聲呼喊。

chaos.en: Clear instructions prevented chaos when everyone left the building.
chaos.zh: 清楚的指示避免大家離開建築物時陷入混亂。

chapel.en: The small chapel is known for its stained glass windows.
chapel.zh: 這座小教堂以彩繪玻璃窗聞名。

chapter.en: Please read the next chapter before Wednesday's discussion.
chapter.zh: 請在星期三討論前讀完下一章。

character.en: The main character changes greatly by the end of the novel.
character.zh: 小說主角到故事結尾時有很大的改變。

characteristic.en: Patience is an important characteristic of a good researcher.
characteristic.zh: 耐心是優秀研究人員的重要特質。

characterize.en: Researchers characterize the region as warm, humid, and biologically diverse.
characterize.zh: 研究人員把這個地區描述為溫暖、潮濕且生物多樣。

charge.en: The museum does not charge students for admission on Fridays.
charge.zh: 博物館每週五不向學生收取入場費。

charitable.en: The club organized a charitable event to support local families.
charitable.zh: 社團舉辦慈善活動來協助當地家庭。

charity.en: Students collected books for a charity that supports young readers.
charity.zh: 學生為支持年輕讀者的慈善機構募集書籍。

charm.en: The old neighborhood has a quiet charm that attracts visitors.
charm.zh: 這個老社區有一種吸引遊客的寧靜魅力。

chart.en: The chart shows how the temperature changed during the experiment.
chart.zh: 這張圖表顯示實驗期間溫度的變化。

chase.en: The puppy began to chase a ball across the yard.
chase.zh: 小狗開始在院子裡追著球跑。

chat.en: We had a short chat before the afternoon class began.
chat.zh: 下午課開始前，我們簡短聊了一下。

cheap.en: A cheap option can still be reliable if you compare the features carefully.
cheap.zh: 如果仔細比較功能，便宜的選項仍然可能很可靠。

cheat.en: Students should never cheat because learning depends on honest effort.
cheat.zh: 學生不應作弊，因為學習有賴誠實的努力。

check.en: Always check your answers before handing in the test.
check.zh: 交卷前一定要檢查答案。

checkup.en: The doctor recommended a regular checkup to monitor overall health.
checkup.zh: 醫師建議定期健康檢查以追蹤整體健康狀況。

cheek.en: A cold breeze touched her cheek as she opened the window.
cheek.zh: 她打開窗戶時，一陣冷風拂過她的臉頰。

cheer.en: The crowd began to cheer when the team scored.
cheer.zh: 球隊得分時，人群開始歡呼。

cheerful.en: Her cheerful voice helped the group feel more relaxed before presenting.
cheerful.zh: 她開朗的聲音讓小組在簡報前更加放鬆。

cheese.en: He added a slice of cheese to the warm sandwich.
cheese.zh: 他在熱三明治裡加了一片起司。

chef.en: The chef explained how fresh ingredients affect the final flavor.
chef.zh: 主廚解釋新鮮食材如何影響最後的味道。

chemical.en: Students wore gloves while handling the chemical in the laboratory.
chemical.zh: 學生在實驗室處理化學物質時戴著手套。

chemist.en: The chemist tested several samples before writing the final report.
chemist.zh: 化學家測試了多個樣本後才撰寫最終報告。

chemistry.en: Chemistry helps explain how different substances react with each other.
chemistry.zh: 化學幫助我們了解不同物質如何彼此反應。

cherish.en: Many graduates cherish the friendships they formed during high school.
cherish.zh: 許多畢業生珍惜高中時建立的友誼。

cherry.en: A ripe cherry fell from the tree onto the grass.
cherry.zh: 一顆成熟的櫻桃從樹上掉到草地。

chess.en: Playing chess can help students practice planning several moves ahead.
chess.zh: 下棋可以幫助學生練習提前規劃好幾步。

chest.en: The old wooden chest contained letters, photographs, and family records.
chest.zh: 這只老木箱裡放著信件、照片與家族紀錄。

chestnut.en: We found a chestnut beneath the trees beside the trail.
chestnut.zh: 我們在步道旁的樹下發現一顆栗子。

chew.en: Take time to chew your food slowly before swallowing it.
chew.zh: 吞嚥前要花時間慢慢咀嚼食物。

chicken.en: The restaurant serves grilled chicken with rice and vegetables.
chicken.zh: 這家餐廳供應烤雞配飯和蔬菜。

chief.en: The chief concern in the experiment was keeping the temperature stable.
chief.zh: 這項實驗最主要的考量是維持溫度穩定。

child.en: Every child needs enough sleep for healthy growth and learning.
child.zh: 每個孩子都需要充足睡眠，以維持健康成長與學習。

childhood.en: The photograph reminded her of a favorite place from childhood.
childhood.zh: 這張照片讓她想起童年時最喜歡的一個地方。

childish.en: The teacher asked us to avoid childish arguments during the group discussion.
childish.zh: 老師請我們在小組討論時避免幼稚的爭論。

chili.en: My father added a little chili to the soup for extra flavor.
chili.zh: 爸爸在湯裡加了一點辣椒增添風味。

chill.en: A sudden chill filled the room when the window opened.
chill.zh: 窗戶打開時，房間突然出現一陣寒意。

chilly.en: The morning was chilly, so everyone wore a light jacket.
chilly.zh: 早晨有點冷，所以大家都穿了薄外套。

chimney.en: Smoke rose from the chimney on the cold winter morning.
chimney.zh: 寒冷冬日早晨，煙從煙囪升起。

chimpanzee.en: The documentary follows a chimpanzee living in a protected forest.
chimpanzee.zh: 這部紀錄片追蹤一隻住在保護森林裡的黑猩猩。

chin.en: He rested his chin on his hand while reading the article.
chin.zh: 他閱讀文章時把下巴靠在手上。

china.en: The museum displayed a set of delicate china from the last century.
china.zh: 博物館展示了一組上個世紀的精緻瓷器。

chip.en: A tiny chip in the glass made the cup unsafe to use.
chip.zh: 玻璃上的小缺口讓這個杯子不適合繼續使用。

chirp.en: We could hear birds chirp outside the classroom before sunrise.
chirp.zh: 日出前，我們可以聽見鳥兒在教室外啁啾。

chocolate.en: She shared a piece of chocolate with her classmate after lunch.
chocolate.zh: 午餐後，她和同學分享了一塊巧克力。

choice.en: Your final choice should depend on the evidence you have collected.
choice.zh: 最後的選擇應根據你蒐集到的證據。

choir.en: The school choir practiced every week before the winter concert.
choir.zh: 學校合唱團在冬季音樂會前每週練習。

choke.en: Small objects can choke a young child if handled carelessly.
choke.zh: 小物品若處理不慎，可能讓幼童噎到。

cholesterol.en: The article explains how cholesterol levels can be influenced by diet.
cholesterol.zh: 這篇文章說明膽固醇數值如何受到飲食影響。

choose.en: Students can choose one topic for their final presentation.
choose.zh: 學生可以選擇一個主題作為期末報告。

chop.en: Please chop the vegetables into small pieces before cooking them.
chop.zh: 烹煮前請把蔬菜切成小塊。

chopstick.en: He used a chopstick to point at the model without touching it.
chopstick.zh: 他用一根筷子指向模型，避免直接碰觸。

chord.en: The guitarist practiced the same chord until it sounded clear.
chord.zh: 吉他手反覆練習同一個和弦，直到聲音清楚。

chore.en: Washing the dishes is a daily chore in our home.
chore.zh: 洗碗是我們家每天都要做的家務。

chorus.en: Everyone joined the chorus during the final part of the song.
chorus.zh: 歌曲最後一段時，大家都加入副歌合唱。

chronic.en: The article discusses chronic traffic problems in large cities.
chronic.zh: 這篇文章討論大城市長期存在的交通問題。

chunk.en: She divided the long reading passage into a smaller chunk.
chunk.zh: 她把長篇閱讀文章分成較小的一段。

church.en: The old church has stood in the town for over a century.
church.zh: 這座老教堂已在鎮上矗立超過一個世紀。

cigarette.en: The health poster explains why cigarette smoke can harm nearby people.
cigarette.zh: 健康海報說明香菸煙霧為何可能傷害周遭的人。

cinema.en: The old cinema now hosts films, talks, and community events.
cinema.zh: 這間老電影院現在舉辦電影放映、講座與社區活動。

circle.en: Draw a circle around the correct answer on the worksheet.
circle.zh: 請在學習單上把正確答案圈起來。

circuit.en: The students built a simple circuit during science class.
circuit.zh: 學生在自然課中組裝了一個簡單電路。

circular.en: The class arranged the chairs in a circular pattern for discussion.
circular.zh: 全班把椅子排成圓形方便討論。

circulate.en: The teacher asked students to circulate the survey among their classmates.
circulate.zh: 老師請學生把問卷傳給班上同學填寫。

circulation.en: Regular exercise can improve blood circulation throughout the body.
circulation.zh: 規律運動可以改善全身的血液循環。

circumstance.en: Under this circumstance, delaying the trip was the safest choice.
circumstance.zh: 在這種情況下，延後旅行是最安全的選擇。

circus.en: The history exhibit explains how the traveling circus changed over time.
circus.zh: 歷史展覽說明巡迴馬戲團如何隨時間改變。

cite.en: Students should cite reliable sources when writing research reports.
cite.zh: 學生撰寫研究報告時應引用可靠來源。

citizen.en: Every citizen has a role in protecting the local environment.
citizen.zh: 每位公民都有保護當地環境的責任。

citizenship.en: The course introduces students to rights and responsibilities of citizenship.
citizenship.zh: 這門課向學生介紹公民身分的權利與責任。

city.en: The city added more bicycle lanes to reduce traffic congestion.
city.zh: 這座城市增設更多自行車道，以減少交通壅塞。

civic.en: The course encourages students to take part in civic activities.
civic.zh: 這門課鼓勵學生參與公民活動。

civil.en: The discussion remained civil even when the students strongly disagreed.
civil.zh: 即使學生意見分歧很大，討論仍保持理性有禮。

civilian.en: The museum records how civilian life changed during the conflict.
civilian.zh: 博物館記錄衝突期間平民生活如何改變。

civilization.en: The river supported the growth of an ancient civilization for centuries.
civilization.zh: 這條河流數百年來支持一個古老文明的發展。

civilize.en: Writers once used the word civilize in ways that reflected historical bias.
civilize.zh: 過去的作者曾以帶有歷史偏見的方式使用 civilize 這個字。

claim.en: The article makes a claim that is supported by several studies.
claim.zh: 這篇文章提出一項由多項研究支持的主張。

clam.en: The guide found a clam resting beneath the shallow water.
clam.zh: 導覽員在淺水下發現一顆蛤蜊。

clap.en: The audience began to clap when the final speaker finished.
clap.zh: 最後一位講者結束時，觀眾開始鼓掌。

clarify.en: Please clarify your main point with one concrete example.
clarify.zh: 請用一個具體例子說明你的主要觀點。

clarity.en: The editor revised the paragraph to improve its clarity and flow.
clarity.zh: 編輯修改這段文字，以提升清楚度與流暢度。

clash.en: The two events clash, so students must choose one to attend.
clash.zh: 兩場活動時間衝突，因此學生必須選一場參加。

clasp.en: A small metal clasp keeps the necklace securely closed.
clasp.zh: 一個小金屬扣環讓項鍊穩穩扣住。

class.en: Our class will visit the science museum next Friday.
class.zh: 我們班下星期五要參觀科學博物館。

classic.en: The library displayed a classic novel beside several modern works.
classic.zh: 圖書館把一部經典小說放在幾本現代作品旁展示。

classical.en: She listens to classical music while doing quiet homework.
classical.zh: 她做需要安靜完成的作業時會聽古典音樂。

classification.en: The classification system groups the samples by size and material.
classification.zh: 這套分類系統依大小與材質將樣本分組。

classify.en: Students classify the rocks according to color, texture, and hardness.
classify.zh: 學生依顏色、質地與硬度分類岩石。

classmate.en: My classmate helped me understand the final math problem.
classmate.zh: 我的同學幫我理解最後一道數學題。

clause.en: This clause explains when the agreement can be changed.
clause.zh: 這個條款說明在何種情況下可以修改協議。

claw.en: The bird used its claw to hold the branch firmly.
claw.zh: 那隻鳥用爪子牢牢抓住樹枝。

clay.en: Students shaped wet clay into small bowls during art class.
clay.zh: 學生在美術課把濕黏土塑成小碗。

clean.en: Please clean the equipment carefully after finishing the experiment.
clean.zh: 實驗完成後請仔細清潔器材。

cleaner.en: The cleaner finished the hallway before students arrived in the morning.
cleaner.zh: 清潔人員在早上學生到校前完成走廊清潔。

clear.en: A clear explanation makes a difficult idea easier to understand.
clear.zh: 清楚的解釋能讓困難的觀念更容易理解。

clearance.en: The truck needs enough clearance to pass safely under the bridge.
clearance.zh: 卡車需要足夠淨空才能安全通過橋下。

clerk.en: The store clerk helped us find the correct size.
clerk.zh: 店員幫我們找到正確的尺寸。

clever.en: She found a clever way to solve the problem with fewer steps.
clever.zh: 她找到一個用更少步驟解決問題的聰明方法。

click.en: Click the save button before closing the document.
click.zh: 關閉文件前請點擊儲存按鈕。

client.en: The designer met with the client to discuss the new website.
client.zh: 設計師與客戶見面討論新網站。

cliff.en: A safety fence keeps visitors away from the edge of the cliff.
cliff.zh: 安全圍欄讓遊客遠離懸崖邊緣。

climate.en: The island has a warm climate for most of the year.
climate.zh: 這座島大部分時間氣候溫暖。

climax.en: The story reaches its climax near the end of the final chapter.
climax.zh: 故事在最後一章接近結尾時達到高潮。

climb.en: We began to climb the hill before sunrise.
climb.zh: 我們在日出前開始爬上山坡。

cling.en: Wet leaves cling to the sidewalk after a heavy rain.
cling.zh: 大雨過後，濕葉子黏在行人道上。

clinic.en: The school clinic provides basic care for students who feel unwell.
clinic.zh: 學校保健室為身體不適的學生提供基本照護。

clinical.en: The article summarizes clinical research without giving personal medical advice.
clinical.zh: 這篇文章整理臨床研究，但不提供個人醫療建議。

clip.en: She used a clip to keep the papers together during class.
clip.zh: 她用夾子把課堂上的文件夾在一起。

clock.en: The clock on the wall was five minutes slow.
clock.zh: 牆上的時鐘慢了五分鐘。

clockwise.en: Turn the handle clockwise until the lid is firmly closed.
clockwise.zh: 順時針轉動把手，直到蓋子牢牢關緊。

clone.en: The lesson discusses how scientists define a biological clone.
clone.zh: 這堂課討論科學家如何定義生物學上的複製個體。

close.en: Please close the window before leaving the classroom.
close.zh: 離開教室前請把窗戶關上。

closet.en: The sports equipment is stored in a closet beside the gym.
closet.zh: 運動器材存放在體育館旁的儲藏櫃裡。

closure.en: The road closure forced buses to use a different route.
closure.zh: 道路封閉迫使公車改走不同路線。

cloth.en: Use a soft cloth to clean the computer screen.
cloth.zh: 請用柔軟的布清潔電腦螢幕。

clothe.en: The organization works to clothe families who need basic supplies.
clothe.zh: 這個組織協助有需要的家庭取得基本衣物。

clothes.en: She packed warm clothes because the mountain weather was cold.
clothes.zh: 因為山區天氣寒冷，她帶了保暖衣物。

clothing.en: Warm clothing is important when hiking in cold mountain weather.
clothing.zh: 在寒冷山區健行時，保暖衣物很重要。

cloud.en: A dark cloud appeared above the mountains before the storm.
cloud.zh: 暴風雨前，一大片烏雲出現在山上。

cloudy.en: The sky remained cloudy throughout most of the afternoon.
cloudy.zh: 整個下午大部分時間天空都維持多雲。

clown.en: A clown entertained children at the community festival with simple tricks.
clown.zh: 一名小丑在社區節慶用簡單把戲逗孩子開心。

club.en: The science club meets every Wednesday after school.
club.zh: 科學社每星期三放學後聚會。

clue.en: The final clue helped the students solve the classroom puzzle.
clue.zh: 最後一個線索幫助學生解開教室謎題。

clumsy.en: The clumsy robot dropped the block during its first test.
clumsy.zh: 那台笨拙的機器人在第一次測試時掉下積木。

cluster.en: A cluster of stars appeared clearly in the night sky.
cluster.zh: 夜空中清楚出現一群聚集的星星。

coach.en: The coach encouraged the players to communicate during the game.
coach.zh: 教練鼓勵球員在比賽中互相溝通。

coal.en: Burning coal produces energy but also releases carbon dioxide.
coal.zh: 燃燒煤可以產生能源，但也會排放二氧化碳。

coalition.en: Several groups formed a coalition to support the environmental project.
coalition.zh: 數個團體組成聯盟支持這項環境計畫。

coarse.en: The coarse surface felt rough compared with the polished sample.
coarse.zh: 這個粗糙表面與拋光樣本相比摸起來很不平滑。

coast.en: The storm moved slowly along the eastern coast overnight.
coast.zh: 暴風雨整夜沿著東部海岸緩慢移動。

coastline.en: The map shows how the coastline changed after years of erosion.
coastline.zh: 地圖顯示海岸線在多年侵蝕後如何改變。

coat.en: He wore a thick coat because the morning was unusually cold.
coat.zh: 因為早晨異常寒冷，他穿了一件厚外套。

cockroach.en: A cockroach appeared near the sink, so the area was cleaned.
cockroach.zh: 水槽附近出現一隻蟑螂，因此該區域被清理。

cocoa.en: She mixed cocoa with warm milk for the winter drink.
cocoa.zh: 她把可可和溫牛奶混合成冬季飲品。

coconut.en: The recipe uses coconut to add a mild tropical flavor.
coconut.zh: 這份食譜用椰子增添淡淡的熱帶風味。

code.en: Students wrote simple code to control the small robot.
code.zh: 學生寫了簡單程式碼來控制小型機器人。

coffee.en: She bought a cup of coffee before the morning meeting.
coffee.zh: 早會前她買了一杯咖啡。

cognitive.en: Sleep can influence cognitive performance such as attention and memory.
cognitive.zh: 睡眠可能影響注意力與記憶等認知表現。

coherent.en: A coherent essay connects each paragraph to the main argument.
coherent.zh: 連貫的文章會把每一段都連結到主要論點。

coin.en: The old coin was displayed behind glass in the museum.
coin.zh: 這枚古老硬幣被陳列在博物館的玻璃櫃後。

coincidence.en: It was a coincidence that both groups chose the same topic.
coincidence.zh: 兩組剛好選到相同主題只是一個巧合。

cola.en: The survey compared water, juice, and cola preferences among students.
cola.zh: 這份調查比較學生對水、果汁和可樂的偏好。

cold.en: The water felt extremely cold after the temperature dropped overnight.
cold.zh: 夜間降溫後，水摸起來非常冰冷。

collaboration.en: The project succeeded because of close collaboration between three classes.
collaboration.zh: 這項專題因三個班級密切合作而成功。

collapse.en: The weak structure could collapse if too much weight was added.
collapse.zh: 如果加上過多重量，這個脆弱結構可能會倒塌。

collar.en: The dog wore a bright collar with its name attached.
collar.zh: 那隻狗戴著一個附有名字的亮色項圈。

colleague.en: She asked a colleague to review the report before publication.
colleague.zh: 她請一位同事在出版前審閱報告。

collect.en: Students collect data every week for their science project.
collect.zh: 學生每週為科學專題蒐集資料。

collection.en: The museum has a large collection of traditional tools.
collection.zh: 這座博物館收藏了大量傳統工具。

collective.en: The final decision reflected the collective opinion of the whole group.
collective.zh: 最後決定反映了整個小組的共同意見。

collector.en: The collector donated several rare postcards to the local museum.
collector.zh: 這位收藏家捐了幾張稀有明信片給地方博物館。

college.en: She plans to study engineering when she enters college.
college.zh: 她計畫上大學後念工程。

collision.en: The safety system helps reduce the risk of a collision.
collision.zh: 這套安全系統有助於降低碰撞風險。

colloquial.en: The teacher explained that the phrase is common in colloquial English.
colloquial.zh: 老師解釋這個片語在口語英文中很常見。

colonial.en: The museum examines buildings from the region's colonial period.
colonial.zh: 博物館研究這個地區殖民時期的建築。

colony.en: The scientists observed a colony of birds nesting on the island.
colony.zh: 科學家觀察島上一群築巢的鳥類群落。

color.en: The leaves change color when the weather becomes cooler.
color.zh: 天氣變涼時，樹葉會變色。

colorful.en: The market was filled with colorful signs, fruit, and flowers.
colorful.zh: 市場裡充滿繽紛的招牌、水果與花朵。

column.en: Write each answer in the correct column of the table.
column.zh: 請把每個答案寫在表格正確的欄位中。

columnist.en: The columnist writes a weekly article about education and technology.
columnist.zh: 這位專欄作家每週撰寫教育與科技文章。

comb.en: She used a comb to tidy her hair before the performance.
comb.zh: 她在表演前用梳子整理頭髮。

combination.en: A combination of practice and feedback improved the team's performance.
combination.zh: 練習與回饋的結合提升了團隊表現。

combine.en: We can combine the two ideas into one stronger proposal.
combine.zh: 我們可以把這兩個想法結合成一個更好的提案。

come.en: Many useful ideas come from asking simple questions.
come.zh: 許多實用想法都來自提出簡單問題。

comedian.en: The comedian used everyday school experiences as material for gentle jokes.
comedian.zh: 這位喜劇演員用日常校園經驗作為輕鬆笑話的素材。

comedy.en: The class watched a short comedy before discussing different film genres.
comedy.zh: 全班看了一部短喜劇，再討論不同電影類型。

comet.en: Astronomers tracked the comet as it moved across the night sky.
comet.zh: 天文學家追蹤彗星穿越夜空的移動。

comfort.en: A quiet room can provide comfort after a stressful day.
comfort.zh: 忙碌有壓力的一天後，安靜的房間能帶來舒適感。

comfortable.en: These chairs are comfortable enough for long study sessions.
comfortable.zh: 這些椅子很舒適，適合長時間讀書。

comic.en: The library keeps a comic section for students who enjoy illustrated stories.
comic.zh: 圖書館設有漫畫區，提供給喜歡圖像故事的學生。

comma.en: Place a comma after the opening phrase in this sentence.
comma.zh: 請在這個句子的開頭片語後加上逗號。

command.en: The computer will follow each command in the order given.
command.zh: 電腦會依照輸入順序執行每一道指令。

comment.en: Please leave a short comment explaining why you chose that answer.
comment.zh: 請留下簡短留言，說明你為何選擇那個答案。

commentary.en: The documentary includes expert commentary that explains the historical background.
commentary.zh: 這部紀錄片包含專家評論，用來說明歷史背景。

commentator.en: The sports commentator explained the strategy clearly during the match.
commentator.zh: 體育評論員在比賽中清楚解釋戰術。

commerce.en: Online commerce has changed how people buy everyday products.
commerce.zh: 線上商業改變了人們購買日常用品的方式。

commercial.en: The commercial used humor to make the product memorable.
commercial.zh: 這則廣告用幽默讓產品更令人印象深刻。

commission.en: The city commission reviewed the proposal before approving new park facilities.
commission.zh: 市府委員會在核准新公園設施前審查了提案。

commit.en: Students should commit enough time to preparing for major exams.
commit.zh: 學生應投入足夠時間準備重要考試。

commitment.en: Learning a language requires patience, practice, and long-term commitment.
commitment.zh: 學習語言需要耐心、練習與長期投入。

committee.en: The committee will review the proposal at tomorrow's meeting.
committee.zh: 委員會會在明天的會議審查這項提案。

commodity.en: Rice remains an important commodity in many parts of Asia.
commodity.zh: 稻米在亞洲許多地區仍是重要商品。

common.en: This is a common mistake among students learning new grammar patterns.
common.zh: 這是學生學習新文法句型時常見的錯誤。

commonplace.en: Online meetings have become commonplace in many international organizations.
commonplace.zh: 線上會議已在許多國際組織中變得很普遍。

commonwealth.en: The textbook uses commonwealth to describe a political community in historical context.
commonwealth.zh: 課本在歷史脈絡中用 commonwealth 描述一種政治共同體。

communicate.en: Clear diagrams can help students communicate complex ideas more effectively.
communicate.zh: 清楚的圖示能幫助學生更有效地傳達複雜概念。

communication.en: Good communication can prevent many problems in group projects.
communication.zh: 良好溝通能避免小組專題中的許多問題。

communicative.en: The course uses communicative activities to help students practice speaking naturally.
communicative.zh: 這門課使用溝通式活動幫助學生自然練習口說。

communism.en: The history class compared communism with other political and economic systems.
communism.zh: 歷史課比較了共產主義與其他政治及經濟制度。

communist.en: The article explains how a communist state may organize its economy.
communist.zh: 這篇文章說明共產國家可能如何組織其經濟。

community.en: Students joined a community clean-up event on Saturday morning.
community.zh: 學生星期六早上參加了社區清潔活動。

commute.en: Many workers commute by train because parking is limited downtown.
commute.zh: 許多上班族搭火車通勤，因為市中心停車位有限。

commuter.en: Each commuter can check train delays through the transit app.
commuter.zh: 每位通勤者都能透過交通應用程式查看列車延誤。

compact.en: The compact camera fits easily inside a small travel bag.
compact.zh: 這台小型相機很容易放進小旅行袋。

companion.en: The guide served as a helpful companion during the museum visit.
companion.zh: 導覽員在博物館參觀期間成為很有幫助的陪伴者。

company.en: The company plans to reduce its energy use next year.
company.zh: 這家公司計畫明年降低能源使用量。

comparable.en: The two studies produced comparable results despite using different samples.
comparable.zh: 儘管使用不同樣本，兩項研究仍得到可比較的結果。

comparative.en: The report provides a comparative analysis of three learning methods.
comparative.zh: 這份報告提供三種學習方法的比較分析。

compare.en: Compare the two graphs before writing your conclusion.
compare.zh: 寫結論前先比較這兩張圖表。

comparison.en: The report includes a comparison of three different learning methods.
comparison.zh: 這份報告比較了三種不同的學習方法。

compass.en: The hikers used a compass to confirm the correct direction.
compass.zh: 健行者用指南針確認正確方向。

compassion.en: The volunteer showed compassion toward families facing difficult circumstances.
compassion.zh: 這名志工對面臨困難處境的家庭展現同理與關懷。

compassionate.en: A compassionate response can make a worried student feel supported.
compassionate.zh: 有同理心的回應能讓焦慮的學生感到被支持。

compatible.en: Make sure the new file format is compatible with the school computer.
compatible.zh: 請確認新的檔案格式和學校電腦相容。

compel.en: Strong evidence may compel researchers to reconsider their original explanation.
compel.zh: 有力證據可能迫使研究人員重新考慮原本的解釋。

compensate.en: Extra study time may compensate for lessons missed during an absence.
compensate.zh: 額外讀書時間可能彌補缺席期間錯過的課程。

compensation.en: The company offered compensation for the delay caused by the system error.
compensation.zh: 公司針對系統錯誤造成的延誤提供補償。

compete.en: Several schools will compete in the regional science contest.
compete.zh: 數所學校將參加地區科學競賽。

competence.en: The practical test measures competence in several basic laboratory skills.
competence.zh: 實作測驗衡量幾項基本實驗技能的熟練程度。

competent.en: A competent team can complete the task efficiently and accurately.
competent.zh: 有能力的團隊可以有效率且準確地完成任務。

competition.en: The competition attracted students from across the country.
competition.zh: 這項比賽吸引了全國各地的學生。

competitive.en: The scholarship program is highly competitive this year.
competitive.zh: 今年這項獎學金計畫競爭非常激烈。

competitor.en: Each competitor had ten minutes to present a solution to the judges.
competitor.zh: 每位參賽者有十分鐘向評審提出解決方案。

compile.en: Students compile information from several reliable sources for the report.
compile.zh: 學生從數個可靠來源整理資訊來完成報告。

complain.en: Some residents complain about the noise from late-night traffic.
complain.zh: 一些居民抱怨深夜交通造成的噪音。

complaint.en: The office recorded each complaint and replied within two working days.
complaint.zh: 辦公室記錄每項申訴，並在兩個工作天內回覆。

complement.en: The chart and written explanation complement each other in the report.
complement.zh: 圖表與文字說明在報告中彼此補充。

complete.en: Please complete the form before the deadline on Friday.
complete.zh: 請在星期五截止日前完成表格。

complex.en: The diagram makes a complex process easier to understand.
complex.zh: 這張圖讓複雜的過程更容易理解。

complexion.en: The portrait artist used warm tones to match the subject's complexion.
complexion.zh: 肖像畫家使用暖色調來配合人物的膚色。

complexity.en: The diagram reduces the complexity of the process into five clear steps.
complexity.zh: 這張圖把複雜流程簡化成五個清楚步驟。

compliance.en: Regular inspections help ensure compliance with laboratory safety rules.
compliance.zh: 定期檢查有助於確保遵守實驗室安全規定。

complicate.en: Too many extra rules can complicate a simple procedure.
complicate.zh: 太多額外規定可能讓簡單程序變得複雜。

complication.en: A scheduling complication forced the team to move the meeting online.
complication.zh: 一項時程上的複雜狀況迫使團隊改為線上開會。

compliment.en: The teacher gave the group a compliment for its clear presentation.
compliment.zh: 老師稱讚這組的簡報很清楚。

comply.en: All participants must comply with the rules listed on the form.
comply.zh: 所有參與者都必須遵守表格上列出的規定。

component.en: Each component of the machine has a different function.
component.zh: 機器的每個組件都有不同功能。

compose.en: Students were asked to compose a short paragraph using the new words.
compose.zh: 學生被要求用新單字寫一小段文章。

composer.en: The composer created music for several student theater productions.
composer.zh: 這位作曲家為幾齣學生戲劇製作創作音樂。

composition.en: Her composition had a clear introduction and a strong conclusion.
composition.zh: 她的作文有清楚的開頭和有力的結尾。

compound.en: Water is a compound made from hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
compound.zh: 水是由氫原子和氧原子組成的化合物。

comprehend.en: Students often comprehend difficult ideas better after seeing a clear example.
comprehend.zh: 學生看過清楚例子後，通常更能理解困難概念。

comprehension.en: Regular reading practice can improve vocabulary and comprehension over time.
comprehension.zh: 規律閱讀練習可以逐漸提升字彙與理解能力。

comprehensive.en: The final review provides a comprehensive summary of the entire unit.
comprehensive.zh: 期末複習提供整個單元的完整摘要。

comprise.en: The final assessment will comprise a written test and short presentation.
comprise.zh: 期末評量將包含筆試和短篇簡報。

compromise.en: The two groups reached a compromise after discussing their different priorities.
compromise.zh: 兩組討論不同優先事項後達成妥協。

compulsory.en: Safety training is compulsory before students may enter the laboratory.
compulsory.zh: 學生進入實驗室前，安全訓練是強制必修的。

compute.en: The program can compute the average score in less than a second.
compute.zh: 這個程式能在不到一秒內計算平均分數。

computer.en: The school replaced several old computer units in the library.
computer.zh: 學校更換了圖書館裡幾台老舊電腦。

computerize.en: The library plans to computerize its old paper borrowing records.
computerize.zh: 圖書館計畫把舊的紙本借閱紀錄電腦化。

comrade.en: In the novel, each comrade depended on the others during the journey.
comrade.zh: 在小說中，每位同志在旅途中都彼此依靠。

conceal.en: Clouds can conceal the mountains from view on rainy days.
conceal.zh: 下雨天時，雲層可能會遮住山景。

concede.en: After checking the data, the group had to concede that its first idea was wrong.
concede.zh: 檢查資料後，小組不得不承認最初的想法有誤。

conceive.en: It is difficult to conceive a solution without enough information.
conceive.zh: 在資訊不足的情況下，很難構想出解決方案。

concentrate.en: It is easier to concentrate when your phone is turned off.
concentrate.zh: 手機關機時比較容易集中注意力。

concentration.en: Noise can reduce concentration during difficult reading tasks.
concentration.zh: 噪音會降低進行困難閱讀時的專注力。

concept.en: The teacher explained the concept with a simple everyday example.
concept.zh: 老師用簡單的日常例子解釋這個概念。

conception.en: The exhibition challenges the common conception of what a classroom should be.
conception.zh: 這場展覽挑戰人們對教室應該是什麼樣子的普遍觀念。

concern.en: Air pollution is a major concern in many large cities.
concern.zh: 空氣污染是許多大城市的重要問題。

concerning.en: The school sent parents an update concerning the new schedule.
concerning.zh: 學校寄給家長一份關於新時程的最新通知。

concert.en: The school concert will take place in the main hall tonight.
concert.zh: 學校音樂會今晚會在大禮堂舉行。

concession.en: The organizers made one concession by extending the submission deadline.
concession.zh: 主辦單位做出一項讓步，延長了繳交期限。

concise.en: A concise summary should include the main idea without unnecessary detail.
concise.zh: 簡潔摘要應包含主旨，不加入不必要細節。

conclude.en: We cannot conclude anything until all the results are checked.
conclude.zh: 在所有結果都檢查完成前，我們不能下結論。

conclusion.en: The conclusion summarizes the main findings of the report.
conclusion.zh: 結論總結了報告的主要發現。

concrete.en: Please give a concrete example to support your argument.
concrete.zh: 請舉一個具體例子支持你的論點。

condemn.en: The school will condemn bullying and support students who report it.
condemn.zh: 學校會譴責霸凌，並支持提出通報的學生。

condense.en: Please condense the long paragraph into three clear sentences.
condense.zh: 請把這段長文濃縮成三個清楚句子。

condition.en: The roads were in poor condition after several days of heavy rain.
condition.zh: 連續幾天大雨後，道路狀況很差。

conduct.en: The class will conduct a small survey about reading habits.
conduct.zh: 全班將進行一項關於閱讀習慣的小型調查。

conductor.en: The conductor guided the orchestra through the final rehearsal smoothly.
conductor.zh: 指揮順利帶領樂團完成最後一次彩排。

cone.en: The geometry lesson explains how to calculate the volume of a cone.
cone.zh: 幾何課說明如何計算圓錐體積。

confederation.en: The chapter describes a confederation formed by several independent regions.
confederation.zh: 這一章描述由數個獨立地區組成的邦聯。

conference.en: The teacher attended an education conference during the weekend.
conference.zh: 老師週末參加了一場教育研討會。

confess.en: He decided to confess that he had copied the wrong data.
confess.zh: 他決定坦承自己抄錯了資料。

confession.en: Her confession helped the group understand how the mistake happened.
confession.zh: 她的坦承幫助小組了解錯誤是如何發生的。

confidence.en: Regular speaking practice can build confidence over time.
confidence.zh: 規律口說練習能逐漸建立自信。

confident.en: She felt confident after practicing her presentation several times.
confident.zh: 練習報告好幾次後，她感到很有自信。

confidential.en: The school keeps personal student information confidential at all times.
confidential.zh: 學校始終將學生個人資料保密。

confine.en: The experiment was designed to confine the heat within a small container.
confine.zh: 這項實驗設計用來把熱能限制在小容器內。

confirm.en: Further testing will confirm whether the first result was reliable.
confirm.zh: 進一步測試將確認第一次的結果是否可靠。

conflict.en: Clear communication can prevent a small disagreement from becoming conflict.
conflict.zh: 清楚溝通能避免小歧見演變成衝突。

conform.en: All reports must conform to the same formatting rules.
conform.zh: 所有報告都必須符合相同的格式規定。

confront.en: Students must confront difficult questions instead of ignoring them completely.
confront.zh: 學生必須面對困難問題，而不是完全忽略它們。

confrontation.en: A calm discussion prevented the disagreement from becoming a confrontation.
confrontation.zh: 冷靜討論避免意見不合演變成正面衝突。

confuse.en: Similar spelling can confuse students who are learning new vocabulary.
confuse.zh: 相似的拼字可能讓正在學新單字的學生混淆。

confusion.en: Clear labels can reduce confusion when several samples look similar.
confusion.zh: 當多個樣本看起來相似時，清楚標籤可以減少混淆。

congratulate.en: Teachers gathered to congratulate the students on their successful project.
congratulate.zh: 老師們聚在一起祝賀學生專題成功。

congratulation.en: The card included a warm congratulation for the graduating class.
congratulation.zh: 卡片中寫著對畢業班溫暖的祝賀。

congress.en: The article explains how congress debates major national policies.
congress.zh: 這篇文章說明國會如何辯論重大國家政策。

congressman.en: The textbook uses congressman when discussing older political records.
congressman.zh: 課本在討論較早期政治紀錄時使用 congressman 這個字。

congresswoman.en: The congresswoman answered questions from students during the public forum.
congresswoman.zh: 那位女國會議員在公共論壇中回答學生提問。

connect.en: This lesson helps students connect scientific ideas with daily life.
connect.zh: 這堂課幫助學生把科學概念和日常生活連結起來。

connection.en: The study found a connection between sleep and memory performance.
connection.zh: 這項研究發現睡眠與記憶表現之間有關聯。

conquer.en: The team worked hard to conquer its fear of public speaking.
conquer.zh: 團隊努力克服對公開演講的恐懼。

conquest.en: The museum exhibit examines how conquest changed the region's history.
conquest.zh: 博物館展覽探討征服如何改變該地區的歷史。

conscience.en: Her conscience told her to admit the mistake honestly.
conscience.zh: 她的良心告訴她應誠實承認錯誤。

conscientious.en: A conscientious student checks every source before submitting a report.
conscientious.zh: 認真的學生會在繳交報告前檢查每個資料來源。

conscious.en: Students became more conscious of how much paper they used.
conscious.zh: 學生更意識到自己使用了多少紙張。

consecutive.en: She practiced for five consecutive days before the presentation.
consecutive.zh: 她在簡報前連續練習了五天。

consensus.en: The group reached a consensus after discussing several possible solutions.
consensus.zh: 小組討論數個可能方案後達成共識。

consent.en: The survey requires parental consent before younger students can participate.
consent.zh: 這份調查需要家長同意，年幼學生才能參加。

consequence.en: One consequence of poor planning is unnecessary stress.
consequence.zh: 規劃不佳的一個後果是不必要的壓力。

consequent.en: The road closure and consequent delays affected several bus routes.
consequent.zh: 道路封閉以及隨之而來的延誤影響了多條公車路線。

conservation.en: Water conservation became a major topic in the environmental science class.
conservation.zh: 節約用水成為環境科學課的重要主題。

conservative.en: The estimate was conservative because the researchers avoided optimistic assumptions.
conservative.zh: 這項估計較保守，因為研究人員避免採用過度樂觀的假設。

conserve.en: Turning off unused lights can conserve energy throughout the school day.
conserve.zh: 關掉不用的燈可以在整個上課日節省能源。

consider.en: Please consider both advantages and disadvantages before making a decision.
consider.zh: 做決定前請同時考慮優點和缺點。

considerable.en: The new system saved a considerable amount of time.
considerable.zh: 新系統節省了相當多的時間。

considerate.en: It was considerate of her to lower her voice in the library.
considerate.zh: 她在圖書館降低音量，是很體貼的行為。

consideration.en: Safety should be the first consideration when planning the experiment.
consideration.zh: 規劃實驗時，安全應該是第一項考量。

consist.en: The final exam will consist of four different sections.
consist.zh: 期末考將由四個不同部分組成。

consistent.en: The results were consistent across all three groups.
consistent.zh: 三個小組的結果都一致。

consolation.en: Finishing the project successfully was some consolation after the delay.
consolation.zh: 在延期之後，成功完成專題多少帶來一些安慰。

console.en: Her friends tried to console her after the disappointing result.
console.zh: 她的朋友在令人失望的結果後試著安慰她。

consonant.en: The teacher asked us to identify each consonant in the word.
consonant.zh: 老師請我們找出這個單字中的每個子音。

conspiracy.en: The article warns readers not to accept a conspiracy claim without evidence.
conspiracy.zh: 這篇文章提醒讀者，不要在沒有證據時接受陰謀論主張。

constant.en: Constant practice is more useful than studying only before exams.
constant.zh: 持續練習比只在考前讀書更有用。

constitute.en: These three sections constitute the main part of the report.
constitute.zh: 這三個部分構成報告的主要內容。

constitution.en: The class studied how a constitution defines basic rules of government.
constitution.zh: 全班研究憲法如何界定政府的基本規則。

constitutional.en: The debate focused on whether the proposed rule was constitutional.
constitutional.zh: 辯論聚焦於這項提議規定是否符合憲法。

constraint.en: Limited time was the main constraint on the project.
constraint.zh: 時間有限是這項專題的主要限制。

construct.en: Students used wooden sticks to construct a small bridge model.
construct.zh: 學生用木棒搭建一座小型橋梁模型。

construction.en: Road construction caused heavy traffic near the school this morning.
construction.zh: 道路施工造成今天早上學校附近交通壅塞。

constructive.en: Constructive feedback helps students improve without discouraging them.
constructive.zh: 建設性的回饋能幫助學生進步，又不會讓他們氣餒。

consult.en: Students should consult more than one source before drawing a conclusion.
consult.zh: 學生在下結論前應查閱不只一個來源。

consultant.en: The school invited a technology consultant to review its network system.
consultant.zh: 學校邀請一位科技顧問檢視網路系統。

consultation.en: After consultation with teachers, the school adjusted the new timetable.
consultation.zh: 與老師討論後，學校調整了新的課表。

consume.en: Older machines often consume more electricity than newer models.
consume.zh: 舊型機器通常比新型機器消耗更多電力。

consumer.en: A careful consumer compares prices before making a large purchase.
consumer.zh: 謹慎的消費者在大額購買前會比較價格。

consumption.en: The graph shows a steady decline in household water consumption.
consumption.zh: 圖表顯示家庭用水量穩定下降。

contact.en: Please contact the teacher if you cannot attend the meeting.
contact.zh: 如果你無法參加會議，請聯絡老師。

contagious.en: The health lesson explains why some illnesses are highly contagious.
contagious.zh: 健康課說明為什麼有些疾病具有高度傳染性。

contain.en: This box may contain materials needed for the experiment.
contain.zh: 這個箱子可能裝有實驗所需材料。

container.en: Store the liquid in a clean container with a tight lid.
container.zh: 請把液體存放在有密封蓋的乾淨容器裡。

contaminate.en: Dirty tools can contaminate samples and affect the final results.
contaminate.zh: 髒污的工具可能污染樣本並影響最後結果。

contemplate.en: Students should contemplate several solutions before choosing the final design.
contemplate.zh: 學生在選擇最終設計前應思考幾種解決方案。

contemporary.en: The course compares classical literature with contemporary writing.
contemporary.zh: 這門課比較古典文學與當代寫作。

contempt.en: The story shows how contempt can damage trust within a group.
contempt.zh: 故事呈現輕蔑如何破壞團體中的信任。

contend.en: Some researchers contend that the change began much earlier.
contend.zh: 一些研究人員主張這項變化早得多就開始了。

content.en: The teacher reviewed the content before giving the final quiz.
content.zh: 老師在期末小考前複習了課程內容。

contention.en: The main contention of the essay is supported by three examples.
contention.zh: 這篇文章的主要主張由三個例子支持。

contentment.en: She found contentment in a simple routine of reading and walking.
contentment.zh: 她從閱讀與散步的簡單日常中獲得滿足。

contest.en: Our team entered a writing contest organized by the library.
contest.zh: 我們的隊伍參加了圖書館舉辦的寫作比賽。

contestant.en: Each contestant had two minutes to answer the final question.
contestant.zh: 每位參賽者有兩分鐘回答最後一題。

context.en: The meaning of a word often depends on its context.
context.zh: 單字的意思常取決於它所在的上下文。

continent.en: The map shows the major mountain ranges on each continent.
continent.zh: 這張地圖顯示每個洲的主要山脈。

continental.en: The researchers compared weather patterns across the continental region.
continental.zh: 研究人員比較整個大陸地區的天氣型態。

continual.en: Continual interruptions made it difficult for the group to concentrate.
continual.zh: 持續不斷的打擾讓小組難以專心。

continue.en: The class will continue the discussion after lunch.
continue.zh: 全班會在午餐後繼續討論。

continuity.en: The editor checked the story for continuity between different scenes.
continuity.zh: 編輯檢查故事不同場景之間是否連貫。

continuous.en: The sensor records continuous changes in temperature throughout the day.
continuous.zh: 感測器會記錄全天連續的溫度變化。

contract.en: The company signed a contract with a local supplier.
contract.zh: 這家公司與當地供應商簽了一份合約。

contractor.en: The school hired a contractor to repair the damaged roof.
contractor.zh: 學校雇用承包商修理受損的屋頂。

contradict.en: The new evidence appears to contradict the earlier conclusion.
contradict.zh: 新的證據似乎與先前的結論互相矛盾。

contradiction.en: The teacher noticed a contradiction between the chart and the written explanation.
contradiction.zh: 老師注意到圖表與文字說明之間有矛盾。

contrary.en: Contrary to our prediction, the second method produced better results.
contrary.zh: 與我們的預測相反，第二種方法得到更好的結果。

contrast.en: The report draws a clear contrast between the two approaches.
contrast.zh: 這份報告清楚對比了兩種方法。

contribute.en: Everyone can contribute one idea to improve the group project.
contribute.zh: 每個人都可以提出一個想法來改善小組專題。

contribution.en: Every team member made an important contribution to the final presentation.
contribution.zh: 每位組員都對最後簡報做出重要貢獻。

control.en: The experiment tests how temperature can control the speed of the reaction.
control.zh: 這個實驗測試溫度如何控制反應速度。

controller.en: The controller lets users adjust the device from a distance.
controller.zh: 這個控制器讓使用者可以遠端調整裝置。

controversial.en: The class discussed the controversial topic from several different viewpoints.
controversial.zh: 全班從幾個不同觀點討論這個具爭議的議題。

controversy.en: The class discussed the controversy from several different viewpoints.
controversy.zh: 全班從幾個不同觀點討論這項爭議。

convene.en: The committee will convene after school to review the proposal.
convene.zh: 委員會會在放學後開會審查這項提案。

convenience.en: Many students choose digital notes for their convenience and easy access.
convenience.zh: 許多學生因為方便又容易存取而選擇數位筆記。

convenient.en: Online registration is convenient for students who live far away.
convenient.zh: 線上報名對住得遠的學生很方便。

convention.en: The annual science convention attracted students from many different schools.
convention.zh: 年度科學大會吸引了來自許多不同學校的學生。

conventional.en: The class compared a conventional method with a newer digital approach.
conventional.zh: 全班比較傳統方法與較新的數位方式。

conversation.en: A short conversation can help students practice natural speaking patterns.
conversation.zh: 簡短對話能幫助學生練習自然的口說句型。

converse.en: Students had a chance to converse with exchange students after class.
converse.zh: 學生下課後有機會和交換學生交談。

conversion.en: The worksheet explains the conversion from centimeters to meters.
conversion.zh: 這張學習單說明公分轉換成公尺的方法。

convert.en: The program can convert the data into a simple chart.
convert.zh: 這個程式可以把資料轉換成簡單圖表。

convey.en: The diagram can convey complex information more clearly than a long paragraph.
convey.zh: 圖解能比長篇文字更清楚傳達複雜資訊。

convict.en: The history article explains how courts may convict a defendant based on evidence.
convict.zh: 這篇歷史文章說明法院可能如何根據證據判定被告有罪。

conviction.en: She spoke with conviction because she had carefully studied the evidence.
conviction.zh: 她說得很有信念，因為她仔細研究過證據。

convince.en: The data may convince readers that the new method is more effective.
convince.zh: 這些資料可能說服讀者相信新方法更有效。

cook.en: We learned to cook a simple meal during the class activity.
cook.zh: 我們在課堂活動中學會煮一道簡單餐點。

cooker.en: The electric cooker shuts off automatically when the rice is ready.
cooker.zh: 電鍋在飯煮好時會自動關閉。

cookie.en: She saved one cookie to eat after finishing her homework.
cookie.zh: 她留了一塊餅乾，準備寫完作業後吃。

cool.en: Keep the medicine in a cool place away from sunlight.
cool.zh: 請把藥品放在陰涼且避免陽光直射的地方。

cooperate.en: Students must cooperate closely to complete the project on time.
cooperate.zh: 學生必須密切合作，才能準時完成專題。

cooperation.en: The event succeeded because of strong cooperation among all the volunteers.
cooperation.zh: 這場活動因所有志工通力合作而成功。

cooperative.en: A cooperative attitude made the group project much easier to complete.
cooperative.zh: 合作的態度讓小組專題更容易完成。

coordinate.en: Teachers coordinate the schedule so major tests do not overlap.
coordinate.zh: 老師會協調時程，避免重要考試重疊。

cop.en: The story uses cop as an informal word for a police officer.
cop.zh: 故事用 cop 作為 police officer 的非正式說法。

cope.en: A clear schedule can help students cope with several deadlines.
cope.zh: 清楚的時程可以幫助學生應付多個截止日期。

copper.en: Copper is often used in wires because it conducts electricity well.
copper.zh: 銅常被用來製作電線，因為它導電性良好。

copy.en: Please copy the sentence carefully into your notebook.
copy.zh: 請把這個句子仔細抄到筆記本上。

copyright.en: Students should respect copyright when using images in a presentation.
copyright.zh: 學生在簡報中使用圖片時應尊重著作權。

coral.en: The documentary explains how warmer seas can affect coral growth.
coral.zh: 紀錄片說明較暖的海水如何影響珊瑚生長。

cord.en: Please keep the power cord away from the wet floor.
cord.zh: 請讓電源線遠離潮濕的地板。

core.en: The core idea of the lesson is easy to remember.
core.zh: 這堂課的核心概念很容易記住。

corn.en: The farmer planted corn in the field beside the river.
corn.zh: 農夫在河邊的田裡種玉米。

corner.en: The bookstore is located on the corner across from the station.
corner.zh: 書店位於車站對面的街角。

corporate.en: The report examines how corporate decisions can affect local communities.
corporate.zh: 這份報告探討企業決策如何影響地方社區。

corporation.en: The corporation published its annual report before the shareholder meeting.
corporation.zh: 這家公司在股東會前公布了年度報告。

correct.en: Check whether each answer is correct before submitting the worksheet.
correct.zh: 提交學習單前要確認每個答案是否正確。

correlation.en: The study found a correlation between sleep quality and concentration.
correlation.zh: 這項研究發現睡眠品質與專注力之間有相關性。

correspond.en: The numbers in the table correspond to locations on the map.
correspond.zh: 表格中的數字對應到地圖上的位置。

correspondence.en: The museum preserves correspondence between the writer and her editor.
correspondence.zh: 博物館保存這位作家與編輯之間的書信。

correspondent.en: The correspondent sent a detailed report from the international conference.
correspondent.zh: 那位記者從國際會議傳回了一份詳細報導。

corridor.en: Students waited quietly in the corridor outside the classroom.
corridor.zh: 學生安靜地在教室外走廊等候。

corrupt.en: A corrupt process can damage public trust in an institution.
corrupt.zh: 腐敗的程序可能損害大眾對機構的信任。

corruption.en: The article discusses how corruption can weaken public institutions.
corruption.zh: 這篇文章討論腐敗如何削弱公共機構。

cosmetic.en: The repair was only cosmetic and did not improve the machine's performance.
cosmetic.zh: 這項修理只有外觀上的改善，並未提升機器效能。

cosmetics.en: The store placed its cosmetics near the front entrance for convenience.
cosmetics.zh: 商店為了方便，把化妝品放在前方入口附近。

cost.en: The total cost includes transportation, meals, and museum tickets.
cost.zh: 總費用包含交通、餐費和博物館門票。

costly.en: Ignoring small maintenance problems can become costly over time.
costly.zh: 忽略小型維修問題，久而久之可能代價高昂。

costume.en: Each student designed a costume for the school performance.
costume.zh: 每位學生都為學校表演設計了一套服裝。

cottage.en: The family stayed in a small cottage near the lake.
cottage.zh: 這家人住在湖邊的一間小屋裡。

cotton.en: This shirt is made from soft cotton that feels comfortable.
cotton.zh: 這件襯衫由柔軟棉布製成，穿起來很舒服。

couch.en: We moved the couch closer to the window for better light.
couch.zh: 我們把沙發移到更靠近窗戶的地方，以獲得更好的光線。

cough.en: A persistent cough can make it difficult to focus in class.
cough.zh: 持續咳嗽可能讓人在課堂上難以專心。

council.en: The student council proposed several ideas for improving the library.
council.zh: 學生會提出幾項改善圖書館的想法。

counsel.en: The teacher offered counsel to students choosing their research topics.
counsel.zh: 老師為選擇研究主題的學生提供建議。

counselor.en: The school counselor helped students plan their future course choices.
counselor.zh: 學校輔導老師協助學生規劃未來的選課方向。

count.en: Please count the number of responses before entering the data.
count.zh: 輸入資料前請先數回覆的數量。

countable.en: The teacher explained which nouns are countable in this grammar exercise.
countable.zh: 老師說明這份文法練習中哪些名詞是可數的。

counter.en: The cashier placed the receipt on the counter beside the register.
counter.zh: 收銀員把收據放在收銀機旁的櫃檯上。

counterpart.en: She exchanged ideas with her counterpart from another school.
counterpart.zh: 她和另一所學校的對應夥伴交換想法。

country.en: Each country faces different challenges in protecting the environment.
country.zh: 每個國家在環境保護方面面臨不同挑戰。

countryside.en: Many families visit the countryside during long weekends for fresh air.
countryside.zh: 許多家庭會在連假到鄉間呼吸新鮮空氣。

county.en: The county opened a new public library near the central station.
county.zh: 這個郡在中央車站附近開設了一間新的公共圖書館。

couple.en: We waited a couple of minutes for the bus to arrive.
couple.zh: 我們等了幾分鐘讓公車到站。

coupon.en: She used a coupon to reduce the price of her lunch.
coupon.zh: 她使用折價券降低午餐的價格。

courage.en: It takes courage to admit a mistake in front of others.
courage.zh: 在別人面前承認錯誤需要勇氣。

courageous.en: It was courageous of him to admit the mistake publicly.
courageous.zh: 他公開承認錯誤是很有勇氣的。

course.en: This course teaches students how to analyze scientific data.
course.zh: 這門課教學生如何分析科學資料。

court.en: The school has a basketball court behind the gym.
court.zh: 學校體育館後方有一座籃球場。

courteous.en: The staff remained courteous even when the office became crowded.
courteous.zh: 即使辦公室變得擁擠，工作人員仍保持有禮。

courtesy.en: Simple courtesy makes group discussions more respectful and productive.
courtesy.zh: 基本禮貌能讓小組討論更尊重彼此且更有效率。

courtyard.en: Students gathered in the courtyard before the school ceremony began.
courtyard.zh: 學校典禮開始前，學生聚集在中庭。

cousin.en: My cousin studies engineering and enjoys building small robots.
cousin.zh: 我的表親就讀工程相關科系，也喜歡製作小型機器人。

cover.en: The final test will cover all the chapters we studied.
cover.zh: 期末考會涵蓋我們讀過的所有章節。

coverage.en: The news report provided balanced coverage of both sides of the issue.
coverage.zh: 新聞報導對議題雙方提供了較均衡的報導。

cow.en: The farmer led the cow back to the field after feeding.
cow.zh: 農夫餵食後把那頭牛帶回田野。

coward.en: The novel questions whether the character should really be called a coward.
coward.zh: 小說質疑是否真的該把那個角色稱為膽小鬼。

cowardly.en: The story criticizes the cowardly decision to abandon the team.
cowardly.zh: 這個故事批評那個拋棄團隊的懦弱決定。

cowboy.en: The museum displayed an old cowboy hat from the western frontier.
cowboy.zh: 博物館展示了一頂來自西部拓荒時期的老牛仔帽。

cozy.en: The small reading room feels cozy on cold winter afternoons.
cozy.zh: 寒冷的冬日下午，這間小閱覽室感覺很舒適。

crab.en: A small crab moved quickly across the wet sand.
crab.zh: 一隻小螃蟹快速爬過濕潤的沙地。

crack.en: A thin crack appeared in the wall after the earthquake.
crack.zh: 地震後，牆上出現了一道細裂縫。

crackdown.en: The city announced a crackdown on illegal dumping near the river.
crackdown.zh: 市政府宣布將加強取締河邊非法棄置垃圾的行為。

cracker.en: He ate a cracker with cheese during the afternoon break.
cracker.zh: 他在下午休息時間吃了一片搭配起司的餅乾。

cradle.en: The museum displayed an old wooden cradle from a rural home.
cradle.zh: 博物館展示了一個來自鄉村家庭的老木搖籃。

craft.en: Students used recycled paper to craft decorations for the classroom.
craft.zh: 學生用回收紙製作教室裝飾。

cram.en: Students should review regularly instead of trying to cram overnight.
cram.zh: 學生應該規律複習，而不是試圖在一夜之間硬塞知識。

cramp.en: A leg cramp forced the runner to stop and stretch.
cramp.zh: 腿部抽筋迫使跑者停下來伸展。

crane.en: A large crane lifted the heavy materials onto the building site.
crane.zh: 大型起重機把沉重材料吊到建築工地。

crash.en: The sudden computer crash interrupted the presentation for several minutes.
crash.zh: 電腦突然當機，讓簡報中斷了好幾分鐘。

crater.en: The telescope revealed a large crater near the moon's surface edge.
crater.zh: 望遠鏡顯示月球表面邊緣附近有一個大型隕石坑。

crawl.en: The small insect began to crawl across the classroom floor.
crawl.zh: 那隻小昆蟲開始爬過教室地板。

crayon.en: The child used a blue crayon to color the ocean.
crayon.zh: 那個孩子用藍色蠟筆替海洋上色。

crazy.en: The schedule became crazy after three meetings were added unexpectedly.
crazy.zh: 臨時增加三場會議後，行程變得非常混亂。

cream.en: She added a little cream to the soup before serving it.
cream.zh: 上桌前，她在湯裡加了一點鮮奶油。

create.en: Students will create a poster about saving energy at school.
create.zh: 學生會製作一張關於校園節能的海報。

creation.en: The creation of the new website took several months of planning.
creation.zh: 新網站的建立花了好幾個月規劃。

creative.en: The teacher encouraged students to find a creative solution to the problem.
creative.zh: 老師鼓勵學生為這個問題找出有創意的解決方法。

creativity.en: The project encourages creativity by allowing students to choose their own format.
creativity.zh: 這項專題讓學生自行選擇形式，以鼓勵創意。

creator.en: The creator explained how the animation was developed from early sketches.
creator.zh: 創作者說明這部動畫如何從早期草圖發展而來。

creature.en: The documentary introduced a deep-sea creature rarely seen by humans.
creature.zh: 紀錄片介紹了一種人類很少見到的深海生物。

credibility.en: Clear evidence can improve the credibility of a research report.
credibility.zh: 清楚的證據可以提升研究報告的可信度。

credible.en: A credible source should explain where its evidence comes from.
credible.zh: 可信的來源應該說明證據從何而來。

credit.en: The report gives credit to everyone who contributed to the research.
credit.zh: 這份報告對所有參與研究的人給予應有肯定。

creek.en: We followed a narrow creek through the forest during the field trip.
creek.zh: 校外教學時，我們沿著森林中的一條小溪前進。

creep.en: Shadows began to creep across the field as evening approached.
creep.zh: 傍晚接近時，陰影開始慢慢爬過田野。

crew.en: The flight crew completed a safety check before passengers boarded.
crew.zh: 乘客登機前，機組人員完成了安全檢查。

cricket.en: The exchange students taught us the basic rules of cricket.
cricket.zh: 交換學生教我們板球的基本規則。

crime.en: The article examines how technology is used to prevent crime.
crime.zh: 這篇文章探討科技如何被用來預防犯罪。

criminal.en: The article discussed how courts evaluate evidence in a criminal case.
criminal.zh: 這篇文章討論法院如何評估刑事案件中的證據。

cripple.en: A major power failure could cripple the entire transportation system.
cripple.zh: 大規模停電可能使整個交通系統癱瘓。

crisis.en: Clear communication is especially important during a crisis.
crisis.zh: 在危機期間，清楚溝通尤其重要。

crispy.en: The vegetables stayed crispy after a short time in the oven.
crispy.zh: 蔬菜在烤箱中短時間烘烤後仍保持酥脆。

criteria.en: The judges used clear criteria to evaluate each presentation.
criteria.zh: 評審使用明確標準來評量每一場簡報。

criterion.en: Accuracy is one important criterion when evaluating the experiment.
criterion.zh: 評估實驗時，準確度是一項重要標準。

critic.en: The critic praised the film's clear storytelling and strong performances.
critic.zh: 評論家稱讚這部電影敘事清楚且演出有力。

critical.en: Critical reading helps students distinguish evidence from unsupported claims.
critical.zh: 批判性閱讀能幫助學生區分證據與缺乏支持的主張。

criticism.en: The writer accepted the criticism and revised the confusing paragraph.
criticism.zh: 作者接受批評並修改了令人困惑的段落。

criticize.en: It is easier to criticize an idea than to suggest a better one.
criticize.zh: 批評一個想法往往比提出更好的替代方案容易。

crocodile.en: The zoo built a larger habitat for its adult crocodile.
crocodile.zh: 動物園為成年的鱷魚建造了更大的棲息地。

crop.en: Heavy rain damaged part of the rice crop this year.
crop.zh: 大雨今年損壞了一部分稻作。

cross.en: Use the bridge to cross the river safely.

crossing.en: Students should use the marked crossing when walking across the road.
crossing.zh: 學生過馬路時應使用有標示的行人穿越道。

crow.en: A black crow landed on the fence near the playground.
crow.zh: 一隻黑色烏鴉停在操場附近的圍欄上。

crowd.en: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium before the game.
crowd.zh: 比賽前，一大群人聚集在體育場外。

crown.en: The museum displayed a jeweled crown behind thick glass.
crown.zh: 博物館把一頂鑲有珠寶的王冠展示在厚玻璃後方。

crucial.en: Clear instructions are crucial when students perform a complex experiment.
crucial.zh: 學生進行複雜實驗時，清楚說明非常重要。

crude.en: The first model was crude, but it helped the team test its idea.
crude.zh: 第一個模型雖然粗糙，但幫助團隊測試想法。

cruel.en: The novel shows how cruel behavior can harm an entire community.
cruel.zh: 這本小說呈現殘酷行為如何傷害整個社群。

cruelty.en: The campaign raises awareness about cruelty toward animals.
cruelty.zh: 這項活動提升人們對虐待動物問題的關注。

cruise.en: The family planned a short cruise during the summer vacation.
cruise.zh: 這個家庭計畫在暑假安排一次短程郵輪旅行。

crunchy.en: The salad includes crunchy vegetables and a light dressing.
crunchy.zh: 這份沙拉包含爽脆的蔬菜和清爽的醬汁。

crush.en: Heavy boxes can crush fragile items if they are stacked carelessly.
crush.zh: 如果堆放不慎，重箱子可能壓壞易碎物品。

crutch.en: He used a crutch while recovering from a leg injury.
crutch.zh: 腿傷復原期間，他使用拐杖行走。

cry.en: The baby's cry could be heard from the next room.
cry.zh: 從隔壁房間可以聽見嬰兒的哭聲。

crystal.en: The science lab displayed a clear crystal under a bright lamp.
crystal.zh: 科學實驗室在明亮的燈下展示了一顆透明晶體。

cub.en: The bear cub stayed close to its mother near the river.
cub.zh: 那隻小熊在河邊緊跟著母熊。

cube.en: The teacher used a wooden cube to explain three-dimensional shapes.
cube.zh: 老師用木製立方體說明三維形狀。

cucumber.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
cucumber.zh: 她切了一條小黃瓜並加入沙拉中。

cue.en: The actor waited for a clear cue before entering the stage.
cue.zh: 演員等到明確提示後才走上舞台。

cuisine.en: The festival introduced visitors to local cuisine from several regions.
cuisine.zh: 這場節慶向遊客介紹來自不同地區的在地料理。

cultivate.en: Schools can cultivate curiosity by encouraging students to ask questions.
cultivate.zh: 學校可以透過鼓勵學生提問來培養好奇心。

cultural.en: The museum offers cultural programs for students throughout the year.
cultural.zh: 博物館全年為學生提供文化活動。

culture.en: Food is an important part of culture in every society.
culture.zh: 食物是每個社會文化的重要部分。

cumulative.en: The graph shows the cumulative total after each month of data collection.
cumulative.zh: 這張圖顯示每個月資料蒐集後的累積總量。

cunning.en: The fox is portrayed as cunning in many traditional stories.
cunning.zh: 在許多傳統故事中，狐狸被描寫得很狡猾。

cup.en: She filled a cup with warm water before class.
cup.zh: 上課前，她倒了一杯溫水。

cupboard.en: The cups are stored in the cupboard beside the sink.
cupboard.zh: 杯子收在水槽旁的櫥櫃裡。

curb.en: New rules were introduced to curb unnecessary energy use.
curb.zh: 新規定被推出以抑制不必要的能源使用。

cure.en: Researchers are still looking for a cure for the disease.
cure.zh: 研究人員仍在尋找這種疾病的治療方法。

curfew.en: The youth camp has a curfew at ten every night.
curfew.zh: 這個青年營每天晚上十點有門禁時間。

curiosity.en: Her curiosity led her to read more about astronomy.
curiosity.zh: 她的好奇心促使她閱讀更多天文學相關內容。

curious.en: Curious students often ask questions that lead to deeper learning.
curious.zh: 好奇的學生常會提出能帶來更深入學習的問題。

curl.en: A small curl of smoke rose from the candle.
curl.zh: 一小縷煙從蠟燭上方捲起。

currency.en: Travelers should check the local currency before exchanging money.
currency.zh: 旅客在換錢前應先確認當地貨幣。

current.en: The report summarizes the current situation of public transportation in the city.
current.zh: 這份報告整理了城市大眾運輸的目前狀況。

curriculum.en: The school updated its science curriculum to include more experiments.
curriculum.zh: 學校更新了科學課程，加入更多實驗。

curry.en: The restaurant serves a mild curry with vegetables and rice.
curry.zh: 這家餐廳供應搭配蔬菜和白飯的溫和咖哩。

curse.en: The old legend describes a curse placed on the abandoned castle.
curse.zh: 這則古老傳說描述一個施加在廢棄城堡上的詛咒。

curtain.en: She opened the curtain to let morning sunlight enter the room.
curtain.zh: 她拉開窗簾，讓晨光進入房間。

curve.en: The road follows a gentle curve around the hillside.
curve.zh: 這條道路沿著山坡形成一個平緩彎道。

cushion.en: He placed a cushion behind his back for extra support.
cushion.zh: 他在背後放了一個靠墊增加支撐。

custody.en: The museum kept the rare document in secure custody overnight.
custody.zh: 博物館把這份稀有文件整夜安全保管。

custom.en: Removing shoes before entering the house is a common custom in some places.
custom.zh: 在某些地方，進屋前脫鞋是一種常見習俗。

customary.en: It is customary to remove shoes before entering some homes.
customary.zh: 進入某些家庭前脫鞋是一種常見習俗。

customer.en: The store asked each customer to complete a short survey.
customer.zh: 商店請每位顧客填寫一份簡短問卷。

customs.en: Travelers must follow customs rules when bringing goods across borders.
customs.zh: 旅客攜帶物品跨境時必須遵守海關規定。

cut.en: Use scissors to cut the paper along the dotted line.
cut.zh: 請用剪刀沿著虛線剪紙。

cute.en: The bookstore sells cute notebooks with small animal illustrations.
cute.zh: 這家書店販售有小動物插圖的可愛筆記本。

cycle.en: The diagram shows the complete water cycle from evaporation to rainfall.
cycle.zh: 這張圖示顯示從蒸發到降雨的完整水循環。

cynical.en: His cynical comment suggested that he doubted everyone's intentions.
cynical.zh: 他那句憤世嫉俗的評論顯示他懷疑每個人的動機。

daily.en: A short daily review can help students remember new vocabulary.
daily.zh: 每天做一點簡短複習能幫助學生記住新單字。

dairy.en: The store keeps dairy products in a refrigerated section.
dairy.zh: 商店把乳製品放在冷藏區。

dam.en: The dam controls river flow and stores water for nearby towns.
dam.zh: 這座水壩控制河流水量，並為附近城鎮儲水。

damage.en: Heavy rain caused damage to several roads near the mountain.
damage.zh: 豪雨造成山區附近多條道路受損。

damp.en: The basement remained damp after several days of rain.
damp.zh: 連續幾天下雨後，地下室仍然很潮濕。

dance.en: The students learned a traditional dance for the school festival.
dance.zh: 學生為校慶學了一支傳統舞蹈。

dancer.en: The dancer practiced the final routine carefully before the school performance began.
dancer.zh: 那位舞者在校內表演開始前仔細練習最後一段舞步。

danger.en: The warning sign tells visitors about the danger near the cliff.
danger.zh: 警告標誌提醒遊客懸崖附近的危險。

dangerous.en: It is dangerous to use electrical equipment near water.
dangerous.zh: 在水邊使用電器設備很危險。

dare.en: Few students dare to speak without preparing their ideas first.
dare.zh: 很少學生敢在沒有先準備想法的情況下發言。

dark.en: The room became dark when the power suddenly went out.
dark.zh: 突然停電時，房間變得一片漆黑。

darling.en: The old song became a darling of local radio listeners.
darling.zh: 那首老歌成了當地廣播聽眾的最愛。

dash.en: He made a quick dash across the courtyard before the rain started.
dash.zh: 下雨前，他快速衝過中庭。

data.en: The team collected data from three different experiments before drawing conclusions.
data.zh: 團隊在下結論前，從三個不同實驗蒐集資料。

database.en: The library database helps students locate books and research articles quickly.
database.zh: 圖書館資料庫能幫助學生快速找到書籍和研究文章。

date.en: Please write the date at the top of your worksheet.
date.zh: 請在學習單上方寫上日期。

daughter.en: His daughter enjoys reading science books after school.
daughter.zh: 他的女兒放學後喜歡閱讀科學書籍。

dawn.en: We reached the mountain viewpoint just before dawn painted the sky pale orange.
dawn.zh: 我們在黎明把天空染成淡橘色前抵達了山上的觀景點。

day.en: We spent the whole day preparing for the presentation.
day.zh: 我們花了一整天準備報告。

dazzle.en: The bright stage lights can dazzle performers if they look directly at them.
dazzle.zh: 如果表演者直視明亮的舞台燈光，可能會感到目眩。

dead.en: The plant was dead because it had not received enough water.
dead.zh: 這株植物因為沒有得到足夠的水而枯死。

deadline.en: The project deadline was moved to Friday after the schedule changed.
deadline.zh: 行程變更後，專題截止日改到星期五。

deadly.en: Scientists study deadly diseases carefully to understand how they spread and can be prevented.
deadly.zh: 科學家仔細研究致命疾病，以了解它們如何傳播以及如何預防。

deaf.en: The school installed visual alarms to support deaf students during emergencies.
deaf.zh: 學校安裝了視覺警報，以在緊急情況下協助聽障學生。

deafen.en: Extremely loud sounds can deafen people temporarily, so hearing protection is important.
deafen.zh: 極大的聲響可能暫時使人失去聽覺，因此保護聽力很重要。

deal.en: The class discussed how to deal with stress before exams.
deal.zh: 全班討論考試前如何處理壓力。

dealer.en: The art dealer explained the history of the painting to visitors.
dealer.zh: 藝術品商人向訪客說明那幅畫的歷史。

dear.en: She wrote a short letter beginning with Dear Grandma.
dear.zh: 她寫了一封以親愛的奶奶開頭的短信。

death.en: The article explains how pollution can increase the risk of early death.
death.zh: 這篇文章說明污染如何增加早逝風險。

debate.en: The class held a debate about the benefits of public transportation.
debate.zh: 全班進行了一場關於大眾運輸優點的辯論。

debris.en: Workers removed debris from the road after the storm.
debris.zh: 暴風雨後，工人清除了道路上的碎片。

debt.en: The family worked hard to reduce its debt over several years.
debt.zh: 這個家庭花了好幾年努力減少債務。

debut.en: The young singer made her debut at a local music festival last summer.
debut.zh: 那位年輕歌手去年夏天在地方音樂節首次登台。

decade.en: The city has changed greatly over the past decade.
decade.zh: 這座城市在過去十年間有很大變化。

decay.en: Moisture can cause wooden structures to decay over many years.
decay.zh: 濕氣可能讓木造結構經年累月逐漸腐朽。

deceive.en: The advertisement may deceive customers if important details are hidden.
deceive.zh: 如果隱藏重要細節，這則廣告可能會欺騙消費者。

decent.en: The hotel offers decent rooms at a reasonable price.
decent.zh: 這家旅館以合理價格提供品質不錯的房間。

decide.en: We will decide the final topic after hearing everyone's ideas.
decide.zh: 聽完每個人的想法後，我們會決定最後主題。

decision.en: The committee made a decision after reviewing all the evidence.
decision.zh: 委員會審查所有證據後做出決定。

decisive.en: Her decisive response helped the team solve the problem before the deadline.
decisive.zh: 她果斷的回應幫助團隊在截止日前解決問題。

deck.en: Passengers gathered on the deck to watch the sunset.
deck.zh: 乘客聚集在甲板上欣賞夕陽。

declaration.en: The club released a declaration explaining its goals for the coming school year.
declaration.zh: 社團發布了一份聲明，說明下個學年的目標。

declare.en: The officials will declare the final results tomorrow morning.
declare.zh: 相關人員會在明天早上宣布最終結果。

decline.en: The graph shows a gradual decline in energy use.
decline.zh: 圖表顯示能源使用量逐漸下降。

decorate.en: Students will decorate the classroom before the school festival begins.
decorate.zh: 校慶開始前，學生會布置教室。

decoration.en: The handmade decoration was placed above the classroom door.
decoration.zh: 手作裝飾被放在教室門上方。

decrease.en: Regular maintenance can decrease the risk of unexpected equipment failure.
decrease.zh: 定期維護可以降低設備突然故障的風險。

dedicate.en: She plans to dedicate an hour each evening to reading English.
dedicate.zh: 她打算每天晚上撥一小時專心閱讀英文。

dedication.en: Her dedication to daily practice gradually improved her performance.
dedication.zh: 她對每日練習的投入逐漸提升了表現。

deduct.en: The teacher may deduct points for answers without supporting evidence.
deduct.zh: 答案如果沒有證據支持，老師可能會扣分。

deed.en: The story praises a generous deed performed without expecting a reward.
deed.zh: 這個故事讚揚一件不求回報的慷慨善行。

deem.en: The committee may deem the proposal acceptable after further review.
deem.zh: 委員會進一步審查後可能認定這項提案可以接受。

deep.en: The discussion became deep when students began asking broader questions.
deep.zh: 當學生開始提出更廣泛的問題時，討論變得更深入。

deepen.en: Reading different viewpoints can deepen your understanding of an issue.
deepen.zh: 閱讀不同觀點可以加深你對議題的理解。

deer.en: A deer stood quietly near the forest path before disappearing behind the trees.
deer.zh: 一隻鹿靜靜站在森林小徑旁，之後消失在樹後。

default.en: The app uses dark mode as the default setting on this device.
default.zh: 這個應用程式在此裝置上把深色模式設為預設值。

defeat.en: The team refused to give up after its first defeat.
defeat.zh: 球隊在第一次落敗後仍拒絕放棄。

defect.en: Engineers found a small defect during the final product inspection.
defect.zh: 工程師在產品最終檢查時發現一個小瑕疵。

defend.en: The lawyer used strong evidence to defend the accused person.
defend.zh: 律師用有力證據為被告辯護。

defendant.en: The defendant listened carefully while the judge explained the next legal step.
defendant.zh: 被告仔細聽著法官說明下一個法律程序。

defense.en: Good defense helped the team protect its narrow lead.
defense.zh: 良好的防守幫助球隊守住微弱領先。

defensible.en: Her conclusion was defensible because it was supported by several reliable sources.
defensible.zh: 她的結論站得住腳，因為有多個可靠來源支持。

defensive.en: The team adopted a defensive strategy after taking an early lead.
defensive.zh: 球隊早早領先後採取了防守策略。

defiance.en: His quiet defiance surprised the coach, who had expected immediate agreement.
defiance.zh: 他沉默的反抗讓教練感到意外，因為教練原本以為他會立刻同意。

deficit.en: The school reduced its budget deficit by cutting unnecessary operating expenses.
deficit.zh: 學校透過刪減不必要的營運支出來縮小預算赤字。

define.en: Please define the key term before giving your example.
define.zh: 舉例前請先定義這個關鍵詞。

definite.en: We need a definite answer before making the final reservation.
definite.zh: 在完成最後預訂前，我們需要一個明確答案。

definition.en: The textbook provides a clear definition for each scientific term.
definition.zh: 課本為每個科學術語提供清楚的定義。

definitive.en: Researchers said more evidence was needed before reaching a definitive conclusion.
definitive.zh: 研究人員表示，在得出明確結論前還需要更多證據。

defy.en: The tiny plant seemed to defy the harsh weather and continued growing.
defy.zh: 那株小植物彷彿無視惡劣天候，仍然持續生長。

degree.en: The temperature increased by one degree during the experiment.
degree.zh: 實驗期間溫度上升了一度。

delay.en: Heavy rain may delay the outdoor event until tomorrow.
delay.zh: 大雨可能使戶外活動延到明天。

delegate.en: The club will delegate several tasks to different student teams.
delegate.zh: 社團會把幾項工作分派給不同學生小組。

delegation.en: A student delegation visited the city hall to learn about local government.
delegation.zh: 一個學生代表團參訪市政府，了解地方政府的運作。

deliberate.en: The judges will deliberate before announcing the final result.
deliberate.zh: 評審會在公布最後結果前仔細討論。

delicate.en: The delicate glass model must be moved with great care.
delicate.zh: 這個精緻的玻璃模型搬動時必須非常小心。

delicious.en: The soup was simple but surprisingly delicious.
delicious.zh: 這道湯很簡單，卻意外地美味。

delight.en: The unexpected message brought delight to the entire class.
delight.zh: 這則意外的消息讓全班都感到喜悅。

delightful.en: The café had a delightful view of the river and nearby hills.
delightful.zh: 那間咖啡館可以看到河流與附近山丘，景色十分宜人。

deliver.en: The company will deliver the new computers to school next week.
deliver.zh: 公司下週會把新電腦送到學校。

delivery.en: The delivery arrived earlier than expected on Friday morning.
delivery.zh: 這批貨在星期五早上比預期更早送達。

demand.en: There is strong demand for faster public transportation in the city.
demand.zh: 城市對更快速的大眾運輸有很高需求。

democracy.en: The lesson introduced basic ideas about democracy and civic participation.
democracy.zh: 這堂課介紹民主與公民參與的基本概念。

democratic.en: The club used a democratic process to choose its new leader.
democratic.zh: 社團用民主程序選出新的領導者。

demonstrate.en: The experiment will demonstrate how pressure affects the container.
demonstrate.zh: 這項實驗將展示壓力如何影響容器。

demonstration.en: The science teacher gave a demonstration showing how air pressure affects water.
demonstration.zh: 自然老師做了一個示範，說明氣壓如何影響水。

denial.en: His denial did not match the evidence shown in the security video.
denial.zh: 他的否認與監視器影片所顯示的證據不符。

dense.en: The dense fog made the distant buildings difficult to see.
dense.zh: 濃霧讓遠處的建築物很難看清。

density.en: Scientists measured the density of each sample in the laboratory.
density.zh: 科學家在實驗室測量每個樣本的密度。

dental.en: Regular dental checkups can help identify small problems before they become serious.
dental.zh: 定期牙科檢查有助於在問題變嚴重前及早發現。

dentist.en: The dentist explained how regular brushing helps protect teeth.
dentist.zh: 牙醫說明規律刷牙如何幫助保護牙齒。

deny.en: He did not deny making the mistake in the report.
deny.zh: 他沒有否認自己在報告中犯了錯。

depart.en: The last train will depart from platform three at ten thirty tonight.
depart.zh: 今晚末班車將於十點半從第三月台出發。

department.en: The science department organized a special lecture for students.
department.zh: 自然科部門為學生舉辦了一場特別講座。

departure.en: The train's departure was delayed by heavy rain.
departure.zh: 火車因豪雨而延誤發車。

depend.en: Your final score may depend on both tests and class participation.
depend.zh: 你的最後成績可能取決於考試和課堂參與。

dependent.en: Young children are often dependent on adults for daily care.
dependent.zh: 年幼兒童的日常照顧常依賴成年人。

depict.en: The mural will depict daily life in the town one hundred years ago.
depict.zh: 這幅壁畫將描繪一百年前這座小鎮的日常生活。

deplete.en: Heavy use can quickly deplete the battery during a long trip.
deplete.zh: 長途旅行時，大量使用會很快耗盡電池。

deploy.en: Engineers will deploy additional sensors to collect data during the field test.
deploy.zh: 工程師將部署更多感測器，在實地測試期間蒐集資料。

deposit.en: The hotel requires a small deposit when guests make reservations.
deposit.zh: 旅客訂房時，旅館會要求支付一小筆訂金。

depress.en: Long periods of bad weather can depress people's mood.
depress.zh: 長時間的壞天氣可能使人的情緒低落。

depression.en: The article discusses economic depression as a historical topic.
depression.zh: 這篇文章以歷史議題的角度討論經濟蕭條。

deprive.en: Lack of sleep can deprive students of the energy needed to concentrate.
deprive.zh: 睡眠不足可能使學生缺乏專注所需的精力。

depth.en: The students measured the depth of the water near the shore.
depth.zh: 學生測量了岸邊水域的深度。

deputy.en: The deputy director presented the report while the director attended another meeting.
deputy.zh: 主任出席另一場會議時，由副主任提出報告。

derive.en: Researchers can derive useful conclusions from carefully organized data.
derive.zh: 研究人員可以從妥善整理的資料推導出有用結論。

descend.en: The hikers began to descend before the weather became worse.
descend.zh: 天氣惡化前，登山者開始下山。

descent.en: The hikers slowed their descent because the trail became steep and slippery.
descent.zh: 登山客因山路變得陡峭濕滑而放慢下山速度。

describe.en: Use three sentences to describe what happened in the story.
describe.zh: 請用三個句子描述故事中發生的事情。

description.en: The report includes a detailed description of the experimental procedure.
description.zh: 報告包含對實驗程序的詳細描述。

descriptive.en: A descriptive paragraph helps readers imagine a place through specific details.
descriptive.zh: 描述性的段落能透過具體細節幫助讀者想像一個地方。

desert.en: Very little rain falls in this desert each year.
desert.zh: 這片沙漠每年的降雨量很少。

deserve.en: Students who worked hard deserve recognition for their effort.
deserve.zh: 努力付出的學生值得因他們的努力受到肯定。

design.en: The group worked together to design a simple water filter.
design.zh: 小組合作設計了一個簡單的濾水器。

designer.en: The designer presented three possible layouts for the new website.
designer.zh: 設計師提出三種新網站可能的版面配置。

desirable.en: Strong communication skills are desirable for students applying to the leadership program.
desirable.zh: 良好的溝通能力是申請領導培訓計畫學生的理想條件。

desire.en: Her desire to improve motivated her to practice every day.
desire.zh: 她想進步的渴望促使她每天練習。

desk.en: My notes were still on the desk after class ended.
desk.zh: 下課後我的筆記還放在桌上。

despair.en: The team refused to give in to despair after losing the first match.
despair.zh: 球隊在輸掉第一場比賽後拒絕陷入絕望。

desperate.en: The village was desperate for rain after several months of unusually dry weather.
desperate.zh: 經歷數月異常乾旱後，那個村莊非常渴望降雨。

despise.en: She does not despise failure because each mistake can teach something useful.
despise.zh: 她並不鄙視失敗，因為每次錯誤都可能帶來有用的學習。

despite.en: Despite the rain, the outdoor event continued as planned.
despite.zh: 儘管下雨，戶外活動仍照計畫進行。

dessert.en: We shared a small chocolate dessert after finishing dinner at the restaurant.
dessert.zh: 我們在餐廳吃完晚餐後一起分食了一份小巧克力甜點。
