destination.en: The bus reached its final destination shortly before noon.
destination.zh: 公車在中午前不久抵達最終目的地。

destined.en: The old theater seemed destined for closure until volunteers raised enough money.
destined.zh: 那間老戲院原本似乎注定要關閉，直到志工募到足夠資金。

destiny.en: He believed effort could shape his destiny more than luck alone.
destiny.zh: 他相信努力比單靠運氣更能塑造自己的命運。

destroy.en: A strong earthquake can destroy poorly built structures.
destroy.zh: 強烈地震可能摧毀結構不良的建築。

destruction.en: The storm caused widespread destruction along the coast and damaged several roads.
destruction.zh: 暴風雨在沿海造成廣泛破壞，也損壞了數條道路。

destructive.en: Strong winds can be destructive when they strike weak buildings.
destructive.zh: 強風襲擊結構脆弱的建築時可能造成嚴重破壞。

detach.en: Please detach the form from the booklet before handing it to the teacher.
detach.zh: 請先把表格從小冊子上拆下來，再交給老師。

detail.en: Please check every detail before submitting the final report.
detail.zh: 提交最終報告前，請檢查每個細節。

detain.en: Officials may detain a traveler briefly when additional identity checks are required.
detain.zh: 需要進一步身分查驗時，官員可能會短暫留置旅客。

detect.en: The sensor can detect small changes in temperature within seconds.
detect.zh: 感測器可以在數秒內偵測到微小的溫度變化。

detective.en: The novel follows a detective who solves a complicated mystery.
detective.zh: 這本小說描寫一位偵探解開複雜謎團的故事。

detention.en: The school uses detention only after repeated rule violations.
detention.zh: 學校只會在反覆違規後才使用留校處分。

deter.en: Clear warning signs can deter visitors from entering dangerous areas.
deter.zh: 清楚的警告標誌可以阻止遊客進入危險區域。

detergent.en: This detergent works well in cold water and leaves little residue.
detergent.zh: 這種清潔劑在冷水中效果很好，而且殘留物很少。

determination.en: Her determination helped her finish the difficult project on schedule.
determination.zh: 她的決心幫助她如期完成這項困難的專題。

determine.en: The test helps determine which material is the strongest.
determine.zh: 這項測試有助於判斷哪種材料最堅固。

develop.en: Reading widely can help students develop stronger writing skills.
develop.zh: 廣泛閱讀能幫助學生培養更好的寫作能力。

development.en: The report examines the development of public transportation in the city.
development.zh: 這份報告探討這座城市大眾運輸的發展。

device.en: The device records temperature changes throughout the entire experiment.
device.zh: 這個裝置會記錄整個實驗期間的溫度變化。

devil.en: In the old story, the devil tries to trick the traveler with false promises.
devil.zh: 在那個古老故事裡，惡魔試圖用虛假的承諾欺騙旅人。

devise.en: The students worked together to devise a simpler method for collecting data.
devise.zh: 學生們合作設計出一種更簡單的資料蒐集方法。

devote.en: She plans to devote more time to reading before the exam.
devote.zh: 她打算在考前投入更多時間閱讀。

devotion.en: Her devotion to the project impressed the entire research team.
devotion.zh: 她對專題的投入讓整個研究團隊留下深刻印象。

devour.en: Hungry caterpillars can devour many leaves in a surprisingly short time.
devour.zh: 飢餓的毛毛蟲能在令人驚訝的短時間內吃掉許多葉子。

dew.en: Tiny drops of dew covered the grass early in the morning.
dew.zh: 清晨時，草地上覆蓋著一顆顆小露珠。

diabetes.en: Doctors study diabetes to improve prevention, treatment, and long-term health outcomes.
diabetes.zh: 醫師研究糖尿病，以改善預防、治療與長期健康結果。

diagnose.en: Engineers used the test results to diagnose the system problem.
diagnose.zh: 工程師利用測試結果判斷系統問題。

diagnosis.en: An accurate diagnosis helps doctors choose the most appropriate treatment for a patient.
diagnosis.zh: 準確的診斷能幫助醫師為病人選擇最適合的治療方式。

diagram.en: The diagram shows how energy moves through the system.
diagram.zh: 這張圖表顯示能量如何在系統中流動。

dial.en: Turn the dial slowly until the radio signal becomes clear.
dial.zh: 慢慢轉動旋鈕，直到收音機訊號變清楚。

dialect.en: This dialect is spoken mainly in villages along the northern coast.
dialect.zh: 這種方言主要在北部沿海的村落中使用。

dialogue.en: The story uses dialogue to reveal the characters' different viewpoints.
dialogue.zh: 這個故事透過對話呈現角色不同的觀點。

diameter.en: The diameter of the circular table is one hundred twenty centimeters.
diameter.zh: 這張圓桌的直徑是一百二十公分。

diamond.en: The museum displayed a small diamond beside other rare minerals.
diamond.zh: 博物館把一顆小鑽石與其他稀有礦物一起展出。

diaper.en: The parent packed an extra diaper in the baby's travel bag.
diaper.zh: 家長在嬰兒的旅行袋裡多放了一片尿布。

diary.en: She kept a diary to record important events during the trip.
diary.zh: 她寫日記記錄旅途中重要的事情。

dictate.en: A single test score should not dictate every decision about a student's future.
dictate.zh: 單一次考試成績不應決定學生未來的每一項選擇。

dictation.en: The teacher used a short dictation exercise to practice spelling and listening.
dictation.zh: 老師用一段簡短聽寫練習來訓練拼字與聽力。

dictator.en: The history lesson explained how a dictator can weaken democratic institutions over time.
dictator.zh: 歷史課說明獨裁者如何可能逐漸削弱民主制度。

dictatorship.en: The documentary examined daily life under a dictatorship without praising the regime.
dictatorship.zh: 這部紀錄片探討獨裁統治下的日常生活，並未讚揚該政權。

dictionary.en: A dictionary can help students confirm spelling and common meanings.
dictionary.zh: 字典可以幫助學生確認拼字和常見字義。

die.en: Some plants die quickly if they receive too little sunlight.
die.zh: 有些植物若得到太少陽光會很快枯死。

diesel.en: The old bus uses diesel, while the newer model runs on electricity.
diesel.zh: 那輛舊公車使用柴油，而較新的車型則以電力行駛。

diet.en: A balanced diet should include several different kinds of food.
diet.zh: 均衡飲食應包含多種不同食物。

differ.en: The two plans differ mainly in cost and completion time.
differ.zh: 這兩個計畫主要在成本與完成時間上不同。

difference.en: There is a clear difference between the two methods.
difference.zh: 這兩種方法之間有明顯差異。

different.en: Different students may learn best in different ways.
different.zh: 不同學生最適合的學習方式可能不同。

differentiate.en: Students must differentiate facts from opinions in the article.
differentiate.zh: 學生必須分辨文章中的事實與意見。

difficult.en: The question looks difficult, but it becomes easier after careful analysis.
difficult.zh: 這題看起來很難，但仔細分析後會變得比較容易。

difficulty.en: She had difficulty understanding the article without background knowledge.
difficulty.zh: 沒有背景知識時，她很難理解這篇文章。

dig.en: The children used small tools to dig holes for the new plants.
dig.zh: 孩子們用小工具挖洞，好種下新的植物。

digest.en: It takes time for the body to digest a large meal completely.
digest.zh: 身體需要一些時間才能完全消化一頓大餐。

digestion.en: Drinking enough water can support normal digestion throughout the day.
digestion.zh: 攝取足夠水分有助於維持一整天正常的消化作用。

digital.en: The school introduced a digital system for submitting homework online.
digital.zh: 學校導入數位系統，讓學生在線上繳交作業。

dignity.en: Everyone deserves to be treated with respect and dignity.
dignity.zh: 每個人都應受到尊重並保有尊嚴。

dilemma.en: The team faced a dilemma between speed and accuracy.
dilemma.zh: 團隊面臨速度與準確度之間的兩難。

diligence.en: Her diligence was clear in the careful notes she reviewed every evening.
diligence.zh: 她每天晚上仔細複習筆記，顯示出她的勤奮。

diligent.en: The diligent student reviewed her notes before every quiz.
diligent.zh: 那位勤奮的學生在每次小考前都會複習筆記。

dim.en: The hallway looked dim because only one small light was still working.
dim.zh: 走廊看起來很昏暗，因為只剩一盞小燈還亮著。

dime.en: He found a dime under the seat while cleaning the old car.
dime.zh: 他在清理舊車時，在座位下找到一枚十美分硬幣。

dimension.en: The table lists the length, width, and height of each dimension.
dimension.zh: 表格列出各個尺寸的長、寬與高。

diminish.en: Regular maintenance can diminish the risk of unexpected system failure.
diminish.zh: 定期維護可以降低系統意外故障的風險。

dine.en: Visitors can dine outdoors when the weather is cool and dry.
dine.zh: 天氣涼爽乾燥時，遊客可以在戶外用餐。

dinner.en: We discussed the trip while eating dinner together.
dinner.zh: 我們一起吃晚餐時討論了這趟旅程。

dinosaur.en: The museum's largest dinosaur skeleton fills most of the central hall.
dinosaur.zh: 博物館最大的恐龍骨架幾乎占滿中央大廳。

dip.en: Temperatures may dip below ten degrees during the coldest nights this week.
dip.zh: 本週最冷的夜晚，氣溫可能降到十度以下。

diploma.en: Graduates received a diploma at the end of the ceremony.
diploma.zh: 畢業生在典禮結束時領到畢業證書。

diplomacy.en: Careful diplomacy helped the two sides reopen talks after months of tension.
diplomacy.zh: 謹慎的外交努力幫助雙方在數月緊張後重新展開談判。

diplomat.en: The diplomat attended a meeting about regional cooperation.
diplomat.zh: 那位外交官出席了一場關於區域合作的會議。

diplomatic.en: Her diplomatic reply reduced tension without avoiding the main issue.
diplomatic.zh: 她圓融的回應降低了緊張氣氛，同時沒有迴避主要問題。

direct.en: The teacher gave direct feedback on the student's first draft.
direct.zh: 老師直接針對學生的初稿提供回饋。

direction.en: The sign shows the direction of the nearest exit.
direction.zh: 這個標誌顯示最近出口的方向。

directive.en: The new directive asks staff to report safety problems as soon as possible.
directive.zh: 新的指示要求員工盡快回報安全問題。

director.en: The director explained the main idea behind the short film.
director.zh: 導演說明了這部短片背後的主要概念。

directory.en: The online directory lists contact information for each school office.
directory.zh: 線上名錄列出每個學校辦公室的聯絡資訊。

dirt.en: The shoes were covered in dirt after the students crossed the muddy field.
dirt.zh: 學生走過泥濘的田地後，鞋子上沾滿了泥土。

dirty.en: The water looked dirty after the heavy rain.
dirty.zh: 大雨過後，水看起來很髒。

disability.en: The building added ramps to improve access for people with disability.
disability.zh: 這棟建築增設斜坡，以改善身心障礙者的通行。

disable.en: You can disable notifications during class to avoid unnecessary distractions.
disable.zh: 上課時可以停用通知，以避免不必要的干擾。

disadvantage.en: A major disadvantage of the plan is its high long-term cost.
disadvantage.zh: 這項計畫的一大缺點是長期成本很高。

disagree.en: Students may disagree while still respecting one another.
disagree.zh: 學生可以有不同意見，同時仍彼此尊重。

disagreement.en: A calm discussion helped resolve the disagreement between the two groups.
disagreement.zh: 冷靜討論有助於解決兩組之間的意見不合。

disappear.en: The clouds began to disappear as the weather improved.
disappear.zh: 天氣好轉時，雲開始散去。

disappoint.en: Poor preparation can disappoint teammates who are depending on you.
disappoint.zh: 準備不足可能讓依賴你的隊友失望。

disappointment.en: She hid her disappointment and congratulated the winner after the final result.
disappointment.zh: 最終結果公布後，她藏起失望並向得獎者道賀。

disapprove.en: Some parents disapprove of the proposal because they think it is too expensive.
disapprove.zh: 有些家長不贊成這項提案，因為他們認為費用太高。

disaster.en: The city updated its disaster plan after the severe storm.
disaster.zh: 嚴重暴風雨後，市政府更新了災害應變計畫。

disastrous.en: Poor planning can have disastrous results when a project depends on strict timing.
disastrous.zh: 當專案高度依賴時間安排時，規劃不佳可能帶來災難性的結果。

disbelief.en: She stared at the final score in disbelief after the unexpected comeback.
disbelief.zh: 在意外逆轉後，她難以置信地盯著最終比分。

disc.en: The old computer still has a drive for reading a compact disc.
disc.zh: 那台舊電腦仍有可以讀取光碟的光碟機。

discard.en: Please discard damaged materials instead of returning them to the storage shelf.
discard.zh: 請丟棄損壞的材料，不要把它們放回儲物架。

discharge.en: The hospital will discharge the patient after the final examination is completed.
discharge.zh: 完成最後一次檢查後，醫院會讓病人出院。

disciple.en: The ancient text describes a disciple learning patiently from a respected teacher.
disciple.zh: 這篇古文描述一名弟子耐心向受人尊敬的老師學習。

disciplinary.en: The school formed a disciplinary committee to review the repeated rule violations.
disciplinary.zh: 學校成立紀律委員會，審查反覆違規的情況。

discipline.en: Regular practice requires patience and self-discipline.
discipline.zh: 規律練習需要耐心和自律。

disclose.en: Companies must disclose important risks clearly before investors make major decisions.
disclose.zh: 公司必須在投資人做重大決策前清楚揭露重要風險。

disclosure.en: Full disclosure of the study's methods allows other researchers to evaluate its results.
disclosure.zh: 完整揭露研究方法，能讓其他研究者評估其結果。

discomfort.en: He felt mild discomfort after sitting in the same position for several hours.
discomfort.zh: 他維持同一姿勢坐了數小時後，感到輕微不適。

disconnect.en: Remember to disconnect the charger before moving the device to another room.
disconnect.zh: 把裝置移到另一個房間前，記得先拔掉充電器。

discount.en: Students receive a discount when they show a valid school card.
discount.zh: 學生出示有效學生證即可獲得折扣。

discourage.en: A single low score should not discourage you from continuing to improve.
discourage.zh: 一次低分不應該讓你失去繼續進步的信心。

discouragement.en: Her teacher offered support when discouragement made studying feel unusually difficult.
discouragement.zh: 當挫折感讓讀書變得特別困難時，老師給了她支持。

discourse.en: The class compared formal discourse with casual conversation in everyday situations.
discourse.zh: 課堂比較正式論述與日常情境中的隨意對話。

discover.en: Students may discover new patterns when they organize the data clearly.
discover.zh: 學生把資料整理清楚後，可能會發現新的規律。

discovery.en: The discovery changed how scientists understood the ancient site.
discovery.zh: 這項發現改變了科學家對古代遺址的理解。

discreet.en: The counselor was discreet when discussing the student's private concern.
discreet.zh: 輔導老師在談論學生的私人困擾時十分謹慎。

discriminate.en: Good readers learn to discriminate between reliable evidence and weak claims.
discriminate.zh: 優秀的讀者會學著分辨可靠證據與薄弱主張。

discrimination.en: The school has rules against discrimination based on personal background or identity.
discrimination.zh: 學校有規定禁止因個人背景或身分而產生的歧視。

discuss.en: We will discuss the article in small groups tomorrow.
discuss.zh: 我們明天會分小組討論這篇文章。

discussion.en: The discussion became more useful after students began using evidence.
discussion.zh: 學生開始使用證據後，討論變得更有意義。

disease.en: The lesson explains how exercise can reduce the risk of disease.
disease.zh: 這堂課說明運動如何降低疾病風險。

disgrace.en: He feared the scandal would bring disgrace to the organization he represented.
disgrace.zh: 他擔心這起醜聞會讓他所代表的組織蒙羞。

disguise.en: The actor wore a simple disguise so few people recognized him outside.
disguise.zh: 那位演員做了簡單偽裝，因此在外面很少有人認出他。

disgust.en: The smell from the spoiled food caused immediate disgust among the students.
disgust.zh: 壞掉食物的氣味立刻讓學生感到厭惡。

dish.en: This dish is made with rice, vegetables, and fresh fish.
dish.zh: 這道料理由米飯、蔬菜和新鮮魚類製成。

dishonest.en: A dishonest answer may solve a problem briefly but create larger trouble later.
dishonest.zh: 不誠實的回答或許能暫時解決問題，卻可能日後造成更大的麻煩。

disk.en: The file was saved on an external disk for backup.
disk.zh: 這個檔案被儲存在外接磁碟中作為備份。

dislike.en: I dislike crowded buses, so I usually leave home a little earlier.
dislike.zh: 我不喜歡擁擠的公車，所以通常會提早一點出門。

dismay.en: To everyone's dismay, the outdoor concert was canceled because of heavy rain.
dismay.zh: 令大家失望的是，戶外音樂會因大雨而取消。

dismiss.en: The teacher did not dismiss the question and explained it carefully.
dismiss.zh: 老師沒有忽視那個問題，而是仔細加以說明。

disorder.en: The sudden power failure caused temporary disorder in the busy station.
disorder.zh: 突然停電使繁忙的車站一度陷入混亂。

dispensable.en: Some decorative details are dispensable when time for the project is limited.
dispensable.zh: 當專題時間有限時，有些裝飾性細節可以省略。

dispense.en: This machine can dispense drinking water when you press the blue button.
dispense.zh: 按下藍色按鈕後，這台機器就會供應飲用水。

display.en: The museum will display student artwork in the main hall next month.
display.zh: 博物館下個月將在主廳展示學生作品。

disposable.en: The school reduced its use of disposable cups during campus events.
disposable.zh: 學校在校園活動中減少使用一次性杯子。

disposal.en: Proper disposal of electronic waste helps reduce pollution and recover useful materials.
disposal.zh: 妥善處理電子廢棄物有助於減少污染並回收有用材料。

dispose.en: Residents should dispose of batteries at designated recycling points rather than ordinary trash bins.
dispose.zh: 居民應把電池送到指定回收點，而不是丟進一般垃圾桶。

dispute.en: The neighbors settled their dispute by discussing the problem calmly and sharing the cost.
dispute.zh: 鄰居們透過冷靜討論問題並分攤費用，解決了爭端。

disrupt.en: Heavy rain may disrupt transportation across the region this evening.
disrupt.zh: 大雨今晚可能會打亂整個地區的交通。

dissent.en: The discussion allowed respectful dissent without turning into a personal argument.
dissent.zh: 這場討論允許有禮貌的異議，而不演變成人身爭執。

dissolve.en: Salt will dissolve more quickly in warm water than in cold water.
dissolve.zh: 鹽在溫水中會比在冷水中溶解得更快。

distance.en: The distance from the station to the school is about two kilometers.
distance.zh: 車站到學校的距離大約兩公里。

distant.en: A distant mountain range appeared clearly after the morning fog disappeared.
distant.zh: 晨霧散去後，遠方的山脈清楚地出現了。

distinct.en: The two species have distinct patterns that make identification easier.
distinct.zh: 這兩個物種有明顯不同的花紋，因此更容易辨認。

distinction.en: The essay explains the distinction between correlation and direct causation.
distinction.zh: 這篇文章說明相關性與直接因果關係之間的差異。

distinctive.en: The building has a distinctive roof that makes it easy to recognize.
distinctive.zh: 這棟建築有一個很有特色的屋頂，因此很容易辨認。

distinguish.en: Students learn to distinguish reliable sources from unreliable ones.
distinguish.zh: 學生學習分辨可靠與不可靠的資料來源。

distinguished.en: A distinguished scientist visited the school to speak about climate research.
distinguished.zh: 一位傑出的科學家到校分享氣候研究。

distract.en: Background noise can distract students who are trying to read carefully.
distract.zh: 背景噪音可能使正在專心閱讀的學生分心。

distraction.en: Turning off notifications can reduce distraction while you are studying.
distraction.zh: 關閉通知可以減少讀書時的干擾。

distress.en: The rescue team responded quickly after receiving a distress call from the hikers.
distress.zh: 救援隊接獲登山客的求救訊號後迅速出動。

distribute.en: The teacher will distribute the worksheets before the activity begins.
distribute.zh: 活動開始前老師會發下學習單。

distribution.en: The map shows the distribution of rainfall across different parts of the island.
distribution.zh: 這張地圖顯示島上不同地區的降雨分布。

district.en: The school district plans to renovate several older classrooms next year.
district.zh: 學區計畫明年整修幾間較老舊的教室。

disturb.en: Please speak quietly so you do not disturb students in the library.
disturb.zh: 請小聲說話，以免打擾圖書館裡的學生。

disturbance.en: The sudden disturbance outside briefly interrupted the science presentation.
disturbance.zh: 外面的突發騷動短暫打斷了科學簡報。

ditch.en: Rainwater collected in a shallow ditch beside the country road.
ditch.zh: 雨水積在鄉間道路旁的一條淺溝裡。

dive.en: The penguin can dive deep into the ocean in search of food.
dive.zh: 企鵝能潛入海洋深處尋找食物。

diverse.en: The library offers a diverse collection of books from many cultures and fields.
diverse.zh: 圖書館提供涵蓋多種文化與領域的多元藏書。

diversify.en: The company plans to diversify its products to reach more customers.
diversify.zh: 公司計畫讓產品更多元，以接觸更多顧客。

diversion.en: The construction created a temporary diversion for traffic near the station.
diversion.zh: 施工使車站附近的交通暫時改道。

diversity.en: Cultural diversity can enrich classroom discussions by introducing different perspectives and experiences.
diversity.zh: 文化多樣性可以透過不同觀點與經驗豐富課堂討論。

divert.en: Police may divert traffic when road repairs block the main intersection.
divert.zh: 道路施工封鎖主要路口時，警方可能會改道車流。

divide.en: Please divide the class into four groups before starting the activity.
divide.zh: 開始活動前，請把全班分成四組。

dividend.en: The company announced a small dividend after reporting a profitable year.
dividend.zh: 公司在公布獲利年度後宣布發放小額股利。

divine.en: The ancient poem describes a king who believed he had divine protection.
divine.zh: 這首古詩描述一位相信自己受到神聖庇護的國王。

division.en: Clear division of tasks helped the team finish the project on time.
division.zh: 清楚分工幫助團隊準時完成專題。

divorce.en: The novel explores how a divorce changes relationships within one family.
divorce.zh: 這本小說探討離婚如何改變一個家庭中的關係。

dizzy.en: She felt dizzy after standing up too quickly from the chair.
dizzy.zh: 她從椅子上站得太快，因此感到頭暈。

do.en: Students do better when they review difficult material in short sessions.
do.zh: 學生把困難內容分成短時間複習時，通常表現更好。

doc.en: The shared doc contains the latest notes from our group discussion.
doc.zh: 這份共用文件包含我們小組討論的最新筆記。

dock.en: The ferry reached the dock just before the afternoon rain began.
dock.zh: 渡輪在午後雨勢開始前剛好抵達碼頭。

doctor.en: The doctor advised him to rest and drink more water.
doctor.zh: 醫師建議他多休息並多喝水。

doctrine.en: The course compares each doctrine with the historical conditions in which it developed.
doctrine.zh: 這門課把各種學說與其發展時的歷史條件相互比較。

document.en: Save the document before closing the computer program.
document.zh: 關閉電腦程式前要先儲存文件。

documentary.en: We watched a documentary about coral reefs and changing ocean temperatures.
documentary.zh: 我們看了一部關於珊瑚礁與海洋溫度變化的紀錄片。

dodge.en: The cyclist had to dodge a fallen branch on the path.
dodge.zh: 騎士不得不閃過小徑上的一根倒下樹枝。

dog.en: The dog waited quietly outside the store for its owner.
dog.zh: 那隻狗安靜地在店外等主人。

doll.en: The museum displayed a handmade doll from the early twentieth century.
doll.zh: 博物館展出一個二十世紀初的手工娃娃。

dollar.en: The price increased by one dollar after the discount period ended.
dollar.zh: 折扣期結束後，價格上漲了一美元。

dolphin.en: A dolphin surfaced beside the boat before swimming back into deeper water.
dolphin.zh: 一隻海豚在船邊浮出水面，之後游回較深的水域。

domain.en: This question belongs to the domain of environmental science rather than economics.
domain.zh: 這個問題屬於環境科學領域，而不是經濟學領域。

dome.en: The old library has a glass dome above its central reading room.
dome.zh: 老圖書館的中央閱覽室上方有一座玻璃圓頂。

domestic.en: Domestic travel increased during the holiday because many families stayed within the country.
domestic.zh: 假期期間國內旅遊增加，因為許多家庭選擇留在國內。

dominant.en: Blue is the dominant color in the painting, covering most of the background.
dominant.zh: 藍色是這幅畫的主色，覆蓋了大部分背景。

dominate.en: One topic should not dominate the entire group discussion.
dominate.zh: 一個主題不應主導整場小組討論。

donate.en: Students can donate used books to the community reading program.
donate.zh: 學生可以把二手書捐給社區閱讀計畫。

donation.en: The library used the donation to buy new books for young readers.
donation.zh: 圖書館利用這筆捐款為年輕讀者購買新書。

donkey.en: The farmer used a donkey to carry supplies along the narrow trail.
donkey.zh: 農夫用驢子沿著狹窄山徑搬運物資。

donor.en: Each donor received a short report explaining how the funds were used.
donor.zh: 每位捐款人都收到一份簡短報告，說明資金如何被使用。

doom.en: The article rejects the idea that one mistake will doom the project.
doom.zh: 這篇文章否定一次錯誤就會注定專題失敗的想法。

door.en: Please close the door quietly when you leave.
door.zh: 離開時請輕輕把門關上。

doorway.en: She paused in the doorway before entering the crowded classroom.
doorway.zh: 她在門口停了一下，才走進擁擠的教室。

dorm.en: The new dorm includes a quiet room for evening study.
dorm.zh: 新宿舍設有一間供晚間讀書使用的安靜房間。

dormitory.en: The university built a dormitory within walking distance of the library.
dormitory.zh: 大學在步行可到圖書館的地方興建了一棟宿舍。

dose.en: The label clearly states the recommended dose for this common over-the-counter medicine.
dose.zh: 標籤清楚標示這種常見成藥的建議劑量。

dot.en: Place a small dot beside each answer you want to review later.
dot.zh: 在你想稍後複習的每個答案旁標上一個小點。

double.en: The number of participants may double if registration remains open.
double.zh: 如果持續開放報名，參與人數可能會增加一倍。

doubt.en: There is little doubt that practice improves performance over time.
doubt.zh: 長期而言，練習能提升表現幾乎沒有疑問。

doubtful.en: The coach was doubtful that the match could continue during the heavy storm.
doubtful.zh: 教練懷疑比賽是否能在暴風雨中繼續進行。

dough.en: The baker covered the dough and left it to rise for an hour.
dough.zh: 麵包師蓋住麵糰，讓它發酵一小時。

doughnut.en: He bought a doughnut and a carton of milk after class.
doughnut.zh: 他下課後買了一個甜甜圈和一盒牛奶。

dove.en: A white dove landed quietly on the roof of the old building.
dove.zh: 一隻白鴿安靜地停在老建築的屋頂上。

down.en: Please write the key points down before the discussion ends.
down.zh: 討論結束前請把重點寫下來。

download.en: Students can download the worksheet from the class website.
download.zh: 學生可以從班級網站下載學習單。

downstairs.en: The computer lab is downstairs beside the main office.
downstairs.zh: 電腦教室在樓下，位於辦公室旁邊。

downtown.en: The bus reaches downtown in about twenty minutes during the morning.
downtown.zh: 早上搭公車約二十分鐘可以到市中心。

downward.en: The graph shows a downward trend in energy use since last winter.
downward.zh: 圖表顯示自去年冬天以來能源使用量呈下降趨勢。

downwards.en: The graph moves downwards as the temperature gradually decreases.
downwards.zh: 隨著溫度逐漸下降，圖表的線條向下移動。

doze.en: He began to doze during the long ride home after practice.
doze.zh: 練習後回家的長途車程中，他開始打瞌睡。

dozen.en: The bakery prepared a dozen sandwiches for the school event.
dozen.zh: 麵包店為學校活動準備了十二個三明治。

draft.en: Please read the first draft carefully and mark any unclear sentences.
draft.zh: 請仔細閱讀初稿，並標出任何不清楚的句子。

drag.en: Do not drag the heavy box across the wooden floor.
drag.zh: 不要把沉重的箱子拖過木地板。

dragon.en: The story features a dragon that guards a hidden mountain lake.
dragon.zh: 故事中有一條守護隱密高山湖泊的龍。

dragonfly.en: A bright dragonfly rested on a leaf beside the pond.
dragonfly.zh: 一隻鮮豔的蜻蜓停在池塘旁的葉子上。

drain.en: Leaves can block the drain and cause water to collect after heavy rain.
drain.zh: 落葉可能堵住排水口，導致大雨後積水。

drama.en: The drama club will perform a short play at the school festival.
drama.zh: 戲劇社將在校慶演出一齣短劇。

dramatic.en: The city experienced a dramatic drop in air pollution after the new policy began.
dramatic.zh: 新政策上路後，這座城市的空氣污染大幅下降。

drastic.en: The committee rejected any drastic change until more evidence became available.
drastic.zh: 在取得更多證據前，委員會拒絕任何激烈的改變。

draught.en: A cold draught came through the open window during the meeting.
draught.zh: 會議進行時，一股冷風從開著的窗戶吹進來。

draw.en: Draw a simple diagram to show how the system works.
draw.zh: 請畫一個簡單圖示，說明這個系統如何運作。

drawer.en: She kept the spare batteries in the top drawer of the desk.
drawer.zh: 她把備用電池放在書桌最上層的抽屜裡。

drawing.en: His drawing shows how the bridge supports weight from both sides.
drawing.zh: 他的圖畫呈現橋梁如何從兩側支撐重量。

dread.en: Many students dread oral presentations until they gain more practice and confidence.
dread.zh: 許多學生在獲得更多練習與信心前都害怕口頭報告。

dreadful.en: The weather was dreadful, so the outdoor event moved indoors.
dreadful.zh: 天氣非常糟，因此戶外活動改到室內舉行。

dream.en: Her dream is to study marine biology in the future.
dream.zh: 她的夢想是未來學習海洋生物學。

dress.en: Students should dress appropriately for the formal ceremony.
dress.zh: 學生應為正式典禮穿著得體。

dresser.en: The lamp stood on a small dresser beside the bed.
dresser.zh: 檯燈放在床邊的一個小梳妝櫃上。

dressing.en: She added a light dressing to the salad before serving it.
dressing.zh: 她上菜前在沙拉上加了一點清爽醬汁。

drift.en: Small boats may drift away from shore when strong winds suddenly appear.
drift.zh: 強風突然出現時，小船可能會漂離岸邊。

drill.en: The school held a fire drill during the second class period.
drill.zh: 學校在第二節課進行消防演練。

drink.en: Remember to drink enough water during long study sessions.
drink.zh: 長時間讀書時記得喝足夠的水。

drip.en: A slow drip from the faucet continued throughout the night.
drip.zh: 水龍頭整晚都持續緩慢滴水。

drive.en: It takes about twenty minutes to drive from school to the station.
drive.zh: 從學校開車到車站大約需要二十分鐘。

driver.en: The bus driver waited until every student was seated.
driver.zh: 公車司機等到每位學生都坐好才開車。

driveway.en: A delivery truck stopped briefly in front of the driveway.
driveway.zh: 一輛送貨卡車短暫停在車道前。

drop.en: The temperature can drop quickly after sunset in the mountains.
drop.zh: 山區日落後氣溫可能快速下降。

drought.en: The long drought reduced crop yields and lowered water levels in local reservoirs.
drought.zh: 長期乾旱降低了農作物產量，也使當地水庫水位下降。

drown.en: Safety lessons teach children how to reduce the risk of drown accidents near water.
drown.zh: 安全課程教導孩子如何降低在水域附近發生溺水事故的風險。

drowsy.en: Warm air and a quiet room made several students feel drowsy after lunch.
drowsy.zh: 溫暖的空氣和安靜的教室讓幾名學生午餐後感到昏昏欲睡。

drugstore.en: The drugstore near the station also sells basic household supplies.
drugstore.zh: 車站附近的藥局也販售基本家庭用品。

drum.en: The drummer struck the drum softly during the quiet opening section.
drum.zh: 鼓手在安靜的開場段落中輕輕敲鼓。

dry.en: Keep the equipment in a dry place after cleaning it.
dry.zh: 清潔設備後請放在乾燥的地方。

dryer.en: The wet towels were placed in the dryer after practice.
dryer.zh: 練習後，濕毛巾被放進烘乾機。

dual.en: The device has a dual purpose as both a clock and timer.
dual.zh: 這個裝置具有時鐘和計時器的雙重用途。

dubious.en: The editor rejected the claim because its evidence seemed dubious.
dubious.zh: 編輯拒絕那項說法，因為其證據看起來不可靠。

duck.en: A duck crossed the path while students were walking around the lake.
duck.zh: 學生繞湖散步時，一隻鴨子穿過小徑。

due.en: The assignment is due at the end of next week.

dull.en: The lecture became less dull after the teacher added real examples.
dull.zh: 老師加入真實例子後，這堂講課變得沒那麼無聊。

dumb.en: The device is simple, but calling it dumb would be misleading.
dumb.zh: 這個裝置雖然簡單，但稱它愚笨並不恰當。

dump.en: The city plans to close the old dump and restore the land.
dump.zh: 市政府計畫關閉舊垃圾場並復育土地。

dumpling.en: She ordered a vegetable dumpling with her bowl of soup.
dumpling.zh: 她點了一顆蔬菜水餃搭配一碗湯。

durable.en: This backpack is durable enough for daily use throughout the school year.
durable.zh: 這個背包夠耐用，能應付整個學年的日常使用。

duration.en: The duration of the experiment depends on how quickly the temperature changes.
duration.zh: 實驗持續時間取決於溫度變化的速度。

during.en: Please remain quiet during the listening section of the exam.
during.zh: 考試聽力部分進行時請保持安靜。

dusk.en: The hikers reached the village just before dusk.
dusk.zh: 登山客在黃昏前不久抵達村莊。

dust.en: A thin layer of dust covered the unused bookshelf.
dust.zh: 沒使用的書架上覆著一層薄薄的灰塵。

dusty.en: The old shelves were dusty after years without regular cleaning.
dusty.zh: 那些舊書架多年沒有定期清潔，因此布滿灰塵。

duty.en: It is the monitor's duty to collect the worksheets after class.
duty.zh: 收學習單是班長下課後的職責。

dwarf.en: A small tree may dwarf nearby flowers without growing very tall.
dwarf.zh: 一棵小樹即使不算高，也可能讓附近花朵顯得十分矮小。

dwell.en: The article does not dwell on minor errors in the earlier study.
dwell.zh: 這篇文章沒有過度著墨先前研究中的小錯誤。

dwelling.en: The archaeologists discovered an ancient dwelling near the edge of the valley.
dwelling.zh: 考古學家在山谷邊緣發現了一處古代住所。

dye.en: The artist used natural dye to color the fabric a deep blue.
dye.zh: 藝術家用天然染料把布染成深藍色。

dynamic.en: The class has a dynamic atmosphere because students often discuss ideas in small groups.
dynamic.zh: 這堂課氣氛很有活力，因為學生常以小組方式討論想法。

dynasty.en: The museum exhibition explores art from an ancient dynasty.
dynasty.zh: 博物館展覽介紹某個古代王朝的藝術。

each.en: Each student received a different question to discuss with the group.
each.zh: 每位學生都拿到不同的問題與小組討論。

eager.en: The students were eager to see the results of the experiment.
eager.zh: 學生們很期待看到實驗結果。

eagle.en: An eagle circled above the valley before disappearing behind the ridge.
eagle.zh: 一隻老鷹在山谷上空盤旋，之後消失在山脊後方。

ear.en: The doctor examined his ear after he reported discomfort.
ear.zh: 他表示耳朵不舒服後，醫師檢查了他的耳朵。

early.en: We arrived early so we could prepare the room before class.
early.zh: 我們提早到達，好在上課前準備教室。

earn.en: Students can earn extra credit by completing the optional project.
earn.zh: 學生完成選做專題可以獲得額外加分。

earnest.en: Her earnest effort impressed the judges even before the final result.
earnest.zh: 她認真的努力在最終結果公布前就打動了評審。

earphone.en: She used one earphone so she could still hear the teacher's instructions.
earphone.zh: 她只戴一邊耳機，這樣仍能聽見老師的指示。

earring.en: She found a silver earring under the desk after class.
earring.zh: 她下課後在桌子下找到一只銀色耳環。

earth.en: The earth moves around the sun once every year.
earth.zh: 地球每年繞太陽運行一圈。

earthquake.en: The earthquake damaged several older buildings in the city.
earthquake.zh: 這場地震損壞了城裡幾棟較老的建築。

ease.en: A clear schedule can ease stress before major exams.
ease.zh: 清楚的時間表能減輕大考前的壓力。

east.en: The sun rises in the east every morning.
east.zh: 太陽每天早上從東方升起。

eastern.en: Heavy rain affected several towns along the eastern coast.
eastern.zh: 大雨影響了東部沿海的幾個城鎮。

easy.en: The first question was easy, but the last one was challenging.
easy.zh: 第一題很簡單，但最後一題很有挑戰性。

eat.en: We usually eat lunch together after the fourth class.
eat.zh: 我們通常第四節課後一起吃午餐。

eccentric.en: The inventor became famous for his eccentric ideas and unusual experiments.
eccentric.zh: 那位發明家因古怪的想法和不尋常的實驗而出名。

echo.en: Our voices produced an echo inside the long stone tunnel.
echo.zh: 我們的聲音在長長的石造隧道裡產生回音。

eclipse.en: The science club gathered outside to observe the lunar eclipse.
eclipse.zh: 科學社到戶外集合，觀察月食。

ecological.en: The report examines the ecological effects of building near the wetland.
ecological.zh: 這份報告探討在濕地附近興建工程的生態影響。

ecology.en: She studies ecology to understand how organisms interact with their environment.
ecology.zh: 她研究生態學，以了解生物如何與環境互動。

economic.en: The report explains how tourism supports local economic growth.
economic.zh: 這份報告說明觀光如何支持地方經濟成長。

economical.en: Taking the bus is often more economical than traveling by taxi.
economical.zh: 搭公車通常比搭計程車更經濟。

economics.en: The course introduces basic economics through examples from everyday life.
economics.zh: 這門課透過日常生活的例子介紹基礎經濟學。

economist.en: An economist explained why prices may rise when demand increases quickly.
economist.zh: 一位經濟學家解釋需求快速增加時價格為何可能上升。

economy.en: A strong economy can create more job opportunities for young people.
economy.zh: 強健的經濟可以為年輕人創造更多工作機會。

ecosystem.en: Removing one species can affect the balance of an entire ecosystem.
ecosystem.zh: 移除一個物種可能影響整個生態系統的平衡。

edge.en: Do not stand too close to the edge of the platform.
edge.zh: 不要站得太靠近月台邊緣。

edible.en: The guide showed us which wild plants were edible and which were not.
edible.zh: 嚮導告訴我們哪些野生植物可以食用、哪些不行。

edit.en: Please edit your essay carefully before submitting the final version.
edit.zh: 提交最終版本前請仔細修改文章。

edition.en: The library received the latest edition of the science textbook.
edition.zh: 圖書館收到最新版的自然科教科書。

editor.en: The editor checked the article for unclear sentences and errors.
editor.zh: 編輯檢查文章中不清楚的句子和錯誤。

editorial.en: The newspaper published an editorial about improving public transportation.
editorial.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇關於改善大眾運輸的社論。

educate.en: Schools should educate students about responsible use of technology.
educate.zh: 學校應教育學生負責任地使用科技。

education.en: Education can provide people with more choices for the future.
education.zh: 教育能為人們的未來提供更多選擇。

educational.en: The museum offers educational programs for students of different ages.
educational.zh: 博物館為不同年齡的學生提供教育活動。

effect.en: The new study method had a positive effect on test performance.
effect.zh: 新的讀書方法對考試表現產生了正面效果。

effective.en: Regular review is an effective way to remember new vocabulary.
effective.zh: 規律複習是記住新單字的有效方法。

efficiency.en: The new system improved efficiency by reducing unnecessary paperwork.
efficiency.zh: 新系統透過減少不必要的文書作業提升效率。

efficient.en: This route is more efficient because it avoids heavy traffic.
efficient.zh: 這條路線因避開塞車而更有效率。

effort.en: Her improvement was the result of steady effort over several months.
effort.zh: 她的進步是數月持續努力的結果。

egg.en: She added an egg to the bowl before mixing the ingredients.
egg.zh: 她在攪拌材料前先在碗裡加入一顆蛋。

ego.en: A strong ego can make it harder to accept useful criticism.
ego.zh: 過強的自我可能讓人更難接受有用的批評。

either.en: You can choose either topic for your final presentation.
either.zh: 期末報告兩個主題你可以任選一個。

elaborate.en: Please elaborate on your answer with one clear supporting example.
elaborate.zh: 請用一個清楚的支持例子進一步說明你的答案。

elastic.en: This elastic band can stretch without breaking under normal use.
elastic.zh: 這條橡皮筋在正常使用下可以伸長而不斷裂。

elbow.en: He rested his elbow on the desk while reading the article.
elbow.zh: 他閱讀文章時把手肘靠在桌上。

elder.en: The village elder shared stories about how the community had changed.
elder.zh: 村中的長者分享了社區如何改變的故事。

elderly.en: The program provides free transportation for elderly residents in the area.
elderly.zh: 這項計畫為當地年長居民提供免費交通服務。

elect.en: Students will elect a class representative at the next meeting.
elect.zh: 學生將在下次班會選出班級代表。

election.en: The school election gave students a chance to practice democratic participation.
election.zh: 校內選舉讓學生有機會練習民主參與。

electric.en: The school replaced an old bus with an electric one.
electric.zh: 學校用電動巴士取代了一輛老舊巴士。

electrical.en: Electrical equipment should be kept away from water.

electrician.en: An electrician inspected the damaged wiring before the classroom reopened.
electrician.zh: 教室重新開放前，一位電工檢查了受損的電線。

electricity.en: The solar panels produce enough electricity for several classrooms.
electricity.zh: 這些太陽能板能為數間教室提供足夠電力。

electronic.en: Students submit most assignments through an electronic learning system.
electronic.zh: 學生大多透過電子學習系統繳交作業。

electronics.en: The store sells electronics such as headphones, tablets, and small speakers.
electronics.zh: 這家店販售耳機、平板和小型喇叭等電子產品。

elegant.en: The bridge has an elegant design that combines strength with simplicity.
elegant.zh: 這座橋的設計優雅，兼具堅固與簡潔。

element.en: Trust is an important element of successful teamwork.
element.zh: 信任是成功團隊合作的重要要素。

elementary.en: The program introduces elementary coding skills to younger students.
elementary.zh: 這項計畫向年幼學生介紹基礎程式設計技能。

elephant.en: An elephant can communicate with other members of its herd over long distances.
elephant.zh: 大象可以和遠距離外的象群成員溝通。

elevate.en: The new platform will elevate the equipment above possible floodwater.
elevate.zh: 新的平台會把設備抬高到可能的洪水水位之上。

elevator.en: The elevator stopped on every floor during the busy morning period.
elevator.zh: 早上繁忙時段，電梯每一層都停。

eligible.en: Students with enough credits are eligible to apply for the program.
eligible.zh: 學分足夠的學生有資格申請這項計畫。

eliminate.en: The team tried to eliminate unnecessary steps from the process.
eliminate.zh: 團隊試著刪除流程中不必要的步驟。

eloquent.en: Her eloquent speech made a complex issue easier to understand.
eloquent.zh: 她流暢有說服力的演說讓複雜議題更容易理解。

else.en: If this solution fails, we will need to try something else.
else.zh: 如果這個方法失敗，我們就得試別的方法。

elsewhere.en: The library was full, so we decided to study elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: 圖書館坐滿了，所以我們決定到別處讀書。

email.en: Please send me an email if the meeting time changes.
email.zh: 如果會議時間改變，請寄電子郵件告訴我。

embarrass.en: The teacher avoided questions that might embarrass students in front of classmates.
embarrass.zh: 老師避免提出可能讓學生在同學面前尷尬的問題。

embarrassment.en: He laughed at his small mistake instead of letting embarrassment ruin the presentation.
embarrassment.zh: 他對自己的小錯誤一笑置之，沒有讓尷尬毀掉簡報。

embassy.en: Travelers contacted the embassy for updated information about local regulations.
embassy.zh: 旅客聯絡大使館，以取得當地規定的最新資訊。

embrace.en: The school decided to embrace new technology while keeping effective traditional methods.
embrace.zh: 學校決定接受新科技，同時保留有效的傳統方法。

emerge.en: A clear pattern began to emerge after more data were collected.
emerge.zh: 蒐集更多資料後，一個明顯的模式開始出現。

emergency.en: Every classroom has clear instructions for what to do in an emergency.
emergency.zh: 每間教室都有緊急情況時該怎麼做的清楚指示。

emigrant.en: The novel follows an emigrant who builds a new life overseas.
emigrant.zh: 這本小說描述一名移民在海外建立新生活的故事。

emigrate.en: Many families chose to emigrate because they hoped for better opportunities abroad.
emigrate.zh: 許多家庭選擇移居海外，希望獲得更好的機會。

emigration.en: Economic change contributed to increased emigration from the region during that decade.
emigration.zh: 經濟變化使那十年間該地區的移民人數增加。

emission.en: The factory installed new equipment to reduce carbon emission from its operations.
emission.zh: 工廠安裝新設備，以減少營運產生的碳排放。

emotion.en: Music can express emotion even when no words are used.
emotion.zh: 即使沒有歌詞，音樂也能表達情感。

emotional.en: The ending of the film was emotional but not overly dramatic.
emotional.zh: 電影結尾很感人，但並不過度煽情。

emperor.en: The museum displayed letters written during the reign of the emperor.
emperor.zh: 博物館展出那位皇帝在位期間寫下的信件。

emphasis.en: The teacher placed special emphasis on checking evidence before making conclusions.
emphasis.zh: 老師特別強調在下結論前要先檢查證據。

emphasize.en: The coach used the meeting to emphasize the importance of teamwork.
emphasize.zh: 教練利用會議強調團隊合作的重要性。

empire.en: The ancient empire controlled trade routes across a large area.
empire.zh: 那個古代帝國控制了大片區域的貿易路線。

employ.en: The company plans to employ more workers next year.
employ.zh: 這家公司計畫明年聘用更多員工。

employee.en: Each employee received training before using the new system.
employee.zh: 每位員工使用新系統前都接受了訓練。

employer.en: The employer offered flexible hours during the busy season.
employer.zh: 雇主在忙碌季節提供彈性工時。

employment.en: The course teaches practical skills that may improve future employment opportunities.
employment.zh: 這門課教授可能提升未來就業機會的實用技能。

empty.en: The classroom was empty when I arrived after school.
empty.zh: 我放學後到達時，教室裡沒有人。

enable.en: Digital tools enable students to organize information more easily.
enable.zh: 數位工具讓學生能更容易整理資訊。

enclose.en: Please enclose a copy of the form with your application.
enclose.zh: 請在申請資料中附上一份表格副本。

encounter.en: Students often encounter unfamiliar words when reading academic articles.
encounter.zh: 學生閱讀學術文章時常會遇到不熟悉的單字。

encourage.en: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions when they are confused.
encourage.zh: 老師應鼓勵學生在困惑時提出問題。

encouragement.en: A few words of encouragement helped her continue after a difficult week.
encouragement.zh: 幾句鼓勵的話幫助她在艱難的一週後繼續努力。

encyclopedia.en: The student used an encyclopedia to confirm several background facts.
encyclopedia.zh: 那名學生使用百科全書確認幾項背景事實。

end.en: Please hand in your worksheet at the end of class.

endanger.en: Polluting the river could endanger animals that depend on clean water.
endanger.zh: 污染河流可能危害依賴乾淨水源的動物。

endeavor.en: The research project was a joint endeavor involving several schools.
endeavor.zh: 這項研究計畫是數所學校共同投入的合作成果。

ending.en: The unexpected ending changed how readers understood the whole story.
ending.zh: 出乎意料的結局改變了讀者對整個故事的理解。

endorse.en: Several teachers endorse the new reading program after reviewing its results.
endorse.zh: 幾位老師檢視成果後支持這項新的閱讀計畫。

endorsement.en: The proposal gained public endorsement after its benefits became clearer.
endorsement.zh: 這項提案的好處更清楚後，獲得了大眾支持。

endowment.en: The university used its endowment to support scholarships and research.
endowment.zh: 大學利用基金支持獎學金與研究。

endurance.en: Long-distance running requires both physical endurance and careful pacing.
endurance.zh: 長跑需要體力耐力，也需要適當配速。

endure.en: Some plants can endure long periods with very little water.
endure.zh: 有些植物可以忍受長時間缺水。

enemy.en: In the story, the former enemy later becomes an unexpected ally.
enemy.zh: 在故事中，原本的敵人後來成為意想不到的盟友。

energetic.en: The energetic students volunteered to organize games for the school festival.
energetic.zh: 充滿活力的學生自願為校慶安排遊戲。

energy.en: Solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
energy.zh: 太陽能可以減少對化石燃料的依賴。

enforce.en: Schools enforce safety rules to protect students during laboratory activities.
enforce.zh: 學校會執行安全規定，以保護進行實驗活動的學生。

enforcement.en: Stronger enforcement of traffic rules reduced dangerous driving near the school.
enforcement.zh: 加強交通規則的執法，減少了學校附近的危險駕駛。

engage.en: Good questions can engage students in deeper discussion.
engage.zh: 好問題能讓學生投入更深入的討論。

engagement.en: Student engagement increased when the lesson included discussion and hands-on activities.
engagement.zh: 課程加入討論與實作活動後，學生參與度提高了。

engine.en: The mechanic checked the engine before the long trip.
engine.zh: 長途旅行前，技師檢查了引擎。

engineer.en: The engineer tested the bridge design before construction began.
engineer.zh: 工程師在施工前測試了橋梁設計。

engineering.en: She hopes to study engineering and design useful technology.
engineering.zh: 她希望學習工程並設計實用科技。

enhance.en: Better lighting can enhance concentration in the study area.
enhance.zh: 更好的照明可以提升讀書區的專注力。

enhancement.en: The software update includes an enhancement that makes searching much faster.
enhancement.zh: 這次軟體更新包含一項改良，讓搜尋速度快很多。

enjoy.en: Many students enjoy learning through games and group activities.
enjoy.zh: 許多學生喜歡透過遊戲和小組活動學習。

enjoyable.en: The review session became more enjoyable after the teacher added a quiz game.
enjoyable.zh: 老師加入問答遊戲後，複習課變得更有趣。

enjoyment.en: Her enjoyment of reading grew after she discovered historical novels.
enjoyment.zh: 她發現歷史小說後，對閱讀的樂趣增加了。

enlarge.en: You can enlarge the image to examine the small labels more clearly.
enlarge.zh: 你可以放大圖片，更清楚查看小標示。

enlargement.en: The enlargement of the photo revealed details that were hard to notice before.
enlargement.zh: 照片放大後，顯示出先前不容易注意到的細節。

enlighten.en: The documentary may enlighten viewers about how coral reefs support marine life.
enlighten.zh: 這部紀錄片可以讓觀眾更了解珊瑚礁如何支持海洋生物。

enlightenment.en: The course encouraged enlightenment through questioning, evidence, and open discussion.
enlightenment.zh: 這門課透過提問、證據與開放討論促進理解與啟發。

enormous.en: The project required an enormous amount of time and careful planning.
enormous.zh: 這項專題需要大量時間與仔細規劃。

enough.en: We have enough time to review the final chapter today.
enough.zh: 我們今天有足夠時間複習最後一章。

enrich.en: Reading widely can enrich your vocabulary and improve your writing.
enrich.zh: 廣泛閱讀可以豐富詞彙並提升寫作能力。

enrichment.en: The school offers enrichment activities for students interested in science and art.
enrichment.zh: 學校為對科學與藝術有興趣的學生提供延伸學習活動。

enroll.en: Students can enroll in the course after completing the required form.
enroll.zh: 學生填完必要表格後即可註冊這門課。

enrollment.en: Enrollment increased after the school introduced more elective courses.
enrollment.zh: 學校增加更多選修課後，註冊人數上升了。

ensure.en: Double-check the instructions to ensure every step is completed.
ensure.zh: 再次確認說明，以確保每個步驟都完成。

enter.en: Students must enter their ID number before starting the test.
enter.zh: 學生開始測驗前必須輸入學號。

enterprise.en: The small enterprise grew steadily by focusing on reliable service.
enterprise.zh: 這家小型企業靠著可靠服務穩定成長。

entertain.en: The short performance was designed to entertain visitors during the break.
entertain.zh: 這場短演出是為了在休息時間娛樂訪客。

entertainment.en: The festival offers music, food, and entertainment for families.
entertainment.zh: 這個節慶提供音樂、美食和適合家庭的娛樂活動。

enthusiasm.en: Her enthusiasm for science inspired several classmates to join the club.
enthusiasm.zh: 她對科學的熱情鼓舞幾位同學加入社團。

enthusiastic.en: The class gave an enthusiastic response to the new group project.
enthusiastic.zh: 全班對新的小組專題給予熱烈回應。

entire.en: The entire class worked together to finish the project.
entire.zh: 全班一起合作完成了這項專題。

entitle.en: Completing the program will entitle students to receive a certificate.
entitle.zh: 完成這項計畫後，學生將有資格獲得證書。

entity.en: Each organization is treated as a separate entity in the database.
entity.zh: 資料庫會把每個組織視為獨立實體。

entrance.en: Students gathered near the main entrance before the museum opened.
entrance.zh: 博物館開門前，學生聚集在主要入口附近。

entrepreneur.en: The entrepreneur started a small company that designs reusable containers.
entrepreneur.zh: 那位創業家成立了一家設計可重複使用容器的小公司。

entry.en: Each contest entry must include a title and short description.
entry.zh: 每件參賽作品都必須附上標題和簡短說明。

envelope.en: She placed the application form inside a large envelope before mailing it.
envelope.zh: 她把申請表放進大信封後寄出。

envious.en: He felt envious at first, but later congratulated his friend's success.
envious.zh: 他一開始有些羨慕，但後來仍向朋友的成功道賀。

environment.en: A quiet environment can help students concentrate for longer periods.
environment.zh: 安靜的環境能幫助學生更長時間保持專注。

environmental.en: The class discussed several environmental problems affecting local communities.
environmental.zh: 全班討論了幾個影響當地社區的環境問題。

envision.en: The planners envision a greener neighborhood with more parks and bike lanes.
envision.zh: 規劃者構想一個有更多公園與自行車道的綠色社區。

envy.en: Constant envy can distract people from appreciating their own progress.
envy.zh: 持續的嫉妒可能讓人忽略自己的進步。

epidemic.en: Public health officials studied the epidemic to understand how it spread.
epidemic.zh: 公共衛生人員研究這場流行病，以了解它如何傳播。

episode.en: The final episode explains what happened to each main character.
episode.zh: 最後一集說明每個主要角色後來發生了什麼。

equal.en: Each group should receive an equal amount of time to present.
equal.zh: 每組都應獲得相同的報告時間。

equality.en: The discussion focused on equality of opportunity in education.
equality.zh: 討論聚焦在教育機會平等。

equalize.en: The new funding plan aims to equalize resources among different schools.
equalize.zh: 新的資助計畫旨在讓不同學校之間的資源更平均。

equate.en: We should not equate a high score with complete understanding.
equate.zh: 我們不應把高分直接等同於完全理解。

equation.en: The teacher showed us how to solve the equation step by step.
equation.zh: 老師一步一步示範如何解這個方程式。

equip.en: The school will equip the new classroom with digital learning tools.
equip.zh: 學校會為新教室配備數位學習工具。

equipment.en: Students must return all equipment after finishing the experiment.
equipment.zh: 學生完成實驗後必須歸還所有器材。

equity.en: The policy emphasizes equity by giving extra support where needs are greater.
equity.zh: 這項政策重視公平，在需求較大的地方提供更多支持。

equivalent.en: The two measurements are approximately equivalent after unit conversion.
equivalent.zh: 經過單位換算後，這兩個測量值大致相等。

era.en: The invention marked the beginning of a new era in communication.
era.zh: 這項發明象徵通訊新時代的開始。

erase.en: Use a pencil so you can erase mistakes easily while drafting.
erase.zh: 起草時用鉛筆，這樣可以輕鬆擦掉錯誤。

eraser.en: She used an eraser to remove the pencil mark from her worksheet.
eraser.zh: 她用橡皮擦把學習單上的鉛筆痕擦掉。

erect.en: Workers will erect a temporary stage in front of the auditorium.
erect.zh: 工作人員會在禮堂前搭建臨時舞台。

errand.en: She stopped at the bookstore while running an errand for her teacher.
errand.zh: 她替老師辦事時順道去了書店。

error.en: The program displayed an error after the file name was entered incorrectly.
error.zh: 檔名輸入錯誤後，程式顯示一則錯誤訊息。

erupt.en: Scientists monitor the mountain closely because the volcano could erupt without much warning.
erupt.zh: 科學家密切監測那座山，因為火山可能在幾乎沒有預警下爆發。

escalator.en: The escalator beside the station entrance was closed for routine maintenance.
escalator.zh: 車站入口旁的手扶梯因例行維修而暫停使用。

escape.en: The hikers followed the marked trail to escape the heavy rain.
escape.zh: 健行者沿著標示步道避開大雨。

escort.en: A staff member will escort visitors from the lobby to the conference room.
escort.zh: 工作人員會陪同訪客從大廳前往會議室。

especially.en: This chapter is especially important for the final exam.
especially.zh: 這一章對期末考尤其重要。

essay.en: Her essay presents a clear argument supported by strong evidence.
essay.zh: 她的文章提出清楚論點並有有力證據支持。

essence.en: The summary captures the essence of the argument in just two sentences.
essence.zh: 這份摘要只用兩句話就掌握了論點的核心。

essential.en: Clean water is essential for human health and survival.
essential.zh: 乾淨的水對人類健康與生存至關重要。

establish.en: The club hopes to establish a regular reading program this semester.
establish.zh: 社團希望這學期建立固定的閱讀計畫。

establishment.en: The establishment of a study group helped students share useful review strategies.
establishment.zh: 成立讀書會幫助學生分享實用的複習策略。

estate.en: The old estate has been converted into a public museum.
estate.zh: 那座老莊園已改建成公共博物館。

esteem.en: The scientist earned great esteem for explaining difficult ideas clearly to the public.
esteem.zh: 那位科學家因能清楚向大眾解釋困難概念而備受敬重。

estimate.en: We can estimate the distance by using the map scale.
estimate.zh: 我們可以利用地圖比例尺估算距離。

eternal.en: The poem explores the human wish for eternal peace and lasting memory.
eternal.zh: 這首詩探討人們對永恆和平與長久記憶的渴望。

eternity.en: Waiting for the delayed bus felt like an eternity on the cold evening.
eternity.zh: 在寒冷的夜晚等誤點公車，感覺像等了一輩子。

ethic.en: A strong work ethic can help students finish long projects consistently.
ethic.zh: 良好的工作倫理能幫助學生持續完成長期專題。

ethical.en: Researchers must follow ethical rules when collecting personal information.
ethical.zh: 研究人員蒐集個人資訊時必須遵守倫理規範。

ethnic.en: The festival celebrates music and food from several ethnic communities.
ethnic.zh: 這場節慶慶祝來自不同族群社區的音樂與食物。

evacuate.en: Students practiced how to evacuate the building safely during an emergency drill.
evacuate.zh: 學生練習在緊急演練中如何安全撤離建築物。

evaluate.en: The committee will evaluate each proposal before making a final decision.
evaluate.zh: 委員會會評估每項提案後再做最後決定。

evaluation.en: The teacher's evaluation included comments on both strengths and areas for improvement.
evaluation.zh: 老師的評量包含優點以及需要改進之處的意見。

eve.en: The town square became crowded on the eve of the festival.
eve.zh: 節慶前夕，鎮上的廣場變得非常熱鬧。

even.en: Even a short walk can help improve your mood.
even.zh: 即使只是短暫散步，也能幫助改善心情。

evening.en: The library stays open until nine in the evening.
evening.zh: 圖書館晚上開放到九點。

event.en: The school event attracted more visitors than expected.
event.zh: 這場校內活動吸引的訪客比預期多。

eventual.en: Their eventual success came after several failed attempts and careful revisions.
eventual.zh: 他們經過幾次失敗和仔細修正後，最終取得成功。

ever.en: Have you ever visited a science museum at night?
ever.zh: 你曾經在晚上參觀過科學博物館嗎？

evergreen.en: The evergreen trees stayed green even after the weather became much colder.
evergreen.zh: 即使天氣變得更冷，常綠樹仍保持翠綠。

every.en: Every student must bring a notebook to the workshop.
every.zh: 每位學生都必須帶筆記本參加工作坊。

everybody.en: Everybody in the group received a clear role before the activity began.
everybody.zh: 活動開始前，小組裡每個人都分配到明確角色。

everyone.en: Everyone in the group contributed at least one idea.
everyone.zh: 小組裡每個人都至少提出了一個想法。

everything.en: Please check that everything is ready before the presentation begins.
everything.zh: 報告開始前請確認所有東西都準備好了。

evidence.en: Strong evidence is necessary to support a scientific conclusion.
evidence.zh: 有力證據是支持科學結論所必需的。

evident.en: It became evident that the original plan needed several changes.
evident.zh: 很明顯原本的計畫需要做幾項修改。

evil.en: The novel avoids a simple division between good and evil characters.
evil.zh: 這本小說避免把角色簡單分成善與惡。

evoke.en: The old photograph can evoke strong memories of childhood.
evoke.zh: 這張老照片能喚起強烈的童年回憶。

evolution.en: The exhibit explains the evolution of communication from letters to smartphones.
evolution.zh: 展覽說明通訊方式從書信到智慧型手機的演變。

evolve.en: Languages evolve as speakers create new words and change old expressions.
evolve.zh: 語言會隨著使用者創造新詞並改變舊表達而演變。

exact.en: Please record the exact time when the reaction begins.
exact.zh: 請記錄反應開始的確切時間。

exaggerate.en: Do not exaggerate the results when the evidence is still limited.
exaggerate.zh: 證據仍有限時，不要誇大研究結果。

exaggeration.en: The headline was an exaggeration that made the story sound more dramatic.
exaggeration.zh: 那個標題有些誇大，讓故事聽起來更戲劇化。

exam.en: She reviewed vocabulary every night before the exam.
exam.zh: 考試前她每天晚上都複習單字。

examination.en: The final examination includes reading, vocabulary, and a short writing section.
examination.zh: 期末考包含閱讀、單字和一小段寫作。

examine.en: The researchers will examine the samples under a microscope.
examine.zh: 研究人員會在顯微鏡下檢查樣本。

examinee.en: Each examinee must place personal items under the desk before the test begins.
examinee.zh: 每位考生都必須在考試開始前把個人物品放到桌下。

examiner.en: The examiner explained the speaking test rules before asking the first question.
examiner.zh: 考官在提出第一個問題前先說明口試規則。

example.en: The teacher gave an example to explain the difficult grammar rule.
example.zh: 老師舉了一個例子來解釋困難的文法規則。

exceed.en: The final cost should not exceed the budget approved by the committee.
exceed.zh: 最後成本不應超過委員會核准的預算。

excel.en: Students often excel when they practice steadily and ask for useful feedback.
excel.zh: 學生持續練習並主動尋求有用回饋時，往往能表現出色。

excellence.en: The award recognizes excellence in both academic work and community service.
excellence.zh: 這個獎項表揚在學業與社區服務上的傑出表現。

excellent.en: She received excellent feedback on her final presentation.
excellent.zh: 她的期末報告獲得了非常好的回饋。

except.en: Everyone attended the meeting except one student who was sick.
except.zh: 除了生病的一位學生外，所有人都參加了會議。

exception.en: Everyone must follow the rule, with one exception for medical needs.
exception.zh: 每個人都必須遵守規定，只有醫療需求可作例外。

exceptional.en: Her exceptional performance earned praise from both teachers and classmates.
exceptional.zh: 她出色的表現獲得老師和同學的稱讚。

excerpt.en: The teacher provided a short excerpt from the article for close reading practice.
excerpt.zh: 老師提供文章的一小段節錄，讓學生練習精讀。

excess.en: The body stores some excess energy for later use.
excess.zh: 身體會儲存部分多餘能量以供之後使用。

excessive.en: Excessive screen time can interfere with sleep and concentration.
excessive.zh: 過多的螢幕使用時間可能影響睡眠與專注力。

exchange.en: The exchange program allows students to experience another culture directly.
exchange.zh: 交換計畫讓學生能直接體驗另一種文化。

excite.en: New discoveries can excite students and make science feel more relevant.
excite.zh: 新發現能讓學生感到興奮，也讓科學更貼近生活。

excited.en: The students were excited about visiting the new exhibition.
excited.zh: 學生對參觀新展覽感到很興奮。

excitement.en: There was visible excitement in the classroom before the science competition began.
excitement.zh: 科學競賽開始前，教室裡明顯充滿興奮氣氛。

exciting.en: The final game was exciting from beginning to end.
exciting.zh: 最後一場比賽從頭到尾都很精彩。

exclaim.en: Students may exclaim in surprise when the experiment produces an unexpected color change.
exclaim.zh: 當實驗出現意外的顏色變化時，學生可能會驚呼。

exclude.en: The study will exclude incomplete responses from the final analysis.
exclude.zh: 這項研究會把不完整的回答排除在最後分析之外。

exclusion.en: The policy was revised to prevent unfair exclusion from school activities.
exclusion.zh: 這項政策經過修訂，以防止學生被不公平地排除在校內活動之外。

exclusive.en: The interview includes exclusive information that was not released earlier.
exclusive.zh: 這篇訪談包含先前尚未公開的獨家資訊。

excuse.en: He gave a reasonable excuse for arriving late to class.
excuse.zh: 他為上課遲到提出了一個合理理由。

execute.en: The team must execute the plan carefully to avoid unnecessary delays.
execute.zh: 團隊必須仔細執行計畫，以避免不必要的延誤。

execution.en: Good execution is as important as a strong idea in a group project.
execution.zh: 在小組專題中，良好的執行和好的想法同樣重要。

executive.en: A company executive visited the school to discuss careers in international business.
executive.zh: 一位公司主管到學校分享國際商務相關職涯。

exempt.en: Students with approved medical reasons may be exempt from the activity.
exempt.zh: 有核准醫療理由的學生可以免參加這項活動。

exercise.en: Regular exercise can improve both physical and mental health.
exercise.zh: 規律運動能改善身心健康。

exert.en: The heavy box can exert considerable pressure on the weak shelf.
exert.zh: 這個重箱子會對脆弱的架子施加相當大的壓力。

exhaust.en: Long hours without rest can exhaust even highly motivated students.
exhaust.zh: 長時間不休息，即使很有動力的學生也會精疲力竭。

exhibit.en: The museum will exhibit student artwork throughout the summer.
exhibit.zh: 博物館將在整個夏季展出學生作品。

exhibition.en: The science exhibition attracted visitors from several nearby schools.
exhibition.zh: 這場科學展覽吸引了附近數所學校的參觀者。

exile.en: The historical figure spent many years in exile before returning home.
exile.zh: 那位歷史人物流亡多年後才返回家鄉。

exist.en: Several possible solutions exist for this problem.
exist.zh: 這個問題有數種可能的解決方法。

existence.en: Scientists found new evidence supporting the existence of water beneath the surface.
existence.zh: 科學家找到支持地表下存在水的新證據。

exit.en: Please keep the emergency exit clear during the school performance tonight.
exit.zh: 今晚校內表演期間，請保持緊急出口暢通。

exotic.en: The garden contains several exotic plants from tropical regions.
exotic.zh: 這座花園裡有幾種來自熱帶地區的外來植物。

expand.en: The school plans to expand the library by adding more study areas.
expand.zh: 學校計畫增加更多自習區來擴建圖書館。

expansion.en: The expansion of the railway shortened travel time between the two cities.
expansion.zh: 鐵路擴建縮短了兩座城市之間的旅行時間。

expect.en: We expect the results to improve after more practice.
expect.zh: 我們預期增加練習後結果會改善。

expectation.en: The teacher's expectation was that every student would submit the report on time.
expectation.zh: 老師的期待是每位學生都能準時繳交報告。

expedition.en: The research team prepared carefully for an expedition to the remote island.
expedition.zh: 研究團隊為前往偏遠島嶼的考察做了充分準備。

expenditure.en: The club recorded every expenditure before preparing its annual budget report.
expenditure.zh: 社團在準備年度預算報告前記錄了每一筆支出。

expense.en: The school covered the travel expense for the competition.
expense.zh: 學校負擔了比賽的交通費用。

expensive.en: The new equipment is expensive but more reliable.
expensive.zh: 新設備很昂貴，但更可靠。

experience.en: Volunteering gave her useful experience in working with children.
experience.zh: 志工服務讓她獲得與兒童相處的實用經驗。

experiment.en: The experiment tested how light affects plant growth.
experiment.zh: 這項實驗測試光線如何影響植物生長。

experimental.en: The class compared an experimental method with the standard procedure in the textbook.
experimental.zh: 全班比較一種實驗性方法和課本中的標準程序。

expert.en: An expert visited the class to explain renewable energy technology.
expert.zh: 一位專家到班上說明再生能源技術。

expertise.en: The project benefited from her expertise in data analysis and statistics.
expertise.zh: 這項專題受益於她在資料分析與統計方面的專業。

expiration.en: Check the expiration date before using any packaged food from the cabinet.
expiration.zh: 使用櫥櫃裡的包裝食品前，請先查看保存期限。

expire.en: This temporary pass will expire at the end of the month.
expire.zh: 這張臨時通行證會在月底到期。

explain.en: Please explain your answer using evidence from the passage.
explain.zh: 請用文章中的證據解釋你的答案。

explanation.en: Her explanation was clear enough for everyone to follow.
explanation.zh: 她的解釋很清楚，每個人都能理解。

explicit.en: The instructions give explicit rules for formatting the report.
explicit.zh: 說明中明確列出報告格式的規則。

explode.en: The documentary explains why overheated containers can explode under unsafe conditions.
explode.zh: 這部紀錄片說明容器在不安全的過熱情況下為何可能爆裂。

exploit.en: The design aims to exploit natural light during the daytime.
exploit.zh: 這項設計旨在白天充分利用自然光。

exploration.en: The course encourages exploration of different solutions before choosing the most practical one.
exploration.zh: 這門課鼓勵先探索不同解法，再選擇最實際的一種。

explore.en: Students used the website to explore different career options.
explore.zh: 學生使用網站探索不同的職涯選擇。

explosion.en: The science lesson discussed how an explosion releases energy very quickly.
explosion.zh: 科學課討論爆炸如何在很短時間內釋放能量。

explosive.en: The safety video explains why explosive materials require strict professional handling.
explosive.zh: 安全影片說明爆炸性物質為何必須由專業人員嚴格處理。

export.en: The program can export the results as a spreadsheet file.
export.zh: 這個程式可以把結果匯出成試算表檔案。

expose.en: The activity can expose students to ideas from different cultures.
expose.zh: 這項活動能讓學生接觸來自不同文化的觀點。

exposure.en: Regular exposure to English can improve listening skills over a long period.
exposure.zh: 長期規律接觸英文可以提升聽力能力。

express.en: Students should learn to express their ideas clearly and politely.
express.zh: 學生應學會清楚且有禮貌地表達想法。

expression.en: Her facial expression showed that she was surprised.
expression.zh: 她的臉部表情顯示她很驚訝。

expressive.en: Her expressive reading made the poem easier for the audience to understand.
expressive.zh: 她富有表情的朗讀讓觀眾更容易理解那首詩。

extend.en: The teacher agreed to extend the deadline by two days.
extend.zh: 老師同意把截止日期延後兩天。

extension.en: The teacher granted a short extension because the computer system failed unexpectedly.
extension.zh: 因為電腦系統突然故障，老師同意延長一點繳交期限。

extensive.en: The library has an extensive collection of books about science and history.
extensive.zh: 圖書館收藏了大量科學與歷史相關書籍。

extent.en: The survey measured the extent to which students preferred digital textbooks.
extent.zh: 這份調查衡量學生偏好數位課本的程度。

exterior.en: The exterior of the old building was repaired before the rainy season.
exterior.zh: 雨季開始前，老建築的外部已完成修繕。

external.en: External factors such as weather can affect the final result.
external.zh: 天氣等外部因素可能影響最後結果。

extinct.en: Scientists study fossils to learn why some ancient species became extinct.
extinct.zh: 科學家研究化石，以了解某些古代物種為何滅絕。

extra.en: We had extra time to check our answers before class ended.
extra.zh: 下課前我們有額外時間檢查答案。

extract.en: Students extract key information from the passage before answering questions.
extract.zh: 學生回答問題前先從文章中擷取關鍵資訊。

extracurricular.en: Joining an extracurricular club can help students discover interests beyond regular classes.
extracurricular.zh: 參加課外社團能幫助學生發現正規課程以外的興趣。

extraordinary.en: The rescue team showed extraordinary cooperation during the difficult mountain exercise.
extraordinary.zh: 救援隊在困難的山區演練中展現了非凡的合作精神。

extreme.en: The school canceled outdoor activities because of the extreme heat that afternoon.
extreme.zh: 由於當天下午酷熱，學校取消了戶外活動。

eye.en: The bright light made it difficult to keep one eye open.
eye.zh: 強光讓人很難睜開一隻眼睛。

eyebrow.en: He raised one eyebrow when he noticed the unusual answer on the board.
eyebrow.zh: 他看到白板上不尋常的答案時挑起一邊眉毛。

eyelash.en: A tiny eyelash fell onto the page while she was reading.
eyelash.zh: 她閱讀時，一根小睫毛掉到頁面上。

eyelid.en: Dust irritated his eyelid, so he rinsed his eye with clean water.
eyelid.zh: 灰塵刺激了他的眼皮，所以他用乾淨的水沖洗眼睛。

eyesight.en: Good lighting can reduce strain and help protect your eyesight while studying.
eyesight.zh: 良好照明能減少眼睛疲勞，並有助於保護讀書時的視力。

fable.en: The class read a short fable and discussed the lesson behind its ending.
fable.zh: 全班讀了一篇短寓言，並討論結尾背後的寓意。

fabric.en: This fabric dries quickly and is suitable for outdoor sports clothing.
fabric.zh: 這種布料乾得很快，適合製作戶外運動服裝。

fabulous.en: The students created a fabulous display using recycled paper and simple materials.
fabulous.zh: 學生用回收紙和簡單材料做出很棒的展示作品。

face.en: Students often face new challenges when they enter high school.
face.zh: 學生進入高中後常會面臨新的挑戰。

facial.en: Her facial expression changed when she finally understood the difficult joke.
facial.zh: 當她終於聽懂那個難懂的笑話時，臉上的表情變了。

facilitate.en: Clear instructions can facilitate cooperation during group activities.
facilitate.zh: 清楚的說明可以促進小組活動中的合作。

facility.en: The new sports facility includes a gym and an indoor court.
facility.zh: 新的運動設施包含健身房與室內球場。

fact.en: Please separate each fact from personal opinion in your notes.
fact.zh: 請在筆記中把每項事實與個人意見分開。

faction.en: The history lesson explained how one faction disagreed with another over political reform.
faction.zh: 歷史課說明一個派系如何因政治改革而與另一派意見不合。

factor.en: Sleep is an important factor in students' ability to concentrate.
factor.zh: 睡眠是影響學生專注能力的重要因素。

factory.en: The factory installed new equipment to reduce energy use.
factory.zh: 這家工廠安裝新設備以降低能源使用。

faculty.en: The university faculty held a meeting to discuss changes to the curriculum.
faculty.zh: 大學教職員召開會議，討論課程調整。

fade.en: The bright poster began to fade after months of direct sunlight.
fade.zh: 那張鮮豔海報在陽光直射數月後開始褪色。

fahrenheit.en: The weather report showed the temperature in both Celsius and Fahrenheit.
fahrenheit.zh: 天氣預報同時以攝氏和華氏顯示溫度。

fail.en: Do not be afraid to fail when trying something new.
fail.zh: 嘗試新事物時不要害怕失敗。

failure.en: Failure can provide useful information about how to improve a design.
failure.zh: 失敗可以提供如何改進設計的有用資訊。

faint.en: A faint sound from the hallway became clearer as the door opened.
faint.zh: 走廊傳來的微弱聲音在門打開後變得更清楚。

fair.en: The teacher used clear rules to make the competition fair.
fair.zh: 老師用明確規則讓比賽保持公平。

fairly.en: The teacher tried to grade every report fairly.
fairly.zh: 老師努力公平地評分每份報告。

fairy.en: The story follows a fairy who helps a village solve a difficult problem.
fairy.zh: 這個故事描述一位仙女幫助村莊解決困難問題。

faith.en: Her faith in steady practice helped her continue after several difficult attempts.
faith.zh: 她相信持續練習，讓她在幾次困難嘗試後仍繼續努力。

faithful.en: The film is a faithful adaptation of the main ideas in the novel.
faithful.zh: 這部電影忠實改編了小說中的主要想法。

fake.en: The teacher showed students how to recognize a fake news headline online.
fake.zh: 老師教學生如何辨識網路上的假新聞標題。

fall.en: Temperatures usually fall quickly after sunset in the mountains.
fall.zh: 山區日落後氣溫通常會快速下降。

false.en: The article contained several false claims that lacked evidence.
false.zh: 這篇文章包含幾項缺乏證據的錯誤主張。

falter.en: Her confidence did not falter even when the first experiment failed.
falter.zh: 即使第一次實驗失敗，她的信心也沒有動搖。

fame.en: The athlete used his fame to support several community education programs.
fame.zh: 那位運動員利用自己的名氣支持多項社區教育計畫。

familiar.en: The song sounded familiar even though I could not remember its title.
familiar.zh: 這首歌聽起來很熟悉，但我想不起歌名。

familiarity.en: Familiarity with the question format can reduce stress during an important exam.
familiarity.zh: 熟悉題型可以降低重要考試時的壓力。

family.en: Her family supported her decision to study abroad.
family.zh: 她的家人支持她出國留學的決定。

famous.en: The museum displays works by several famous local artists.
famous.zh: 博物館展示數位知名在地藝術家的作品。

fan.en: A small fan helped keep the classroom cool.
fan.zh: 一台小風扇幫助教室保持涼爽。

fancy.en: The restaurant looks fancy, but its lunch menu is reasonably priced.
fancy.zh: 這家餐廳看起來很高級，但午餐價格相當合理。

fantastic.en: The class did a fantastic job presenting its research to visiting parents.
fantastic.zh: 全班向來訪家長介紹研究成果時表現得非常出色。

fantasy.en: The novel combines fantasy with historical details from an ancient kingdom.
fantasy.zh: 這本小說把奇幻元素和古代王國的歷史細節結合在一起。

far.en: The station is not far from the school entrance.

fare.en: The bus fare increased slightly at the beginning of the new year.
fare.zh: 新年開始時，公車票價小幅上調。

farewell.en: The graduating class held a farewell party on the final school day.
farewell.zh: 畢業班在最後一個上課日舉辦了歡送會。

farm.en: The farm grows vegetables without using harmful chemicals.
farm.zh: 這座農場種植蔬菜時不使用有害化學物質。

farmer.en: The farmer checked the weather before planting the seeds.
farmer.zh: 農夫在播種前先查看天氣。

farther.en: The second trail goes farther into the forest than the first one.
farther.zh: 第二條步道比第一條更深入森林。

fascinate.en: Stories about deep space continue to fascinate many students in science class.
fascinate.zh: 關於深空的故事持續吸引許多科學課學生。

fascination.en: Her fascination with insects led her to begin a small observation project.
fascination.zh: 她對昆蟲的著迷促使她開始一項小型觀察專題。

fashion.en: Fashion trends can change quickly, but comfort remains important to many people.
fashion.zh: 流行趨勢可能很快改變，但舒適對許多人仍很重要。

fashionable.en: The jacket became fashionable after several popular athletes began wearing it.
fashionable.zh: 幾位受歡迎的運動員開始穿這件外套後，它變得很流行。

fast.en: The train is fast enough to reach the city in an hour.
fast.zh: 這班火車速度夠快，一小時就能到城市。

fasten.en: Please fasten the strap securely before carrying the equipment upstairs.
fasten.zh: 把器材搬上樓前，請先把帶子牢牢扣好。

fat.en: The nutrition label shows how much fat the food contains.
fat.zh: 營養標示顯示這份食物含有多少脂肪。

fatal.en: The safety lesson explained how careful planning can prevent potentially fatal accidents.
fatal.zh: 安全課說明周詳規劃如何避免可能致命的事故。

fate.en: The story leaves the hero's final fate unclear until the last chapter.
fate.zh: 故事直到最後一章才揭示主角最後的命運。

father.en: Her father helped her repair the old bicycle.
father.zh: 她的父親幫她修理舊腳踏車。

fatigue.en: Regular breaks can reduce fatigue during a long afternoon of studying.
fatigue.zh: 長時間讀書的下午，定期休息可以減少疲勞。

faucet.en: A loose faucet caused water to drip slowly into the sink overnight.
faucet.zh: 鬆動的水龍頭讓水整晚慢慢滴進水槽。

fault.en: The technician found a fault in the electrical system.
fault.zh: 技師在電力系統中發現了一個故障。

favor.en: Could you do me a favor and carry these books?
favor.zh: 你可以幫我一個忙，拿這些書嗎？

favorable.en: The outdoor event will continue only if the weather remains favorable.
favorable.zh: 只有天氣狀況持續良好，戶外活動才會繼續進行。

favorite.en: Science is her favorite subject because she enjoys experiments.
favorite.zh: 自然科是她最喜歡的科目，因為她喜歡做實驗。

fax.en: The office still keeps a fax machine for a few official documents.
fax.zh: 辦公室仍保留一台傳真機，用來處理少數正式文件。

fear.en: Practice can reduce the fear of speaking in front of others.
fear.zh: 練習可以減少在眾人面前說話的恐懼。

fearful.en: The puppy looked fearful at first but relaxed after hearing a calm voice.
fearful.zh: 小狗起初看起來很害怕，但聽到平靜的聲音後便放鬆了。

feasible.en: The team chose a feasible plan that fit the available time.
feasible.zh: 團隊選擇了一個符合現有時間的可行計畫。

feast.en: The festival ended with a community feast featuring dishes from several regions.
feast.zh: 這場節慶以一場包含多地料理的社區盛宴作為結尾。

feather.en: A small feather landed on the windowsill during the windy afternoon.
feather.zh: 一根小羽毛在有風的下午落到窗台上。

feature.en: One useful feature of the app is its offline dictionary.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是離線字典。

federal.en: The article compares federal and local responsibilities in managing public transportation.
federal.zh: 這篇文章比較聯邦與地方在管理大眾運輸上的責任。

fee.en: The museum charges a small entrance fee on weekends.
fee.zh: 博物館週末會收取少額入場費。

feeble.en: The feeble signal became stronger after the antenna was adjusted.
feeble.zh: 調整天線後，微弱的訊號變得更強。

feed.en: Please do not feed the animals without permission.
feed.zh: 沒有許可請不要餵食動物。

feedback.en: The teacher's feedback helped me revise the introduction more clearly.
feedback.zh: 老師的回饋幫助我更清楚地修改前言。

feel.en: Most students feel more confident after enough practice.
feel.zh: 大多數學生充分練習後會更有自信。

feeling.en: She described the feeling of relief after finishing the exam.
feeling.zh: 她描述了考完試後如釋重負的感覺。

fellow.en: A fellow student showed me how to organize the research notes.
fellow.zh: 一位同學示範如何整理研究筆記。

female.en: The study included an equal number of male and female participants.
female.zh: 這項研究包含相同人數的男性與女性參與者。

feminine.en: The article examines how feminine styles have changed across different periods.
feminine.zh: 這篇文章探討女性化風格在不同時期如何改變。

fence.en: A tall fence surrounds the school garden.
fence.zh: 一座高圍欄圍住了學校花園。

ferry.en: The ferry carries passengers across the harbor every morning.
ferry.zh: 渡輪每天早上載乘客穿越港口。

fertile.en: The valley has fertile soil that supports many kinds of crops.
fertile.zh: 這座山谷有肥沃土壤，適合種植多種作物。

fertility.en: Scientists study soil fertility to understand which crops can grow well.
fertility.zh: 科學家研究土壤肥力，以了解哪些作物能良好生長。

fertilizer.en: The farmer used organic fertilizer to improve the soil before planting.
fertilizer.zh: 農夫在種植前使用有機肥料改善土壤。

festival.en: The school festival includes performances, games, and food stalls.
festival.zh: 校慶包含表演、遊戲和美食攤位。

fetch.en: Please fetch the reference book from the shelf near the window.
fetch.zh: 請從窗邊的書架拿那本參考書過來。

fever.en: A high fever can be a sign that someone needs medical attention.
fever.zh: 高燒可能表示某人需要醫療照護。

few.en: Only a few students finished the challenge on their first attempt.
few.zh: 只有少數學生第一次嘗試就完成挑戰。

fiance.en: Her fiance joined the family for dinner after the graduation ceremony.
fiance.zh: 她的未婚夫在畢業典禮後和家人一起吃晚餐。

fiancé.en: Her fiancé helped carry the boxes into the new apartment.
fiancé.zh: 她的未婚夫幫忙把箱子搬進新公寓。

fiber.en: Whole grains are a useful source of dietary fiber.
fiber.zh: 全穀類是膳食纖維的良好來源。

fiction.en: Historical fiction can make past events feel more vivid to readers.
fiction.zh: 歷史小說能讓讀者更生動地感受過去事件。

field.en: The students collected soil samples from a nearby field.
field.zh: 學生從附近田地採集土壤樣本。

fierce.en: The teams faced fierce competition during the final round.
fierce.zh: 兩隊在決賽中面臨激烈競爭。

fight.en: The two characters fight at first but later become friends.
fight.zh: 兩個角色一開始爭鬥，後來卻成為朋友。

fighter.en: The documentary follows a fighter who trains with discipline and patience.
fighter.zh: 這部紀錄片記錄一名格鬥選手以自律與耐心訓練的過程。

figure.en: The figure shows how the system changes over time.
figure.zh: 這張圖顯示系統如何隨時間改變。

file.en: Please save the file before turning off the computer.
file.zh: 關閉電腦前請先儲存檔案。

fill.en: Please fill the bottle with clean water before the trip.
fill.zh: 出發前請把瓶子裝滿乾淨的水。

film.en: The class watched a short film about ocean conservation.
film.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋保育的短片。

filter.en: This filter removes small particles from the water before testing.
filter.zh: 這個濾網會在檢測前去除水中的小顆粒。

fin.en: The fish uses its tail fin to change direction quickly.
fin.zh: 魚利用尾鰭快速改變方向。

final.en: The final question requires students to explain their reasoning.
final.zh: 最後一題要求學生解釋推理過程。

finally.en: After several revisions, the report was finally ready to submit.
finally.zh: 經過多次修改後，報告終於可以提交了。

finance.en: The course introduces basic ideas about personal finance and saving.
finance.zh: 這門課介紹個人理財與儲蓄的基本概念。

financial.en: The family created a financial plan before making the large purchase.
financial.zh: 這個家庭在進行大筆消費前先制定財務計畫。

find.en: You can find the answer by comparing the two paragraphs.
find.zh: 你可以比較這兩段來找到答案。

fine.en: The weather should be fine for tomorrow's outdoor activity.
fine.zh: 明天的戶外活動天氣應該不錯。

finger.en: He injured his finger while moving a heavy box.
finger.zh: 他搬重箱子時弄傷了手指。

finish.en: Please finish the first section before moving to the next one.
finish.zh: 請完成第一部分後再進入下一部分。

finite.en: The project has a finite amount of time and money available.
finite.zh: 這項專題可使用的時間與經費都是有限的。

fire.en: The fire alarm sounded during the morning class.
fire.zh: 早上上課時火警警報響了。

fireman.en: A fireman visited the school to explain basic fire safety.
fireman.zh: 一名消防員到學校說明基本防火安全。

fireplace.en: The old house has a stone fireplace in the main room.
fireplace.zh: 這棟老屋的主要房間裡有一座石造壁爐。

fireproof.en: The cabinet is made from fireproof material to protect important records.
fireproof.zh: 這個櫃子使用防火材料製成，以保護重要紀錄。

firewoman.en: A firewoman spoke to the class about emergency preparedness.
firewoman.zh: 一名女性消防員向全班說明緊急應變準備。

firework.en: A single firework lit up the sky during the public celebration.
firework.zh: 公共慶典期間，一枚煙火照亮了天空。

firm.en: The school has a firm rule against cheating on tests.
firm.zh: 學校對考試作弊有嚴格規定。

first.en: Read the instructions first before answering any questions.
first.zh: 回答任何問題前請先閱讀說明。

fiscal.en: The report outlines the government's fiscal plan for the coming year.
fiscal.zh: 這份報告概述政府下一年度的財政計畫。

fish.en: The river contains several species of freshwater fish.
fish.zh: 這條河裡有數種淡水魚。

fisherman.en: A fisherman checked the weather forecast before leaving the harbor.
fisherman.zh: 一名漁夫離港前先查看天氣預報。

fishery.en: The coastal fishery supports many families in the small town.
fishery.zh: 沿海漁業支撐這座小鎮許多家庭的生計。

fist.en: He raised his fist in celebration after the team won the match.
fist.zh: 球隊贏得比賽後，他舉起拳頭慶祝。

fit.en: This schedule should fit most students' study routines.
fit.zh: 這個時間表應該能配合大多數學生的讀書作息。

fix.en: The technician came to fix the broken projector.
fix.zh: 技師來修理故障的投影機。

flag.en: The flag was raised before the ceremony began.
flag.zh: 典禮開始前旗幟被升起。

flake.en: A tiny snow flake landed on her sleeve and quickly melted.
flake.zh: 一小片雪花落在她的袖子上，很快就融化了。

flame.en: The small flame went out when the wind became stronger.
flame.zh: 風變強後，小火焰熄滅了。

flash.en: A bright flash of lightning appeared beyond the mountains.
flash.zh: 一道明亮的閃電出現在群山後方。

flashlight.en: We used a flashlight to read the map during the power outage.
flashlight.zh: 停電時我們用手電筒查看地圖。

flat.en: The road remains flat for several kilometers after the bridge.
flat.zh: 過橋後道路有好幾公里都很平坦。

flatter.en: Good friends do not simply flatter each other; they also give useful advice.
flatter.zh: 好朋友不只彼此奉承，也會提供有用的建議。

flavor.en: Adding fresh herbs can improve the flavor of a simple soup.
flavor.zh: 加入新鮮香草可以提升簡單湯品的風味。

flaw.en: The reviewer noticed a flaw in the argument and asked for more evidence.
flaw.zh: 審閱者發現論證中的缺陷，並要求更多證據。

flea.en: The veterinarian checked the dog for signs of a flea problem.
flea.zh: 獸醫檢查狗是否有跳蚤問題的跡象。

flee.en: The birds began to flee when the loud machine started nearby.
flee.zh: 附近的大型機器啟動時，鳥群開始逃離。

fleet.en: The company replaced part of its delivery fleet with electric vehicles.
fleet.zh: 公司把部分配送車隊改成電動車。

flesh.en: The peach has soft flesh beneath its thin skin.
flesh.zh: 桃子薄薄的果皮下有柔軟的果肉。

flexibility.en: A little flexibility can help a study plan survive unexpected changes.
flexibility.zh: 一點彈性可以讓讀書計畫因應突發變化。

flexible.en: Our schedule is flexible enough to include an extra review session.
flexible.zh: 我們的時程很有彈性，可以加入一次額外複習。

flight.en: Our flight was delayed because of strong winds.
flight.zh: 我們的班機因強風而延誤。

flip.en: Flip the card over to check the definition on the back.
flip.zh: 把卡片翻過來查看背面的定義。

float.en: A piece of wood can float on water because its density is low.
float.zh: 木頭因密度較低而能浮在水面上。

flock.en: A flock of birds rested in the field before continuing south.
flock.zh: 一群鳥在田野休息後繼續往南飛。

flood.en: Heavy rain caused a flood in several low-lying streets.
flood.zh: 大雨造成幾條低窪街道淹水。

floor.en: The science laboratory is on the third floor.
floor.zh: 自然科實驗室位於三樓。

flour.en: The recipe requires two cups of flour and one cup of water.
flour.zh: 這份食譜需要兩杯麵粉和一杯水。

flourish.en: Plants can flourish when they receive enough light and water.
flourish.zh: 植物在獲得足夠陽光與水分時能茁壯成長。

flow.en: The diagram shows how water can flow through the system.
flow.zh: 這張圖示顯示水如何流經系統。

flower.en: The flower opened fully after several sunny days.
flower.zh: 經過幾個晴天後，這朵花完全綻放。

flu.en: Students with the flu should rest and follow medical advice.
flu.zh: 感染流感的學生應休息並遵從醫療建議。

fluency.en: Daily reading can gradually improve your English fluency.
fluency.zh: 每天閱讀可以逐漸提升你的英語流暢度。

fluent.en: She became fluent in English after years of steady practice.
fluent.zh: 她經過多年穩定練習後，英語變得流利。

fluid.en: The scientist measured how quickly the fluid moved through the tube.
fluid.zh: 科學家測量液體通過管子的速度。

flunk.en: One difficult test does not mean you will flunk the entire course.
flunk.zh: 一次困難的考試不代表你會整門課不及格。

flush.en: Please flush the pipe with clean water before starting the experiment.
flush.zh: 開始實驗前，請用清水沖洗管線。

flute.en: She practices the flute for thirty minutes after school.
flute.zh: 她放學後會練習長笛三十分鐘。

fly.en: Some birds fly thousands of kilometers during seasonal migration.
fly.zh: 有些鳥類季節遷徙時會飛行數千公里。

foam.en: White foam formed on the surface as the waves reached the rocks.
foam.zh: 海浪拍到岩石時，表面形成白色泡沫。

focus.en: Please focus on the main question when writing your answer.
focus.zh: 寫答案時請聚焦在主要問題上。

foe.en: In the story, the former foe eventually becomes a trusted ally.
foe.zh: 故事中，昔日的敵人最後成為值得信任的盟友。

fog.en: Thick fog reduced visibility on the mountain road this morning.
fog.zh: 今早濃霧降低了山路上的能見度。

foggy.en: The morning was foggy, so drivers moved more slowly than usual.
foggy.zh: 早晨霧很濃，因此駕駛比平常開得更慢。

fold.en: Fold the paper in half before cutting along the marked line.
fold.zh: 沿著標記線剪之前，先把紙對折。

folk.en: The festival includes folk music from several regions of Taiwan.
folk.zh: 這個節慶包含來自臺灣不同地區的民間音樂。

folklore.en: Local folklore often preserves stories about a community's past.
folklore.zh: 地方民間傳說常保存社區過往的故事。

follow.en: Please follow the safety instructions during the experiment.
follow.zh: 實驗進行時請遵守安全說明。

follower.en: A careful follower checks information before sharing it online.
follower.zh: 謹慎的追蹤者會先查證資訊再於網路分享。

following.en: Read the following paragraph and identify its main idea.
following.zh: 閱讀下面這一段，找出它的主旨。

fond.en: My grandfather is fond of solving crossword puzzles in the morning.
fond.zh: 我祖父很喜歡早上解填字遊戲。

food.en: The event provides food and drinks for all participants.
food.zh: 這場活動為所有參與者提供餐點和飲料。
