fool.en: The story warns that pride can make even a wise person act like a fool.
fool.zh: 這個故事警告，驕傲可能讓聰明人也做出愚蠢的事。

foolish.en: It would be foolish to ignore clear evidence in the report.
foolish.zh: 忽視報告中的明確證據是愚蠢的。

foot.en: He hurt his foot while running on the wet field.
foot.zh: 他在濕滑的球場跑步時傷了腳。

football.en: The football team practices every Tuesday and Thursday.
football.zh: 足球隊每星期二和星期四練習。

for.en: This guide is designed for students preparing for the exam.
for.zh: 這份指南是為準備考試的學生設計的。

forbid.en: School rules forbid students from entering the laboratory without supervision.
forbid.zh: 校規禁止學生在無人指導下進入實驗室。

force.en: The strong force of the wind pushed the door shut.
force.zh: 強風的力量把門吹關了。

forecast.en: The forecast predicts cooler weather and light rain tomorrow.
forecast.zh: 氣象預報預測明天天氣較涼並有小雨。

foreign.en: Learning a foreign language can broaden your view of the world.
foreign.zh: 學習外語可以拓展你對世界的看法。

foreigner.en: The guide explained local customs clearly to each foreigner in the group.
foreigner.zh: 導遊向團體中的每位外國人清楚說明當地習俗。

forest.en: The forest provides habitat for many plants and animals.
forest.zh: 森林為許多動植物提供棲地。

forever.en: Digital files may not last forever without careful backups.
forever.zh: 如果沒有妥善備份，數位檔案未必能永久保存。

forge.en: The two schools hope to forge a long-term partnership through the exchange program.
forge.zh: 兩所學校希望透過交流計畫建立長期合作關係。

forget.en: Do not forget to bring your student card tomorrow.
forget.zh: 明天不要忘記帶學生證。

forgive.en: It can take time to forgive someone after a serious disagreement.
forgive.zh: 嚴重爭執後，原諒一個人可能需要時間。

fork.en: Place the fork beside the plate before the guests arrive.
fork.zh: 客人到達前，把叉子放在盤子旁。

form.en: Please complete the form and return it by Friday.
form.zh: 請填好表格並在星期五前繳回。

formal.en: Students wore formal clothes for the graduation ceremony.
formal.zh: 學生穿著正式服裝參加畢業典禮。

format.en: Please use the same format for every section of the report.
format.zh: 請讓報告的每個部分使用相同格式。

formation.en: The diagram shows the formation of clouds above the mountains.
formation.zh: 這張圖顯示山區上空雲層的形成。

former.en: A former student returned to share advice about university life.
former.zh: 一位校友回來分享大學生活的建議。

formidable.en: The final project seemed formidable until the tasks were divided into smaller steps.
formidable.zh: 期末專題原本看似艱鉅，直到任務被拆成較小步驟。

formula.en: Use this formula to calculate the area of the triangle.
formula.zh: 使用這個公式計算三角形面積。

formulate.en: Students formulate a hypothesis before beginning the experiment.
formulate.zh: 學生在開始實驗前先提出假設。

forsake.en: The character refuses to forsake his principles even under pressure.
forsake.zh: 這個角色即使面臨壓力也不願放棄自己的原則。

fort.en: The old fort overlooks the harbor from the top of the hill.
fort.zh: 這座古堡從山丘頂俯瞰港口。

forth.en: The speaker stepped forth to present the team's final proposal.
forth.zh: 講者走上前，提出團隊的最終提案。

forthcoming.en: The school announced details about the forthcoming science fair this morning.
forthcoming.zh: 學校今早公布了即將舉行的科展細節。

fortify.en: Engineers used stronger materials to fortify the bridge against severe weather.
fortify.zh: 工程師使用更堅固的材料強化橋梁，以抵抗惡劣天候。

fortunate.en: We were fortunate to finish the hike before the heavy rain began.
fortunate.zh: 我們很幸運，在大雨開始前完成了健行。

fortune.en: Good preparation often matters more than fortune in an important competition.
fortune.zh: 在重要比賽中，充分準備往往比運氣更重要。

forum.en: The student forum gave everyone a chance to discuss campus improvements.
forum.zh: 學生論壇讓每個人都有機會討論校園改善。

forward.en: Please move forward carefully until you reach the marked line.
forward.zh: 請小心往前移動，直到到達標示線。

forwards.en: The line moved forwards slowly as more passengers entered the station.
forwards.zh: 隨著更多乘客進站，隊伍慢慢向前移動。

fossil.en: The museum displayed a fossil discovered in a nearby mountain area.
fossil.zh: 博物館展出了一件在附近山區發現的化石。

foster.en: Group discussion can foster curiosity and stronger communication skills.
foster.zh: 小組討論可以培養好奇心與更好的溝通能力。

foul.en: A foul smell from the drain caused the class to open the windows.
foul.zh: 排水孔傳來的惡臭讓全班打開窗戶。

found.en: Local volunteers helped found a community library for younger children.
found.zh: 地方志工協助成立一座供年幼孩童使用的社區圖書館。

foundation.en: Basic reading skills provide a strong foundation for later learning.
foundation.zh: 基本閱讀能力為後續學習建立穩固基礎。

founder.en: The founder explained how the small company grew over ten years.
founder.zh: 創辦人說明這家小公司如何在十年間成長。

fountain.en: Students gathered beside the fountain during the lunch break.
fountain.zh: 午休時，學生聚集在噴水池旁。

fowl.en: The farm raises several kinds of fowl in a large outdoor area.
fowl.zh: 這座農場在大型戶外區域飼養數種家禽。

fox.en: A fox appeared near the forest trail just before sunset.
fox.zh: 日落前，一隻狐狸出現在森林步道附近。

fraction.en: Only a small fraction of the class chose the most difficult topic.
fraction.zh: 全班只有一小部分選擇了最困難的主題。

fracture.en: The doctor confirmed a minor fracture after examining the X-ray.
fracture.zh: 醫師查看 X 光後確認有輕微骨折。

fragile.en: The fragile model must be carried carefully between classrooms.
fragile.zh: 這個易碎模型在教室之間搬運時必須小心。

fragment.en: Researchers examined each pottery fragment before rebuilding the ancient bowl.
fragment.zh: 研究人員在重建古碗前，檢查每一片陶器碎片。

fragrance.en: The fragrance of fresh flowers filled the small exhibition room.
fragrance.zh: 新鮮花朵的香氣充滿了小型展覽室。

fragrant.en: The garden was filled with fragrant herbs after the spring rain.
fragrant.zh: 春雨過後，花園裡充滿芳香的香草氣味。

frame.en: The photographer adjusted the frame before taking the final picture.
frame.zh: 攝影師在拍下最後一張照片前調整了畫面構圖。

framework.en: The teacher provided a simple framework for organizing the essay.
framework.zh: 老師提供了一個簡單架構來整理文章。

franchise.en: The company opened its first overseas franchise near the train station.
franchise.zh: 這家公司在火車站附近開設第一家海外加盟店。

frank.en: She gave a frank answer when the group asked about the problem.
frank.zh: 小組詢問問題時，她坦率地回答。

frantic.en: The office became frantic when the network suddenly stopped working.
frantic.zh: 網路突然停止運作時，辦公室變得一片忙亂。

fraud.en: The article explains how consumers can recognize common forms of fraud.
fraud.zh: 這篇文章說明消費者如何辨識常見的詐騙形式。

freak.en: A freak storm interrupted the outdoor concert without any warning.
freak.zh: 一場異常暴風雨毫無預警地中斷了戶外音樂會。

free.en: The museum offers free admission to students on Wednesdays.
free.zh: 博物館星期三對學生免費開放。

freedom.en: The discussion focused on the balance between freedom and responsibility.
freedom.zh: 討論聚焦在自由與責任之間的平衡。

freeway.en: Traffic slowed on the freeway because of heavy rain during rush hour.
freeway.zh: 尖峰時段的大雨使高速公路車流變慢。

freeze.en: Water will freeze when the temperature remains below zero long enough.
freeze.zh: 當溫度長時間維持在零度以下，水就會結冰。

freezer.en: The ice cream should remain in the freezer until dessert is served.
freezer.zh: 冰淇淋在甜點上桌前應一直放在冷凍庫。

freight.en: The port handles large amounts of freight arriving from overseas.
freight.zh: 這座港口處理大量從海外抵達的貨運。

frequency.en: The survey measured the frequency of exercise among high school students.
frequency.zh: 這份調查測量高中生運動的頻率。

frequent.en: Frequent practice helped her become more confident during presentations.
frequent.zh: 頻繁練習幫助她在簡報時更有自信。

fresh.en: The market sells fresh fruit and vegetables every morning.
fresh.zh: 市場每天早上販售新鮮蔬果。

freshman.en: Every freshman attends an orientation session during the first week.
freshman.zh: 每位大一新生都會在第一週參加新生說明會。

friction.en: Friction between the tires and road helps the bicycle stop safely.
friction.zh: 輪胎與路面之間的摩擦力幫助腳踏車安全停下。

fridge.en: Please put the leftover food in the fridge before leaving.
fridge.zh: 離開前請把剩下的食物放進冰箱。

friend.en: A good friend can offer support during difficult times.
friend.zh: 好朋友能在困難時提供支持。

friendly.en: The staff were friendly and answered all our questions.
friendly.zh: 工作人員很友善，回答了我們所有問題。

friendship.en: Their friendship grew stronger after they worked on the project together.
friendship.zh: 他們一起做專題後，友誼變得更深厚。

fries.en: He ordered a sandwich with a small serving of fries.
fries.zh: 他點了一份三明治和一小份薯條。

fright.en: The sudden noise gave everyone a brief fright during the rehearsal.
fright.zh: 排練時的突然聲響把大家嚇了一跳。

frighten.en: Sudden loud noises can frighten animals in the area.
frighten.zh: 突然的巨大聲響可能會嚇到附近的動物。

frog.en: A small frog jumped into the pond beside the path.
frog.zh: 一隻小青蛙跳進步道旁的池塘。

from.en: Students from different classes worked together on the project.
from.zh: 來自不同班級的學生一起完成這項專題。

front.en: Please write your name on the front of the worksheet.
front.zh: 請把名字寫在學習單正面。

frontier.en: Space research continues to push the frontier of scientific knowledge.
frontier.zh: 太空研究持續拓展科學知識的前沿。

frost.en: A thin layer of frost covered the grass early in the morning.
frost.zh: 清晨時草地覆蓋著一層薄霜。

frown.en: He began to frown when the instructions became difficult to understand.
frown.zh: 當說明變得難以理解時，他開始皺眉。

fruit.en: Fresh fruit is available in the school cafeteria every day.
fruit.zh: 學校餐廳每天都有新鮮水果。

frustrate.en: Unclear instructions can frustrate students during a difficult assignment.
frustrate.zh: 不清楚的指示可能讓學生在困難作業中感到挫折。

frustration.en: She took a short break when frustration made the task harder.
frustration.zh: 當挫折感讓任務變得更困難時，她短暫休息了一下。

fry.en: The cook used a shallow pan to fry the vegetables quickly.
fry.zh: 廚師用淺鍋快速煎炒蔬菜。

fuel.en: The new bus uses less fuel than the older model.
fuel.zh: 這款新公車比舊型號使用更少燃料。

fulfill.en: The program helps students fulfill the community service requirement.
fulfill.zh: 這項計畫幫助學生完成社區服務要求。

fulfillment.en: She found fulfillment in helping younger students improve their reading skills.
fulfillment.zh: 她從幫助年幼學生提升閱讀能力中獲得成就感。

full.en: The classroom was full before the lecture even started.
full.zh: 講座開始前教室就已經坐滿了。

fume.en: A strange fume from the machine caused workers to leave the room.
fume.zh: 機器散發的異常氣體讓工作人員離開房間。

fun.en: The activity was fun and also helped us learn new words.
fun.zh: 這項活動很有趣，也幫助我們學習新單字。

function.en: The teacher explained the function of each part of the machine.
function.zh: 老師說明機器每個零件的功能。

functional.en: The old computer is slow but still functional for basic tasks.
functional.zh: 這台舊電腦雖然很慢，但仍能處理基本工作。

fund.en: The school created a fund to support students with financial needs.
fund.zh: 學校設立基金幫助有經濟需求的學生。

fundamental.en: Clear communication is fundamental to successful teamwork in any project.
fundamental.zh: 清楚溝通是任何專案成功合作的基本要素。

funeral.en: The family held a quiet funeral and invited close relatives.
funeral.zh: 這家人舉行了一場安靜的喪禮，邀請近親參加。

funny.en: The funny story made the whole class laugh during the break.
funny.zh: 那個有趣的故事讓全班在下課時笑了起來。

fur.en: The animal's thick fur helps it survive cold mountain winters.
fur.zh: 這種動物濃密的毛皮幫助牠度過寒冷的山區冬季。

furious.en: She was furious when the team ignored the agreed safety rules.
furious.zh: 團隊忽視事先同意的安全規則時，她非常生氣。

furnish.en: The school plans to furnish the new study room with larger desks.
furnish.zh: 學校計畫為新自習室配置較大的書桌。

furniture.en: The library replaced old furniture to create more comfortable study areas.
furniture.zh: 圖書館更換舊家具，打造更舒適的讀書空間。

further.en: Further research is needed before the scientists can confirm the result.
further.zh: 科學家在確認結果前，還需要進一步研究。

furthermore.en: The plan saves money; furthermore, it reduces energy use.
furthermore.zh: 這項計畫能省錢；此外，也能減少能源使用。

fury.en: The storm reached its greatest fury shortly before midnight.
fury.zh: 暴風雨在午夜前不久達到最猛烈的程度。

fuse.en: Engineers designed the parts to fuse together under controlled heat.
fuse.zh: 工程師設計這些零件，使它們能在受控加熱下融合。

fuss.en: There was little fuss when the schedule changed at the last minute.
fuss.zh: 行程臨時更改時，大家並沒有太多抱怨。

future.en: She hopes to work in environmental science in the future.
future.zh: 她希望未來從事環境科學相關工作。

gain.en: Students can gain confidence by practicing short presentations regularly.
gain.zh: 學生可以透過規律練習短講來建立自信。

galaxy.en: The telescope captured a distant galaxy far beyond our solar system.
galaxy.zh: 望遠鏡拍攝到一個遠在太陽系之外的星系。

gallery.en: The gallery displays paintings created by local high school students.
gallery.zh: 這間藝廊展出當地高中生創作的畫作。

gallon.en: The container can hold nearly one gallon of clean water.
gallon.zh: 這個容器可以裝將近一加侖的乾淨水。

gallop.en: The horse began to gallop across the field after the gate opened.
gallop.zh: 柵門打開後，馬開始在田野上奔馳。

gamble.en: It would be a gamble to launch the project without testing it first.
gamble.zh: 在沒有先測試的情況下啟動專案會是一場冒險。

game.en: The final game attracted a large crowd to the stadium.
game.zh: 決賽吸引大批觀眾到體育場。

gang.en: The documentary examines how a street gang affected the neighborhood.
gang.zh: 這部紀錄片探討街頭幫派如何影響社區。

gangster.en: The old film portrays a gangster trying to escape from the police.
gangster.zh: 這部老電影描寫一名試圖逃離警方追捕的黑幫人物。

gap.en: The study found a clear gap between the two groups.
gap.zh: 這項研究發現兩組之間有明顯差距。

garage.en: The bicycles are stored in the garage behind the house.
garage.zh: 腳踏車存放在房子後方的車庫裡。

garbage.en: Students separated recyclable materials from ordinary garbage after lunch.
garbage.zh: 學生午餐後把可回收物與一般垃圾分開。

garden.en: Students planted herbs in a small garden beside the classroom.
garden.zh: 學生在教室旁的小花園種了香草。

gardener.en: The gardener planted new flowers along the path near the library.
gardener.zh: 園丁在圖書館附近的小徑旁種下新花朵。

garlic.en: The soup has a mild garlic flavor that becomes stronger when heated.
garlic.zh: 這道湯有淡淡的蒜味，加熱後會更明顯。

garment.en: Each garment was labeled with washing instructions before being displayed.
garment.zh: 每件衣物在展示前都標上洗滌說明。

gas.en: The experiment measures how quickly the gas expands when heated.
gas.zh: 這個實驗測量氣體受熱時膨脹的速度。

gasoline.en: The report compares gasoline use with electricity use in transportation.
gasoline.zh: 這份報告比較交通運輸中汽油與電力的使用。

gasp.en: The audience gave a gasp when the final result appeared on screen.
gasp.zh: 最終結果出現在螢幕上時，觀眾驚呼了一聲。

gate.en: The school gate opens at seven every morning.
gate.zh: 校門每天早上七點開啟。

gather.en: We gather information from several sources before writing the report.
gather.zh: 我們在寫報告前會從多個來源蒐集資訊。

gathering.en: The annual gathering brings former students back to visit the school.
gathering.zh: 年度聚會讓畢業校友回到學校參訪。

gauge.en: Teachers use short quizzes to gauge how well students understand the lesson.
gauge.zh: 老師用小考衡量學生對課程內容的理解程度。

gay.en: The article discusses how schools can support gay students with respect.
gay.zh: 這篇文章討論學校如何以尊重的方式支持同志學生。

gaze.en: She paused to gaze at the stars above the quiet campsite.
gaze.zh: 她停下來凝視安靜營地上方的星空。

gear.en: The cycling club checks every piece of gear before long trips.
gear.zh: 自行車社在長途活動前會檢查每件裝備。

gender.en: The survey compared study habits without making assumptions about gender.
gender.zh: 這份調查比較學習習慣，並未對性別做預設。

gene.en: A gene can influence certain traits passed from parents to children.
gene.zh: 基因可能影響由父母傳給子女的某些特徵。

general.en: The teacher gave a general overview before discussing the details.
general.zh: 老師先做整體概述，再討論細節。

generate.en: The new system can generate a summary from the collected data.
generate.zh: 新系統可以根據蒐集的資料產生摘要。

generation.en: Each generation develops its own habits for using technology.
generation.zh: 每一代人都會形成自己的科技使用習慣。

generator.en: The backup generator kept essential lights working during the power outage.
generator.zh: 停電時，備用發電機讓必要照明持續運作。

generosity.en: Her generosity encouraged other students to donate books to the program.
generosity.zh: 她的慷慨鼓勵其他學生也捐書給這項計畫。

generous.en: She was generous enough to share her notes with the whole group.
generous.zh: 她很大方地把筆記分享給整個小組。

genetic.en: The article explains how genetic information can influence certain traits.
genetic.zh: 這篇文章說明遺傳資訊如何影響某些特徵。

genetics.en: The class studied basic genetics through simple examples of inherited traits.
genetics.zh: 課堂透過遺傳特徵的簡單例子學習基礎遺傳學。

genius.en: The inventor was praised as a genius after solving the complex problem.
genius.zh: 這位發明家解決複雜問題後，被讚為天才。

genre.en: Students chose one literary genre to analyze for their final report.
genre.zh: 學生選擇一種文學類型作為期末報告分析主題。

gentle.en: A gentle breeze made the afternoon walk more comfortable.
gentle.zh: 柔和的微風讓午後散步更舒服。

gentleman.en: The elderly gentleman thanked the students for helping carry his bags.
gentleman.zh: 那位年長紳士感謝學生幫忙提袋子。

genuine.en: The researcher looked for genuine patterns rather than random differences.
genuine.zh: 研究人員尋找真正的規律，而不是隨機差異。

geographical.en: The map shows geographical differences between coastal and mountain regions.
geographical.zh: 這張地圖顯示沿海與山區之間的地理差異。

geography.en: Geography helps students understand how people interact with different environments.
geography.zh: 地理幫助學生了解人類如何與不同環境互動。

geometry.en: Geometry helps students understand shapes, angles, and spatial relationships.
geometry.zh: 幾何幫助學生理解形狀、角度與空間關係。

germ.en: Washing your hands can reduce the spread of each harmful germ.
germ.zh: 洗手可以減少每種有害病菌的傳播。

gesture.en: A simple gesture can sometimes communicate more than words.
gesture.zh: 一個簡單手勢有時比言語傳達得更多。

get.en: Students get better at writing when they practice regularly.
get.zh: 學生規律練習後，寫作能力會變得更好。

ghost.en: The story describes a friendly ghost living in an abandoned house.
ghost.zh: 故事描述一個住在廢棄房屋裡的友善鬼魂。

giant.en: A giant tree stood at the center of the old village square.
giant.zh: 一棵巨大的樹矗立在老村莊廣場中央。

gift.en: The class prepared a small gift for the retiring teacher.
gift.zh: 全班為即將退休的老師準備了一份小禮物。

gifted.en: The gifted student also worked hard to improve weak areas.
gifted.zh: 這位有天分的學生也努力改善自己的弱項。

gigantic.en: A gigantic screen displayed the results during the school festival.
gigantic.zh: 校慶期間，一面巨大的螢幕顯示活動結果。

giggle.en: Several students began to giggle when the teacher told a joke.
giggle.zh: 老師講笑話時，幾位學生開始咯咯笑。

ginger.en: She added a small piece of ginger to the warm tea.
ginger.zh: 她在熱茶裡加入一小片薑。

giraffe.en: A giraffe can reach leaves growing high above many other animals.
giraffe.zh: 長頸鹿能吃到比許多其他動物更高處的葉子。

girl.en: The girl asked a thoughtful question during the science lesson.
girl.zh: 那個女孩在自然課提出了一個有深度的問題。

give.en: Please give one reason to support your answer.
give.zh: 請提供一個理由來支持你的答案。

glacier.en: The glacier has become smaller as average temperatures have risen.
glacier.zh: 隨著平均氣溫上升，這座冰河已經縮小。

glad.en: I am glad that we finished the project before the deadline.
glad.zh: 我很高興我們在期限前完成了專題。

glamorous.en: The job looked glamorous from outside but required long hours of preparation.
glamorous.zh: 這份工作從外表看很光鮮，但需要長時間準備。

glamour.en: The documentary looks beyond the glamour of the fashion industry.
glamour.zh: 這部紀錄片探討時尚產業光鮮亮麗表面之外的一面。

glance.en: She took a quick glance at the schedule before leaving the classroom.
glance.zh: 離開教室前，她快速看了一眼行程表。

glare.en: The glare from the screen made the text difficult to read.
glare.zh: 螢幕反光讓文字變得難以閱讀。

glass.en: The laboratory uses thick glass containers for this experiment.
glass.zh: 實驗室在這項實驗中使用厚玻璃容器。

glasses.en: He cleaned his glasses before reading the small print on the chart.
glasses.zh: 他在閱讀圖表上的小字前先擦乾淨眼鏡。

gleam.en: A faint gleam of sunlight appeared through the clouds after the storm.
gleam.zh: 暴風雨過後，一絲微弱陽光穿過雲層。

glide.en: The bird seemed to glide smoothly above the lake without effort.
glide.zh: 那隻鳥似乎毫不費力地在湖面上方平穩滑翔。

glimpse.en: We caught a brief glimpse of the mountain before clouds covered it.
glimpse.zh: 雲層遮住山峰前，我們短暫瞥見了它。

glitter.en: Tiny drops of rain began to glitter in the afternoon sunlight.
glitter.zh: 細小雨滴開始在午後陽光下閃閃發亮。

global.en: Climate change is a global issue that affects every region.
global.zh: 氣候變遷是影響各地區的全球性議題。

globe.en: The teacher used a globe to explain the location of major oceans.
globe.zh: 老師用地球儀說明主要海洋的位置。

gloom.en: A sense of gloom disappeared when the team finally solved the problem.
gloom.zh: 當團隊終於解決問題時，低落的氣氛消散了。

gloomy.en: The morning looked gloomy, but the sky cleared before lunch.
gloomy.zh: 早晨看起來陰沉，但中午前天空就放晴了。

glorious.en: We enjoyed a glorious sunset after reaching the top of the hill.
glorious.zh: 我們登上山頂後欣賞到壯麗的夕陽。

glory.en: The athlete cared more about teamwork than personal glory after the match.
glory.zh: 比賽後，那位運動員更重視團隊合作，而不是個人榮耀。

glove.en: Wear a glove when handling materials that may irritate the skin.
glove.zh: 處理可能刺激皮膚的材料時要戴手套。

glow.en: The lamps began to glow softly as evening settled over the park.
glow.zh: 傍晚降臨公園時，燈光開始柔和地發亮。

glue.en: Use a small amount of glue to attach the paper to the board.
glue.zh: 用少量膠水把紙黏到板子上。

go.en: We plan to go to the museum after lunch.
go.zh: 我們計畫午餐後去博物館。

goal.en: Setting a clear goal can make study plans more effective.
goal.zh: 設定明確目標能讓讀書計畫更有效。

goalkeeper.en: The goalkeeper caught the ball before it crossed the goal line.
goalkeeper.zh: 守門員在球越過球門線前把球接住了。

goat.en: A young goat climbed onto a rock beside the farm fence.
goat.zh: 一隻小山羊爬上農場圍欄旁的岩石。

god.en: The novel describes how people once believed each god controlled part of nature.
god.zh: 這部小說描述古人如何相信每位神祇掌管自然的一部分。

goddess.en: The museum displayed an ancient statue of a goddess from local mythology.
goddess.zh: 博物館展出一尊來自當地神話的古代女神雕像。

gold.en: The museum displayed a small gold object from ancient times.
gold.zh: 博物館展示了一件古代的小型金製品。

golden.en: The field turned golden under the warm light of the setting sun.
golden.zh: 田野在夕陽溫暖的光線下變成金黃色。

golf.en: She learned the basic rules of golf during a school sports camp.
golf.zh: 她在學校運動營學會了高爾夫球的基本規則。

good.en: Good preparation can reduce stress before an important exam.
good.zh: 充分準備可以減少重要考試前的壓力。

goodbye.en: We said goodbye to our exchange students after the final class.
goodbye.zh: 最後一堂課後，我們向交換學生道別。

goods.en: The market sells locally made goods to visitors throughout the year.
goods.zh: 這個市場全年向遊客販售當地製作的商品。

goodwill.en: The project created goodwill between the school and the surrounding community.
goodwill.zh: 這項計畫促進了學校與周邊社區之間的善意。

goose.en: A goose stood near the pond while its young followed closely behind.
goose.zh: 一隻鵝站在池塘旁，幼鵝緊跟在後面。

gorgeous.en: The photographer captured a gorgeous view of the mountains after the rain.
gorgeous.zh: 攝影師拍下雨後山區的美麗景色。

gorilla.en: The documentary followed a gorilla family living in a protected forest.
gorilla.zh: 這部紀錄片跟拍一個生活在保護森林中的大猩猩家庭。

gospel.en: The class discussed how gospel music influenced several modern musical styles.
gospel.zh: 課堂討論福音音樂如何影響多種現代音樂風格。

gossip.en: Spreading gossip can damage trust even when the story seems harmless.
gossip.zh: 散播八卦即使看似無害，也可能破壞信任。

govern.en: Clear laws help govern how public institutions make important decisions.
govern.zh: 清楚的法律有助於規範公共機構如何做重要決策。

government.en: The government announced new measures to improve public transportation.
government.zh: 政府宣布了改善大眾運輸的新措施。

governor.en: The governor visited the region to discuss transportation and education plans.
governor.zh: 州長造訪該地區，討論交通與教育計畫。

gown.en: The graduate adjusted her gown before walking onto the stage.
gown.zh: 畢業生走上舞台前整理好自己的畢業袍。

grab.en: He had to grab the railing when the bus stopped suddenly.
grab.zh: 公車突然停下時，他不得不抓住扶手。

grace.en: The dancer moved across the stage with impressive grace and control.
grace.zh: 舞者以令人印象深刻的優雅與控制力在舞台上移動。

graceful.en: The swan made a graceful turn as it moved across the lake.
graceful.zh: 天鵝在湖面前進時優雅地轉了個彎。

gracious.en: Our host was gracious and made every visitor feel welcome.
gracious.zh: 主人十分親切有禮，讓每位訪客都感到受歡迎。

grade.en: Her grade improved after she changed her study habits.
grade.zh: 她改變讀書習慣後，成績進步了。

gradual.en: The graph shows a gradual increase in temperature during the afternoon.
gradual.zh: 圖表顯示下午氣溫逐漸上升。

graduate.en: She hopes to graduate with strong skills in science and English.
graduate.zh: 她希望畢業時具備扎實的科學與英文能力。

graduation.en: The school held its graduation ceremony in the auditorium on Friday.
graduation.zh: 學校星期五在禮堂舉行畢業典禮。

grain.en: Farmers store dry grain in large containers after harvest.
grain.zh: 農民收成後把乾燥穀物存放在大型容器中。

gram.en: The science activity required exactly one gram of salt for each sample.
gram.zh: 這項科學活動每個樣本都需要正好一公克的鹽。

grammar.en: Good grammar helps make your writing easier to understand.
grammar.zh: 良好的文法能讓文章更容易理解。

grammatical.en: The teacher explained why the sentence was grammatical but still sounded unnatural.
grammatical.zh: 老師解釋那個句子為何文法正確，卻仍聽起來不自然。

grand.en: The old theater has a grand entrance with tall stone columns.
grand.zh: 那座老劇院有一個帶著高大石柱的宏偉入口。

grandfather.en: My grandfather enjoys telling stories about his school days.
grandfather.zh: 我祖父喜歡講他學生時代的故事。

grandmother.en: My grandmother taught me how to prepare this traditional dish.
grandmother.zh: 我祖母教我如何準備這道傳統料理。

grant.en: The university offered a grant to support the research project.
grant.zh: 大學提供一筆補助金支持這項研究。

grape.en: She placed a grape beside each cheese cube on the plate.
grape.zh: 她在盤中每塊起司旁放了一顆葡萄。

grapefruit.en: A grapefruit has a stronger bitter taste than many other citrus fruits.
grapefruit.zh: 葡萄柚比許多其他柑橘類水果有更明顯的苦味。

graph.en: The graph shows how average temperature changed over the past decade.
graph.zh: 這張圖表顯示過去十年平均溫度如何變化。

graphic.en: The report includes a graphic that summarizes the survey results clearly.
graphic.zh: 報告包含一張清楚整理調查結果的圖像。

grasp.en: A strong grasp of basic algebra makes later lessons much easier.
grasp.zh: 扎實掌握基礎代數會讓之後的課程容易許多。

grass.en: The grass grew quickly after several days of rain.
grass.zh: 連續幾天下雨後，草長得很快。

grasshopper.en: A grasshopper jumped from the path into the tall grass nearby.
grasshopper.zh: 一隻蚱蜢從小徑跳進附近的高草叢。

grassy.en: The students sat on a grassy slope during the outdoor lesson.
grassy.zh: 學生在戶外課程中坐在一個長滿草的斜坡上。

grateful.en: I am grateful for the classmates who helped me finish the project.
grateful.zh: 我很感激幫助我完成專題的同學。

gratitude.en: She expressed gratitude to the volunteers who organized the community event.
gratitude.zh: 她向籌辦社區活動的志工表達感謝。

grave.en: The report described the water shortage as a grave environmental concern.
grave.zh: 報告把缺水形容為嚴重的環境問題。

gravity.en: The experiment demonstrates how gravity pulls objects toward the ground.
gravity.zh: 這項實驗示範重力如何把物體拉向地面。

gray.en: Dark clouds turned the afternoon sky a deep gray before the storm.
gray.zh: 暴風雨前，烏雲把午後天空染成深灰色。

graze.en: Several sheep graze quietly in the field behind the farmhouse.
graze.zh: 幾隻羊安靜地在農舍後方的田地吃草。

grease.en: The mechanic wiped grease from the metal surface before checking it.
grease.zh: 技師檢查前先擦掉金屬表面的油脂。

greasy.en: The paper became greasy after it touched the fried food.
greasy.zh: 那張紙碰到油炸食物後變得油膩。

great.en: The new library is a great place for quiet study.
great.zh: 新圖書館是安靜讀書的好地方。

greed.en: The novel shows how greed can damage friendships and family relationships.
greed.zh: 這本小說呈現貪婪如何破壞友情與家庭關係。

greedy.en: The story warns that a greedy character may lose what matters most.
greedy.zh: 故事提醒人們，貪心的角色可能失去最重要的事物。

green.en: The school added more green spaces around the campus.
green.zh: 學校在校園周圍增加了更多綠地。

greenhouse.en: The school greenhouse allows students to grow vegetables during cooler months.
greenhouse.zh: 學校溫室讓學生能在較冷的月份種植蔬菜。

greet.en: Students stood at the entrance to greet visiting teachers.
greet.zh: 學生站在入口迎接來訪教師。

greeting.en: Her warm greeting helped the new student feel less nervous.
greeting.zh: 她溫暖的問候讓新同學感到沒那麼緊張。

grief.en: The novel explores how a family learns to live with grief.
grief.zh: 這本小說探討一個家庭如何學著面對悲傷。

grieve.en: People may grieve in different ways after losing someone important.
grieve.zh: 失去重要的人之後，每個人可能用不同方式哀傷。

grill.en: We used the outdoor grill to cook vegetables during the picnic.
grill.zh: 野餐時，我們用戶外烤架烤蔬菜。

grim.en: The forecast looked grim, but the storm changed direction overnight.
grim.zh: 預報看起來不樂觀，但暴風雨一夜之間改變了方向。

grin.en: A wide grin appeared on his face when the results were announced.
grin.zh: 結果公布時，他臉上露出大大的笑容。

grind.en: The machine can grind roasted beans into a fine powder quickly.
grind.zh: 這台機器可以快速把烘焙豆磨成細粉。

grip.en: She tightened her grip on the umbrella as the wind grew stronger.
grip.zh: 風變強時，她把雨傘握得更緊。

groan.en: The old door gave a soft groan when it slowly opened.
groan.zh: 那扇老門慢慢打開時發出低沉的嘎吱聲。

grocery.en: The grocery store added a section for locally grown vegetables.
grocery.zh: 這家雜貨店新增了一區販售在地種植的蔬菜。

groom.en: The groom thanked the guests before the celebration began.
groom.zh: 慶祝活動開始前，新郎向賓客致謝。

gross.en: The company reported its gross income before subtracting operating costs.
gross.zh: 公司先公布總收入，再扣除營運成本。

ground.en: The heavy box was placed carefully on the ground.
ground.zh: 那個沉重的箱子被小心放到地上。

group.en: Each group must present its findings to the class.
group.zh: 每個小組都必須向全班報告研究結果。

grow.en: Plants grow faster when they receive enough light and water.
grow.zh: 植物得到足夠陽光和水分時會長得更快。

growl.en: We heard a low growl from the dog behind the fence.
growl.zh: 我們聽到圍欄後的狗發出低沉吼聲。

growth.en: The chart shows steady growth in online learning over five years.
growth.zh: 圖表顯示線上學習在五年間穩定成長。

grumble.en: Some students grumble about homework but still complete it on time.
grumble.zh: 有些學生會抱怨作業，但仍會準時完成。

guarantee.en: Careful planning cannot guarantee success, but it can reduce mistakes.
guarantee.zh: 仔細規劃無法保證成功，但能減少錯誤。

guard.en: A security guard stood near the entrance during the evening event.
guard.zh: 晚間活動期間，一名警衛站在入口附近。

guardian.en: A parent or guardian must sign the permission form before Friday.
guardian.zh: 家長或監護人必須在星期五前簽署同意書。

guava.en: The fruit stand sells fresh guava along with bananas and oranges.
guava.zh: 水果攤販售新鮮芭樂，也有香蕉和柳橙。

guess.en: Try to guess the word's meaning from the surrounding sentence.
guess.zh: 試著從周圍句子猜出這個單字的意思。

guest.en: A guest speaker will visit our class next Monday.
guest.zh: 下星期一會有一位客座講者來我們班。

guidance.en: The counselor offered guidance about choosing subjects for next semester.
guidance.zh: 輔導老師提供下學期選課方面的建議。

guide.en: The guide explained the history of the old building clearly.
guide.zh: 導覽員清楚介紹了這棟老建築的歷史。

guideline.en: Each guideline explains one rule for writing the research report.
guideline.zh: 每一項指引都說明撰寫研究報告的一條規則。

guilt.en: He felt guilt after realizing his careless comment had hurt a friend.
guilt.zh: 他發現自己無心的話傷害朋友後感到內疚。

guilty.en: The court found the defendant guilty after reviewing the evidence.
guilty.zh: 法院審查證據後判定被告有罪。

guitar.en: She practices guitar for thirty minutes after finishing her homework.
guitar.zh: 她寫完作業後會練三十分鐘吉他。

gulf.en: The discussion revealed a wide gulf between the two proposed solutions.
gulf.zh: 討論顯示兩個提案之間有很大的差距。

gull.en: A gull circled above the harbor before landing near the pier.
gull.zh: 一隻海鷗在港口上空盤旋後降落在碼頭附近。

gum.en: Please throw your gum away before entering the science laboratory.
gum.zh: 進入科學實驗室前請把口香糖丟掉。

gut.en: The article explains how the gut contains many kinds of helpful bacteria.
gut.zh: 文章說明腸道中含有許多種類的有益細菌。

guy.en: The guy at the information desk showed us where to go.
guy.zh: 服務台的那位先生告訴我們該往哪裡走。

gym.en: The basketball team practices in the gym every Tuesday afternoon.
gym.zh: 籃球隊每週二下午都在體育館練習。

gymnasium.en: The school gymnasium can hold several hundred people during large events.
gymnasium.zh: 學校體育館在大型活動時可容納數百人。

habit.en: Reading every day can become a useful study habit.
habit.zh: 每天閱讀可以成為有用的學習習慣。

habitat.en: Wetlands provide an important habitat for birds, insects, and many other animals.
habitat.zh: 濕地為鳥類、昆蟲和許多其他動物提供重要棲地。

habitual.en: Habitual late arrivals can make group projects harder to organize effectively.
habitual.zh: 習慣性遲到會讓小組專題更難有效安排。

hacker.en: The article explains how an ethical hacker can help improve computer security.
hacker.zh: 這篇文章說明道德駭客如何協助改善電腦安全。

hail.en: Small pieces of hail covered the playground after the sudden afternoon storm.
hail.zh: 午後突來的暴風雨後，小塊冰雹覆蓋了操場。

hair.en: Her hair was still wet after swimming practice.
hair.zh: 游泳練習後，她的頭髮還是濕的。

haircut.en: He got a haircut before the school ceremony on Friday afternoon.
haircut.zh: 他在星期五下午的學校典禮前剪了頭髮。

hairdresser.en: The hairdresser asked what style would be practical for everyday school life.
hairdresser.zh: 髮型師詢問哪種髮型最適合日常校園生活。

half.en: Only half of the students finished the task on time.
half.zh: 只有一半學生準時完成任務。

hall.en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main hall.
hall.zh: 畢業典禮會在大禮堂舉行。

hallway.en: Students displayed their science posters along the hallway outside the library.
hallway.zh: 學生把科學海報展示在圖書館外的走廊上。

halt.en: Heavy rain forced the outdoor rehearsal to halt for nearly an hour.
halt.zh: 大雨迫使戶外彩排暫停將近一小時。

ham.en: The sandwich contained ham, lettuce, tomato, and a slice of cheese.
ham.zh: 這份三明治裡有火腿、生菜、番茄和一片起司。

hamburger.en: She ordered a hamburger with salad during the class trip lunch break.
hamburger.zh: 班級旅行午餐休息時，她點了一個漢堡配沙拉。

hammer.en: The workshop keeps each hammer in a labeled drawer after class.
hammer.zh: 工作坊下課後會把每支鐵鎚收在有標籤的抽屜裡。

hamper.en: Poor communication can hamper progress even when every team member works hard.
hamper.zh: 即使每位組員都很努力，溝通不良仍可能妨礙進度。

hand.en: Please raise your hand if you know the answer.
hand.zh: 如果你知道答案，請舉手。

handful.en: Only a handful of students stayed after class to finish the display.
handful.zh: 只有少數學生下課後留下來完成展示。

handicap.en: The old rule created an unnecessary handicap for smaller teams in the contest.
handicap.zh: 舊規則讓較小的隊伍在比賽中承受不必要的不利條件。

handicraft.en: The cultural fair included a handicraft workshop using paper and natural materials.
handicraft.zh: 文化市集包含一場使用紙張與天然材料的手工藝工作坊。

handkerchief.en: A clean handkerchief was folded neatly inside the costume pocket.
handkerchief.zh: 一條乾淨的手帕整齊摺好放在戲服口袋裡。

handle.en: Students must handle laboratory equipment with great care.
handle.zh: 學生操作實驗室設備時必須非常小心。

handwriting.en: Clear handwriting makes written answers easier for teachers to read accurately.
handwriting.zh: 清楚的筆跡能讓老師更容易正確閱讀作答內容。

handy.en: A small notebook is handy for recording new vocabulary during class.
handy.zh: 小筆記本很方便，可以在上課時記下新單字。

hang.en: Please hang your wet raincoat near the door before entering the classroom.
hang.zh: 進教室前，請把濕雨衣掛在門邊。

hanger.en: Each costume was placed on a hanger with the actor's name attached.
hanger.zh: 每套戲服都掛在衣架上，並附上演員姓名。

happen.en: Unexpected problems can happen even with careful planning.
happen.zh: 即使仔細規劃，仍可能發生意外問題。

happy.en: She felt happy after completing the difficult assignment.
happy.zh: 完成困難的作業後，她感到很開心。

harass.en: School rules clearly state that students must never harass or threaten others.
harass.zh: 校規明確規定學生不得騷擾或威脅他人。

harassment.en: The school provides several ways for students to report harassment safely.
harassment.zh: 學校提供多種方式，讓學生能安全通報騷擾事件。

harbor.en: Fishing boats returned to the harbor before the weather became worse.
harbor.zh: 天氣惡化前，漁船回到了港口。

hard.en: The team worked hard to finish the project before Friday.
hard.zh: 團隊努力工作，在星期五前完成專題。

harden.en: The clay will harden after it dries completely in a warm room.
harden.zh: 黏土在溫暖房間裡完全乾燥後會變硬。

hardly.en: I could hardly hear the speaker because the room was noisy.
hardly.zh: 房間太吵，我幾乎聽不到講者說話。

hardship.en: The novel follows a family that stays hopeful despite years of hardship.
hardship.zh: 這本小說描寫一個家庭即使多年面臨困境仍保持希望。

hardware.en: The computer club upgraded its hardware before starting the new project.
hardware.zh: 電腦社在開始新專題前升級了硬體設備。

harm.en: Too much noise can harm concentration during study.
harm.zh: 過多噪音會傷害讀書時的專注力。

harmful.en: Some chemicals are harmful if they enter the water supply.
harmful.zh: 有些化學物質若進入供水系統會造成危害。

harmonica.en: He learned a simple song on the harmonica during music class.
harmonica.zh: 他在音樂課用口琴學會了一首簡單的曲子。

harmony.en: The choir practiced until every voice blended together in harmony.
harmony.zh: 合唱團持續練習，直到每個聲部和諧融合。

harness.en: Engineers hope to harness wind power more efficiently in coastal areas.
harness.zh: 工程師希望在沿海地區更有效率地利用風力。

harsh.en: The harsh winter damaged several young trees in the school garden.
harsh.zh: 嚴酷的冬天傷害了學校花園裡幾棵幼樹。

harvest.en: Farmers began the rice harvest after several weeks of dry weather.
harvest.zh: 連續幾週乾燥天氣後，農民開始收割稻米。

haste.en: In his haste, he forgot to check the final page of the test.
haste.zh: 他因為匆忙，忘了檢查考卷最後一頁。

hasten.en: Warmer temperatures can hasten the melting of mountain snow in spring.
hasten.zh: 較高的溫度可能加速春季山區積雪融化。

hasty.en: A hasty decision may create more problems than it solves.
hasty.zh: 匆促的決定可能製造比解決更多的問題。

hat.en: He wore a hat to protect himself from the strong sun.
hat.zh: 他戴帽子來避免強烈陽光直射。

hatch.en: The eggs usually hatch after several weeks in a warm nest.
hatch.zh: 這些蛋通常會在溫暖巢中數週後孵化。

hate.en: I hate wasting time when a problem can be solved simply.
hate.zh: 如果問題可以簡單解決，我很討厭浪費時間。

hateful.en: The teacher reminded everyone that hateful language can seriously harm others.
hateful.zh: 老師提醒大家，充滿仇恨的言語可能嚴重傷害他人。

hatred.en: The novel shows how hatred can divide communities for many years.
hatred.zh: 這本小說呈現仇恨如何讓社群分裂多年。

haul.en: Workers used a cart to haul boxes across the large warehouse.
haul.zh: 工作人員用推車把箱子運過大型倉庫。

haunt.en: Memories of the difficult season continued to haunt the team for months.
haunt.zh: 那段艱難賽季的記憶持續困擾團隊好幾個月。

have.en: We have enough information to begin the next stage.
have.zh: 我們已經有足夠資訊可以開始下一階段。

hawk.en: A hawk circled high above the field while we watched quietly.
hawk.zh: 我們安靜觀看時，一隻鷹在田野上空盤旋。

hay.en: The farmer stored dry hay in the barn before the rainy season.
hay.zh: 農夫在雨季前把乾草存放在穀倉裡。

hazard.en: Loose cables on the floor can become a safety hazard in classrooms.
hazard.zh: 地板上鬆散的電線可能成為教室中的安全危險。

he.en: He checked the final answer twice before submitting the test.
he.zh: 他交卷前把最後答案檢查了兩次。

head.en: She turned her head when someone called her name.
head.zh: 有人叫她名字時，她轉過頭去。

headache.en: After reading for hours, he developed a mild headache and took a break.
headache.zh: 讀了幾個小時後，他有點頭痛，便休息了一下。

headline.en: The headline summarized the main point of the news article.
headline.zh: 標題概括了這篇新聞的重點。

headphone.en: One headphone stopped working during the listening practice in class.
headphone.zh: 課堂聽力練習時，其中一邊耳機突然不能用了。

headquarters.en: The organization moved its headquarters to a larger office near the station.
headquarters.zh: 該組織把總部搬到車站附近一間更大的辦公室。

heal.en: Small cuts usually heal over time when they are kept clean.
heal.zh: 小傷口保持清潔時，通常會隨時間癒合。

health.en: Regular sleep is important for both physical and mental health.
health.zh: 規律睡眠對身心健康都很重要。

healthful.en: The cafeteria added several healthful choices such as fruit and whole grains.
healthful.zh: 餐廳增加了水果與全穀物等健康選擇。

healthy.en: A healthy routine should include enough sleep and exercise.
healthy.zh: 健康的作息應包含充足睡眠與運動。

heap.en: A heap of fallen leaves collected beside the garden wall.
heap.zh: 一堆落葉聚集在花園牆邊。

hear.en: Could you speak louder so everyone can hear you?
hear.zh: 你可以說大聲一點，讓每個人都聽得到嗎？

heart.en: Exercise can help keep the heart strong and healthy.
heart.zh: 運動有助於維持心臟強健與健康。

hearty.en: We ate a hearty breakfast before beginning the long morning hike.
hearty.zh: 開始漫長的上午健行前，我們吃了一頓豐盛早餐。

heat.en: Dark surfaces absorb more heat under direct sunlight.
heat.zh: 深色表面在陽光直射下會吸收更多熱能。

heater.en: The classroom heater was turned on before students arrived that morning.
heater.zh: 那天早上學生到校前，教室暖氣就先開啟了。

heaven.en: The poem uses heaven as a symbol of peace and hope.
heaven.zh: 這首詩以天堂象徵和平與希望。

heavy.en: The heavy rain caused flooding in several low areas.
heavy.zh: 大雨造成幾個低窪地區淹水。

hedge.en: A tall hedge separates the school garden from the parking area.
hedge.zh: 一排高樹籬把學校花園和停車區隔開。

heel.en: The back of the shoe rubbed against his heel during the walk.
heel.zh: 走路時，鞋子後方摩擦到他的腳跟。

height.en: The students measured the height of each plant every week.
height.zh: 學生每週測量每株植物的高度。

heighten.en: Bright lighting can heighten the contrast between colors in a photograph.
heighten.zh: 明亮的光線可以提高照片中顏色之間的對比。

heir.en: The novel follows an heir who must decide how to manage the family estate.
heir.zh: 這本小說描述一位繼承人如何決定管理家族產業。

helicopter.en: A rescue helicopter flew over the valley during the training exercise.
helicopter.zh: 救援直升機在訓練演習期間飛越山谷。

hello.en: She smiled and said hello to the new student beside her.
hello.zh: 她微笑著向身旁的新同學說哈囉。

helmet.en: The cyclist checked that his helmet was secure before the race.
helmet.zh: 自行車手在比賽前確認安全帽已戴牢。

help.en: Clear notes can help you review more efficiently before exams.
help.zh: 清楚的筆記能幫助你在考前更有效率地複習。

helpful.en: The teacher gave helpful feedback on my first draft.
helpful.zh: 老師針對我的初稿提供了有幫助的回饋。

hemisphere.en: Winter begins at different times in each hemisphere because of Earth's tilt.
hemisphere.zh: 因為地球傾斜，兩個半球的冬季開始時間不同。

hen.en: A hen led several chicks across the yard toward their shelter.
hen.zh: 一隻母雞帶著幾隻小雞穿過院子走向棚舍。

hence.en: The road was flooded, hence the school bus took another route.
hence.zh: 道路淹水，因此校車改走另一條路線。

her.en: The teacher returned her report with several useful comments.
her.zh: 老師把她的報告退回，並附上幾則實用評語。

herb.en: The cooking class used a fresh herb to add flavor to the soup.
herb.zh: 烹飪課用新鮮香草替湯增添風味。

herd.en: A herd of deer crossed the field just before sunset.
herd.zh: 日落前，一群鹿穿過田野。

here.en: Please write your name here before submitting the form.
here.zh: 提交表格前請在這裡寫上你的名字。

heritage.en: The festival celebrates the town's cultural heritage through music and food.
heritage.zh: 這個節慶透過音樂與食物慶祝城鎮的文化傳承。

hero.en: The novel's hero solves the mystery by carefully examining small clues.
hero.zh: 小說中的主角透過仔細觀察小線索解開謎團。

heroic.en: The article described the firefighters' rescue effort as truly heroic.
heroic.zh: 文章把消防員的救援行動形容為真正英勇。

heroine.en: The heroine of the story becomes more confident as the journey continues.
heroine.zh: 故事中的女主角隨著旅程進行變得更有自信。

hers.en: The blue notebook on the desk is hers, not mine.
hers.zh: 桌上的藍色筆記本是她的，不是我的。

herself.en: She taught herself basic coding by following several beginner lessons online.
herself.zh: 她透過幾堂線上入門課自學基礎程式設計。

hesitate.en: Do not hesitate to ask questions when the instructions are unclear.
hesitate.zh: 當說明不清楚時，不要猶豫，請直接提問。

hesitation.en: After a brief hesitation, he raised his hand and answered the question.
hesitation.zh: 短暫猶豫後，他舉手回答了問題。

hide.en: Thick clouds can hide the mountain peaks from view in winter.
hide.zh: 冬天厚重的雲層可能遮住山峰。

hierarchy.en: The diagram shows the hierarchy of roles within the organization.
hierarchy.zh: 這張圖顯示組織內各角色的層級關係。

high.en: The mountain road reaches a high point near the old temple.
high.zh: 這條山路在老廟附近到達較高的位置。

highlight.en: Use the final paragraph to highlight the main conclusion of your report.
highlight.zh: 請用最後一段凸顯報告的主要結論。

highly.en: This study method is highly effective for reviewing vocabulary.
highly.zh: 這種讀書方法對複習單字非常有效。

highway.en: The new highway reduced travel time between the two towns significantly.
highway.zh: 新公路大幅縮短了兩座城鎮之間的旅行時間。

hike.en: Our class planned a short hike along the forest trail on Saturday.
hike.zh: 我們班計畫星期六沿著森林步道健行一小段。

hill.en: We climbed the hill to get a better view of the city.
hill.zh: 我們爬上山丘，以便看見更好的城市景色。

him.en: The teacher asked him to explain how he solved the problem.
him.zh: 老師請他說明自己如何解決這個問題。

himself.en: He built the small model himself after studying the instructions carefully.
himself.zh: 他仔細研究說明後，自己完成了這個小模型。

hint.en: The teacher gave us a hint without revealing the final answer.
hint.zh: 老師給了我們一個提示，但沒有透露最後答案。

hip.en: The diagram shows how the hip connects the upper leg to the body.
hip.zh: 圖示說明髖部如何連接大腿與身體。

hippo.en: The zoo's hippo spent most of the afternoon resting in the water.
hippo.zh: 動物園的河馬下午大部分時間都在水中休息。

hippopotamus.en: A hippopotamus can spend many hours in water during hot weather.
hippopotamus.zh: 天氣炎熱時，河馬可以在水中待上好幾個小時。

hire.en: The company plans to hire more interns for the summer research program.
hire.zh: 公司計畫為暑期研究計畫聘用更多實習生。

his.en: His explanation was clear enough for everyone to understand.
his.zh: 他的解釋很清楚，大家都能理解。

historian.en: A local historian explained how the railway changed the town's economy.
historian.zh: 一位地方歷史學家解釋鐵路如何改變城鎮經濟。

historic.en: The city is restoring a historic building near the old railway station.
historic.zh: 市政府正在修復舊火車站附近的一棟歷史建築。

historical.en: The class visited a historical building that was over one hundred years old.
historical.zh: 全班參觀了一棟有百年以上歷史的建築。

history.en: History helps us understand how societies change over time.
history.zh: 歷史幫助我們了解社會如何隨時間改變。

hit.en: The ball hit the wall and bounced back toward us.
hit.zh: 球撞到牆後彈回我們這邊。

hive.en: The beekeeper checked the hive carefully without disturbing the bees.
hive.zh: 養蜂人仔細檢查蜂巢，避免驚擾蜜蜂。

hoarse.en: His voice became hoarse after cheering loudly throughout the game.
hoarse.zh: 他整場比賽大聲加油後，聲音變得沙啞。

hobby.en: Photography became her favorite hobby after she joined the school club.
hobby.zh: 加入學校社團後，攝影成了她最喜歡的興趣。

hockey.en: The students watched a hockey match to learn more about the sport.
hockey.zh: 學生觀看一場冰上曲棍球比賽，以了解這項運動。

hold.en: The school will hold a science fair next month.
hold.zh: 學校下個月會舉辦科展。

holder.en: The ticket holder must show identification before entering the event area.
holder.zh: 持票人進入活動區前必須出示身分證明。

hole.en: The workers repaired a large hole in the road.
hole.zh: 工人修補了道路上的一個大洞。

holiday.en: We visited our relatives during the long holiday.
holiday.zh: 我們在長假期間拜訪了親戚。

hollow.en: The old tree had a hollow trunk where small animals could shelter.
hollow.zh: 那棵老樹的樹幹中空，小動物可以在裡面躲藏。

holy.en: The temple is considered a holy place by many local residents.
holy.zh: 許多當地居民把這座寺廟視為神聖之地。

home.en: I reviewed my notes at home after school.
home.zh: 放學後我在家複習筆記。

homeland.en: The author often wrote about memories of her homeland in later essays.
homeland.zh: 作者在後期文章中常寫到對故鄉的回憶。

homesick.en: He felt homesick during his first week at the summer program.
homesick.zh: 參加暑期課程的第一週，他感到想家。

hometown.en: She returned to her hometown during the holiday to visit relatives.
hometown.zh: 假期期間，她回到家鄉探望親戚。

homework.en: She finished her homework before joining the online study group that evening.
homework.zh: 她當晚加入線上讀書會前先完成了作業。

honest.en: An honest answer is more useful than pretending to understand the question.
honest.zh: 誠實的回答比假裝懂題目更有幫助。

honesty.en: The teacher praised his honesty when he admitted making a mistake.
honesty.zh: 他承認犯錯時，老師肯定了他的誠實。

honey.en: A spoonful of honey gave the plain yogurt a mild sweetness.
honey.zh: 一匙蜂蜜讓原味優格多了一點溫和甜味。

honeymoon.en: The travel article described a quiet island popular with honeymoon visitors.
honeymoon.zh: 這篇旅遊文章介紹一座很受蜜月旅客歡迎的安靜島嶼。

honor.en: It was an honor for the student team to represent their school.
honor.zh: 能代表學校參賽，對學生團隊來說是一項榮譽。

honorable.en: The judges praised her honorable decision to report the scoring error.
honorable.zh: 評審稱讚她主動回報計分錯誤的正直決定。

honorary.en: The university awarded an honorary degree to the respected scientist.
honorary.zh: 大學授予那位受敬重的科學家榮譽學位。

hook.en: The teacher used a question as a hook to begin the lesson.
hook.zh: 老師用一個問題作為引子開始這堂課。

hop.en: The small bird made one quick hop across the garden path.
hop.zh: 那隻小鳥在花園小徑上快速跳了一下。

hope.en: We hope the weather will improve before the trip.
hope.zh: 我們希望旅行前天氣會好轉。

hopeful.en: The team remained hopeful after seeing steady improvement during practice.
hopeful.zh: 看到練習成果穩定進步後，團隊仍然充滿希望。

horizon.en: Dark clouds appeared on the horizon shortly before the evening storm.
horizon.zh: 傍晚暴風雨前不久，地平線上出現了烏雲。

horizontal.en: Draw a horizontal line across the graph at the value of ten.
horizontal.zh: 請在圖表數值十的位置畫一條水平線。

hormone.en: The biology lesson explained how a hormone can carry signals through the body.
hormone.zh: 生物課說明荷爾蒙如何在體內傳遞訊號。

horn.en: The driver used the horn briefly to warn people near the crossing.
horn.zh: 駕駛短按喇叭，提醒平交道附近的人注意。

horrible.en: The weather was horrible, so the field trip moved to an indoor museum.
horrible.zh: 天氣很糟，因此戶外校外教學改到室內博物館。

horrify.en: The documentary did not aim to horrify viewers but to explain the disaster calmly.
horrify.zh: 這部紀錄片不是要嚇壞觀眾，而是冷靜說明那場災難。

horror.en: She prefers mystery stories to horror because they feel less intense.
horror.zh: 她比較喜歡推理故事而不是恐怖故事，因為感覺沒那麼刺激。

horse.en: A horse stood quietly beside the fence while visitors took photos.
horse.zh: 遊客拍照時，一匹馬安靜站在圍欄旁。

hose.en: The gardener used a hose to water the plants behind the greenhouse.
hose.zh: 園丁用水管澆溫室後方的植物。

hospitable.en: The host family was hospitable and helped the exchange student feel comfortable.
hospitable.zh: 接待家庭非常好客，讓交換學生感到自在。

hospital.en: The new hospital provides emergency care around the clock.
hospital.zh: 這家新醫院全天候提供急診照護。

hospitality.en: The visitors appreciated the warm hospitality they received during the cultural exchange.
hospitality.zh: 訪客很感謝文化交流期間受到的熱情款待。

hospitalize.en: Doctors may hospitalize a patient when close medical observation is necessary.
hospitalize.zh: 需要密切醫療觀察時，醫師可能會安排病人住院。

host.en: Our class will host a small exhibition for parents next Friday.
host.zh: 我們班下週五將舉辦一場給家長參觀的小型展覽。

hostage.en: The history lesson discussed how negotiators worked to protect each hostage.
hostage.zh: 歷史課討論談判人員如何努力保護每一名人質。

hostel.en: The student hostel has a shared kitchen and a quiet reading room.
hostel.zh: 學生旅舍有共用廚房和安靜的閱覽室。

hostess.en: The hostess welcomed each guest and showed them to their seats.
hostess.zh: 女主人迎接每位賓客並帶他們入座。

hostile.en: A hostile tone can make a simple disagreement much harder to resolve.
hostile.zh: 敵對的語氣會讓簡單的意見不合更難解決。

hostility.en: The teacher encouraged calm discussion instead of hostility during the debate.
hostility.zh: 老師鼓勵辯論時冷靜討論，而不是彼此敵視。

hot.en: The classroom became too hot after the air conditioner stopped.
hot.zh: 冷氣停止運作後，教室變得太熱。

hotel.en: The hotel is within walking distance of the train station.
hotel.zh: 這家旅館距離火車站很近，走路可到。

hour.en: The meeting lasted for nearly an hour this afternoon.
hour.zh: 今天下午的會議持續了將近一小時。

hourly.en: The weather station records temperature changes on an hourly basis.
hourly.zh: 氣象站每小時記錄一次溫度變化。

house.en: The old house was renovated without changing its original style.
house.zh: 這棟老房子在保留原本風格的情況下完成整修。

household.en: The survey asked about average household energy use each month.
household.zh: 這份調查詢問每戶家庭每月的平均能源使用量。

housekeeper.en: The housekeeper left fresh towels outside the guest room that morning.
housekeeper.zh: 那天早上，房務人員把乾淨毛巾放在客房外。

housewife.en: The novel portrays a housewife who later starts a small business.
housewife.zh: 這本小說描寫一位後來創業的家庭主婦。

housework.en: Sharing housework fairly gives everyone more time for other responsibilities.
housework.zh: 公平分擔家務能讓每個人有更多時間處理其他責任。

housing.en: The report examines how public transportation affects access to affordable housing.
housing.zh: 這份報告探討大眾運輸如何影響平價住宅的可及性。

hover.en: A small drone seemed to hover above the field during the demonstration.
hover.zh: 示範活動時，一架小型無人機似乎停在球場上空。

how.en: The experiment shows how temperature affects the reaction speed.
how.zh: 這個實驗顯示溫度如何影響反應速度。

however.en: The first method was faster; however, the second was more accurate.
however.zh: 第一種方法較快；然而，第二種較準確。

howl.en: We could hear a distant dog howl across the valley at night.
howl.zh: 夜裡我們能聽見遠處山谷另一側的狗嚎聲。

hug.en: She gave her grandmother a warm hug after returning from the trip.
hug.zh: 旅行回來後，她給了奶奶一個溫暖的擁抱。

huge.en: The project required a huge amount of time and cooperation.
huge.zh: 這項專題需要大量時間與合作。

hum.en: The air conditioner began to hum softly during the quiet exam.
hum.zh: 安靜的考試期間，冷氣開始發出輕微嗡嗡聲。

human.en: The exhibition explores how human activity affects the natural environment.
human.zh: 這場展覽探討人類活動如何影響自然環境。

humanity.en: The exhibition explores how science has changed everyday life for humanity.
humanity.zh: 這場展覽探討科學如何改變全人類的日常生活。

humankind.en: The telescope helps scientists study questions about the future of humankind.
humankind.zh: 望遠鏡幫助科學家研究與人類未來有關的問題。

humble.en: Despite winning the contest, she remained humble and thanked her teammates.
humble.zh: 儘管贏得比賽，她仍保持謙虛並感謝隊友。

humid.en: The classroom felt humid after the rain because the windows were closed.
humid.zh: 下雨後因為窗戶關著，教室裡感覺很潮濕。

humidity.en: High humidity can make a warm afternoon feel even hotter outdoors.
humidity.zh: 高濕度會讓戶外溫暖的午後感覺更熱。

humiliate.en: Teachers should correct mistakes without trying to humiliate any student.
humiliate.zh: 老師應該糾正錯誤，但不應羞辱任何學生。

humor.en: A little humor can make a presentation more enjoyable for the audience.
humor.zh: 一點幽默可以讓報告對觀眾來說更有趣。

humorous.en: The speaker used a humorous story to make the difficult topic easier to follow.
humorous.zh: 講者用一個幽默故事讓困難主題更容易理解。

hunch.en: She had a hunch that the missing file had been saved elsewhere.
hunch.zh: 她直覺認為遺失的檔案可能被存到別處了。

hundred.en: More than one hundred students joined the school event.
hundred.zh: 超過一百名學生參加了學校活動。

hunger.en: The charity raises money to reduce hunger in low-income communities.
hunger.zh: 這個慈善組織募款以減少低收入社區的飢餓問題。

hungry.en: I felt hungry after practicing basketball for two hours.
hungry.zh: 打了兩小時籃球後，我覺得很餓。

hunt.en: The students had to hunt for reliable sources before writing the report.
hunt.zh: 學生在寫報告前必須尋找可靠資料來源。

hunter.en: The museum exhibit describes how an ancient hunter tracked animals for food.
hunter.zh: 博物館展覽介紹古代獵人如何追蹤動物以取得食物。

hurdle.en: Limited time was the biggest hurdle the team faced during the project.
hurdle.zh: 時間有限是團隊進行專題時面臨的最大障礙。

hurricane.en: The documentary explains how a hurricane gains energy over warm ocean water.
hurricane.zh: 這部紀錄片說明颶風如何從溫暖海水中獲得能量。

hurry.en: There is no need to hurry if we follow the schedule.
hurry.zh: 只要照著行程走，就不需要急。

hurt.en: She hurt her knee while running during sports practice.
hurt.zh: 她在體育練習跑步時傷到膝蓋。

husband.en: Her husband joined the family dinner after finishing work that evening.
husband.zh: 她的丈夫當晚下班後加入家庭晚餐。

hush.en: A sudden hush fell over the room when the results appeared onscreen.
hush.zh: 結果出現在螢幕上時，房間突然安靜下來。

hut.en: The hikers rested beside a small hut near the mountain trail.
hut.zh: 健行者在山徑旁的一間小屋附近休息。

hybrid.en: The school adopted a hybrid schedule combining classroom lessons with online activities.
hybrid.zh: 學校採用混合式課表，結合實體課程與線上活動。

hydrogen.en: Hydrogen is the lightest element listed on the periodic table.
hydrogen.zh: 氫是元素週期表中最輕的元素。

hygiene.en: Good hygiene practices help keep shared classrooms clean and comfortable.
hygiene.zh: 良好的衛生習慣有助於維持共用教室乾淨舒適。

hypocrite.en: The character fears being called a hypocrite for ignoring his own advice.
hypocrite.zh: 這個角色擔心自己不遵守自己的建議而被稱為偽君子。

hypothesis.en: The experiment was designed to test the students' original hypothesis.
hypothesis.zh: 這項實驗是為了驗證學生原先的假設。

i.en: The pronoun i is normally written as a capital letter in English.
i.zh: 英文代名詞 i 通常要寫成大寫字母。

ice.en: The ice melted quickly after we placed it in the sun.
ice.zh: 我們把冰放到陽光下後，它很快就融化了。

iceberg.en: Only part of an iceberg is visible above the ocean surface.
iceberg.zh: 冰山只有一部分會露在海面上。

icon.en: Tap the camera icon to open the photo section of the app.
icon.zh: 點一下相機圖示，就能開啟應用程式的照片區。

icy.en: The path became icy overnight, so visitors walked more carefully in the morning.
icy.zh: 小徑夜裡結冰，因此遊客早上走得更小心。

idea.en: Her idea helped the group solve the problem more efficiently.
idea.zh: 她的想法幫助小組更有效率地解決問題。

ideal.en: A quiet room is ideal for tasks that require deep concentration.
ideal.zh: 安靜的房間很適合需要高度專注的工作。

identical.en: The two samples looked identical but produced different results in the test.
identical.zh: 兩個樣本看起來完全相同，但測試結果不同。

identification.en: The field guide provides clear identification tips for common local birds.
identification.zh: 這本野外指南提供常見本地鳥類的清楚辨識技巧。

identify.en: Researchers identify several factors that may affect student performance.
identify.zh: 研究人員找出幾個可能影響學生表現的因素。

identity.en: The website asks users to confirm their identity before changing passwords.
identity.zh: 網站要求使用者在更改密碼前確認身分。

ideology.en: The history class compared how ideology influenced different political movements.
ideology.zh: 歷史課比較意識形態如何影響不同政治運動。

idiom.en: This English idiom makes more sense when you learn its cultural background.
idiom.zh: 了解文化背景後，這個英文慣用語會更容易理解。

idiot.en: Calling someone an idiot usually makes a disagreement more personal and less productive.
idiot.zh: 稱別人是笨蛋通常只會讓爭執更針對個人，也更難有結果。

idle.en: The old machine remained idle until the replacement part finally arrived.
idle.zh: 替換零件終於送到前，那台舊機器一直處於閒置狀態。

idol.en: The museum displayed a stone idol discovered near the ancient settlement.
idol.zh: 博物館展示一尊在古代聚落附近發現的石製偶像。

if.en: Use if to introduce a condition that may affect the final result.
if.zh: 可以使用 if 來引出可能影響最終結果的條件。

ignorance.en: The lesson shows how ignorance of basic facts can lead to poor decisions.
ignorance.zh: 這堂課說明缺乏基本事實知識可能導致不佳決策。

ignorant.en: It is better to ask questions than remain ignorant about an important issue.
ignorant.zh: 面對重要議題時，與其一無所知，不如主動提問。

ignore.en: Do not ignore small errors when checking your final report.
ignore.zh: 檢查最後報告時，不要忽略小錯誤。

ill.en: She stayed home because she felt ill in the morning.
ill.zh: 她早上覺得身體不舒服，所以待在家裡。

illuminate.en: Street lamps illuminate the path so pedestrians can see clearly at night.
illuminate.zh: 路燈照亮道路，讓行人在夜間能清楚看見。

illusion.en: The mirror creates an illusion that makes the narrow room look larger.
illusion.zh: 鏡子製造出一種錯覺，讓狹窄房間看起來更大。

illustrate.en: The chart helps illustrate how the population changed over time.
illustrate.zh: 這張圖表有助於說明人口如何隨時間變化。

illustration.en: The textbook includes an illustration of the human heart.
illustration.zh: 課本中有一張人體心臟的插圖。

image.en: The image shows how the coastline changed over several decades.
image.zh: 這張影像顯示海岸線在數十年間如何改變。

imaginary.en: The story follows an imaginary traveler exploring a city beneath the sea.
imaginary.zh: 這個故事描寫一位虛構旅人探索海底城市。

imagination.en: Creative writing gives students room to use imagination while practicing vocabulary.
imagination.zh: 創意寫作讓學生在練習單字時也能發揮想像力。

imaginative.en: Her imaginative solution turned ordinary recycled materials into a useful model.
imaginative.zh: 她富有想像力的解法把普通回收材料變成實用模型。

imagine.en: Imagine how different school would be without computers or the internet.
imagine.zh: 想像一下，如果沒有電腦或網路，學校會有多麼不同。

imitate.en: Young learners often imitate pronunciation they hear from teachers and recordings.
imitate.zh: 年輕學習者常會模仿從老師與錄音中聽到的發音。

imitation.en: The sculpture is an imitation of a much older work from another region.
imitation.zh: 這座雕塑是另一地區更古老作品的仿製品。

immediate.en: The school took immediate action after the water pipe broke.
immediate.zh: 水管破裂後，學校立刻採取行動。

immense.en: The telescope revealed an immense cloud of gas surrounding the distant star.
immense.zh: 望遠鏡顯示遙遠恆星周圍有一大片巨大的氣體雲。

immigrant.en: The novel tells the story of an immigrant adapting to a new community.
immigrant.zh: 這本小說講述一位移民適應新社區的故事。

immigrate.en: Some families immigrate for work, education, safety, or other personal reasons.
immigrate.zh: 有些家庭因工作、教育、安全或其他個人原因移居他國。

immigration.en: The report examines how immigration can influence population and labor markets.
immigration.zh: 這份報告探討移民如何影響人口與勞動市場。

imminent.en: Dark clouds and strong winds suggested that a storm was imminent.
imminent.zh: 烏雲和強風顯示暴風雨即將來臨。

immune.en: The science article explains how the immune system responds to certain infections.
immune.zh: 這篇科學文章說明免疫系統如何對某些感染作出反應。

impact.en: Regular exercise can have a positive impact on concentration.
impact.zh: 規律運動可以對專注力產生正面影響。

imperative.en: It is imperative that every team member understands the safety rules before the trip.
imperative.zh: 每位隊員在出發前都了解安全規則是非常重要的。

imperial.en: The museum displays several maps from the country's former imperial period.
imperial.zh: 博物館展示了數張來自該國昔日帝國時期的地圖。

implement.en: The school plans to implement the new recycling program next semester.
implement.zh: 學校計畫下學期實施新的回收方案。

implication.en: The report explains one important implication of the new environmental policy.
implication.zh: 這份報告說明了新環境政策的一項重要影響。

implicit.en: The passage contains an implicit message about personal responsibility.
implicit.zh: 這篇文章包含一個關於個人責任的隱含訊息。

imply.en: The results may imply that sleep affects learning efficiency.
imply.zh: 這些結果可能暗示睡眠會影響學習效率。

import.en: The company plans to import more recycled materials for its new products.
import.zh: 公司計畫為新產品進口更多再生材料。

importance.en: The teacher emphasized the importance of checking evidence before accepting a claim.
importance.zh: 老師強調在接受一項說法前查核證據的重要性。

important.en: It is important to check the source before trusting information online.
important.zh: 相信網路資訊前先查證來源很重要。

impose.en: The school may impose a limit on the number of participants.
impose.zh: 學校可能會限制參加人數。

imposing.en: The old courthouse is an imposing building with tall stone columns.
imposing.zh: 那座老法院是一棟有高大石柱、氣勢宏偉的建築。

impress.en: Her clear explanation managed to impress the entire class.
impress.zh: 她清楚的解釋讓全班留下深刻印象。

impression.en: Her clear explanation made a strong impression on the visiting judges.
impression.zh: 她清楚的說明給來訪的評審留下深刻印象。

impressive.en: The science club presented an impressive model of a solar-powered house.
impressive.zh: 科學社展示了一個令人印象深刻的太陽能住宅模型。

imprison.en: The novel describes a ruler who would imprison critics for speaking openly.
imprison.zh: 這本小說描述一位會因批評者公開發言而將其監禁的統治者。

imprisonment.en: The history lesson examined how unjust imprisonment affected several political movements.
imprisonment.zh: 歷史課探討不公正監禁如何影響數個政治運動。

improve.en: Daily reading can improve both vocabulary and reading speed.
improve.zh: 每天閱讀可以提升字彙量與閱讀速度。

improvement.en: The second draft showed clear improvement in organization and grammar.
improvement.zh: 第二版草稿在組織與文法方面有明顯進步。

impulse.en: He resisted the impulse to answer before reading the entire question carefully.
impulse.zh: 他忍住還沒仔細讀完整題目就作答的衝動。

in.en: Please place the completed worksheet in the blue folder.
in.zh: 請把完成的學習單放進藍色資料夾。

incentive.en: The school offered an incentive for classes that reduced waste.
incentive.zh: 學校為減少垃圾的班級提供獎勵。

inch.en: The plant grew nearly an inch after several days of warm weather.
inch.zh: 經過幾天溫暖天氣後，那株植物長高了將近一英吋。

incident.en: The school reviewed the incident before changing its safety rules.
incident.zh: 學校在修改安全規定前檢討了這起事件。

incline.en: The road begins to incline sharply near the top of the hill.
incline.zh: 道路接近山頂時開始明顯上坡。

include.en: The final report should include at least two reliable sources.
include.zh: 最後報告應至少包含兩個可靠來源。

including.en: Several students, including Mia, volunteered to organize the school book fair.
including.zh: 包括 Mia 在內的幾位學生自願籌辦校園書展。

inclusive.en: The club adopted an inclusive policy so more students could participate comfortably.
inclusive.zh: 社團採取包容性的政策，讓更多學生能自在參與。

income.en: The survey compares household income across different regions.
income.zh: 這份調查比較不同地區的家庭收入。

incorporate.en: The revised report will incorporate feedback from both teachers.
incorporate.zh: 修訂後的報告會納入兩位老師的回饋。

increase.en: Better lighting can increase comfort in the study area.
increase.zh: 更好的照明可以提升讀書區的舒適度。

incredible.en: The telescope provided an incredible view of the moon during the astronomy event.
incredible.zh: 望遠鏡在天文活動中提供了令人驚嘆的月球景象。

incur.en: Late changes may incur additional costs for the event organizers.
incur.zh: 臨時更動可能會讓活動主辦單位產生額外費用。

indeed.en: The task was indeed difficult, but the team completed it successfully.
indeed.zh: 這項任務確實很困難，但團隊仍成功完成。

independence.en: Learning to plan her own schedule gave her greater independence at school.
independence.zh: 學會規劃自己的時間表讓她在學校更獨立。

independent.en: Students completed an independent research project during the semester.
independent.zh: 學生在學期中完成一項獨立研究專題。

index.en: Use the index at the back of the book to find the topic.
index.zh: 請使用書後的索引找到這個主題。

indicate.en: The red marks indicate which answers need to be corrected.
indicate.zh: 紅色記號指出哪些答案需要修正。

indication.en: A sudden drop in temperature can be an indication of changing weather.
indication.zh: 氣溫突然下降可能是天氣正在改變的跡象。

indifference.en: Public indifference can make an important community problem harder to solve.
indifference.zh: 大眾的冷漠可能讓重要的社區問題更難解決。

indifferent.en: He seemed indifferent at first, but later joined the cleanup project.
indifferent.zh: 他一開始看似漠不關心，但後來加入了清潔計畫。

indigenous.en: The exhibit introduces indigenous art traditions from several regions of the island.
indigenous.zh: 展覽介紹島上數個地區的原住民族藝術傳統。

indignant.en: The students were indignant when they discovered the competition rules had changed unfairly.
indignant.zh: 學生發現比賽規則被不公平地更改時感到憤慨。

indispensable.en: Reliable data are indispensable when making a strong scientific conclusion.
indispensable.zh: 要做出有力的科學結論，可靠資料不可或缺。

individual.en: Each individual must submit a separate copy of the worksheet.
individual.zh: 每個人都必須各自繳交一份學習單。

indoor.en: The school moved the concert to an indoor hall because of heavy rain.
indoor.zh: 因為大雨，學校把音樂會移到室內禮堂。

indoors.en: The class stayed indoors while the storm passed over the neighborhood.
indoors.zh: 暴風雨經過附近時，全班留在室內。

induce.en: Bright light can induce faster growth in some young plants.
induce.zh: 強光可能促使某些幼苗生長得更快。

indulge.en: She allowed herself to indulge in a mystery novel after finishing her homework.
indulge.zh: 完成作業後，她讓自己享受讀一本推理小說的時光。

industrial.en: The documentary explores how an industrial city changed over fifty years.
industrial.zh: 這部紀錄片探討一座工業城市五十年來的變化。

industrialize.en: Some countries began to industrialize rapidly during the nineteenth century.
industrialize.zh: 有些國家在十九世紀開始快速工業化。

industry.en: The local industry has changed greatly because of new technology.
industry.zh: 當地產業因新科技而有很大改變。

inevitable.en: Some mistakes are inevitable when people learn a new skill.
inevitable.zh: 人們學習新技能時，有些錯誤是難免的。

infant.en: The museum exhibit includes clothing once worn by an infant centuries ago.
infant.zh: 博物館展覽包含數百年前嬰兒曾穿過的衣物。

infect.en: Some plant diseases can infect crops and reduce the yearly harvest.
infect.zh: 有些植物疾病會感染作物並降低年度收成。

infection.en: The health lesson explained how an infection can spread through a community.
infection.zh: 健康課說明感染如何在社區中傳播。

infectious.en: The article explains why some infectious diseases spread more easily than others.
infectious.zh: 這篇文章說明為何某些傳染病比其他疾病更容易傳播。

infer.en: Readers can infer the character's feelings from her actions.
infer.zh: 讀者可以從角色的行動推測她的感受。

inferior.en: The cheaper material proved inferior during the durability test.
inferior.zh: 較便宜的材料在耐用度測試中表現較差。

infinite.en: In mathematics, an infinite sequence continues without reaching a final term.
infinite.zh: 在數學中，無限數列會持續下去而沒有最後一項。

inflation.en: The economics class discussed how inflation can affect household spending decisions.
inflation.zh: 經濟課討論通貨膨脹如何影響家庭支出決策。

inflict.en: Careless words can inflict lasting emotional harm on other people.
inflict.zh: 不經思考的話語可能對他人造成長久的情緒傷害。

influence.en: Friends can influence the way teenagers choose their hobbies.
influence.zh: 朋友可能影響青少年選擇興趣的方式。

influential.en: The class studied an influential scientist whose work changed modern astronomy.
influential.zh: 全班研究了一位對現代天文學影響深遠的科學家。

inform.en: Please inform the teacher if you cannot attend the meeting.
inform.zh: 如果你無法參加會議，請通知老師。

information.en: Reliable information is important when making a research conclusion.
information.zh: 做研究結論時，可靠資訊非常重要。

informative.en: The museum guide gave an informative talk about the history of the building.
informative.zh: 博物館導覽員對這棟建築的歷史做了很有資訊性的介紹。

infrastructure.en: Reliable public infrastructure helps cities handle transportation and water needs efficiently.
infrastructure.zh: 可靠的公共基礎建設有助城市有效處理交通與用水需求。

ingredient.en: Fresh vegetables are an important ingredient in this dish.
ingredient.zh: 新鮮蔬菜是這道料理的重要食材。

inhabit.en: Several bird species inhabit the wetlands throughout most of the year.
inhabit.zh: 有數種鳥類一年中大部分時間棲息在這片濕地。

inhabitant.en: Every inhabitant of the island depends on the same limited water supply.
inhabitant.zh: 島上的每位居民都仰賴同一個有限的水源。

inherent.en: Every method has inherent limits that researchers need to consider.
inherent.zh: 每種方法都有研究人員需要考量的固有限制。

inherit.en: Some children inherit certain physical traits from both of their parents.
inherit.zh: 有些孩子會從父母雙方遺傳某些身體特徵。

initial.en: The initial plan was revised after the team received feedback.
initial.zh: 團隊收到回饋後修改了原先的計畫。

initiate.en: The student council will initiate a recycling campaign next month.
initiate.zh: 學生會將在下個月發起一項回收活動。

initiative.en: The recycling initiative encouraged students to reduce plastic waste.
initiative.zh: 這項回收倡議鼓勵學生減少塑膠垃圾。

inject.en: The textbook shows how researchers inject harmless dye into a model system.
inject.zh: 課本說明研究人員如何把無害染料注入模型系統。

injection.en: The diagram illustrates how an injection delivers material into a closed system.
injection.zh: 這張圖示說明注入如何把物質送入封閉系統。

injure.en: Poor technique can injure players during intense sports practice.
injure.zh: 不正確的技巧可能使球員在激烈運動練習中受傷。

injury.en: He returned to practice after recovering from a knee injury.
injury.zh: 膝傷康復後，他回到練習場。

injustice.en: The novel encourages readers to question injustice and unfair treatment in society.
injustice.zh: 這本小說鼓勵讀者質疑社會中的不公與不公平待遇。

ink.en: The old letter was written in blue ink on thin paper.
ink.zh: 那封舊信是用藍色墨水寫在薄紙上的。

inland.en: The storm weakened as it moved inland away from the coast.
inland.zh: 暴風雨離開海岸向內陸移動時逐漸減弱。

inn.en: The travelers stayed at a small inn near the mountain station.
inn.zh: 旅客住在山區車站附近的一間小旅店。

inner.en: The inner part of the device contains several small sensors.
inner.zh: 這個裝置內部包含數個小型感測器。

inning.en: The home team scored three runs during the final inning of the game.
inning.zh: 主隊在比賽最後一局拿下三分。

innocence.en: The court drama centers on a student trying to prove his innocence.
innocence.zh: 這齣法庭劇圍繞一名學生試圖證明自己的清白。

innocent.en: The investigation showed that the accused student was completely innocent.
innocent.zh: 調查顯示那名被指控的學生完全無辜。

innovation.en: Innovation in technology often changes how people study and work.
innovation.zh: 科技創新經常改變人們學習與工作的方式。

innovative.en: The students proposed an innovative way to reduce waste at school.
innovative.zh: 學生提出一個創新的方式來減少校園垃圾。

innumerable.en: The night sky contains innumerable stars that cannot all be seen clearly.
innumerable.zh: 夜空中有無數恆星，並不是每一顆都能清楚看見。

input.en: The design team asked students for input before changing the library layout.
input.zh: 設計團隊在更改圖書館配置前徵求學生意見。

inquire.en: You can inquire at the front desk about the museum schedule.
inquire.zh: 你可以在服務台詢問博物館的行程安排。

inquiry.en: The teacher welcomed every inquiry and encouraged students to ask follow-up questions.
inquiry.zh: 老師歡迎每個提問，並鼓勵學生繼續追問。

insane.en: The novel portrays the rumor as insane rather than believable.
insane.zh: 這本小說把那個謠言描寫得荒謬而不可信。

insect.en: The students observed an insect through a magnifying glass.
insect.zh: 學生透過放大鏡觀察一隻昆蟲。

insert.en: Please insert the chart after the second paragraph of your report.
insert.zh: 請把圖表插入報告第二段之後。

inside.en: Please wait inside the building until the rain becomes lighter.
inside.zh: 請在建築物內等待，直到雨勢變小。

insight.en: The interview gave us useful insight into how the project was organized.
insight.zh: 這次訪談讓我們深入了解這項計畫是如何組織的。

insist.en: Good researchers insist on checking their evidence before drawing a conclusion.
insist.zh: 優秀的研究者會堅持在下結論前查核證據。

insistence.en: Her insistence on accurate measurements improved the quality of the experiment.
insistence.zh: 她對精確測量的堅持提升了實驗品質。

inspect.en: Technicians inspect the equipment before students use it.
inspect.zh: 技術人員會在學生使用設備前先進行檢查。

inspection.en: The bridge reopened after a detailed safety inspection was completed.
inspection.zh: 詳細的安全檢查完成後，那座橋重新開放。

inspector.en: The inspector checked the building records before entering the laboratory.
inspector.zh: 檢查員在進入實驗室前查看了建築紀錄。

inspiration.en: The mountain scenery became the inspiration for her final art project.
inspiration.zh: 山景成為她期末藝術專題的靈感來源。

inspire.en: A good teacher can inspire students to explore new ideas.
inspire.zh: 好老師能啟發學生探索新的想法。

install.en: Workers will install new lights in the library this weekend.
install.zh: 工人這個週末會在圖書館安裝新燈具。

installation.en: The new computer installation was completed before the semester began.
installation.zh: 新的電腦安裝工程在學期開始前完成。

instance.en: For instance, public transportation can reduce traffic in cities.
instance.zh: 例如，大眾運輸可以減少城市交通流量。

instant.en: The app gives an instant notification when a new assignment is posted.
instant.zh: 有新作業發布時，這個應用程式會立即通知。

instead.en: We took the train instead because the highway was crowded.
instead.zh: 因為高速公路很塞，我們改搭火車。

instinct.en: A bird may rely on instinct when choosing a place to build its nest.
instinct.zh: 鳥類選擇築巢地點時可能會依靠本能。

instinctive.en: Her instinctive reaction was to protect the books from the sudden rain.
instinctive.zh: 她本能的反應是保護那些書免受突如其來的雨淋。

institute.en: The research institute publishes an annual report on climate trends.
institute.zh: 這所研究機構每年發布氣候趨勢報告。

institution.en: The institution provides scholarships for students with strong academic records.
institution.zh: 該機構為學業表現優秀的學生提供獎學金。

instruct.en: The coach will instruct beginners on the basic rules before practice starts.
instruct.zh: 教練會在練習開始前指導初學者基本規則。

instruction.en: Read each instruction carefully before starting the experiment.
instruction.zh: 開始實驗前請仔細閱讀每一項指示。

instructor.en: The instructor demonstrated the experiment before students worked in groups.
instructor.zh: 講師先示範實驗，再讓學生分組操作。

instrument.en: The laboratory uses a special instrument to measure air pressure.
instrument.zh: 實驗室使用特殊儀器測量氣壓。

insult.en: A disagreement should never become an excuse to insult another student.
insult.zh: 意見不合不應成為侮辱其他學生的藉口。

insurance.en: Travel insurance can help cover unexpected costs during a trip.
insurance.zh: 旅遊保險可以協助負擔旅途中意外產生的費用。

intact.en: The ancient vase remained intact despite being buried for many centuries.
intact.zh: 那只古老花瓶雖埋藏數百年，仍保持完整。

intake.en: The school recorded a larger student intake than expected this year.
intake.zh: 學校今年記錄到的學生入學人數比預期更多。

integrate.en: The project will integrate science, technology, and design skills.
integrate.zh: 這項專題將整合科學、科技與設計能力。

integration.en: The project promotes integration between science lessons and local environmental studies.
integration.zh: 這個計畫促進科學課程與在地環境研究的整合。

integrity.en: Academic integrity means completing your own work and citing sources properly.
integrity.zh: 學術誠信意味著自己完成作業並正確引用資料來源。

intellect.en: Her curiosity and intellect made the discussion lively and thoughtful.
intellect.zh: 她的好奇心與才智讓討論變得生動而有深度。

intellectual.en: The debate offered an intellectual challenge to students in the class.
intellectual.zh: 這場辯論為班上學生帶來知識層面的挑戰。

intelligence.en: The discussion focused on how artificial intelligence may change education.
intelligence.zh: 討論著重於人工智慧可能如何改變教育。

intelligent.en: The system uses intelligent software to organize large amounts of data.
intelligent.zh: 這套系統使用智慧軟體整理大量資料。

intend.en: We intend to finish the project before the end of May.
intend.zh: 我們打算在五月底前完成專題。

intense.en: The intense discussion continued until the class period ended.
intense.zh: 激烈的討論一直持續到下課。

intensify.en: Dark clouds began to intensify as the afternoon storm approached.
intensify.zh: 隨著午後暴風雨接近，烏雲開始加劇。

intensity.en: The intensity of the rain surprised everyone waiting at the station.
intensity.zh: 雨勢的強度讓在車站等候的每個人都很驚訝。

intensive.en: She joined an intensive language course during the summer vacation.
intensive.zh: 她在暑假參加了一門密集語言課程。

intent.en: His intent was to explain the problem clearly, not criticize anyone.
intent.zh: 他的用意是清楚解釋問題，而不是批評任何人。

intention.en: My intention is to finish the report before Friday afternoon.
intention.zh: 我的打算是在星期五下午以前完成報告。

interact.en: Students interact with classmates while completing the group activity.
interact.zh: 學生在完成小組活動時會與同學互動。

interaction.en: Classroom interaction helps students practice speaking and listening skills naturally.
interaction.zh: 課堂互動能幫助學生自然練習口說與聽力能力。

interest.en: Her interest in science grew after visiting the museum.
interest.zh: 參觀博物館後，她對科學的興趣增加了。

interested.en: Many students are interested in learning how robots work.
interested.zh: 許多學生對了解機器人如何運作感興趣。

interesting.en: The article gives an interesting explanation of animal communication.
interesting.zh: 這篇文章對動物溝通提供了有趣的解釋。

interfere.en: Background noise can interfere with concentration during a difficult reading task.
interfere.zh: 背景噪音可能會干擾進行困難閱讀任務時的專注力。

interference.en: Radio interference made the emergency announcement difficult to hear clearly.
interference.zh: 無線電干擾讓緊急廣播很難聽清楚。

interior.en: The museum interior was bright, quiet, and easy to explore.
interior.zh: 博物館內部明亮、安靜，而且很容易參觀。

intermediate.en: This course is designed for students at an intermediate level.
intermediate.zh: 這門課是為中等程度的學生設計的。

internal.en: The machine stopped because of an internal electrical problem.
internal.zh: 這台機器因內部電路問題而停止運作。

international.en: The school joined an international exchange program with several partner schools.
international.zh: 學校加入了與數所姊妹校合作的國際交換計畫。

internet.en: The internet makes it easier to access information from many sources.
internet.zh: 網路讓人更容易取得多種來源的資訊。

interpret.en: Different readers may interpret the same story in different ways.
interpret.zh: 不同讀者可能用不同方式解讀同一個故事。

interpretation.en: Different readers may have a different interpretation of the same poem.
interpretation.zh: 不同讀者可能對同一首詩有不同解讀。

interpreter.en: An interpreter helped the visitors understand the guide's explanation accurately.
interpreter.zh: 口譯員幫助訪客準確理解導覽員的說明。

interrupt.en: Please do not interrupt while another student is presenting.
interrupt.zh: 其他同學報告時，請不要打斷。

interruption.en: A brief interruption delayed the presentation by only a few minutes.
interruption.zh: 一次短暫的中斷只讓簡報延遲了幾分鐘。

intersection.en: The library stands near the busy intersection beside the city park.
intersection.zh: 圖書館位在市立公園旁那個繁忙的十字路口附近。

interval.en: Students took a short break at regular interval points during practice.
interval.zh: 學生在練習過程中的固定間隔點短暫休息。

intervene.en: A teacher may intervene when a group discussion becomes unproductive.
intervene.zh: 當小組討論失去成效時，老師可能會介入。

intervention.en: Early teacher intervention helped the group resolve its disagreement peacefully.
intervention.zh: 老師及早介入，幫助小組和平解決意見分歧。

interview.en: She prepared several questions before the interview with the scientist.
interview.zh: 她在訪問科學家前準備了幾個問題。

intimidate.en: A difficult question should not intimidate you into giving up immediately.
intimidate.zh: 一道困難的題目不該嚇得你立刻放棄。

into.en: The class was divided into four groups for the activity.
into.zh: 全班為了活動被分成四組。

intonation.en: Changing your intonation can make a spoken sentence sound more natural.
intonation.zh: 改變語調可以讓口語句子聽起來更自然。

intrigue.en: Ancient maps continue to intrigue students who enjoy history and geography.
intrigue.zh: 古老地圖仍持續吸引喜愛歷史與地理的學生。

introduce.en: The teacher will introduce the new topic with a short video.
introduce.zh: 老師會用一段短影片介紹新主題。

introduction.en: The introduction explains the purpose and structure of the report.
introduction.zh: 前言說明了報告的目的與架構。

intrude.en: Please knock before entering so you do not intrude on the meeting.
intrude.zh: 進入前請先敲門，以免打擾會議。

intruder.en: The alarm warned the staff that an intruder had entered the closed building.
intruder.zh: 警報提醒工作人員有人闖入已關閉的建築物。

intuition.en: Her intuition told her to check the calculation one more time.
intuition.zh: 她的直覺告訴她要再檢查一次計算。

invade.en: The history lesson explains why one empire tried to invade another region.
invade.zh: 歷史課解釋了為何某個帝國曾試圖入侵另一個地區。

invaluable.en: The teacher's feedback was invaluable when I revised my final essay.
invaluable.zh: 我修改期末作文時，老師的回饋非常寶貴。

invariably.en: The bus invariably becomes crowded during the morning rush hour.
invariably.zh: 這班公車在早晨尖峰時段總是會變得很擁擠。

invasion.en: The documentary examines the invasion from several historical perspectives.
invasion.zh: 這部紀錄片從多個歷史角度探討那次入侵。

invent.en: Engineers often invent new tools to solve practical problems.
invent.zh: 工程師常發明新工具來解決實際問題。

invention.en: The invention changed how people communicated across long distances.
invention.zh: 這項發明改變了人們遠距溝通的方式。

inventor.en: The young inventor demonstrated a simple device at the science fair.
inventor.zh: 這位年輕發明家在科展展示了一個簡單裝置。

inventory.en: The store checks its inventory before ordering more school supplies.
inventory.zh: 商店在訂購更多文具前會先盤點庫存。

invest.en: The company plans to invest more money in clean energy.
invest.zh: 公司計畫投入更多資金於潔淨能源。

investigate.en: The science team will investigate why the plants grew differently.
investigate.zh: 科學小組將調查植物生長不同的原因。

investigation.en: The investigation focused on how the equipment failure had occurred.
investigation.zh: 調查重點放在設備故障是如何發生的。

investigator.en: The investigator carefully reviewed the records before writing the final report.
investigator.zh: 調查人員在撰寫最終報告前仔細檢視了紀錄。

investment.en: Education is an important investment in a person's future.
investment.zh: 教育是對個人未來的重要投資。

invitation.en: I received an invitation to attend the school's science exhibition next week.
invitation.zh: 我收到邀請，下週參加學校的科學展覽。

invite.en: The club plans to invite a local artist to speak.
invite.zh: 社團計畫邀請一位在地藝術家來演講。

involve.en: The project will involve students from three different classes.
involve.zh: 這項專題會有三個不同班級的學生參與。

involvement.en: Student involvement made the charity event more organized and energetic.
involvement.zh: 學生的參與讓公益活動更有組織也更有活力。

iron.en: The bridge contains iron parts that require regular inspection and maintenance.
iron.zh: 這座橋含有需要定期檢查與維護的鐵製部件。

ironic.en: It was ironic that the rain stopped just after we went indoors.
ironic.zh: 很諷刺的是，我們一進室內雨就停了。

irony.en: The story uses irony to show the difference between appearance and reality.
irony.zh: 這個故事運用反諷來呈現表象與現實的差異。

irritable.en: Lack of sleep can make someone irritable during a long school day.
irritable.zh: 睡眠不足可能讓人在漫長的上課日變得易怒。
