irritate.en: Repeated tapping sounds can irritate people who are trying to concentrate.
irritate.zh: 反覆的敲擊聲可能會惹惱正在專心的人。

island.en: The small island is known for its clear water and coral reefs.
island.zh: 這座小島以清澈海水與珊瑚礁聞名。

isle.en: The small isle appears on maps as a protected natural area.
isle.zh: 這座小島在地圖上標示為受保護的自然區域。

isolate.en: Researchers isolate one variable to study its effect more clearly.
isolate.zh: 研究人員會隔離單一變因，以更清楚研究它的影響。

isolation.en: The research station operates in isolation during the coldest winter months.
isolation.zh: 研究站在最寒冷的冬季月份處於與外界隔離的狀態。

issue.en: Water shortage is an important issue in many regions.
issue.zh: 缺水是許多地區的重要議題。

it.en: It became clear that the team needed a better plan.
it.zh: 事情變得很清楚：這個團隊需要一個更好的計畫。

itch.en: The wool sweater caused a slight itch on his arm.
itch.zh: 那件羊毛毛衣讓他的手臂有一點發癢。

item.en: Each item on the checklist should be reviewed before submission.
item.zh: 提交前應檢查清單上的每一項。

its.en: The school updated its website before the new semester began.
its.zh: 學校在新學期開始前更新了它的網站。

itself.en: The machine turns itself off when it becomes too hot.
itself.zh: 機器過熱時會自行關閉。

ivory.en: The museum display explains why illegal ivory trade threatens elephants.
ivory.zh: 博物館展示說明了非法象牙交易為何威脅大象。

ivy.en: Green ivy covered part of the old brick wall near the garden.
ivy.zh: 綠色常春藤覆蓋了花園旁老磚牆的一部分。

jacket.en: Bring a light jacket because the evening may become cool.
jacket.zh: 帶一件薄外套，因為晚上可能會變涼。

jade.en: The museum displayed a jade carving from an ancient collection.
jade.zh: 博物館展出了一件來自古代收藏的玉雕。

jail.en: The history book describes how the activist spent months in jail.
jail.zh: 歷史課本描述了那名社會運動者曾在監獄中待了數月。

jam.en: Traffic jam conditions delayed several buses near the station this morning.
jam.zh: 今天早上車站附近的塞車情況讓好幾班公車延誤。

janitor.en: The janitor opened the classroom early so the club could prepare.
janitor.zh: 工友提早打開教室，讓社團可以準備。

jar.en: She stored the dried beans in a clean glass jar.
jar.zh: 她把乾燥豆子裝在乾淨的玻璃罐裡。

jasmine.en: The jasmine near the gate filled the evening air with fragrance.
jasmine.zh: 大門旁的茉莉花讓傍晚空氣充滿香氣。

jaw.en: The diagram labels the jaw as part of the human skull.
jaw.zh: 圖表把下顎標示為人類頭骨的一部分。

jazz.en: The music club performed a short jazz piece at the festival.
jazz.zh: 音樂社在校慶表演了一小段爵士樂。

jealous.en: He felt jealous at first but later congratulated his teammate sincerely.
jealous.zh: 他起初感到嫉妒，但後來真心祝賀隊友。

jealousy.en: The novel explores how jealousy can damage trust between close friends.
jealousy.zh: 這本小說探討嫉妒如何破壞好友之間的信任。

jeans.en: She wore jeans and a school jacket during the field trip.
jeans.zh: 她在校外教學時穿著牛仔褲和學校外套。

jeep.en: A jeep carried researchers along the rough road to the station.
jeep.zh: 一輛吉普車載著研究人員沿崎嶇道路前往研究站。

jelly.en: The dessert included fruit, jelly, and a small scoop of yogurt.
jelly.zh: 這份甜點包含水果、果凍和一小球優格。

jet.en: The jet crossed the sky and disappeared behind the clouds.
jet.zh: 那架噴射機飛越天空後消失在雲層後方。

jewel.en: The crown's central jewel was displayed under protective glass.
jewel.zh: 王冠中央的寶石被放在防護玻璃下展示。

jewelry.en: The exhibit features traditional jewelry from several different cultures.
jewelry.zh: 這項展覽展示來自數種不同文化的傳統珠寶。

jingle.en: A short jingle played before the school radio announcement began.
jingle.zh: 校園廣播開始前播放了一小段廣告歌。

job.en: The volunteer job taught her how to work with different people.
job.zh: 這份志工工作讓她學會如何與不同的人合作。

jockey.en: The article describes how a jockey trains for professional horse racing.
jockey.zh: 這篇文章描述騎師如何為職業賽馬接受訓練。

jog.en: They jog around the track at an easy pace after class.
jog.zh: 他們下課後以輕鬆的速度繞操場慢跑。

join.en: Students can join the science club at the start of each semester.
join.zh: 學生可以在每學期開始時加入科學社。

joint.en: The two schools announced a joint science project for next semester.
joint.zh: 兩所學校宣布下學期將進行一項聯合科學計畫。

joke.en: His harmless joke made the whole class laugh during lunch.
joke.zh: 他無傷大雅的笑話讓全班在午餐時笑了起來。

jolly.en: The jolly guide kept everyone cheerful during the long bus ride.
jolly.zh: 那位開朗的導遊讓大家在漫長車程中保持愉快。

journal.en: She kept a journal to record observations from the biology project.
journal.zh: 她用日誌記錄生物專題的觀察結果。

journalism.en: The club introduced students to basic journalism and responsible reporting.
journalism.zh: 社團向學生介紹新聞工作的基本概念與負責任的報導方式。

journalist.en: The journalist interviewed several experts before publishing the article.
journalist.zh: 那名記者在發表文章前訪問了多位專家。

journey.en: Their train journey across the island lasted nearly six hours.
journey.zh: 他們搭火車橫越全島的旅程持續了將近六小時。

joy.en: She felt great joy after finishing the difficult project successfully.
joy.zh: 她成功完成困難的專題後感到非常喜悅。

joyful.en: The students gave a joyful cheer when the results were announced.
joyful.zh: 結果公布時，學生們發出歡樂的歡呼聲。

joyous.en: The graduation ceremony was a joyous occasion for students and families.
joyous.zh: 畢業典禮對學生與家人而言是個歡樂的時刻。

judge.en: The science fair judge asked careful questions about the experiment.
judge.zh: 科展評審仔細詢問了關於實驗的問題。

judgement.en: Good judgement helps people make careful choices under pressure.
judgement.zh: 良好的判斷力能幫助人在壓力下做出謹慎選擇。

judgment.en: Good judgment is important when evaluating information found online.
judgment.zh: 評估網路資訊時，良好的判斷力很重要。

judicial.en: The article explains the judicial process in simple terms.
judicial.zh: 這篇文章用簡單方式說明司法程序。

jug.en: She filled a glass jug with cold water for the table.
jug.zh: 她把一只玻璃壺裝滿冷水放在桌上。

juice.en: The cafeteria served orange juice with breakfast this morning.
juice.zh: 餐廳今天早上早餐供應柳橙汁。

juicy.en: The peach was sweet and juicy after ripening for several days.
juicy.zh: 那顆桃子熟了幾天後又甜又多汁。

jump.en: The athlete practiced how to jump higher without losing balance.
jump.zh: 這名運動員練習如何跳得更高又不失去平衡。

junction.en: The hikers stopped at the trail junction to check the map.
junction.zh: 健行者在步道交會處停下來查看地圖。

jungle.en: The documentary showed colorful birds living deep in the jungle.
jungle.zh: 紀錄片拍到住在叢林深處的彩色鳥類。

junior.en: The junior students organized a welcome event for new classmates.
junior.zh: 較低年級的學生為新同學舉辦了歡迎活動。

junk.en: We removed old junk from the storage room before repainting it.
junk.zh: 重新粉刷儲藏室前，我們先清掉了舊雜物。

jury.en: The civics lesson explained how a jury works in some legal systems.
jury.zh: 公民課解釋了陪審團在某些法律制度中的運作方式。

just.en: The bus arrived just before the rain started.
just.zh: 公車正好在開始下雨前抵達。

justice.en: The class discussed justice and fairness in several historical cases.
justice.zh: 班上討論了數個歷史案例中的正義與公平。

justify.en: Students should justify each answer with evidence from the passage.
justify.zh: 學生應用文章中的證據說明每個答案的理由。

juvenile.en: The article examines juvenile behavior from an educational perspective.
juvenile.zh: 這篇文章從教育角度探討青少年行為。

kangaroo.en: A kangaroo can travel quickly across wide areas of grassland.
kangaroo.zh: 袋鼠可以快速穿越廣大的草原地區。

keen.en: She has a keen interest in astronomy and often visits the observatory.
keen.zh: 她對天文學有濃厚興趣，經常參觀天文台。

keep.en: Please keep your notes organized so they are easy to review.
keep.zh: 請把筆記整理好，方便之後複習。

keeper.en: The museum keeper checked each display before visitors arrived.
keeper.zh: 博物館管理員在訪客抵達前檢查每件展品。

ketchup.en: He added a little ketchup to his fries at lunch.
ketchup.zh: 他午餐時在薯條上加了一點番茄醬。

kettle.en: The kettle began to whistle when the water became hot.
kettle.zh: 水變熱時，水壺開始發出鳴聲。

key.en: Understanding the key idea makes the passage much easier to follow.
key.zh: 理解關鍵概念後，文章會容易讀懂許多。

keyboard.en: The computer keyboard stopped working during the first lesson.
keyboard.zh: 電腦鍵盤在第一節課時停止運作。

kick.en: He gave the ball a strong kick toward the goal.

kid.en: Every kid in the group received a small notebook.
kid.zh: 小組裡每個孩子都拿到一本小筆記本。

kidney.en: The biology lesson explained how each kidney helps filter the blood.
kidney.zh: 生物課說明每個腎臟如何協助過濾血液。

kill.en: Extreme heat can kill young plants if they lack water.
kill.zh: 如果缺水，極端高溫可能使幼苗枯死。

kilogram.en: The package weighed one kilogram before the shop added extra wrapping.
kilogram.zh: 商店加上額外包裝前，包裹重一公斤。

kilometer.en: The hiking trail continues for another kilometer beyond the wooden bridge.
kilometer.zh: 這條健行步道在木橋之後還延伸一公里。

kin.en: The old records helped her identify distant kin from another town.
kin.zh: 舊紀錄幫助她找出住在另一座城鎮的遠親。

kind.en: A kind comment can encourage someone who feels uncertain.
kind.zh: 一句友善的話能鼓勵感到沒自信的人。

kindergarten.en: My cousin started kindergarten and quickly made several new friends.
kindergarten.zh: 我的表弟開始上幼兒園後很快就交了幾個新朋友。

kindle.en: A good science book can kindle curiosity about the natural world.
kindle.zh: 一本好科普書可以激發人們對自然世界的好奇心。

king.en: The history book describes how the king ruled the country.
king.zh: 歷史課本描述這位國王如何統治國家。

kingdom.en: The museum exhibit describes how the ancient kingdom expanded its trade.
kingdom.zh: 博物館展覽說明這個古代王國如何擴展貿易。

kit.en: The first-aid kit was stored beside the door for emergencies.
kit.zh: 急救包放在門邊，以便緊急時使用。

kitchen.en: The kitchen was cleaned before the cooking activity began.
kitchen.zh: 烹飪活動開始前，廚房已經清理乾淨。

kite.en: The bright kite rose steadily as the wind became stronger.
kite.zh: 隨著風勢變強，那只鮮豔的風箏穩定升高。

knee.en: She hurt her knee while running down the stairs.
knee.zh: 她跑下樓梯時傷到了膝蓋。

kneel.en: The photographer had to kneel to capture the flower closely.
kneel.zh: 攝影師必須跪下來，才能近距離拍攝那朵花。

knife.en: Use the knife carefully when cutting the fruit.
knife.zh: 切水果時請小心使用刀具。

knight.en: The novel follows a young knight on a long journey home.
knight.zh: 這本小說描述一名年輕騎士踏上漫長返鄉旅程。

knit.en: My grandmother likes to knit scarves during quiet winter evenings.
knit.zh: 我的祖母喜歡在安靜的冬夜織圍巾。

knob.en: Turn the silver knob gently to open the old cabinet.
knob.zh: 輕輕轉動銀色旋鈕，就能打開舊櫥櫃。

knock.en: Please knock before entering the teacher's office.
knock.zh: 進入老師辦公室前請先敲門。

knot.en: He tied a firm knot so the rope would stay secure.
knot.zh: 他打了一個牢固的結，讓繩子保持固定。

know.en: It is useful to know which study methods work best for you.
know.zh: 了解哪些讀書方法最適合自己很有幫助。

knowledge.en: Background knowledge can make a difficult article easier to understand.
knowledge.zh: 背景知識能讓困難文章更容易理解。

knowledgeable.en: The guide was knowledgeable about the history of the mountain village.
knowledgeable.zh: 那位導覽員非常了解這座山村的歷史。

koala.en: The zoo sign explained why a koala spends hours resting.
koala.zh: 動物園告示說明無尾熊為何會花很多時間休息。

lab.en: Students wore safety goggles before entering the chemistry lab.
lab.zh: 學生進入化學實驗室前先戴上護目鏡。

label.en: Please label each sample clearly before starting the experiment.
label.zh: 開始實驗前請清楚標示每個樣本。

labor.en: New machines reduced the amount of manual labor required.
labor.zh: 新機器減少了所需的人工勞動量。

laboratory.en: Students must wear safety glasses inside the laboratory.
laboratory.zh: 學生在實驗室內必須戴護目鏡。

lace.en: She replaced the broken lace on her running shoe.
lace.zh: 她把跑鞋上斷掉的鞋帶換掉了。

lack.en: A lack of sleep can make concentration more difficult.
lack.zh: 睡眠不足會讓專注變得更困難。

lad.en: The story describes a cheerful lad who helps his neighbors.
lad.zh: 故事描述一名開朗少年幫助鄰居的情節。

ladder.en: The worker placed the ladder firmly against the wall.
ladder.zh: 工人把梯子穩穩靠在牆上。

lady.en: The lady at the information desk showed us the correct direction.
lady.zh: 服務台的女士告訴我們正確方向。

ladybug.en: A small ladybug landed on the leaf beside my notebook.
ladybug.zh: 一隻小瓢蟲停在我筆記本旁的葉子上。

lag.en: A weak connection can cause noticeable lag during an online lesson.
lag.zh: 網路連線不穩可能讓線上課程出現明顯延遲。

lake.en: We walked around the lake before returning to the bus.
lake.zh: 我們繞湖走了一圈後才回到遊覽車。

lamb.en: The young lamb stayed close to its mother in the field.
lamb.zh: 小羊在田野裡一直靠近母羊。

lamp.en: I switched on the desk lamp to finish reading my notes.
lamp.zh: 我打開檯燈，好把筆記讀完。

land.en: The plane will land shortly after sunset.
land.zh: 飛機會在日落後不久降落。

landlady.en: The landlady explained the apartment rules before handing over the key.
landlady.zh: 女房東交鑰匙前先說明公寓規定。

landlord.en: The landlord repaired the leaking faucet after receiving our message.
landlord.zh: 房東收到我們的訊息後修理了漏水的水龍頭。

landmark.en: The old tower remains a famous landmark in the city center.
landmark.zh: 那座古塔仍是市中心著名的地標。

landscape.en: The mountain landscape changed dramatically after the heavy rain.
landscape.zh: 大雨過後，山區景觀出現明顯變化。

landslide.en: Heavy rain increased the risk of a landslide near the mountain road.
landslide.zh: 大雨提高了山路附近發生土石滑動的風險。

lane.en: Cyclists should remain in the marked lane whenever possible.
lane.zh: 自行車騎士應盡量留在標示的車道內。

language.en: Learning a new language requires regular practice and patience.
language.zh: 學習一種新語言需要規律練習與耐心。

lantern.en: A red lantern hung above the entrance during the festival.
lantern.zh: 節慶期間，一盞紅燈籠掛在入口上方。

lap.en: The runner completed one final lap before leaving the track.
lap.zh: 那名跑者完成最後一圈後離開跑道。

large.en: A large number of students joined the environmental campaign.
large.zh: 很多學生參加了這項環保活動。

largely.en: The project succeeded largely because everyone shared clear responsibilities.
largely.zh: 這個計畫能成功，主要是因為每個人都有明確分工。

laser.en: The science teacher demonstrated how a laser produces a narrow beam.
laser.zh: 科學老師示範雷射如何產生狹窄光束。

lash.en: Strong waves began to lash the empty pier during the storm.
lash.zh: 暴風雨期間，強浪開始猛烈拍打空蕩的碼頭。

last.en: The final presentation will last about twenty minutes.
last.zh: 最後的報告大約會持續二十分鐘。

late.en: We arrived late because the train was delayed.
late.zh: 因為火車延誤，我們遲到了。

lately.en: I have been reading more historical novels lately after school.
lately.zh: 我最近放學後讀了更多歷史小說。

later.en: We can discuss the difficult question later after class.
later.zh: 我們可以下課後再討論這個難題。

latest.en: Please check the latest schedule before leaving home.
latest.zh: 出門前請確認最新時刻表。

latitude.en: The map shows the latitude of each major city clearly.
latitude.zh: 地圖清楚標示每個主要城市的緯度。

latter.en: Between the two plans, the latter seems easier to complete.
latter.zh: 在兩個方案之中，後者看起來比較容易完成。

laugh.en: The whole class began to laugh at the funny example.
laugh.zh: 全班聽到那個有趣的例子後笑了起來。

laughter.en: Warm laughter filled the classroom after the teacher told a joke.
laughter.zh: 老師說完笑話後，教室裡充滿愉快笑聲。

launch.en: The school will launch a new reading program next month.
launch.zh: 學校下個月將推出新的閱讀計畫。

laundry.en: I folded the clean laundry before starting my homework.
laundry.zh: 我先把洗好的衣物摺好，才開始寫作業。

lavish.en: The palace contained lavish rooms decorated with carved wooden panels.
lavish.zh: 宮殿裡有裝飾華麗、帶有木雕牆板的房間。

law.en: The new law aims to improve safety on public roads.
law.zh: 這項新法律旨在提升公共道路安全。

lawful.en: The judge explained why the decision was lawful under current rules.
lawful.zh: 法官說明這項決定為何符合現行法律。

lawmaker.en: Each lawmaker received a copy of the proposed environmental bill.
lawmaker.zh: 每位立法者都收到一份擬議環境法案。

lawn.en: Children played on the wide lawn beside the community center.
lawn.zh: 孩子們在活動中心旁的大片草地上玩耍。

lawsuit.en: The article summarized the lawsuit without taking either side.
lawsuit.zh: 這篇文章中立地摘要了這起訴訟。

lawyer.en: The lawyer explained the case in simple language.
lawyer.zh: 律師用簡單的語言說明這起案件。

lay.en: Please lay the papers flat on the table.

layer.en: A thin layer of ice covered the sidewalk early this morning.
layer.zh: 今天一早，人行道上覆著一層薄冰。

layman.en: The scientist explained the idea in terms a layman could understand.
layman.zh: 科學家用一般人也能理解的方式解釋這個概念。

layout.en: The new layout makes the school website easier to navigate.
layout.zh: 新的版面配置讓學校網站更容易瀏覽。

lazy.en: A lazy afternoon gave us time to read and relax.
lazy.zh: 悠閒的下午讓我們有時間閱讀與放鬆。

lead.en: Good planning can lead to better results and less stress.
lead.zh: 良好規劃能帶來更好的結果和更少壓力。

leader.en: A good leader listens carefully to different opinions.
leader.zh: 好的領導者會仔細聆聽不同意見。

leadership.en: The program helps students develop teamwork and leadership skills.
leadership.zh: 這項計畫幫助學生培養團隊合作與領導能力。

leaf.en: A green leaf floated slowly down from the tree.
leaf.zh: 一片綠葉從樹上慢慢飄落。

league.en: Our school team joined a regional basketball league this semester.
league.zh: 本學期我們校隊加入了區域籃球聯盟。

leak.en: A small leak under the sink caused water to spread.
leak.zh: 水槽下方的小漏水讓水慢慢流開。

lean.en: Do not lean against the display case inside the museum.
lean.zh: 在博物館內不要靠在展示櫃上。

leap.en: The deer made a quick leap across the narrow stream.
leap.zh: 那隻鹿迅速一躍，越過狹窄的小溪。

learn.en: Students learn faster when they use new words in context.
learn.zh: 學生在語境中使用新單字時學得更快。

learned.en: The learned professor answered questions with patience and clear examples.
learned.zh: 那位博學教授耐心地用清楚例子回答問題。

learning.en: Online learning can be effective when students stay organized.
learning.zh: 如果學生有良好規劃，線上學習可以很有效。

lease.en: They read the lease carefully before renting the small apartment.
lease.zh: 他們租下小公寓前仔細閱讀租約。

least.en: Please read at least two sources before writing the report.
least.zh: 寫報告前請至少閱讀兩個資料來源。

leather.en: The museum displayed an old leather bag from the expedition.
leather.zh: 博物館展出一個來自探險隊的舊皮包。

leave.en: Please leave enough time to check your answers.
leave.zh: 請預留足夠時間檢查答案。

lecture.en: The lecture introduced several ideas about renewable energy.
lecture.zh: 這場講座介紹了幾個再生能源相關概念。

lecturer.en: The guest lecturer spoke about renewable energy and urban design.
lecturer.zh: 客座講師談到再生能源與都市設計。

left.en: Turn left at the next corner to reach the station.
left.zh: 在下一個路口左轉就能到車站。

leg.en: He injured his leg during basketball practice.
leg.zh: 他在籃球練習時傷到了腿。

legacy.en: The scientist's legacy continues through the research center she founded.
legacy.zh: 那位科學家的貢獻透過她創立的研究中心延續。

legal.en: The article explains several legal rules related to online privacy.
legal.zh: 這篇文章說明幾項與網路隱私有關的法律規定。

legend.en: The guide told us a local legend about the old bridge.
legend.zh: 導覽員告訴我們一個關於老橋的地方傳說。

legendary.en: The book describes a legendary explorer who crossed the desert.
legendary.zh: 這本書描述一位穿越沙漠的傳奇探險家。

legislation.en: New legislation requires clearer labels on certain consumer products.
legislation.zh: 新法規要求某些消費產品使用更清楚的標示。

legislative.en: The class discussed the legislative process behind new laws.
legislative.zh: 全班討論新法律背後的立法程序。

legislator.en: The legislator attended a public meeting about transportation planning.
legislator.zh: 那位立法者出席了關於交通規劃的公開會議。

legitimate.en: The teacher asked whether the website was a legitimate source of information.
legitimate.zh: 老師詢問這個網站是否為合法且可信的資訊來源。

leisure.en: Reading novels is a popular leisure activity among many students.
leisure.zh: 閱讀小說是許多學生喜愛的休閒活動。

leisurely.en: We took a leisurely walk along the river after lunch.
leisurely.zh: 午餐後我們沿著河邊悠閒散步。

lemon.en: She added a slice of lemon to the glass of water.
lemon.zh: 她在那杯水裡放了一片檸檬。

lemonade.en: The students sold homemade lemonade during the school fair.
lemonade.zh: 學生在校慶園遊會販售自製檸檬汁。

lend.en: Could you lend me your notes after class?
lend.zh: 下課後可以借我你的筆記嗎？

length.en: The teacher asked us to measure the length of the table.
length.zh: 老師要我們測量桌子的長度。

lengthen.en: Adding another paragraph would lengthen the report without improving it.
lengthen.zh: 再加一段只會讓報告變長，卻不會更好。

lengthy.en: The lengthy meeting ended after everyone agreed on the schedule.
lengthy.zh: 漫長會議在大家同意時程後結束。

lens.en: The photographer cleaned the camera lens before taking the picture.
lens.zh: 攝影師拍照前先清潔相機鏡頭。

leopard.en: The documentary followed a leopard moving quietly through tall grass.
leopard.zh: 紀錄片拍攝一隻豹安靜穿過高草叢。

less.en: This method uses less time while producing similar results.
less.zh: 這個方法花更少時間，卻能得到相似結果。

lessen.en: Planting trees can lessen summer heat around school buildings.
lessen.zh: 種樹可以減輕校舍周圍的夏季熱氣。

lesson.en: Today's lesson focuses on how to identify the main idea.
lesson.zh: 今天的課程著重於如何找出主旨。

lest.en: She saved another copy lest the original file become damaged.
lest.zh: 她另外存了一份，以免原始檔案損壞。

let.en: Please let me know if the schedule changes.
let.zh: 如果行程有變，請告訴我。

letter.en: She wrote a short letter to thank her teacher.
letter.zh: 她寫了一封短信感謝老師。

lettuce.en: Fresh lettuce added a crisp texture to the sandwich.
lettuce.zh: 新鮮生菜讓三明治多了爽脆口感。

level.en: This book is suitable for students at an intermediate level.
level.zh: 這本書適合中等程度的學生。

liability.en: The company listed the loan as a long-term liability.
liability.zh: 公司把這筆貸款列為長期負債。

liable.en: Drivers may be liable for damage caused by careless behavior.
liable.zh: 駕駛人可能要為疏忽行為造成的損害負責。

liar.en: Calling someone a liar without evidence can damage trust quickly.
liar.zh: 沒有證據就稱某人是騙子，可能很快破壞信任。

liberal.en: The course offers a liberal range of topics across the humanities.
liberal.zh: 這門課在人文領域提供相當廣泛的主題。

liberate.en: The movement hoped to liberate the region from unfair restrictions.
liberate.zh: 這場運動希望讓該地區擺脫不公平限制。

liberation.en: The museum presents liberation as an important theme in modern history.
liberation.zh: 博物館把解放呈現為近代史的重要主題。

liberty.en: The debate examined how liberty and responsibility can exist together.
liberty.zh: 辯論探討自由與責任如何同時存在。

librarian.en: The librarian helped me locate a book about climate science.
librarian.zh: 圖書館員幫我找到一本氣候科學的書。

library.en: The library stays open later during exam week.
library.zh: 考試週期間圖書館會開放得比較晚。

license.en: The software license explains how the program may be used.
license.zh: 軟體授權說明這個程式可以如何使用。

lick.en: The puppy tried to lick the drops of water from its nose.
lick.zh: 小狗試著舔掉鼻子上的水滴。

lid.en: Please close the lid tightly before placing the container inside.
lid.zh: 把容器放進去前，請先把蓋子蓋緊。

lie.en: It is better to admit a mistake than tell a lie.

lieutenant.en: The history text mentioned a lieutenant who carried the official message.
lieutenant.zh: 歷史課本提到一名負責傳遞正式訊息的中尉。

life.en: Regular exercise can improve both health and quality of life.
life.zh: 規律運動能改善健康和生活品質。

lifeguard.en: The lifeguard watched the swimming area carefully throughout the afternoon.
lifeguard.zh: 救生員整個下午都仔細看守游泳區。

lifelong.en: Reading can become a lifelong habit that supports continuous learning.
lifelong.zh: 閱讀可以成為支持持續學習的終身習慣。

lifetime.en: The old tree may survive for more than a human lifetime.
lifetime.zh: 那棵老樹可能比人的一生還長壽。

lift.en: Please lift the box carefully because it is heavier than it looks.
lift.zh: 請小心抬這個箱子，因為它比看起來重。

light.en: Plants need enough light to grow properly.
light.zh: 植物需要足夠光線才能正常生長。

lighten.en: Opening the curtains will lighten the room during the morning.
lighten.zh: 早上拉開窗簾會讓房間更明亮。

lighthouse.en: The lighthouse stood on a rocky point above the sea.
lighthouse.zh: 燈塔矗立在海上的岩石岬角。

lightning.en: A flash of lightning appeared before the thunder reached us.
lightning.zh: 雷聲傳來前，先出現一道閃電。

like.en: Many students like to review vocabulary before going to bed.
like.zh: 許多學生喜歡在睡前複習單字。

likelihood.en: Dark clouds increased the likelihood of rain later that afternoon.
likelihood.zh: 烏雲增加了當天下午稍後下雨的可能性。

likely.en: Regular practice makes success more likely over time.
likely.zh: 規律練習會讓成功的機會隨時間提高。

likewise.en: The first group improved its score, and the second did likewise.
likewise.zh: 第一組提高了分數，第二組也同樣有所進步。

lily.en: A white lily opened beside the pond after several warm days.
lily.zh: 連續幾個溫暖日子後，池塘旁開了一朵白百合。

limb.en: A heavy tree limb fell across the path after the storm.
limb.zh: 暴風雨後，一根粗大的樹枝倒在步道上。

limit.en: The teacher set a ten-minute limit for the discussion.
limit.zh: 老師為討論設定十分鐘的時間限制。

limitation.en: Time was the main limitation when we planned the project.
limitation.zh: 時間是我們規劃專題時最大的限制。

limp.en: The injured dog began to limp, so its owner called a veterinarian.
limp.zh: 受傷的狗開始跛行，因此主人聯絡了獸醫。

line.en: Please draw a straight line between the two points.
line.zh: 請在兩點之間畫一條直線。

linen.en: The hotel used fresh linen on every bed in the room.
linen.zh: 旅館在房間每張床上都使用乾淨床單。

liner.en: The museum displayed photographs of a famous ocean liner.
liner.zh: 博物館展出一艘著名遠洋客輪的照片。

linger.en: The smell of fresh bread seemed to linger in the kitchen.
linger.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味似乎一直留在廚房裡。

lining.en: The coat has a warm lining that helps block cold wind.
lining.zh: 這件外套有保暖內襯，可幫助阻擋冷風。

link.en: The study found a possible link between sleep and memory.
link.zh: 研究發現睡眠與記憶之間可能存在關聯。

lion.en: The lion rested in the shade during the hottest afternoon hours.
lion.zh: 獅子在午後最炎熱時待在陰影中休息。

lip.en: A small cut on his lip healed after several days.
lip.zh: 他嘴唇上的小傷口幾天後癒合了。

lipstick.en: The theater costume included bright lipstick for the stage performance.
lipstick.zh: 舞台表演的戲服造型包含鮮豔口紅。

liquid.en: Water changes from a solid to a liquid as ice melts.
liquid.zh: 冰融化時，水會從固體變成液體。

list.en: Make a list of the main ideas before writing your summary.
list.zh: 寫摘要前先列出主要觀念。

listen.en: Students should listen carefully before answering the question.
listen.zh: 學生在回答問題前應仔細聆聽。

listener.en: A careful listener asks questions after understanding the main idea.
listener.zh: 細心的聽者會在理解重點後再提問。

liter.en: The bottle can hold exactly one liter of water.
liter.zh: 這個瓶子剛好可以裝一公升的水。

literacy.en: Digital literacy helps students judge whether online information is reliable.
literacy.zh: 數位素養能幫助學生判斷網路資訊是否可靠。

literal.en: A literal translation may sound unnatural in another language.
literal.zh: 逐字翻譯在另一種語言中可能聽起來不自然。

literary.en: The teacher introduced several literary techniques used in the short story.
literary.zh: 老師介紹短篇故事中使用的幾種文學技巧。

literate.en: Being media literate helps people evaluate news more carefully.
literate.zh: 具備媒體素養能幫助人們更仔細評估新聞。

literature.en: The course introduces students to modern literature from several countries.
literature.zh: 這門課介紹來自多個國家的現代文學作品。

litter.en: Volunteers collected litter along the riverbank on Saturday morning.
litter.zh: 志工星期六早上在河岸撿拾垃圾。

little.en: A little preparation can make a difficult task much easier.
little.zh: 一點準備就能讓困難任務容易許多。

live.en: Many people live near the river because transportation is convenient.
live.zh: 許多人住在河邊，因為交通方便。

lively.en: The class became lively when students began sharing travel stories.
lively.zh: 學生開始分享旅行故事後，課堂變得很活潑。

liver.en: The biology diagram shows how the liver helps process nutrients in the body.
liver.zh: 生物圖表顯示肝臟如何幫助身體處理營養物質。

livestock.en: Farmers moved their livestock to higher ground before the heavy rain arrived.
livestock.zh: 大雨來臨前，農民把牲畜移到較高的地方。

lizard.en: A small lizard rested on the warm stone beside the garden path.
lizard.zh: 一隻小蜥蜴停在花園小徑旁溫暖的石頭上。

load.en: The truck carried a heavy load of supplies to the mountain village.
load.zh: 卡車載著一大批補給品前往山村。

loaf.en: We bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery this morning.
loaf.zh: 我們今天早上從麵包店買了一條新鮮麵包。

loan.en: The student applied for a small loan to cover tuition expenses.
loan.zh: 那名學生申請了一筆小額貸款來支付學費。

lobby.en: Visitors waited in the hotel lobby until their rooms were ready.
lobby.zh: 訪客在飯店大廳等候，直到房間準備好。

lobster.en: The aquarium displayed a large lobster hiding beneath a rocky ledge.
lobster.zh: 水族館展示了一隻躲在岩石下方的大龍蝦。

local.en: The school bought vegetables from a local farm.
local.zh: 學校向當地農場購買蔬菜。

locate.en: Use the map to locate the river near the city center.
locate.zh: 利用地圖找出市中心附近那條河的位置。

location.en: The app can show your current location on the map.
location.zh: 這個應用程式可以在地圖上顯示你目前的位置。

lock.en: Remember to lock the classroom door before leaving.
lock.zh: 離開前記得把教室門鎖上。

locker.en: She kept her sports shoes in a locker near the gym.
locker.zh: 她把運動鞋放在體育館附近的置物櫃裡。

lodge.en: Our class stayed at a mountain lodge during the science field trip.
lodge.zh: 我們班在科學校外教學期間住在山間旅舍。

lofty.en: The speaker described a lofty goal of providing education for everyone.
lofty.zh: 演講者描述了讓每個人都能受教育的崇高目標。

log.en: The research team kept a daily log of temperature changes.
log.zh: 研究團隊每天記錄氣溫變化。

logic.en: Her argument followed clear logic and used evidence from the report.
logic.zh: 她的論點邏輯清楚，並使用報告中的證據。

logical.en: A logical argument should connect evidence clearly to its conclusion.
logical.zh: 合乎邏輯的論點應清楚連結證據與結論。

logo.en: The club designed a simple logo for its new website.
logo.zh: 社團為新網站設計了一個簡單的標誌。

lollipop.en: The child chose a strawberry lollipop from the small candy shop.
lollipop.zh: 那個孩子在小糖果店選了一支草莓棒棒糖。

lone.en: A lone bicycle stood outside the quiet station after sunset.
lone.zh: 日落後，一輛孤零零的腳踏車停在安靜的車站外。

lonely.en: Moving to a new school can feel lonely at first.
lonely.zh: 剛轉到新學校時可能會感到孤單。

lonesome.en: The empty road looked lonesome under the pale winter sky.
lonesome.zh: 空蕩的道路在淡淡冬日天空下顯得寂寥。

long.en: The long bridge connects the island with the nearby mainland.
long.zh: 這座長橋連接島嶼與附近的大陸。

longevity.en: Regular exercise and balanced meals may support health and longevity.
longevity.zh: 規律運動與均衡飲食可能有助於健康與長壽。

longitude.en: The geography class used longitude to locate cities on the map.
longitude.zh: 地理課利用經度在地圖上定位城市。

look.en: Look at the graph carefully before choosing your answer.
look.zh: 選答案前請仔細看這張圖表。

loop.en: The hiking trail forms a loop around the lake.
loop.zh: 這條健行步道繞著湖形成一個環狀路線。

loose.en: The loose screw made the chair wobble whenever someone sat down.
loose.zh: 鬆動的螺絲讓椅子每次有人坐下時都會搖晃。

loosen.en: Warm water can loosen the label from the glass jar.
loosen.zh: 溫水可以讓玻璃罐上的標籤鬆開。

lord.en: The historical novel describes a local lord who governed the valley.
lord.zh: 這本歷史小說描述一位治理山谷的地方領主。

lose.en: You may lose important files if you forget to save them.
lose.zh: 如果忘記儲存，你可能會遺失重要檔案。

loser.en: Calling someone a loser can hurt feelings and end a friendship.
loser.zh: 稱別人為失敗者可能傷害感情並破壞友誼。

loss.en: The company reported a small loss during the first quarter.
loss.zh: 公司第一季出現小幅虧損。

lot.en: A lot of students attended the science fair this year.
lot.zh: 今年有很多學生參加科展。

lotion.en: She applied lotion to her hands after washing them repeatedly.
lotion.zh: 她多次洗手後在手上擦了乳液。

lotus.en: A pink lotus opened slowly on the surface of the pond.
lotus.zh: 一朵粉紅蓮花在池塘水面上慢慢綻放。

loud.en: The music was too loud for us to concentrate.
loud.zh: 音樂太大聲，讓我們無法專心。

loudspeaker.en: The principal made an announcement through the school loudspeaker before lunch.
loudspeaker.zh: 校長在午餐前透過學校廣播器發表公告。

lounge.en: Students can relax in the lounge between afternoon classes.
lounge.zh: 學生可以在下午課程之間到休息室放鬆。

lousy.en: The lousy weather forced the outdoor concert to move inside.
lousy.zh: 糟糕的天氣迫使戶外音樂會移到室內舉行。

love.en: She developed a love of reading at an early age.
love.zh: 她從小就培養出對閱讀的喜愛。

lovely.en: The park has a lovely view of the river at sunset.
lovely.zh: 這座公園在日落時可以看到美麗的河景。

lover.en: The museum guide described the poet as a lifelong lover of nature.
lover.zh: 博物館導覽員形容這位詩人終身熱愛大自然。

low.en: The temperature remained low throughout the morning.
low.zh: 整個早上氣溫都維持在低點。

lower.en: The new design could lower energy use in large buildings.
lower.zh: 新的設計可以降低大型建築的能源使用。

loyal.en: A loyal friend stays supportive even during difficult times.
loyal.zh: 忠誠的朋友即使在困難時也會給予支持。

loyalty.en: The story explores loyalty between friends facing a difficult choice.
loyalty.zh: 這個故事探討朋友在面對艱難選擇時的忠誠。

luck.en: Good preparation matters more than luck in most exams.
luck.zh: 在多數考試中，充分準備比運氣更重要。

lucky.en: We were lucky to catch the last train home.
lucky.zh: 我們很幸運趕上最後一班回家的火車。

lucrative.en: The company found a lucrative market for its educational software overseas.
lucrative.zh: 這家公司在海外找到教育軟體的高獲利市場。

luggage.en: Passengers placed their luggage beside the counter before checking in.
luggage.zh: 旅客辦理報到前把行李放在櫃檯旁。

lullaby.en: Her grandmother sang a gentle lullaby to help the baby sleep.
lullaby.zh: 她的祖母唱了一首輕柔搖籃曲幫助嬰兒入睡。

lump.en: A small lump of clay became a bowl during art class.
lump.zh: 一小塊黏土在美術課中被做成了一個碗。

lunar.en: Scientists are studying lunar rocks to learn more about the Moon.
lunar.zh: 科學家正在研究月球岩石，以更了解月球。

lunch.en: We discussed the project during lunch in the cafeteria.
lunch.zh: 我們午餐時在餐廳討論了專題。

lung.en: The diagram shows how each lung expands when we breathe in.
lung.zh: 圖表顯示我們吸氣時每個肺如何擴張。

lure.en: Bright flowers lure insects that help carry pollen between plants.
lure.zh: 鮮豔花朵會吸引昆蟲，幫助植物之間傳播花粉。

lush.en: The valley became lush and green after several weeks of rain.
lush.zh: 連續幾週降雨後，山谷變得翠綠茂盛。

luxurious.en: The hotel looked luxurious, but our room was surprisingly affordable.
luxurious.zh: 這家飯店看起來很豪華，但我們的房間價格意外親民。

luxury.en: Clean drinking water is a necessity rather than a luxury.
luxury.zh: 乾淨飲用水是必需品，而不是奢侈品。

machine.en: The machine stops automatically if the temperature becomes too high.
machine.zh: 溫度過高時，機器會自動停止。

machinery.en: Modern machinery allows the factory to produce parts more efficiently.
machinery.zh: 現代機械讓工廠能更有效率地生產零件。

mad.en: He was mad about the delay but remained polite to the staff.
mad.zh: 他對延誤感到生氣，但對工作人員仍保持禮貌。

madam.en: The clerk politely addressed the customer as madam during the conversation.
madam.zh: 店員在交談中禮貌地稱呼那位顧客為女士。

magazine.en: The library keeps a science magazine near the reading area.
magazine.zh: 圖書館在閱讀區附近放了一本科學雜誌。

magic.en: The stage show used lighting and music to create a sense of magic.
magic.zh: 舞台表演利用燈光與音樂營造魔幻感。

magical.en: The snowy forest looked magical under the early morning light.
magical.zh: 覆雪森林在清晨光線下看起來十分夢幻。

magician.en: The magician surprised the audience with a clever card trick.
magician.zh: 魔術師用巧妙的紙牌魔術讓觀眾驚喜。

magnet.en: A strong magnet can attract certain metals from a short distance.
magnet.zh: 強力磁鐵可以從短距離吸引某些金屬。

magnetic.en: The experiment demonstrated how a magnetic field affects a compass needle.
magnetic.zh: 實驗示範磁場如何影響指南針指針。

magnificent.en: We saw a magnificent view of the mountains from the train.
magnificent.zh: 我們從火車上看到了壯麗的山景。

magnify.en: This microscope can magnify tiny cells for closer observation.
magnify.zh: 這台顯微鏡可以放大微小細胞，方便仔細觀察。

maid.en: The novel mentions a maid who works in a large country house.
maid.zh: 小說提到一位在大型鄉間宅邸工作的女僕。

maiden.en: The old tale follows a brave maiden through a mysterious forest.
maiden.zh: 這則古老故事描述一位勇敢少女穿越神祕森林。

mail.en: The school sent the registration form by mail last week.
mail.zh: 學校上週以郵件寄出了報名表。

main.en: The main reason for the change was improved safety.
main.zh: 這項改變的主要原因是提升安全。

mainland.en: A ferry connects the small island to the mainland every morning.
mainland.zh: 渡輪每天早上連接這座小島與大陸。

mainstream.en: The idea moved from a small community into mainstream discussion.
mainstream.zh: 這個想法從小眾社群進入主流討論。

maintain.en: Regular maintenance helps maintain the equipment in good condition.
maintain.zh: 定期保養有助於讓設備維持良好狀態。

maintenance.en: Regular maintenance keeps the school computers working reliably.
maintenance.zh: 定期維護能讓學校電腦穩定運作。

majestic.en: The majestic mountain rose above the clouds in the distance.
majestic.zh: 雄偉的山峰在遠方高出雲層。

majesty.en: Visitors admired the majesty of the ancient temple at sunrise.
majesty.zh: 遊客在日出時欣賞古寺的宏偉氣勢。

major.en: Traffic is a major problem in many large cities.
major.zh: 交通是許多大城市的一項主要問題。

majority.en: The majority of students supported the new library schedule.
majority.zh: 大多數學生支持新的圖書館開放時間。

make.en: Careful planning can make a difficult project easier to manage.
make.zh: 仔細規劃能讓困難的專題更容易處理。

makeup.en: The theater club prepared stage makeup before the evening performance.
makeup.zh: 戲劇社在晚間演出前準備舞台妝。

male.en: The study compared male and female birds during the nesting season.
male.zh: 這項研究比較築巢季節中的雄鳥與雌鳥。

mall.en: We met at the mall before taking the bus home.
mall.zh: 我們搭公車回家前在購物中心碰面。

mammal.en: A whale is a mammal even though it lives in water.
mammal.zh: 鯨魚雖然生活在水中，仍然是哺乳動物。

man.en: The man at the information desk showed us the correct platform.
man.zh: 服務台的那名男子告訴我們正確月台。

manage.en: She learned to manage her time more effectively before exams.
manage.zh: 她學會在考前更有效管理時間。

management.en: Good time management helps students balance study and rest.
management.zh: 良好的時間管理能幫助學生平衡讀書與休息。

manager.en: The manager explained the new schedule to the staff.
manager.zh: 經理向員工說明了新的排班。

mandate.en: The new policy gives schools a mandate to reduce unnecessary waste.
mandate.zh: 新政策授權學校減少不必要的浪費。

mango.en: She cut a ripe mango into pieces for the fruit salad.
mango.zh: 她把熟芒果切成小塊做水果沙拉。

manifest.en: Stress can manifest in different ways during a busy exam week.
manifest.zh: 壓力在繁忙考試週可能以不同方式表現出來。

manipulate.en: Students manipulate the model to observe how each part moves.
manipulate.zh: 學生操作模型來觀察各個部件如何移動。

mankind.en: The documentary asks how technology may shape the future of mankind.
mankind.zh: 這部紀錄片探討科技可能如何塑造人類的未來。

manner.en: He answered the difficult question in a calm manner.
manner.zh: 他以冷靜的方式回答那個難題。

mansion.en: The historic mansion now serves as a museum for local visitors.
mansion.zh: 這座歷史宅邸如今作為地方博物館使用。

manual.en: The instruction manual explains how to assemble the desk safely.
manual.zh: 說明手冊解釋如何安全組裝這張書桌。

manufacture.en: The factory can manufacture thousands of parts each week.
manufacture.zh: 這座工廠每週可以製造數千個零件。

manufacturer.en: The manufacturer recalled the product after discovering a design problem.
manufacturer.zh: 製造商發現設計問題後召回了產品。

manuscript.en: The library preserves a handwritten manuscript from the nineteenth century.
manuscript.zh: 圖書館保存了一份十九世紀的手寫稿。

many.en: Many students use flashcards to review vocabulary.
many.zh: 許多學生使用單字卡複習單字。

map.en: The map shows several walking routes around the park.
map.zh: 這張地圖顯示公園周邊的幾條步行路線。

maple.en: A red maple stood beside the entrance to the park.
maple.zh: 一棵紅楓樹立在公園入口旁。

mar.en: Heavy pollution can mar the beauty of a natural landscape.
mar.zh: 嚴重污染可能破壞自然景觀的美感。

marathon.en: She trained for months before completing her first marathon.
marathon.zh: 她訓練了好幾個月，才完成第一次馬拉松。

marble.en: The museum floor was made from smooth white marble.
marble.zh: 博物館地板由光滑的白色大理石鋪成。

march.en: Students watched the band march across the field during the ceremony.
march.zh: 學生在典禮中看著樂隊行進穿過操場。

margin.en: Write your notes in the margin beside the paragraph.
margin.zh: 把筆記寫在段落旁的頁邊空白處。

marginal.en: The second method produced only a marginal improvement in accuracy.
marginal.zh: 第二種方法在準確度上只帶來些微提升。

marine.en: Marine scientists recorded changes in water temperature near the reef.
marine.zh: 海洋科學家記錄了珊瑚礁附近水溫的變化。

mark.en: Please mark the correct answer clearly on the sheet.
mark.zh: 請在答案紙上清楚標示正確答案。

marker.en: Use a black marker to label each box clearly.
marker.zh: 用黑色麥克筆清楚標示每個箱子。

market.en: The night market becomes especially busy on weekends.

marriage.en: The novel follows a family through many years of marriage.
marriage.zh: 這本小說描寫一個家庭多年的婚姻生活。

married.en: The biography explains that the writer married young and moved abroad.
married.zh: 傳記說明這位作家年輕時結婚並搬到國外。

marry.en: The biography says the two writers chose to marry after college.
marry.zh: 傳記提到兩位作家大學畢業後選擇結婚。

martial.en: The museum displayed traditional martial equipment from several historical periods.
martial.zh: 博物館展示了不同歷史時期的傳統武術裝備。

marvel.en: Visitors often marvel at the detailed carvings inside the old temple.
marvel.zh: 遊客常對古寺內精細的雕刻感到驚嘆。

marvelous.en: The concert ended with a marvelous performance by the school orchestra.
marvelous.zh: 音樂會以校管弦樂團精彩的演出作結。

masculine.en: The article examines how language can express masculine and feminine styles.
masculine.zh: 文章探討語言如何表達陽剛與陰柔風格。

mask.en: The actor wore a colorful mask during the traditional dance.
mask.zh: 演員在傳統舞蹈中戴著彩色面具。

mass.en: The experiment measured the mass of several objects in grams.
mass.zh: 實驗用公克測量數個物體的質量。

massage.en: A gentle shoulder massage helped her relax after a long day.
massage.zh: 輕柔的肩部按摩讓她在漫長一天後放鬆下來。

massive.en: The storm caused massive delays across the regional train network.
massive.zh: 暴風雨造成區域鐵路系統大規模延誤。

master.en: It takes patience and practice to master a new language skill.
master.zh: 要熟練一項新的語言技能需要耐心與練習。

masterpiece.en: Many critics consider the painting a masterpiece of modern art.
masterpiece.zh: 許多評論家認為這幅畫是現代藝術傑作。

mastery.en: Regular practice gradually leads to greater mastery of difficult concepts.
mastery.zh: 規律練習會逐漸提升對困難概念的掌握。

mat.en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before entering the room.
mat.zh: 進房間前請在地墊上擦一擦鞋子。

match.en: This blue shirt does not match the green jacket very well.
match.zh: 這件藍色上衣和綠色外套不太搭。

mate.en: Each student worked with a class mate during the activity.
mate.zh: 活動期間每位學生都和一位同學合作。

material.en: This material is strong enough to support the model.
material.zh: 這種材料夠堅固，可以支撐模型。

math.en: Our math teacher used a puzzle to introduce the new topic.
math.zh: 我們的數學老師用一道謎題介紹新主題。

mathematical.en: The project requires careful mathematical reasoning and accurate measurements.
mathematical.zh: 這個專題需要仔細的數學推理與精確測量。

mathematics.en: Mathematics provides useful tools for science, economics, and engineering.
mathematics.zh: 數學為科學、經濟與工程提供實用工具。

matter.en: Small details can matter when the final score is close.
matter.zh: 當分數很接近時，小細節也可能很重要。

mattress.en: The old mattress was replaced because it had become uncomfortable.
mattress.zh: 舊床墊因為變得不舒服而被更換。

mature.en: A mature response considers both the problem and possible solutions.
mature.zh: 成熟的回應會同時考慮問題與可能的解決方法。

maturity.en: Her calm response showed unusual maturity for someone so young.
maturity.zh: 她冷靜的回應展現出超越年齡的成熟。

maximum.en: The elevator has a maximum capacity of ten passengers.
maximum.zh: 這部電梯最多可容納十名乘客。

may.en: The outdoor event may be canceled if the rain continues.
may.zh: 如果雨一直下，戶外活動可能會取消。

maybe.en: Maybe we should compare the two plans again before deciding.
maybe.zh: 也許我們應該在決定前再比較一次兩個方案。

mayor.en: The mayor visited the school to discuss plans for safer streets.
mayor.zh: 市長到學校討論改善街道安全的計畫。

me.en: My teacher asked me to explain how I solved the problem.
me.zh: 老師請我說明我是如何解出這道題的。

meadow.en: Wildflowers covered the meadow beside the forest in early spring.
meadow.zh: 初春時，野花覆蓋了森林旁的草地。

meal.en: A balanced meal should include several different kinds of food.
meal.zh: 均衡的一餐應包含多種不同食物。

mean.en: What does this expression mean in the passage?
mean.zh: 這個表達方式在文章中是什麼意思？

meaning.en: Context often helps readers understand the meaning of an unfamiliar word.
meaning.zh: 語境常能幫助讀者理解陌生單字的意思。

meaningful.en: Volunteering can create meaningful connections with people in your community.
meaningful.zh: 志工服務可以和社區中的人建立有意義的連結。

means.en: Public transport provides a convenient means of reaching the city center.
means.zh: 大眾運輸提供了一種方便前往市中心的方式。

meantime.en: The bus was delayed; in the meantime, we reviewed our notes.
meantime.zh: 公車延誤了；等待期間，我們複習了筆記。

meanwhile.en: The first group prepared the slides; meanwhile, the others checked the data.
meanwhile.zh: 第一組準備投影片，同時其他人檢查資料。

measurable.en: The new study method produced a measurable improvement in reading speed.
measurable.zh: 新的讀書方法讓閱讀速度出現可測量的進步。

measure.en: Students measure the temperature at the same time each day.
measure.zh: 學生每天在同一時間測量溫度。

measurement.en: Accurate measurement is important when conducting a chemistry experiment.
measurement.zh: 進行化學實驗時，精確測量非常重要。

meat.en: The restaurant offers vegetables, rice, and several kinds of meat.
meat.zh: 這家餐廳提供蔬菜、米飯和好幾種肉類。

mechanic.en: A mechanic inspected the bicycle and replaced the worn brake cable.
mechanic.zh: 技師檢查腳踏車並更換磨損的煞車線。

mechanical.en: The museum contains several mechanical devices from the early industrial era.
mechanical.zh: 博物館收藏了早期工業時代的幾種機械裝置。

mechanism.en: The lesson explains the basic mechanism behind the water filter.
mechanism.zh: 這堂課說明濾水器背後的基本運作機制。

medal.en: She received a medal for her strong performance in the competition.
medal.zh: 她因比賽中的優秀表現獲得一面獎牌。

media.en: Social media can spread information very quickly among young people.
media.zh: 社群媒體可以在年輕人之間快速傳播資訊。

mediate.en: A teacher helped mediate the disagreement between the two groups.
mediate.zh: 老師協助調解兩組之間的意見分歧。

medical.en: The school invited a medical expert to speak about public health.
medical.zh: 學校邀請一位醫療專家談公共衛生。

medication.en: The health article explains why medication should be used as directed.
medication.zh: 健康文章說明藥物應依指示使用的原因。

medicine.en: Take the medicine exactly as the doctor instructed.
medicine.zh: 請完全按照醫師指示服用藥物。

medieval.en: The castle offers visitors a glimpse of medieval life and architecture.
medieval.zh: 這座城堡讓遊客一窺中世紀生活與建築。

meditate.en: Some students meditate for a few minutes before beginning homework.
meditate.zh: 有些學生在開始寫作業前會冥想幾分鐘。

meditation.en: A short meditation helped the class settle down before the presentation.
meditation.zh: 短暫冥想幫助全班在簡報前安定下來。

medium.en: Watercolor is the artist's favorite medium for painting outdoor scenes.
medium.zh: 水彩是這位藝術家描繪戶外景色最喜歡的媒材。

meet.en: We will meet in front of the library after class.
meet.zh: 下課後我們會在圖書館前碰面。

meeting.en: The meeting ended early because everyone agreed on the plan.
meeting.zh: 因為大家都同意這個計畫，會議提早結束。

melancholy.en: The song has a melancholy mood despite its gentle melody.
melancholy.zh: 這首歌旋律柔和，卻帶有憂鬱的氛圍。

melody.en: I recognized the familiar melody as soon as the piano began.
melody.zh: 鋼琴一開始演奏，我就認出了熟悉的旋律。

melon.en: We shared a chilled melon after lunch on the hot afternoon.
melon.zh: 炎熱午後，我們午餐後一起吃了冰涼的瓜。

melt.en: The ice will melt quickly if you leave it in sunlight.
melt.zh: 如果把冰放在陽光下，它很快就會融化。

member.en: Every member of the team has a different responsibility.
member.zh: 團隊中的每位成員都有不同責任。

membership.en: Club membership gives students access to workshops and special events.
membership.zh: 社團會員資格讓學生能參加工作坊與特別活動。

memorable.en: The class trip became memorable because everyone worked well together.
memorable.zh: 這次班級旅行因大家合作愉快而令人難忘。

memorial.en: A small memorial stands near the station to honor local history.
memorial.zh: 車站附近有一座小紀念碑，用來紀念地方歷史。

memorize.en: Try to understand the idea instead of trying to memorize every sentence.
memorize.zh: 試著理解概念，而不是硬背每一句話。

memory.en: Regular review can improve long-term memory of new vocabulary.
memory.zh: 規律複習能提升新單字的長期記憶。

mend.en: She learned to mend a torn backpack instead of replacing it.
mend.zh: 她學會修補破掉的背包，而不是直接更換。

mental.en: Regular breaks can support mental focus during long study sessions.
mental.zh: 規律休息能幫助長時間讀書時維持專注。

mentality.en: A growth mentality encourages students to learn from mistakes.
mentality.zh: 成長心態鼓勵學生從錯誤中學習。

mention.en: Please mention the source whenever you use information from the article.
mention.zh: 使用文章資訊時，請記得提到資料來源。

mentor.en: A good mentor can offer guidance when students face difficult choices.
mentor.zh: 好的導師能在學生面對艱難選擇時提供指引。

menu.en: The café menu includes sandwiches, soup, and several vegetarian choices.
menu.zh: 咖啡館菜單有三明治、湯和多種素食選擇。

merchandise.en: The museum shop sells merchandise related to the current exhibition.
merchandise.zh: 博物館商店販售與目前展覽相關的商品。

merchant.en: The old merchant sold cloth and spices at the market.
merchant.zh: 那位老商人在市場販售布料和香料。

mercy.en: The story shows a ruler choosing mercy instead of punishment.
mercy.zh: 故事描述一位統治者選擇仁慈而不是懲罰。

mere.en: A mere ten minutes of review improved her confidence before class.
mere.zh: 僅僅十分鐘的複習就提升了她上課前的信心。

merge.en: The two small clubs decided to merge into one larger group.
merge.zh: 兩個小社團決定合併成一個較大的團體。

merit.en: The proposal has merit because it solves several practical problems.
merit.zh: 這項提案有其優點，因為它解決了幾個實際問題。

mermaid.en: The children read a story about a mermaid near the sea.
mermaid.zh: 孩子們讀了一個關於海邊美人魚的故事。

merry.en: The room felt merry during the end-of-year celebration.
merry.zh: 年終慶祝活動時，整個房間充滿歡樂氣氛。

mess.en: Please clean the mess on the table before class begins.
mess.zh: 上課開始前，請把桌上的凌亂收拾乾淨。

message.en: I sent a short message to confirm the meeting time.
message.zh: 我傳了一則簡短訊息確認會議時間。

messenger.en: A messenger delivered the document to the office before noon.
messenger.zh: 一名信使在中午前把文件送到辦公室。

messy.en: His desk became messy after several hours of project work.
messy.zh: 做了幾個小時的專題後，他的桌面變得很亂。

metal.en: The bridge uses strong metal beams to support its weight.
metal.zh: 這座橋使用堅固的金屬樑來支撐重量。

metaphor.en: The teacher explained how a metaphor can make writing more vivid.
metaphor.zh: 老師說明比喻如何讓文章更生動。

meter.en: The runner stopped after completing one hundred meter intervals.
meter.zh: 跑者完成數次一百公尺間歇後停下來休息。

method.en: This method helps students organize complex information more clearly.
method.zh: 這種方法能幫助學生更清楚整理複雜資訊。

metro.en: Many commuters use the metro to reach the city center.
metro.zh: 許多通勤族搭地鐵前往市中心。

metropolitan.en: The metropolitan area includes several cities and surrounding suburbs.
metropolitan.zh: 這個都會區包含數個城市與周邊郊區。

microphone.en: She tested the microphone before giving her presentation on stage.
microphone.zh: 她上台報告前先測試了麥克風。

microscope.en: Students used a microscope to examine tiny plant cells.
microscope.zh: 學生使用顯微鏡觀察微小的植物細胞。

microwave.en: The office has a microwave for heating lunch during breaks.
microwave.zh: 辦公室有一台微波爐供大家休息時加熱午餐。

middle.en: The school is located in the middle of the neighborhood.
middle.zh: 學校位於這個社區的中央。

midnight.en: The final train leaves shortly before midnight on weekdays.
midnight.zh: 平日末班車會在午夜前不久發車。

midst.en: She stayed calm in the midst of a busy school week.
midst.zh: 在忙碌的一週中，她仍保持冷靜。

mighty.en: The mighty river has shaped the valley for thousands of years.
mighty.zh: 這條壯闊河流數千年來塑造了山谷地形。

migrant.en: The article describes challenges faced by a migrant worker abroad.
migrant.zh: 文章描述移工在海外面臨的挑戰。

migration.en: Scientists track bird migration to understand seasonal movement patterns.
migration.zh: 科學家追蹤鳥類遷徙，以了解季節移動模式。

mike.en: The reporter adjusted the mike before the interview began.
mike.zh: 記者在訪談開始前調整麥克風。

mild.en: The weather remained mild despite several days of winter rain.
mild.zh: 儘管連續幾天下冬雨，天氣仍然溫和。

mile.en: The trail continues for another mile beyond the bridge.
mile.zh: 這條步道過橋後還延伸一英里。

milestone.en: Finishing the research project was an important milestone for our team.
milestone.zh: 完成研究專題是我們團隊的重要里程碑。

military.en: The museum presents military history through uniforms, maps, and letters.
military.zh: 博物館透過制服、地圖與書信呈現軍事歷史。

milk.en: She drank a glass of milk with breakfast.
milk.zh: 她早餐時喝了一杯牛奶。

mill.en: The old mill once used river water to power its machinery.
mill.zh: 那座老磨坊曾利用河水驅動機械。

million.en: The charity campaign raised more than one million dollars worldwide.
million.zh: 這項慈善活動在全球募得超過一百萬美元。

millionaire.en: The novel follows a millionaire who chooses a simple rural life.
millionaire.zh: 這本小說描述一名百萬富翁選擇樸實鄉村生活。

mimic.en: Some birds can mimic sounds they hear in their environment.
mimic.zh: 有些鳥可以模仿牠們在環境中聽到的聲音。

mind.en: Keep an open mind when listening to different opinions.
mind.zh: 聽取不同意見時要保持開放的心態。

mine.en: That blue notebook is mine, so please leave it here.
mine.zh: 那本藍色筆記本是我的，請把它留在這裡。

miner.en: The documentary interviewed a retired miner about working underground.
miner.zh: 紀錄片訪問一名退休礦工，談地下工作的經驗。

mineral.en: Quartz is a common mineral found in many types of rock.
mineral.zh: 石英是許多岩石中常見的礦物。

mingle.en: Students had time to mingle after the school ceremony ended.
mingle.zh: 學校典禮結束後，學生有時間互相交流。

miniature.en: The museum displayed a miniature model of the historic station.
miniature.zh: 博物館展示那座歷史車站的縮小模型。

minimal.en: The final design uses a minimal amount of material.
minimal.zh: 最後的設計使用最少量的材料。

minimize.en: Careful planning can minimize errors during the final experiment.
minimize.zh: 仔細規劃可以把最後實驗中的錯誤降到最低。

minimum.en: The course requires a minimum of ten hours of practice.
minimum.zh: 這門課至少需要十小時練習。

minister.en: The minister answered questions about the new education policy.
minister.zh: 部長回答有關新教育政策的問題。

ministry.en: The ministry published updated guidelines for school safety inspections.
ministry.zh: 該部會公布更新版校園安全檢查指引。

minor.en: The report found only a minor difference between the two groups.
minor.zh: 報告發現兩組之間只有小幅差異。

minority.en: A small minority of students chose the optional evening course.
minority.zh: 只有少數學生選擇了選修的晚間課程。

mint.en: Fresh mint gave the cold drink a clean herbal smell.
mint.zh: 新鮮薄荷讓冷飲帶有清新的草本香氣。

minus.en: Ten minus four equals six in this simple equation.
minus.zh: 在這個簡單算式中，十減四等於六。

minute.en: Please wait one minute while I check the schedule.
minute.zh: 請等一分鐘，我確認一下行程。

miracle.en: The coach called the unexpected comeback a small miracle.
miracle.zh: 教練把這次意外逆轉稱為一個小奇蹟。

miraculous.en: The ancient story describes a miraculous event beside the river.
miraculous.zh: 這則古老故事描述河邊發生的一件神奇事件。

mirror.en: The old mirror reflected sunlight across the quiet room.
mirror.zh: 那面舊鏡子把陽光反射到安靜房間裡。

miscellaneous.en: The last drawer contains miscellaneous cables, batteries, and small tools.
miscellaneous.zh: 最後一個抽屜放著各式線材、電池與小工具。

mischief.en: The puppy's harmless mischief made everyone in the house laugh.
mischief.zh: 小狗無傷大雅的惡作劇逗得全家都笑了。

mischievous.en: The mischievous cat hid behind the curtain and surprised us.
mischievous.zh: 那隻調皮的貓躲在窗簾後面嚇了我們一跳。

miserable.en: The cold rain made the long outdoor wait feel miserable.
miserable.zh: 寒冷的雨讓漫長的戶外等待變得很難受。

misery.en: The novel shows how poverty brought misery to the village.
misery.zh: 小說呈現貧困如何為村莊帶來苦難。

misfortune.en: Despite the misfortune, the family rebuilt their business slowly.
misfortune.zh: 儘管遭遇不幸，那家人仍慢慢重建事業。

mislead.en: A dramatic headline can mislead readers if important context is missing.
mislead.zh: 如果缺少重要背景，誇張標題可能誤導讀者。

miss.en: You may miss important details if you read too quickly.
miss.zh: 如果讀得太快，你可能會漏掉重要細節。

missing.en: The teacher noticed one missing page in the copied report.
missing.zh: 老師注意到影印報告少了一頁。

mission.en: The research team's mission is to measure air quality accurately.
mission.zh: 研究團隊的任務是準確測量空氣品質。

missionary.en: The archive contains letters written by a missionary many decades ago.
missionary.zh: 檔案館收藏一位傳教士數十年前寫的書信。

mist.en: A thin mist covered the lake early in the morning.
mist.zh: 一早湖面覆著一層薄霧。

mistake.en: A small mistake can change the final answer completely.
mistake.zh: 一個小錯誤可能完全改變最後答案。

mister.en: The child politely used mister when addressing the unfamiliar visitor.
mister.zh: 孩子禮貌地用先生稱呼那位不熟悉的訪客。

misunderstand.en: Please ask questions if you misunderstand any part of the instructions.
misunderstand.zh: 如果你誤解任何一部分說明，請提出問題。

mix.en: Use a spoon to mix the flour and water evenly.
mix.zh: 用湯匙把麵粉和水均勻混合。

mixture.en: The experiment produced a cloudy mixture after the two liquids combined.
mixture.zh: 兩種液體混合後，實驗產生了混濁的混合物。

moan.en: A low moan came from the old wooden door in the wind.
moan.zh: 風吹時，舊木門發出低沉的呻吟聲。

mob.en: The history article describes how an angry mob gathered outside.
mob.zh: 歷史文章描述憤怒群眾如何聚集在外面。

mobile.en: The library launched a mobile service for readers in rural areas.
mobile.zh: 圖書館推出行動服務，提供給偏鄉讀者。

mobilize.en: Volunteers began to mobilize supplies after the severe storm.
mobilize.zh: 嚴重暴風雨過後，志工開始動員物資。

mock.en: Students should never mock a classmate for making a mistake.
mock.zh: 學生不應因同學犯錯而嘲笑對方。

mode.en: The tablet switches to reading mode when the room becomes dark.
mode.zh: 房間變暗時，平板會切換到閱讀模式。

model.en: The students built a model to explain how the system works.
model.zh: 學生做了一個模型來說明系統如何運作。

moderate.en: A moderate amount of background noise did not affect the results.
moderate.zh: 適量的背景噪音並沒有影響結果。

modern.en: Modern technology has changed the way people communicate.
modern.zh: 現代科技改變了人們溝通的方式。

modernization.en: Railway modernization shortened travel time between several major cities.
modernization.zh: 鐵路現代化縮短了幾個主要城市之間的旅行時間。

modernize.en: The museum plans to modernize its ticket system next year.
modernize.zh: 博物館計畫明年更新其售票系統。

modest.en: The project began with a modest budget and simple equipment.
modest.zh: 這個計畫以不高的預算和簡單設備起步。

modesty.en: Her modesty kept her from taking all the credit herself.
modesty.zh: 她的謙虛使她沒有把所有功勞歸給自己。

modify.en: The group decided to modify the design after the first test.
modify.zh: 第一次測試後，小組決定修改設計。

moist.en: The soil remained moist after several hours of light rain.
moist.zh: 小雨下了幾小時後，土壤仍保持濕潤。

moisture.en: The container protects the paper from moisture and dust.
moisture.zh: 這個容器能保護紙張免受濕氣與灰塵影響。

molecule.en: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.zh: 一個水分子含有兩個氫原子和一個氧原子。

moment.en: Please wait a moment while the file finishes loading.
moment.zh: 請稍等一下，讓檔案載入完成。

momentum.en: The campaign gained momentum after more students joined the project.
momentum.zh: 更多學生加入後，這項活動逐漸形成動能。

monarch.en: The portrait shows a monarch wearing traditional ceremonial clothing.
monarch.zh: 這幅肖像描繪一位穿著傳統禮服的君主。

monetary.en: The report focused on monetary policy and changes in interest rates.
monetary.zh: 這份報告聚焦貨幣政策與利率變化。

money.en: She saved enough money to buy a new laptop.
money.zh: 她存了足夠的錢買一台新筆電。

monitor.en: Researchers monitor the river level after periods of heavy rain.
monitor.zh: 研究人員在豪雨後監測河川水位。

monk.en: The old painting shows a monk reading beside a window.
monk.zh: 這幅古畫描繪一名僧侶在窗邊閱讀。

monkey.en: A monkey watched visitors from a branch above the path.
monkey.zh: 一隻猴子從步道上方的樹枝看著遊客。

monopoly.en: The economics lesson explains how a monopoly can limit competition.
monopoly.zh: 經濟課說明壟斷如何限制市場競爭。

monotony.en: Music helped break the monotony of the long bus ride.
monotony.zh: 音樂打破了漫長搭車過程的單調感。

monster.en: The children drew a friendly monster for the storytelling activity.
monster.zh: 孩子們為說故事活動畫了一隻友善怪物。

monstrous.en: The novel describes a monstrous shadow moving across the empty hall.
monstrous.zh: 小說描述一道可怕巨大影子掠過空蕩大廳。

month.en: The project must be completed by the end of this month.
month.zh: 這項專題必須在這個月底前完成。

monthly.en: The club publishes a monthly newsletter about upcoming school events.
monthly.zh: 社團每月出版一份介紹近期校園活動的通訊。

monument.en: Visitors gathered near the monument to learn about local history.
monument.zh: 遊客聚集在紀念碑附近了解在地歷史。

mood.en: Soft music changed the mood of the room almost immediately.
mood.zh: 柔和音樂幾乎立刻改變了房間氣氛。

moody.en: The weather was moody, shifting from sunshine to rain quickly.
moody.zh: 天氣變化不定，很快從晴天轉成下雨。

moon.en: The full moon appeared above the hills after sunset.
moon.zh: 日落後，滿月出現在山丘上方。

mop.en: We used a mop to clean the wet classroom floor.
mop.zh: 我們用拖把清理教室潮濕的地板。

moral.en: The story raises a moral question about honesty and responsibility.
moral.zh: 這個故事提出關於誠實與責任的道德問題。

morale.en: The team's morale improved after they solved the difficult problem.
morale.zh: 團隊解決難題後，士氣提升了。

morality.en: The philosophy class discussed morality through several everyday examples.
morality.zh: 哲學課透過幾個日常例子討論道德。

more.en: We need more evidence before making a final decision.
more.zh: 做最後決定前，我們需要更多證據。

moreover.en: The plan is affordable; moreover, it can be completed quickly.
moreover.zh: 這項計畫費用合理，而且還能很快完成。

morning.en: I usually review vocabulary for ten minutes every morning.
morning.zh: 我通常每天早上複習十分鐘單字。

mortal.en: Ancient myths often describe gods interacting with mortal people.
mortal.zh: 古代神話常描述神祇與凡人互動。

mortality.en: The report compares mortality rates across different historical periods.
mortality.zh: 這份報告比較不同歷史時期的死亡率。

mortgage.en: The finance lesson explained how a mortgage works over many years.
mortgage.zh: 財經課說明房貸如何在多年期間運作。

mosquito.en: A mosquito buzzed near the window during the warm evening.
mosquito.zh: 溫暖的晚上，一隻蚊子在窗邊嗡嗡飛。

most.en: Most students finished the assignment before the deadline.
most.zh: 大多數學生都在期限前完成了作業。

mostly.en: The audience was mostly students from nearby senior high schools.
mostly.zh: 觀眾大多是附近高中的學生。

motel.en: The travelers stayed at a small motel beside the highway.
motel.zh: 旅客住在公路旁的一間小汽車旅館。

moth.en: A pale moth circled the porch light after sunset.
moth.zh: 日落後，一隻淡色飛蛾繞著門廊燈飛。

mother.en: My mother helped me prepare lunch for the trip.
mother.zh: 我媽媽幫我準備旅程的午餐。

motherhood.en: The interview explored how motherhood changed her daily priorities.
motherhood.zh: 這場訪談探討成為母親如何改變她的日常優先順序。

motion.en: The physics experiment measured the motion of a rolling ball.
motion.zh: 物理實驗測量一顆滾動球的運動。

motivate.en: Clear goals can motivate students to practice more consistently.
motivate.zh: 明確目標可以激勵學生更規律練習。

motivation.en: Her motivation increased after she saw steady improvement in reading.
motivation.zh: 看到閱讀能力穩定進步後，她的學習動機提高了。

motive.en: The story gradually reveals the main character's motive for leaving.
motive.zh: 故事逐漸揭示主角離開的動機。

motor.en: The small motor powered the model car across the table.
motor.zh: 小型馬達驅動模型車穿過桌面。

motorcycle.en: A motorcycle passed slowly through the narrow village street.
motorcycle.zh: 一輛機車慢慢通過狹窄的村莊街道。

motto.en: The school's motto encourages curiosity, responsibility, and lifelong learning.
motto.zh: 校訓鼓勵好奇心、責任感與終身學習。

mound.en: A small mound of soil formed beside the garden path.
mound.zh: 花園小徑旁形成了一小堆土。

mount.en: The museum will mount the photograph inside a protective frame.
mount.zh: 博物館會把照片裝裱在保護框中。

mountain.en: The mountain trail becomes slippery after heavy rain.
mountain.zh: 大雨後山徑會變得濕滑。

mountainous.en: The mountainous region has winding roads and scattered villages.
mountainous.zh: 這個山區有蜿蜒道路與分散的村落。

mourn.en: People gathered to mourn the loss of an important community leader.
mourn.zh: 人們聚在一起悼念一位重要的社區領袖。

mournful.en: A mournful melody played quietly at the memorial event.
mournful.zh: 紀念活動中輕輕播放著一段哀傷的旋律。

mouse.en: A small mouse appeared near the garden shed after sunset.
mouse.zh: 日落後，一隻小老鼠出現在花園小屋附近。

mouth.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough in the classroom.
mouth.zh: 在教室咳嗽時請遮住嘴巴。

move.en: Please move your chair closer to the table.

movement.en: The sudden movement of the curtain caught everyone's attention.
movement.zh: 窗簾突然的動作吸引了大家的注意。

movie.en: The class watched a short movie about ocean conservation.
movie.zh: 全班看了一部關於海洋保育的短片。

mow.en: They mow the school lawn every Friday before sports practice.
mow.zh: 他們每週五在體育練習前修剪校園草地。

much.en: This method requires much less time than the original one.
much.zh: 這個方法比原本的方法省下很多時間。

mud.en: Heavy rain left thick mud along the hiking path.
mud.zh: 大雨在健行步道上留下厚厚的泥巴。

muddy.en: Our shoes became muddy after walking through the wet field.
muddy.zh: 走過潮濕的田地後，我們的鞋子變得泥濘。

mug.en: She poured warm tea into her favorite ceramic mug.
mug.zh: 她把熱茶倒進自己最喜歡的陶瓷杯。

mule.en: The mule carried supplies along the narrow mountain trail.
mule.zh: 騾子沿著狹窄山路運送補給品。

multiple.en: The project uses multiple sources to compare different viewpoints.
multiple.zh: 這項專題使用多個來源比較不同觀點。

multiply.en: To multiply these numbers, follow the steps shown on the board.
multiply.zh: 要將這些數字相乘，請依照黑板上的步驟。

mumble.en: He began to mumble because he felt nervous during the presentation.
mumble.zh: 他在報告時因緊張而開始含糊低語。

municipal.en: The municipal library opened a new study room for students.
municipal.zh: 市立圖書館為學生開放了一間新的自習室。

murmur.en: A quiet murmur spread through the audience before the concert began.
murmur.zh: 音樂會開始前，觀眾席傳出低聲交談。

muscle.en: Regular movement helps each muscle stay active and flexible.
muscle.zh: 規律活動有助於每塊肌肉保持活躍與靈活。

muscular.en: The biology chart shows how the muscular system supports movement.
muscular.zh: 生物圖表顯示肌肉系統如何支持身體活動。

muse.en: The peaceful lake can muse artists seeking ideas for new paintings.
muse.zh: 寧靜的湖泊能啟發尋找新畫作靈感的藝術家。

museum.en: Our class visited the science museum during the field trip.
museum.zh: 我們班在校外教學時參觀了科學博物館。

mushroom.en: A tiny mushroom grew beside the fallen tree after the rain.
mushroom.zh: 雨後，一朵小蘑菇長在倒下的樹旁。

music.en: Soft music can help some students relax while studying.
music.zh: 輕柔音樂能幫助一些學生在讀書時放鬆。

musical.en: The school musical attracted a large audience on opening night.
musical.zh: 學校音樂劇首演當晚吸引了許多觀眾。

musician.en: The young musician practiced the violin before every performance.
musician.zh: 那位年輕音樂家每次演出前都練習小提琴。

must.en: Students must follow the safety rules in the laboratory.
must.zh: 學生在實驗室必須遵守安全規則。

mustache.en: The actor wore a fake mustache for the comedy scene.
mustache.zh: 那位演員在喜劇場景中戴了一撮假鬍子。

mustard.en: He added a little mustard to his sandwich at lunch.
mustard.zh: 午餐時他在三明治裡加了一點芥末。

mute.en: Please mute your microphone while another student is speaking online.
mute.zh: 其他同學在線上發言時請將麥克風靜音。

mutual.en: Successful teamwork depends on mutual respect among all group members.
mutual.zh: 成功的團隊合作有賴所有成員彼此尊重。

my.en: I wrote my name at the top of the page.
my.zh: 我把名字寫在頁面上方。

myself.en: I reminded myself to check every answer before submitting the test.
myself.zh: 我提醒自己交卷前要檢查每一題答案。

mysterious.en: A mysterious light appeared above the hills late at night.
mysterious.zh: 深夜時，山丘上方出現一道神秘的光。

mystery.en: The novel presents a mystery that becomes clearer chapter by chapter.
mystery.zh: 這本小說呈現一個隨章節逐漸明朗的謎團。

myth.en: The history teacher explained how a myth differs from verified evidence.
myth.zh: 歷史老師解釋神話與經過驗證的證據有何不同。

nag.en: Repeated reminders can nag students instead of helping them focus.
nag.zh: 反覆提醒可能會讓學生感到煩躁，而非幫助專心。

nail.en: A loose nail was sticking out of the wooden bench.
nail.zh: 一根鬆動的釘子從木椅上突出來。

naive.en: It was naive to assume every online claim was completely accurate.
naive.zh: 假設網路上的每個說法都完全正確是很天真的。

name.en: Please write your full name at the top of the form.
name.zh: 請在表格上方寫下你的全名。

namely.en: We need two materials, namely paper and clear tape, for the project.
namely.zh: 這個專題需要兩種材料，也就是紙和透明膠帶。

nap.en: A short nap helped him feel more alert in the afternoon.
nap.zh: 短暫午睡讓他下午精神更好。

napkin.en: She placed a napkin beside each plate before dinner began.
napkin.zh: 晚餐開始前，她在每個盤子旁放了一張餐巾。

narrate.en: Students will narrate the short film in their own words.
narrate.zh: 學生將用自己的話為這部短片旁白。

narrative.en: The writer uses a clear narrative to connect the historical events.
narrative.zh: 作者用清楚的敘事串連這些歷史事件。

narrator.en: The narrator describes the village from a child's point of view.
narrator.zh: 敘事者從孩子的角度描述這座村莊。

narrow.en: The path became narrow as we approached the mountain village.
narrow.zh: 我們接近山村時，小路變得很狹窄。

nasty.en: A nasty smell came from the trash bin after the storm.
nasty.zh: 暴風雨後，垃圾桶傳出難聞的氣味。

nation.en: Each nation develops policies based on its own needs.
nation.zh: 每個國家都會依自己的需求制定政策。

national.en: The national museum attracts visitors from many different regions.
national.zh: 這座國家博物館吸引來自許多地區的遊客。

nationalism.en: The class discussed how nationalism influenced several nineteenth-century movements.
nationalism.zh: 全班討論民族主義如何影響十九世紀的多場運動。

nationality.en: The form asks for your nationality along with basic contact information.
nationality.zh: 這份表格除了基本聯絡資料，也會詢問國籍。

native.en: She is a native speaker who also teaches English grammar.
native.zh: 她是母語人士，也教授英文文法。

natural.en: The park is known for its natural scenery and clean air.
natural.zh: 這座公園以自然景觀與清新空氣聞名。

nature.en: Spending time in nature can help people relax and focus.
nature.zh: 接觸大自然能幫助人放鬆並專注。

naughty.en: The story features a naughty puppy that keeps hiding everyone's socks.
naughty.zh: 故事裡有一隻調皮小狗，總是把大家的襪子藏起來。

navigate.en: The map helped us navigate the unfamiliar streets near the station.
navigate.zh: 地圖幫助我們在車站附近陌生的街道中找到方向。

navigation.en: Satellite navigation has made long road trips easier for many drivers.
navigation.zh: 衛星導航讓許多駕駛的長途旅行更方便。

navy.en: The museum exhibit explains the history of the country's navy.
navy.zh: 博物館展覽介紹該國海軍的歷史。

near.en: A small bookstore opened near the station last month.
near.zh: 上個月車站附近開了一家小書店。

nearby.en: We found a nearby café where we could finish our homework.
nearby.zh: 我們找到附近一家可以完成作業的咖啡店。

nearly.en: Nearly all the students completed the survey on time.
nearly.zh: 幾乎所有學生都準時完成問卷。

nearsighted.en: A nearsighted student may need glasses to see the board clearly.
nearsighted.zh: 近視的學生可能需要眼鏡才能清楚看見黑板。

neat.en: Her notes are neat enough for everyone in the group to read.
neat.zh: 她的筆記很整齊，小組每個人都看得懂。

necessary.en: Careful preparation is necessary for a successful science experiment.
necessary.zh: 仔細準備是成功完成科學實驗的必要條件。

necessity.en: Clean water is a basic necessity for every community.
necessity.zh: 乾淨的水是每個社區的基本必需品。

neck.en: He stretched his neck after sitting at the desk for hours.
neck.zh: 坐在書桌前好幾個小時後，他伸展了頸部。

necklace.en: The artist displayed a handmade necklace at the weekend market.
necklace.zh: 那位藝術家在週末市集展示一條手工項鍊。

necktie.en: He wore a blue necktie for the formal school ceremony.
necktie.zh: 他在正式的學校典禮上戴了一條藍色領帶。

need.en: Students need enough sleep to stay focused during class.
need.zh: 學生需要充足睡眠，才能在課堂上保持專注。

needle.en: The compass needle slowly turned toward the north.
needle.zh: 指南針的指針慢慢轉向北方。

needy.en: The charity collects school supplies for needy families each year.
needy.zh: 這個慈善團體每年為有需要的家庭募集學用品。

negative.en: Too much negative feedback can reduce a student's confidence.
negative.zh: 過多負面回饋可能降低學生的自信。

neglect.en: Do not neglect small errors when checking an important report.
neglect.zh: 檢查重要報告時，不要忽略小錯誤。

negotiate.en: Both sides agreed to negotiate a new schedule before the semester began.
negotiate.zh: 雙方同意在學期開始前協商新的時程。

negotiation.en: The negotiation continued until both groups accepted the final plan.
negotiation.zh: 協商持續到兩組都接受最後方案為止。

neighbor.en: Our neighbor helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
neighbor.zh: 鄰居幫我們把箱子搬上樓。

neighborhood.en: The neighborhood has changed a lot since the new station opened.
neighborhood.zh: 新車站開放後，這個社區改變了很多。

neither.en: Neither answer is correct, so read the question again.
neither.zh: 兩個答案都不正確，所以請再讀一次題目。

nephew.en: My nephew enjoys building model airplanes during school vacations.
nephew.zh: 我的姪子喜歡在學校假期組裝模型飛機。

nerve.en: It took some nerve to speak before such a large audience.
nerve.zh: 在那麼多觀眾面前發言需要一些勇氣。

nervous.en: She felt nervous before giving her first speech in English.
nervous.zh: 第一次用英文演講前，她感到很緊張。

nest.en: A bird built its nest under the roof of the shelter.
nest.zh: 一隻鳥在遮棚屋頂下築了巢。

net.en: The fisherman repaired the torn net beside the quiet harbor.
net.zh: 漁夫在安靜的港邊修補破掉的網。

network.en: The school network allows students to access online learning materials.
network.zh: 學校網路讓學生可以存取線上學習資料。

neutral.en: The teacher remained neutral while students discussed the controversial issue.
neutral.zh: 學生討論具爭議的議題時，老師保持中立。

never.en: I never submit an assignment before checking it carefully.
never.zh: 我從不在仔細檢查前交作業。

nevertheless.en: The weather was poor; nevertheless, the outdoor event continued as planned.
nevertheless.zh: 天氣不好；儘管如此，戶外活動仍按計畫進行。

new.en: The teacher introduced a new method for reviewing vocabulary.
new.zh: 老師介紹了一種複習單字的新方法。

news.en: We checked the news to learn more about the storm.
news.zh: 我們查看新聞以了解更多暴風雨資訊。

newspaper.en: The newspaper published an article about local environmental problems.
newspaper.zh: 這家報紙刊登了一篇關於當地環境問題的文章。

next.en: Please read the next section before tomorrow's class.
next.zh: 請在明天上課前讀完下一部分。

nice.en: It was nice to study outside on such a cool afternoon.
nice.zh: 在這麼涼爽的午後到戶外讀書很舒服。

nickel.en: The old machine accepted a nickel as part of the payment.
nickel.zh: 那台舊機器可以接受五分硬幣作為部分付款。

nickname.en: Her nickname came from a funny story in elementary school.
nickname.zh: 她的綽號來自小學時的一個有趣故事。

niece.en: My niece borrowed several picture books from the library.
niece.zh: 我的姪女從圖書館借了幾本圖畫書。

night.en: The temperature dropped quickly after night fell.

nightmare.en: The strange dream felt like a nightmare until he woke up.
nightmare.zh: 那個怪夢像惡夢一樣，直到他醒來才結束。

no.en: There is no simple answer to every social problem.
no.zh: 不是每個社會問題都有簡單答案。

noble.en: The novel praises a noble leader who protects the community.
noble.zh: 這本小說讚揚一位保護社區的高尚領袖。

nobody.en: Nobody knew the correct answer until the teacher explained it.
nobody.zh: 直到老師解釋前，沒有人知道正確答案。

nod.en: She gave a quick nod to show that she understood.
nod.zh: 她快速點頭，表示自己明白了。

noise.en: Traffic noise made it difficult to concentrate on reading.
noise.zh: 交通噪音讓人很難專心閱讀。

noisy.en: The hallway became noisy when classes ended for the day.

nominate.en: Students may nominate a classmate for the service award.
nominate.zh: 學生可以提名同學角逐服務獎。

nomination.en: Her nomination surprised her because she had not expected recognition.
nomination.zh: 她的提名讓她很驚訝，因為她沒預期會受到肯定。

nominee.en: Each nominee gave a short speech before the final vote.
nominee.zh: 每位候選人都在最後投票前發表簡短演說。

none.en: None of the computers worked after the power failure.
none.zh: 停電後，所有電腦都無法使用。

nonprofit.en: The nonprofit provides free tutoring for children after school.
nonprofit.zh: 這個非營利組織在放學後提供兒童免費課輔。

nonsense.en: The teacher asked us to separate evidence from obvious nonsense.
nonsense.zh: 老師要我們把證據和明顯的胡說區分開來。

noodle.en: A single noodle fell from the bowl onto the table.
noodle.zh: 一根麵條從碗裡掉到桌上。

noon.en: The meeting will begin at noon in the main office.
noon.zh: 會議將在中午於主要辦公室開始。

nope.en: He smiled and said nope when asked about the rumor.
nope.zh: 有人問起那個謠言時，他笑著說不。

nor.en: She neither complained nor blamed anyone for the delayed train.
nor.zh: 她既沒有抱怨，也沒有責怪任何人火車誤點。

norm.en: Recycling has become the norm in many schools and offices.
norm.zh: 資源回收已成為許多學校與辦公室的常態。

normal.en: It is normal to feel tired after a long day of study.
normal.zh: 讀書一整天後感到疲累是正常的。

north.en: The hikers continued north until they reached the river.
north.zh: 登山客一路往北走，直到抵達河邊。

northern.en: The northern part of the island receives more rain in winter.
northern.zh: 島嶼北部在冬天有較多降雨。

nose.en: The cold air made my nose feel uncomfortable.
nose.zh: 冷空氣讓我的鼻子感到不舒服。

nostril.en: Cold air entered each nostril as he stepped outside.
nostril.zh: 他走到戶外時，冷空氣進入每個鼻孔。

not.en: This method is not difficult once you understand the basic steps.
not.zh: 一旦了解基本步驟，這個方法其實不難。

notable.en: The report highlights a notable improvement in reading comprehension scores.
notable.zh: 這份報告強調閱讀理解成績有明顯進步。

note.en: Please make a note of the homework deadline in your planner.
note.zh: 請把作業截止日期記在行事曆裡。

notebook.en: I wrote the new vocabulary words in my notebook.
notebook.zh: 我把新的單字寫在筆記本裡。

nothing.en: Nothing changed after we repeated the experiment under the same conditions.
nothing.zh: 在相同條件下重做實驗後，沒有任何變化。

notice.en: Did you notice the difference between the two graphs?
notice.zh: 你有注意到這兩張圖表之間的差異嗎？

noticeable.en: There was a noticeable improvement in her pronunciation this semester.
noticeable.zh: 她這學期的發音有明顯進步。

notify.en: Please notify the teacher if the classroom projector stops working.
notify.zh: 如果教室投影機停止運作，請通知老師。

notion.en: The lesson challenged the common notion that faster is always better.
notion.zh: 這堂課挑戰了速度越快就一定越好的常見觀念。

notorious.en: The intersection is notorious for heavy traffic during rush hour.
notorious.zh: 這個路口以尖峰時段交通壅塞而出名。

nourish.en: Healthy meals nourish the body and provide energy for daily activities.
nourish.zh: 健康餐點能滋養身體並提供日常活動所需能量。

nourishment.en: Plants need sunlight, water, and nourishment from the soil to grow.
nourishment.zh: 植物需要陽光、水分與土壤中的養分才能生長。

novel.en: The class read a short novel about friendship and responsibility.
novel.zh: 全班閱讀了一本關於友誼與責任的短篇小說。

novelist.en: The novelist spent years researching the historical setting of her book.
novelist.zh: 這位小說家花了多年研究作品的歷史背景。

novice.en: A novice can still learn quickly with clear instructions and practice.
novice.zh: 新手只要有清楚指導與練習，仍能快速學習。

now.en: We have enough information to make a decision now.
now.zh: 我們現在已經有足夠資訊可以做決定。

nowadays.en: Nowadays, many students use digital tools for studying.
nowadays.zh: 現在許多學生會使用數位工具來學習。

nowhere.en: The missing key was nowhere to be found after lunch.
nowhere.zh: 午餐後到處都找不到那把遺失的鑰匙。

nuclear.en: The class debated the benefits and risks of nuclear energy.
nuclear.zh: 全班討論核能的優點與風險。

nucleus.en: The diagram shows the nucleus at the center of the cell.
nucleus.zh: 圖表顯示細胞核位於細胞中央。

number.en: Please write your student number beside your name.
number.zh: 請在姓名旁寫上你的學號。

numerous.en: Numerous studies have examined how sleep affects learning and memory.
numerous.zh: 許多研究探討了睡眠如何影響學習與記憶。

nun.en: The historical novel includes a nun who teaches village children.
nun.zh: 這本歷史小說描寫一位教導村中孩子的修女。

nurse.en: The nurse checked his temperature before calling the doctor.
nurse.zh: 護理師在叫醫師前先量了他的體溫。

nursery.en: The plant nursery sells young trees and flowers in spring.
nursery.zh: 這間苗圃在春天販售幼樹與花卉。

nurture.en: Good teachers nurture curiosity by welcoming thoughtful questions from students.
nurture.zh: 好老師藉由歡迎學生提出有思考的問題來培養好奇心。

nut.en: A squirrel carried a nut across the park path.
nut.zh: 一隻松鼠叼著一顆堅果穿過公園小徑。

nutrient.en: Iron is an important nutrient that the body needs.
nutrient.zh: 鐵是身體需要的重要營養素。

nutrition.en: The health class discussed nutrition and balanced meal planning.
nutrition.zh: 健康課討論營養與均衡飲食規劃。

nutritious.en: The cafeteria added more nutritious options to its lunch menu.
nutritious.zh: 餐廳在午餐菜單中增加更多營養選擇。

oak.en: A large oak shaded the benches beside the playground.
oak.zh: 一棵大橡樹為操場旁的長椅遮蔭。

oasis.en: The desert oasis provided water and shade for travelers.
oasis.zh: 沙漠綠洲為旅人提供水源與遮蔭。

oath.en: The official took an oath before beginning the new role.
oath.zh: 那位官員在開始新職務前宣誓。

oatmeal.en: She ate warm oatmeal with fruit before leaving for school.
oatmeal.zh: 她上學前吃了加水果的熱燕麥粥。

obedience.en: Blind obedience is not the same as thoughtful cooperation.
obedience.zh: 盲目服從並不等同於有思考的合作。

obedient.en: The obedient dog waited quietly beside its owner at the park.
obedient.zh: 那隻聽話的狗在公園裡安靜等在主人旁邊。

obey.en: Drivers must obey traffic signals to keep intersections safe.
obey.zh: 駕駛必須遵守交通號誌，以維持路口安全。

object.en: Each object in the experiment was weighed carefully.
object.zh: 實驗中的每個物體都被仔細秤重。

objection.en: She raised an objection when the proposal seemed unfair.
objection.zh: 當提案看起來不公平時，她提出反對意見。

objective.en: Our objective is to reduce unnecessary energy use at school.
objective.zh: 我們的目標是減少校園中不必要的能源使用。

obligation.en: Students have an obligation to follow the laboratory safety rules.
obligation.zh: 學生有義務遵守實驗室安全規定。

oblige.en: School rules oblige students to wear safety glasses in the laboratory.
oblige.zh: 校規要求學生在實驗室配戴護目鏡。

obscure.en: The article explains an obscure historical event in simple language.
obscure.zh: 這篇文章用簡單語言解釋一個鮮為人知的歷史事件。

observation.en: Careful observation helped the students notice changes in the plants.
observation.zh: 仔細觀察幫助學生注意到植物的變化。

observe.en: Students observe the plants every day and record any changes.
observe.zh: 學生每天觀察植物並記錄任何變化。

observer.en: Each observer recorded the birds seen near the lake.
observer.zh: 每位觀察者都記錄在湖邊看到的鳥類。

obsess.en: Do not obsess over one mistake when revising your essay.
obsess.zh: 修改作文時，不要過度糾結於一個錯誤。

obstacle.en: Limited time was the biggest obstacle facing the project team.
obstacle.zh: 時間有限是專題團隊面臨的最大障礙。

obstinate.en: The obstinate character refuses to change his mind despite new evidence.
obstinate.zh: 那個固執的角色即使看到新證據也不願改變想法。

obtain.en: Researchers must obtain reliable data before drawing a conclusion.
obtain.zh: 研究人員在下結論前必須取得可靠資料。

obvious.en: It became obvious that the first method was less efficient.
obvious.zh: 很明顯第一種方法效率較低。

occasion.en: On this occasion, the school invited several former students to speak.
occasion.zh: 這次學校邀請了幾位校友來演講。

occasional.en: An occasional mistake is normal while learning a new language.
occasional.zh: 學習新語言時偶爾犯錯很正常。

occupation.en: The form asks each adult to list an occupation.
occupation.zh: 這份表格要求每位成人填寫職業。

occupy.en: Large shelves occupy most of the space along the back wall.
occupy.zh: 大型書架占據了後牆大部分空間。

occur.en: Small errors can occur when measurements are recorded too quickly.
occur.zh: 測量數據記錄得太快時，可能會出現小錯誤。

occurrence.en: Heavy rain is a common occurrence during the wet season.
occurrence.zh: 大雨在雨季是常見的現象。

ocean.en: Plastic waste can travel long distances across the ocean.
ocean.zh: 塑膠垃圾可能漂過海洋很長的距離。

octopus.en: An octopus can change color to blend with its surroundings.
octopus.zh: 章魚可以改變顏色來融入周遭環境。

odd.en: The machine made an odd sound before it suddenly stopped.
odd.zh: 那台機器突然停止前發出奇怪的聲音。

odor.en: A strange odor came from the old refrigerator in the kitchen.
odor.zh: 廚房裡的舊冰箱傳出一股奇怪氣味。

of.en: The results of the experiment were recorded in a table.
of.zh: 實驗結果被記錄在表格中。

off.en: Please turn off the lights before leaving the classroom.

offend.en: I did not mean to offend anyone with my careless comment.
offend.zh: 我並不是故意要用那句不經意的話冒犯任何人。

offense.en: The coach explained that the team needed a stronger offense.
offense.zh: 教練說明球隊需要更強的進攻。

offensive.en: The website removed an offensive remark from the discussion board.
offensive.zh: 網站從討論區移除了一則冒犯性的留言。

offer.en: The school will offer extra English classes next semester.
offer.zh: 學校下學期會提供額外的英文課。

offering.en: The museum is offering free admission to students this weekend.
offering.zh: 這間博物館本週末提供學生免費入場。

office.en: Please take the form to the school office before noon.
office.zh: 請在中午前把表格送到校務處。

officer.en: A school officer helped direct visitors during the open house.
officer.zh: 一位校方人員在開放日時協助引導訪客。

official.en: The official announcement will be posted on the school website tomorrow.
official.zh: 正式公告明天會發布在學校網站上。

offshore.en: Strong winds affected several offshore islands during the storm.
offshore.zh: 暴風雨期間，強風影響了數座外海島嶼。

offspring.en: The documentary showed how penguins protect their offspring from cold weather.
offspring.zh: 紀錄片展示企鵝如何保護幼鳥免受寒冷天氣影響。

often.en: Students often remember information better after explaining it to others.
often.zh: 學生把資訊解釋給別人聽後，通常會記得更牢。

oil.en: The machine needs a small amount of oil to operate smoothly.
oil.zh: 這台機器需要少量潤滑油才能順暢運作。

ok.en: It is ok to ask questions when the instructions are unclear.
ok.zh: 當指示不清楚時，提出問題是可以的。

okay.en: She checked whether everyone was okay after the sudden power outage.
okay.zh: 突然停電後，她確認每個人是否都沒事。

old.en: The old bridge was repaired before the rainy season began.
old.zh: 雨季開始前，這座老橋先完成了修繕。

olive.en: The salad included tomato, cucumber, and a few slices of olive.
olive.zh: 沙拉裡有番茄、小黃瓜和幾片橄欖。

omit.en: Do not omit your name when submitting the assignment online.
omit.zh: 線上繳交作業時不要漏掉你的名字。
