on.en: Please place your books on the table before class begins.
on.zh: 上課前請把書放在桌上。

once.en: We review these vocabulary words once every week.
once.zh: 我們每週複習這些單字一次。

ongoing.en: The ongoing project will continue throughout the school semester.
ongoing.zh: 這項進行中的專題會持續整個學期。

onion.en: She added chopped onion to the soup for extra flavor.
onion.zh: 她在湯裡加入切碎的洋蔥增添風味。

online.en: The teacher posted the reading materials online before class.
online.zh: 老師在上課前把閱讀資料放到網路上。

only.en: Only a few students finished the difficult task without help.
only.zh: 只有少數學生在沒有幫助下完成這項困難任務。

onto.en: The cat jumped onto the chair beside the window.
onto.zh: 那隻貓跳到窗邊的椅子上。

open.en: Please open the window to improve the airflow in the room.
open.zh: 請打開窗戶，改善房間內的空氣流通。

opera.en: Our music class watched part of a famous opera performance.
opera.zh: 我們音樂課看了一段知名歌劇演出。

operate.en: Only trained students may operate the equipment during the experiment.
operate.zh: 只有受過訓練的學生可以在實驗中操作設備。

operation.en: The operation of the new system requires careful testing first.
operation.zh: 新系統的運作需要先經過仔細測試。

operational.en: The new computer lab became fully operational after several tests.
operational.zh: 新電腦教室經過幾次測試後正式投入使用。

operative.en: The key operative word in the rule is clearly defined.
operative.zh: 這項規則中的關鍵用詞已有清楚定義。

operator.en: The machine operator checked the controls before starting the demonstration.
operator.zh: 機器操作員在示範開始前檢查了控制裝置。

opinion.en: Everyone was invited to share an opinion during the discussion.
opinion.zh: 討論時每個人都被邀請分享自己的意見。

opponent.en: The team studied its opponent carefully before the final match.
opponent.zh: 球隊在決賽前仔細研究了對手。

opportunity.en: The exchange program gives students an opportunity to experience another culture.
opportunity.zh: 交換計畫讓學生有機會體驗另一種文化。

oppose.en: Some residents oppose the plan because they fear increased traffic.
oppose.zh: 一些居民反對這項計畫，因為他們擔心交通增加。

opposite.en: The library is on the opposite side of the street.
opposite.zh: 圖書館在街道的另一側。

opposition.en: The proposal faced strong opposition from several community groups.
opposition.zh: 這項提案遭到幾個社區團體的強烈反對。

oppress.en: The history lesson examined how unfair laws can oppress minority groups.
oppress.zh: 歷史課探討不公平法律如何壓迫少數群體。

oppression.en: The novel explores the effects of oppression on ordinary families.
oppression.zh: 這本小說探討壓迫對一般家庭造成的影響。

opt.en: Students may opt to present their projects in pairs.
opt.zh: 學生可以選擇兩人一組進行專題發表。

optimism.en: Her optimism helped the group stay motivated after several setbacks.
optimism.zh: 她的樂觀讓團隊在幾次挫折後仍保持動力。

optimistic.en: The coach remained optimistic about the team's chances this season.
optimistic.zh: 教練對球隊本季的機會仍保持樂觀。

option.en: Taking the train is often a convenient option for city travel.
option.zh: 搭火車通常是城市旅行方便的選擇。

optional.en: The extra reading is optional but useful for deeper understanding.
optional.zh: 額外閱讀不是必須的，但有助於更深入理解。

or.en: You can submit the assignment online or hand it in personally.
or.zh: 你可以線上繳交作業，也可以親自交。

oral.en: Each student gave a short oral report in English class.
oral.zh: 每位學生都在英文課做了一段簡短口頭報告。

orange.en: She packed an orange and a sandwich for lunch.
orange.zh: 她帶了一顆柳橙和一個三明治當午餐。

orbit.en: The satellite entered orbit around Earth after launch.
orbit.zh: 衛星發射後進入繞地球運行的軌道。

orchard.en: The class visited an orchard to learn how fruit is grown.
orchard.zh: 班級參觀果園，了解水果如何栽種。

orchestra.en: The school orchestra performed at the graduation ceremony.
orchestra.zh: 學校管弦樂團在畢業典禮上演出。

ordeal.en: The long delay was an ordeal for travelers at the station.
ordeal.zh: 漫長的延誤對車站裡的旅客來說是一場煎熬。

order.en: Please put the events in the correct order before answering.
order.zh: 回答前請把事件按正確順序排列。

orderly.en: The volunteers kept the books in an orderly arrangement.
orderly.zh: 志工把書籍整理得井然有序。

ordinary.en: An ordinary object can become useful in a creative experiment.
ordinary.zh: 普通物品在有創意的實驗中也能變得有用。

organ.en: The heart is an organ that pumps blood through the body.
organ.zh: 心臟是一個將血液送往全身的器官。

organic.en: The science class compared organic material with synthetic material.
organic.zh: 自然科學課比較了有機材料與合成材料。

organism.en: Every organism in the pond depends on its environment.
organism.zh: 池塘裡的每個生物都依賴周遭環境。

organization.en: Good organization can make a long report easier to understand.
organization.zh: 良好的組織能讓長篇報告更容易理解。

organize.en: Please organize the information before writing your final report.
organize.zh: 寫最後報告前請先整理資訊。

organizer.en: The event organizer sent the final schedule to all participants.
organizer.zh: 活動主辦人把最終時程寄給所有參與者。

orient.en: The map helps visitors orient themselves inside the large museum.
orient.zh: 這張地圖幫助訪客在大型博物館內辨認方向。

oriental.en: The museum label explained the historical use of the word oriental.
oriental.zh: 博物館標示說明了 oriental 一詞在歷史上的用法。

orientation.en: New students attended an orientation before the semester began.
orientation.zh: 新生在學期開始前參加了新生說明會。

origin.en: The museum display explains the origin of several local traditions.
origin.zh: 博物館展示說明了幾項地方傳統的起源。

original.en: Each group must present an original idea for the final project.
original.zh: 每組都必須為期末專題提出原創想法。

originality.en: The judges praised the originality of her science project.
originality.zh: 評審稱讚她科展作品的原創性。

originate.en: Many everyday words originate from older languages and regional dialects.
originate.zh: 許多日常用字源自較古老的語言與地方方言。

ornament.en: A handmade ornament hung from the classroom window during the festival.
ornament.zh: 節慶期間，一件手工裝飾品掛在教室窗邊。

orphan.en: The novel follows an orphan who discovers a hidden family history.
orphan.zh: 這本小說描述一名孤兒發現隱藏家族歷史的故事。

orphanage.en: The charity donated books to an orphanage in the region.
orphanage.zh: 慈善團體捐書給該地區的一所孤兒院。

orthodox.en: The article compares an orthodox approach with newer methods.
orthodox.zh: 文章比較傳統做法與較新的方法。

other.en: Some students prefer reading, while other students learn better by listening.
other.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，其他學生則用聽的學得更好。

otherwise.en: Please save your work now; otherwise, you may lose your changes.
otherwise.zh: 請現在儲存工作，否則可能會遺失變更。

ounce.en: The recipe lists each ingredient by ounce and gram.
ounce.zh: 食譜以盎司和公克列出每種材料。

our.en: Our class will present the project results next Friday.
our.zh: 我們班下星期五會報告專題成果。

ours.en: That classroom is theirs, while this one is ours.
ours.zh: 那間教室是他們的，而這間是我們的。

ourselves.en: We prepared ourselves carefully before the final presentation.
ourselves.zh: 我們在最後發表前仔細做好準備。

out.en: We went out during lunch to buy some food.
out.zh: 午餐時間我們出去買了一些食物。

outbreak.en: The report described how schools responded to a local flu outbreak.
outbreak.zh: 報告描述學校如何因應當地流感疫情。

outcome.en: The final outcome depended on how carefully the data were analyzed.
outcome.zh: 最後結果取決於資料分析得多仔細。

outdoor.en: The school added an outdoor study area beside the library.
outdoor.zh: 學校在圖書館旁新增一處戶外學習區。

outdoors.en: We spent the afternoon outdoors during the environmental science activity.
outdoors.zh: 環境科學活動時，我們整個下午都待在戶外。

outer.en: The outer layer of the box was damaged during shipping.
outer.zh: 箱子的外層在運送過程中受損。

outfit.en: She chose a simple outfit for the school ceremony.
outfit.zh: 她為學校典禮選了一套簡單的服裝。

outgoing.en: His outgoing personality made it easy to welcome new classmates.
outgoing.zh: 他外向的個性讓他很容易歡迎新同學。

outing.en: The class planned an outing to the science museum.
outing.zh: 班上規劃了一次前往科學博物館的校外活動。

outlaw.en: The story follows an outlaw hiding in a remote mountain town.
outlaw.zh: 故事描述一名逃犯法外之徒躲在偏遠山城。

outlet.en: The shopping outlet offers several stores under one large roof.
outlet.zh: 這間購物中心在同一棟大型建築內有多家商店。

outline.en: The teacher asked us to outline our ideas before writing the essay.
outline.zh: 老師要我們在寫作文前先列出想法大綱。

outlook.en: Her positive outlook helped the team stay calm during setbacks.
outlook.zh: 她積極的看法幫助團隊在遇到挫折時保持冷靜。

outnumber.en: In the club, first-year students outnumber seniors by nearly two to one.
outnumber.zh: 社團裡一年級學生的人數幾乎是高年級學生的兩倍。

output.en: The factory increased its output after installing more efficient equipment.
output.zh: 工廠安裝更有效率的設備後提高了產量。

outrage.en: The unfair decision caused public outrage across the community.
outrage.zh: 那項不公平的決定在社區引起公憤。

outrageous.en: The article criticized the outrageous price increase at the event.
outrageous.zh: 這篇文章批評活動中離譜的漲價。

outright.en: The committee rejected the proposal outright after reviewing the evidence.
outright.zh: 委員會審查證據後直接否決了這項提案。

outset.en: At the outset, everyone agreed on the main goals of the project.
outset.zh: 一開始，大家就同意這項專題的主要目標。

outside.en: Several students waited outside the classroom before the test.
outside.zh: 考試前有幾名學生在教室外等候。

outsider.en: As an outsider, he noticed details that longtime residents often missed.
outsider.zh: 身為外來者，他注意到長期居民常忽略的細節。

outskirts.en: The new sports center stands on the outskirts of the city.
outskirts.zh: 新的運動中心位於城市郊區。

outstanding.en: Her outstanding presentation earned praise from both teachers and students.
outstanding.zh: 她出色的報告獲得老師與學生的稱讚。

outward.en: The door opens outward toward the school courtyard.
outward.zh: 這扇門向外打開，通往學校中庭。

outwards.en: The branches spread outwards as the young tree grew.
outwards.zh: 幼樹長大時，樹枝向外伸展。

oval.en: The designer chose an oval table for the small meeting room.
oval.zh: 設計師為小會議室選了一張橢圓形桌子。

oven.en: The bread was already in the oven when we arrived.
oven.zh: 我們到達時，麵包已經放進烤箱裡。

over.en: The temperature stayed over thirty degrees throughout the afternoon.
over.zh: 整個下午氣溫都維持在三十度以上。

overall.en: The overall quality of the report improved after several revisions.
overall.zh: 經過幾次修改後，報告的整體品質提升了。

overcoat.en: He wore a thick overcoat during the cold winter morning.
overcoat.zh: 寒冷的冬日早晨，他穿著一件厚大衣。

overcome.en: Regular practice helped her overcome her fear of speaking in class.
overcome.zh: 規律練習幫助她克服在課堂上發言的恐懼。

overdo.en: Do not overdo the decorations, or the poster may look crowded.
overdo.zh: 不要把裝飾做得太過頭，否則海報可能看起來很擁擠。

overflow.en: Heavy rain caused the small river to overflow its banks.

overhead.en: An overhead light made the reading table bright enough for study.
overhead.zh: 頭頂的燈光讓閱讀桌亮得足以讀書。

overhear.en: I happened to overhear part of the conversation in the hallway.
overhear.zh: 我碰巧在走廊聽到那段對話的一部分。

overlap.en: The two circles overlap in the center of the diagram.
overlap.zh: 圖中的兩個圓在中央重疊。

overlook.en: Do not overlook the final question at the bottom of the page.
overlook.zh: 不要漏看頁面底部的最後一題。

overnight.en: The temperature dropped sharply overnight after the cold front arrived.
overnight.zh: 冷鋒到達後，氣溫一夜之間大幅下降。

overseas.en: She hopes to study overseas after finishing high school.
overseas.zh: 她希望高中畢業後到海外留學。

oversee.en: A teacher will oversee the students during the science fair.
oversee.zh: 科展期間會有老師負責監督學生。

overtake.en: The faster train began to overtake the local service outside town.
overtake.zh: 較快的列車在城外開始超越區間車。

overthrow.en: The history chapter explains why citizens sought to overthrow the old regime.
overthrow.zh: 歷史章節解釋人民為何想推翻舊政權。

overturn.en: New evidence may overturn the earlier conclusion in the report.
overturn.zh: 新證據可能推翻報告中先前的結論。

overwhelm.en: Too many notifications can overwhelm students during focused study time.
overwhelm.zh: 太多通知可能在專心讀書時讓學生不堪負荷。

overwork.en: Constant pressure can lead people to overwork and lose concentration.
overwork.zh: 持續的壓力可能讓人工作過度並失去專注力。

owe.en: I owe my improvement to regular practice and helpful feedback.
owe.zh: 我的進步要歸功於規律練習與有幫助的回饋。

owl.en: An owl rested quietly on a branch near the forest trail.
owl.zh: 一隻貓頭鷹安靜停在森林步道附近的樹枝上。

own.en: Students should explain the idea in their own words.
own.zh: 學生應該用自己的話解釋這個觀念。

owner.en: The shop owner decided to stay open one hour later.
owner.zh: 店主決定延後一小時打烊。

ownership.en: The project gave students a sense of ownership over their learning.
ownership.zh: 這項專題讓學生對自己的學習更有主人翁意識。

ox.en: An ox pulled the cart slowly across the muddy field.
ox.zh: 一頭牛慢慢拉著車穿過泥濘田地。

oxygen.en: Plants release oxygen as part of the process of photosynthesis.
oxygen.zh: 植物在光合作用過程中會釋放氧氣。

oyster.en: The biology display included a shell from a large oyster.
oyster.zh: 生物展示中有一枚大型牡蠣的殼。

ozone.en: The lesson explained how ozone helps protect Earth from harmful radiation.
ozone.zh: 課堂說明臭氧如何幫助地球抵擋有害輻射。

pace.en: She maintained a steady pace throughout the long walk.
pace.zh: 她在整段長途步行中保持穩定步調。

pack.en: Please pack your notebook and water bottle before the field trip.
pack.zh: 校外教學前請把筆記本和水壺裝好。

package.en: The package arrived at the school office before noon.
package.zh: 包裹在中午前送到學校辦公室。

packet.en: The teacher handed each group a packet of reading materials.
packet.zh: 老師發給每組一包閱讀資料。

pad.en: He wrote the phone number on a small note pad.
pad.zh: 他把電話號碼寫在一本小便條本上。

paddle.en: They used a paddle to move the canoe across the calm lake.
paddle.zh: 他們用槳讓獨木舟穿過平靜的湖面。

page.en: Please turn to page forty before the lesson begins.
page.zh: 上課前請翻到第四十頁。

pain.en: He felt some pain in his shoulder after carrying the boxes.
pain.zh: 搬完箱子後，他的肩膀感到有些疼痛。

painful.en: The loss was painful, but the team learned from the experience.
painful.zh: 那次失敗令人難受，但團隊從中學到經驗。

paint.en: Students used bright colors to paint the classroom mural.
paint.zh: 學生用鮮豔色彩畫教室壁畫。

painter.en: The local painter displayed landscapes inspired by nearby mountains.
painter.zh: 那位在地畫家展出受附近山景啟發的風景畫。

painting.en: The painting shows a quiet village beside the sea.
painting.zh: 這幅畫描繪海邊一座寧靜的村莊。

pair.en: Each pair of students compared their answers after the quiz.
pair.zh: 每兩位學生一組，在小考後比較答案。

pajamas.en: He changed into comfortable pajamas before reading in bed.
pajamas.zh: 他睡前閱讀前換上舒適的睡衣。

pal.en: My old pal from elementary school visited me last weekend.
pal.zh: 我小學時的老朋友上週末來看我。

palace.en: The tourists admired the palace from across the wide square.
palace.zh: 遊客從寬廣廣場另一側欣賞那座宮殿。

pale.en: The morning sky turned pale as the sun rose behind clouds.
pale.zh: 太陽從雲後升起時，晨空變得淡淡的。

palm.en: She held the small stone in the center of her palm.
palm.zh: 她把小石頭放在手掌中央。

pan.en: The cook placed the vegetables in a large pan.
pan.zh: 廚師把蔬菜放進一個大平底鍋裡。

pancake.en: She made a pancake for breakfast before leaving for school.
pancake.zh: 她上學前做了一片鬆餅當早餐。

panda.en: The documentary showed a panda resting among tall bamboo plants.
panda.zh: 紀錄片拍到一隻熊貓在高大的竹子間休息。

panel.en: A panel of teachers reviewed the entries for the contest.
panel.zh: 由教師組成的評審團審查了比賽作品。

panic.en: Do not panic if the computer freezes during your presentation.
panic.zh: 如果簡報時電腦當機，不要慌張。

pants.en: He changed into dry pants after getting caught in the rain.
pants.zh: 他淋雨後換上乾燥的長褲。

papaya.en: The ripe papaya was sliced and shared at lunchtime.
papaya.zh: 成熟的木瓜在午餐時被切片分享。

paper.en: Write your final answer clearly on the paper.
paper.zh: 請把最後答案清楚寫在紙上。

paperback.en: I bought a paperback edition because it was lighter to carry.
paperback.zh: 我買了平裝版，因為比較輕便好攜帶。

parachute.en: The museum displayed an old parachute from an aviation exhibit.
parachute.zh: 博物館在航空展區展示一具舊降落傘。

parade.en: The school band marched in the community parade on Saturday.
parade.zh: 學校樂隊週六參加社區遊行。

paradise.en: The quiet island felt like a paradise to the tired travelers.
paradise.zh: 這座安靜小島對疲憊旅人而言宛如天堂。

paradox.en: The article begins with a paradox that challenges common assumptions.
paradox.zh: 文章以一個挑戰常見假設的悖論開頭。

paragraph.en: Each paragraph should focus on one main idea.
paragraph.zh: 每一段都應聚焦在一個主要觀念上。

parallel.en: The two experiments followed parallel procedures with different materials.
parallel.zh: 這兩項實驗使用不同材料，但採用相似的平行流程。

paralyze.en: Fear can paralyze decision-making when people feel unprepared.
paralyze.zh: 當人們毫無準備時，恐懼可能使決策陷入停滯。

parcel.en: A small parcel was waiting for her at the front desk.
parcel.zh: 一個小包裹正在櫃台等她領取。

pardon.en: Please pardon the interruption while we adjust the projector.
pardon.zh: 我們調整投影機時若有打擾，敬請見諒。

parent.en: A parent attended the meeting to discuss school activities.
parent.zh: 一位家長參加會議討論學校活動。

park.en: We walked through the park after finishing our homework.
park.zh: 寫完作業後，我們穿過公園散步。

parliament.en: The textbook explains how parliament debates and approves proposed laws.
parliament.zh: 課本說明國會如何辯論並通過提議的法律。

parrot.en: The parrot learned to imitate several sounds from its surroundings.
parrot.zh: 這隻鸚鵡學會模仿周遭的幾種聲音。

part.en: The final part of the report explains the results.
part.zh: 報告的最後一部分說明研究結果。

partial.en: The report provides only a partial picture of the situation.
partial.zh: 這份報告只呈現了情況的一部分。

participant.en: Each participant received a schedule before the workshop started.
participant.zh: 每位參與者在工作坊開始前都拿到一份時程表。

participate.en: All students are encouraged to participate in the class discussion.
participate.zh: 鼓勵所有學生參與課堂討論。

participation.en: Active participation often makes group discussions more productive.
participation.zh: 積極參與通常能讓小組討論更有效率。

particle.en: A tiny particle of dust landed on the camera lens.
particle.zh: 一小粒灰塵落在相機鏡頭上。

particular.en: This particular example shows why accurate measurement is important.
particular.zh: 這個特定例子說明了精確測量為何重要。

partly.en: The event was postponed partly because of the heavy rain.
partly.zh: 活動延期部分原因是大雨。

partner.en: My partner checked the data while I prepared the chart.
partner.zh: 我的搭檔檢查資料，而我準備圖表。

partnership.en: The school formed a partnership with a local science center.
partnership.zh: 學校與當地科學中心建立合作關係。

party.en: The class held a small party after the final exam.
party.zh: 期末考後，全班舉辦了一個小聚會。

pass.en: You need to pass the final test to complete the course.
pass.zh: 你需要通過期末測驗才能完成這門課。

passage.en: Read the passage carefully before answering the questions.
passage.zh: 回答問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

passenger.en: Each passenger must keep a ticket until leaving the station.
passenger.zh: 每位乘客都必須保留車票直到離站。

passion.en: Her passion for astronomy led her to join the science club.
passion.zh: 她對天文的熱情促使她加入科學社。

passionate.en: The speaker was passionate about protecting local wildlife and forests.
passionate.zh: 講者對保護在地野生動物與森林充滿熱情。

passive.en: A passive reader may miss important questions raised by the author.
passive.zh: 被動閱讀的人可能錯過作者提出的重要問題。

passport.en: She checked her passport before leaving for the airport.
passport.zh: 她前往機場前檢查了護照。

password.en: Use a strong password and keep it private from other people.
password.zh: 請使用安全性高的密碼，並不要告訴他人。

past.en: The town has changed greatly over the past ten years.
past.zh: 這個城鎮在過去十年間有很大變化。

pasta.en: The cafeteria served pasta with vegetables for lunch today.
pasta.zh: 學校餐廳今天午餐供應蔬菜義大利麵。

paste.en: The students used paste to attach the labels to their posters.
paste.zh: 學生用漿糊把標籤黏在海報上。

pastime.en: Reading mystery novels is her favorite pastime during holidays.
pastime.zh: 假日時閱讀推理小說是她最喜歡的消遣。

pastry.en: The bakery displayed a fresh pastry beside the bread counter.
pastry.zh: 麵包店在麵包櫃旁展示一個新鮮糕點。

pat.en: She gave the dog a gentle pat before leaving the park.
pat.zh: 她離開公園前輕輕拍了那隻狗一下。

patch.en: A dark patch of clouds appeared above the distant hills.
patch.zh: 遠方山丘上方出現一片深色雲層。

patent.en: The inventor applied for a patent to protect the new design.
patent.zh: 發明人申請專利來保護新設計。

path.en: We followed the path through the forest to the lake.
path.zh: 我們沿著森林小徑走到湖邊。

pathetic.en: The character calls his excuse pathetic after realizing it was dishonest.
pathetic.zh: 那個角色發現自己的藉口不誠實後，稱它很可悲。

patience.en: Learning a difficult skill requires practice, patience, and steady effort.
patience.zh: 學習困難技能需要練習、耐心與持續努力。

patient.en: You need to be patient when learning a difficult skill.
patient.zh: 學習困難技能時需要有耐心。

patriot.en: The biography portrays the reformer as a devoted patriot of his era.
patriot.zh: 這本傳記把那位改革者描寫成當時忠於國家的愛國者。

patriotic.en: The museum explains how patriotic songs were used in past ceremonies.
patriotic.zh: 博物館說明愛國歌曲過去如何用於典禮。

patrol.en: Park staff patrol the trails to check signs and visitor safety.
patrol.zh: 公園人員會巡查步道，檢查標誌與遊客安全。

patron.en: A longtime patron donated several books to the community library.
patron.zh: 一位長期支持者捐了幾本書給社區圖書館。

pattern.en: The graph reveals a clear pattern in the monthly data.
pattern.zh: 圖表顯示每月資料中有明顯模式。

pause.en: Take a brief pause before answering a difficult question.
pause.zh: 回答困難問題前可以稍微停頓一下。

pave.en: The city plans to pave the narrow road before the rainy season.
pave.zh: 市政府計畫在雨季前鋪設這條狹窄道路。

pavement.en: Rainwater collected on the uneven pavement after the storm.
pavement.zh: 暴雨後，雨水積在不平整的人行道上。

paw.en: The dog lifted one paw when it stepped onto the cold floor.
paw.zh: 狗踩到冰冷地板時抬起了一隻腳掌。

pay.en: Students do not need to pay for the online materials.
pay.zh: 學生不需要為線上教材付費。

payment.en: The website confirmed our payment immediately after the order was placed.
payment.zh: 下單後，網站立刻確認了我們的付款。

pea.en: A single pea rolled off the plate and onto the table.
pea.zh: 一顆豌豆從盤子滾到桌面上。

peace.en: The two groups worked together to promote peace in the community.
peace.zh: 兩個團體合作促進社區和平。

peaceful.en: The garden remained peaceful despite the busy road nearby.
peaceful.zh: 儘管附近道路繁忙，花園仍然很寧靜。

peach.en: She packed a ripe peach in her lunch box.
peach.zh: 她在午餐盒裡放了一顆熟桃子。

peacock.en: A peacock spread its colorful feathers near the garden gate.
peacock.zh: 一隻孔雀在花園門口附近展開鮮豔羽毛。

peak.en: The hikers reached the peak shortly before the clouds arrived.
peak.zh: 健行者在雲層抵達前不久登上山頂。

peanut.en: The label clearly states that the snack contains peanut ingredients.
peanut.zh: 標籤清楚標示這份點心含有花生成分。

pear.en: He sliced a ripe pear and shared it with his sister.
pear.zh: 他切了一顆熟梨子和妹妹分享。

pearl.en: The exhibit included a pearl beside several different seashells.
pearl.zh: 展覽在幾種不同貝殼旁放了一顆珍珠。

peasant.en: The novel follows a peasant family living near the old castle.
peasant.zh: 小說描寫一戶住在古堡附近的農民家庭。

pebble.en: A smooth pebble rolled down the path after the rain.
pebble.zh: 雨後，一顆光滑小石子滾下小徑。

peculiar.en: A peculiar sound came from the old clock after midnight.
peculiar.zh: 午夜後，那座老鐘傳出奇怪的聲音。

pedal.en: Press the bicycle pedal steadily as you start moving uphill.
pedal.zh: 開始上坡時，要穩定踩動自行車踏板。

pedestrian.en: The city added a pedestrian crossing near the busy station.
pedestrian.zh: 市府在繁忙車站附近增設行人穿越道。

peek.en: She took a quick peek at the schedule before class began.
peek.zh: 上課前她快速看了一眼時程表。

peel.en: Please peel the orange before adding it to the fruit salad.
peel.zh: 把柳橙加入水果沙拉前，請先剝皮。

peep.en: A tiny bird gave a soft peep from the nest.
peep.zh: 一隻小鳥從巢裡發出輕輕的啾聲。

peer.en: Each student asked a peer to review the first draft.
peer.zh: 每位學生都請一位同儕檢查初稿。

pen.en: I used a blue pen to correct the final draft.
pen.zh: 我用藍筆修改最後一版草稿。

penalty.en: The referee explained the penalty before play resumed.
penalty.zh: 比賽恢復前，裁判說明了這次判罰。

pencil.en: Use a pencil so you can change your answer easily.
pencil.zh: 請使用鉛筆，這樣比較容易修改答案。

pending.en: The final decision is still pending further review by the committee.
pending.zh: 最終決定仍在等待委員會進一步審查。

penetrate.en: Sunlight can penetrate the clear water near the shore.
penetrate.zh: 陽光可以穿透岸邊清澈的水。

penguin.en: A penguin moved carefully across the ice in the documentary.
penguin.zh: 紀錄片裡一隻企鵝小心地走過冰面。

peninsula.en: The map shows a long peninsula extending into the sea.
peninsula.zh: 地圖顯示一條長半島伸入海中。

penny.en: He found an old penny inside the wooden box.
penny.zh: 他在木盒裡找到一枚舊便士。

pension.en: The article explains how a pension supports people after retirement.
pension.zh: 文章說明退休金如何在退休後提供生活支持。

people.en: Many people use public transportation to travel across the city.
people.zh: 許多人搭乘大眾運輸在城市中移動。

pepper.en: She added a little pepper to the soup before serving it.
pepper.zh: 她在上湯前加了一點胡椒。

per.en: The bus arrives three times per hour during the afternoon.
per.zh: 下午時段每小時有三班公車。

perceive.en: Different readers may perceive the character's decision in different ways.
perceive.zh: 不同讀者可能會以不同方式看待角色的決定。

percent.en: About sixty percent of the students chose the first option.
percent.zh: 大約百分之六十的學生選擇第一個選項。

percentage.en: The percentage of students using digital textbooks increased this year.
percentage.zh: 今年使用電子課本的學生比例增加了。

perception.en: Media coverage can influence public perception of an event.
perception.zh: 媒體報導可能影響大眾對事件的看法。

perch.en: Two birds perch on the fence every morning.
perch.zh: 每天早上都有兩隻鳥停在籬笆上。

perfect.en: The plan is not perfect, but it is practical.
perfect.zh: 這個計畫並不完美，但很實際。

perfection.en: The teacher said improvement matters more than perfection.
perfection.zh: 老師說進步比追求完美更重要。

perform.en: Students must perform the experiment exactly as the instructions describe.
perform.zh: 學生必須完全按照說明進行實驗。

performance.en: Her performance improved after she changed her practice routine.
performance.zh: 她改變練習方式後，表現有所提升。

performer.en: Each performer waited quietly behind the stage curtain.
performer.zh: 每位表演者都安靜地在舞台布幕後等待。

perfume.en: A light perfume scent remained in the empty room.
perfume.zh: 空房間裡仍留著淡淡的香水味。

perhaps.en: Perhaps we should collect more evidence before making a decision.
perhaps.zh: 也許我們應該在做決定前蒐集更多證據。

peril.en: The story places the explorers in peril during a sudden storm.
peril.zh: 故事讓探險者在突如其來的暴風雨中陷入危險。

period.en: The temperature changed gradually over a period of three hours.
period.zh: 溫度在三小時期間逐漸改變。

perish.en: Many plants may perish when a severe drought lasts too long.
perish.zh: 嚴重乾旱持續太久時，許多植物可能枯死。

permanent.en: The school installed a permanent sign beside the entrance.
permanent.zh: 學校在入口旁裝設了一面永久標示。

permissible.en: Only approved materials are permissible during the laboratory activity.
permissible.zh: 實驗活動期間只允許使用核准的材料。

permission.en: Students need permission before using the auditorium after school.
permission.zh: 學生放學後使用禮堂前需要獲得許可。

permit.en: The rules permit students to use calculators for this section.
permit.zh: 規定允許學生在這個部分使用計算機。

persevere.en: She continued to persevere even when the project became difficult.
persevere.zh: 即使專題變得困難，她仍持續堅持下去。

persist.en: The problem may persist unless the damaged part is replaced.
persist.zh: 除非更換損壞零件，這個問題可能會持續存在。

persistence.en: His persistence helped him improve his English writing over time.
persistence.zh: 他的毅力幫助他逐漸改善英文寫作。

persistent.en: Persistent practice helped the team improve its presentation skills.
persistent.zh: 持續練習幫助團隊提升簡報能力。

person.en: Each person in the group was given a different task.
person.zh: 小組中的每個人都被分配不同任務。

personal.en: Do not share personal information on an unfamiliar website.
personal.zh: 不要在陌生網站上分享個人資訊。

personality.en: Her friendly personality made group discussions more comfortable.
personality.zh: 她友善的個性讓小組討論更自在。

personnel.en: School personnel checked the building before the event opened.
personnel.zh: 活動開始前，校方人員檢查了校舍。

perspective.en: Reading different sources can help students develop a broader perspective.
perspective.zh: 閱讀不同來源能幫助學生建立更廣的觀點。

persuade.en: The speaker used evidence to persuade the audience to support the plan.
persuade.zh: 講者用證據說服聽眾支持這項計畫。

persuasion.en: The advertisement relies on emotion as a form of persuasion.
persuasion.zh: 這則廣告運用情感作為說服方式。

persuasive.en: Her essay was persuasive because it used clear evidence.
persuasive.zh: 她的文章因為使用清楚證據而很有說服力。

pessimism.en: Too much pessimism can make a difficult problem seem impossible.
pessimism.zh: 過度悲觀可能讓困難的問題看起來無法解決。

pessimistic.en: He felt pessimistic at first but changed his view later.
pessimistic.zh: 他一開始很悲觀，但後來改變了看法。

pest.en: Farmers monitor the field for signs of pest damage.
pest.zh: 農民會觀察田地是否出現害蟲造成的損害。

pet.en: Her pet waits by the door when she returns home.
pet.zh: 她回家時，寵物會在門邊等她。

petition.en: Students submitted a petition requesting longer library hours.
petition.zh: 學生提交請願書，希望延長圖書館開放時間。

petrol.en: The article compares petrol use with newer transportation alternatives.
petrol.zh: 文章比較汽油使用與較新的交通替代方案。

petroleum.en: The lesson examined how petroleum is used in modern industry.
petroleum.zh: 課堂探討石油在現代工業中的用途。

petty.en: The teacher encouraged them not to argue over petty differences.
petty.zh: 老師鼓勵他們不要為小事爭執。

pharmacist.en: The pharmacist explained the label information in a clear way.
pharmacist.zh: 藥師清楚說明了標籤上的資訊。

pharmacy.en: The hospital pharmacy stores medicines under controlled conditions.
pharmacy.zh: 醫院藥局在受控條件下保存藥品。

phase.en: The project entered its final phase after months of preparation.
phase.zh: 經過數月準備後，專題進入最後階段。

phenomenon.en: The lesson explains the natural phenomenon using a simple classroom experiment.
phenomenon.zh: 這堂課用簡單的課堂實驗解釋這個自然現象。

philosopher.en: The class read a short passage by an ancient philosopher.
philosopher.zh: 班上閱讀了一段古代哲學家的短文。

philosophical.en: The novel raises a philosophical question about freedom and responsibility.
philosophical.zh: 這本小說提出一個關於自由與責任的哲學問題。

philosophy.en: Her teaching philosophy emphasizes curiosity and independent thinking.
philosophy.zh: 她的教學理念重視好奇心與獨立思考。

phone.en: Please turn off your phone during the exam.

photo.en: We took a group photo in front of the museum.
photo.zh: 我們在博物館前拍了一張團體照。

photograph.en: The old photograph shows the town before the station was built.
photograph.zh: 這張老照片顯示車站興建前的城鎮樣貌。

photographer.en: The photographer waited for better light before taking the picture.
photographer.zh: 攝影師等到光線更好後才拍照。

photographic.en: The exhibition contains photographic records of the city's history.
photographic.zh: 展覽收錄了這座城市歷史的攝影紀錄。

photography.en: She joined the photography club to learn better composition skills.
photography.zh: 她加入攝影社學習更好的構圖技巧。

phrase.en: This phrase is commonly used in formal writing.
phrase.zh: 這個片語常用於正式寫作。

physical.en: Regular exercise supports both physical and mental health.
physical.zh: 規律運動有助於身心健康。

physicist.en: The physicist explained the experiment to a group of students.
physicist.zh: 那位物理學家向一群學生說明實驗。

physics.en: Physics helps explain how motion, force, and energy are related.
physics.zh: 物理學幫助解釋運動、力與能量之間的關係。

pianist.en: The young pianist performed a short piece at the concert.
pianist.zh: 年輕鋼琴家在音樂會演奏了一首短曲。

piano.en: A piano stood in the corner of the music room.
piano.zh: 音樂教室角落放著一架鋼琴。

pick.en: Please pick one topic for your final presentation.
pick.zh: 請為期末報告選一個主題。

pickle.en: He added a slice of pickle to his sandwich.
pickle.zh: 他在三明治裡加了一片醃黃瓜。

pickpocket.en: The travel guide warned visitors to watch for a pickpocket in crowded areas.
pickpocket.zh: 旅遊指南提醒遊客在人多的地方注意扒手。

pickup.en: The school arranged a pickup point beside the main gate.
pickup.zh: 學校在大門旁安排了一個接送點。

picture.en: The picture shows how the machine is assembled.
picture.zh: 這張圖片顯示機器如何組裝。

piece.en: Each piece of evidence should support your main argument.
piece.zh: 每一項證據都應支持你的主要論點。

pitch.en: The team practiced on a wet pitch after the rain stopped.
pitch.zh: 雨停後，球隊在潮濕的球場上練習。

pitcher.en: The pitcher threw carefully during the final inning of the game.
pitcher.zh: 那名投手在比賽最後一局小心投球。

pity.en: She felt pity for the injured bird and called a wildlife center.
pity.zh: 她很同情那隻受傷的鳥，於是聯絡野生動物中心。

pizza.en: We shared a large pizza after finishing the group project.
pizza.zh: 完成小組專題後，我們一起分吃了一大張披薩。

place.en: The meeting will take place in the school library.
place.zh: 會議將在學校圖書館舉行。

placement.en: Careful placement of the lights improved the quality of the photograph.
placement.zh: 仔細安排燈光位置提升了照片品質。

plague.en: The history lesson examined how plague outbreaks changed medieval cities.
plague.zh: 歷史課探討瘟疫爆發如何改變中世紀城市。

plain.en: The teacher used plain language to explain the difficult scientific idea.
plain.zh: 老師用淺白的語言解釋這個困難的科學概念。

plan.en: We made a clear plan before starting the project.
plan.zh: 開始專題前，我們先擬定了清楚的計畫。

plane.en: Our plane landed safely after a short delay caused by weather.
plane.zh: 班機因天候短暫延誤後安全降落。

planet.en: Scientists continue searching for a planet with conditions similar to Earth.
planet.zh: 科學家持續尋找條件與地球相似的行星。

plant.en: This plant grows best in warm and sunny conditions.
plant.zh: 這種植物在溫暖且陽光充足的環境下長得最好。

plantation.en: The history exhibit describes life on a tea plantation many decades ago.
plantation.zh: 歷史展覽描述數十年前茶園裡的生活。

plastic.en: The school is trying to reduce single-use plastic on campus.
plastic.zh: 學校正努力減少校園內的一次性塑膠。

plate.en: She placed the fruit neatly on a large plate.
plate.zh: 她把水果整齊放在一個大盤子上。

platform.en: The school launched an online platform for sharing homework and announcements.
platform.zh: 學校推出線上平台，用來分享作業與公告。

play.en: The students will play basketball after the meeting.
play.zh: 會議後學生要去打籃球。

player.en: Each player must follow the rules during the match.
player.zh: 每位球員在比賽中都必須遵守規則。

playful.en: The playful puppy chased fallen leaves across the quiet yard.
playful.zh: 那隻愛玩的小狗在安靜院子裡追著落葉跑。

playground.en: Students gathered at the playground during the afternoon break.
playground.zh: 學生在下午休息時間聚集在操場。

playwright.en: The young playwright wrote a comedy for the school drama club.
playwright.zh: 那位年輕劇作家為學校戲劇社寫了一齣喜劇。

plea.en: The community group made a plea for more trees in the neighborhood.
plea.zh: 社區團體呼籲在附近種植更多樹木。

plead.en: The students plead for extra practice time before the final performance.
plead.zh: 學生懇求在正式演出前多一些練習時間。

pleasant.en: A pleasant breeze made the outdoor reading session more comfortable.
pleasant.zh: 宜人的微風讓戶外閱讀時間更加舒適。

please.en: Please check the instructions before beginning the task.
please.zh: 開始任務前請先檢查說明。

pleasure.en: It was a pleasure to work with classmates who shared ideas openly.
pleasure.zh: 能和願意公開分享想法的同學合作是一件愉快的事。

pledge.en: The club made a pledge to reduce disposable waste at school events.
pledge.zh: 社團承諾在校內活動中減少一次性垃圾。

plentiful.en: Fresh water is plentiful in the region during the rainy season.
plentiful.zh: 雨季期間，這個地區的淡水資源十分充足。

plenty.en: There is plenty of time to revise the report before Friday.
plenty.zh: 星期五前還有充足時間修改報告。

plot.en: The novel has a complex plot involving several families and generations.
plot.zh: 這本小說有一個涉及多個家庭與世代的複雜情節。

plow.en: Farmers plow the field before planting the next season's crops.
plow.zh: 農民在種植下一季作物前先犁田。

plug.en: Please plug the projector into the outlet before the presentation begins.
plug.zh: 簡報開始前請先把投影機插上插座。

plum.en: She packed a ripe plum with her lunch for school.
plum.zh: 她在學校午餐中帶了一顆熟李子。

plumber.en: A plumber repaired the leaking pipe beneath the kitchen sink.
plumber.zh: 水電工修好了廚房水槽下方漏水的管線。

plunge.en: Temperatures may plunge after the cold front reaches the island tonight.
plunge.zh: 今晚冷鋒抵達後，氣溫可能會大幅下降。

plural.en: The teacher explained when this noun needs a plural form.
plural.zh: 老師說明這個名詞何時需要使用複數形式。

plus.en: The course includes weekly practice plus two review sessions before exams.
plus.zh: 這門課包含每週練習，另外還有兩次考前複習。

pm.en: The library closes at nine pm on most weekdays.
pm.zh: 圖書館大多數平日晚上九點關門。

pneumonia.en: The health article explains why pneumonia can require professional medical care.
pneumonia.zh: 健康文章說明為什麼肺炎可能需要專業醫療照護。

pocket.en: He found the missing ticket inside his jacket pocket.
pocket.zh: 他在外套口袋裡找到遺失的票。

poem.en: Each student chose a short poem to read aloud in class.
poem.zh: 每位學生選了一首短詩在課堂上朗讀。

poet.en: The poet often wrote about rivers, seasons, and ordinary village life.
poet.zh: 那位詩人常描寫河流、季節與平凡的鄉村生活。

poetic.en: The writer uses poetic language to describe the quiet winter landscape.
poetic.zh: 作者用富有詩意的文字描寫寧靜的冬日景色。

poetry.en: Reading poetry helped her notice rhythm and imagery in language.
poetry.zh: 閱讀詩歌讓她更能注意語言中的節奏與意象。

point.en: The teacher explained the main point with a simple example.
point.zh: 老師用簡單例子說明主要重點。

poke.en: He used a pencil to poke a small hole in the paper model.
poke.zh: 他用鉛筆在紙模型上戳了一個小洞。

polar.en: The documentary examines how polar ecosystems respond to changing temperatures.
polar.zh: 紀錄片探討極地生態系如何因應溫度變化。

pole.en: A small flag was attached to the top of the pole.
pole.zh: 一面小旗子被固定在桿子的頂端。

police.en: The police closed the road after the accident.
police.zh: 事故發生後，警方封閉了道路。

policeman.en: A policeman directed traffic near the school during the event.
policeman.zh: 活動期間，一名警察在學校附近指揮交通。

policy.en: The school introduced a new policy to reduce food waste.
policy.zh: 學校推出新政策以減少食物浪費。

polish.en: She used a soft cloth to polish the old wooden table.
polish.zh: 她用柔軟的布擦亮那張舊木桌。

polite.en: It is polite to listen carefully when another person is speaking.
polite.zh: 別人說話時仔細聆聽是一種有禮貌的表現。

political.en: The class compared several political systems from a historical perspective.
political.zh: 全班從歷史角度比較了幾種政治制度。

politician.en: The article describes how a politician answered questions from local reporters.
politician.zh: 文章描述一名政治人物如何回答地方記者的問題。

politics.en: Our civics class studies politics through laws, elections, and public institutions.
politics.zh: 我們的公民課透過法律、選舉與公共制度來學習政治。

poll.en: The class conducted a poll about students' preferred study methods.
poll.zh: 班上進行一項關於學生偏好讀書方法的民調。

pollute.en: Plastic waste can pollute rivers and harm nearby wildlife habitats.
pollute.zh: 塑膠垃圾可能污染河川並傷害附近野生動物棲地。

pollution.en: The city introduced new buses to reduce air pollution downtown.
pollution.zh: 市府引進新公車以減少市中心的空氣污染。

pond.en: Several frogs appeared beside the pond after the evening rain.
pond.zh: 晚間下雨後，池塘旁出現了幾隻青蛙。

ponder.en: She paused to ponder the question before giving her final answer.
ponder.zh: 她停了一下思考問題，才給出最後答案。

pony.en: The children watched a pony graze quietly behind the fence.
pony.zh: 孩子們看著一匹小馬在圍欄後安靜吃草。

pool.en: The community pool closes early on days with severe weather.
pool.zh: 遇到惡劣天候時，社區游泳池會提早關閉。

poor.en: Poor lighting made the small print difficult to read clearly.
poor.zh: 光線不足讓小字很難看清楚。

pop.en: The balloon may pop if too much air is added.
pop.zh: 如果充入太多空氣，氣球可能會爆掉。

popcorn.en: We shared a bowl of popcorn while watching the school film.
popcorn.zh: 我們看校內影片時一起分享了一碗爆米花。

popular.en: This study method is popular because it is simple and effective.
popular.zh: 這種讀書方法因簡單有效而很受歡迎。

popularity.en: The app gained popularity because its design was simple and useful.
popularity.zh: 這個應用程式因設計簡單實用而變得受歡迎。

populate.en: Many small fish populate the shallow waters near the reef.
populate.zh: 許多小魚棲息在珊瑚礁附近的淺水區。

population.en: The city's population has grown steadily over the last decade.
population.zh: 這座城市的人口在過去十年間穩定成長。

porcelain.en: The museum displayed a porcelain bowl decorated with blue patterns.
porcelain.zh: 博物館展示一只有藍色花紋的瓷碗。

porch.en: They left their muddy shoes on the porch before entering.
porch.zh: 他們進屋前把沾泥的鞋留在門廊。

pork.en: The menu clearly marks which dishes contain pork or seafood.
pork.zh: 菜單清楚標示哪些餐點含有豬肉或海鮮。

port.en: The cargo ship arrived at the port shortly after sunrise.
port.zh: 貨輪在日出後不久抵達港口。

portable.en: The class used a portable speaker during the outdoor presentation.
portable.zh: 班上在戶外報告時使用可攜式喇叭。

porter.en: The hotel porter carried the luggage to the front desk.
porter.zh: 旅館行李員把行李搬到櫃台。

portfolio.en: She added her best drawings to a portfolio for the interview.
portfolio.zh: 她把最好的畫作放進作品集準備面試。

portion.en: Only a small portion of the data showed unusual results.
portion.zh: 只有一小部分資料顯示異常結果。

portrait.en: The gallery displayed a portrait painted more than a century ago.
portrait.zh: 畫廊展示一幅一百多年前畫的人像。

portray.en: The film tries to portray village life with warmth and detail.
portray.zh: 這部電影試圖溫暖而細緻地描繪鄉村生活。

pose.en: The sudden change may pose a challenge for small businesses.
pose.zh: 這項突然的改變可能對小型企業造成挑戰。

position.en: Please place the camera in the correct position before recording.
position.zh: 錄影前請把相機放在正確位置。

positive.en: Positive feedback can encourage students to keep improving.
positive.zh: 正向回饋能鼓勵學生持續進步。

possess.en: Some plants possess features that help them survive dry climates.
possess.zh: 有些植物具有幫助它們適應乾燥氣候的特徵。

possession.en: The old photograph became her most treasured family possession.
possession.zh: 那張老照片成了她最珍惜的家族物品。

possibility.en: There is a possibility that tomorrow's outdoor event will move indoors.
possibility.zh: 明天的戶外活動有可能改到室內。

possible.en: We considered every possible solution before choosing one.
possible.zh: 我們在做選擇前考慮了所有可能的解決方案。

post.en: The teacher will post the results on the class website.
post.zh: 老師會把結果公布在班級網站上。

postage.en: The clerk checked the postage before sending the package overseas.
postage.zh: 店員在寄送海外包裹前確認郵資。

postcard.en: He sent a postcard to his grandparents during the school trip.
postcard.zh: 他在校外旅行時寄了一張明信片給祖父母。

poster.en: Our group designed a poster about conserving water at school.
poster.zh: 我們小組設計了一張校園節水海報。

postpone.en: Heavy rain forced the organizers to postpone the outdoor concert.
postpone.zh: 大雨迫使主辦單位延後戶外音樂會。

postponement.en: The postponement gave the team another week to prepare carefully.
postponement.zh: 延期讓團隊多了一週仔細準備。

posture.en: The instructor reminded students to maintain comfortable posture while studying.
posture.zh: 老師提醒學生讀書時保持舒適姿勢。

pot.en: A small pot of herbs sat beside the kitchen window.
pot.zh: 廚房窗邊放著一小盆香草。

potato.en: The farmer showed us how a potato grows beneath the soil.
potato.zh: 農夫向我們展示馬鈴薯如何在土壤下生長。

potent.en: A potent idea can influence public discussion for many years.
potent.zh: 有力的觀念可能影響公共討論許多年。

potential.en: The new method has great potential for saving both time and energy.
potential.zh: 這種新方法很有潛力同時節省時間與能源。

pottery.en: The museum workshop taught students about traditional pottery techniques.
pottery.zh: 博物館工作坊讓學生認識傳統陶藝技法。

poultry.en: The farm keeps poultry in a clean shelter behind the barn.
poultry.zh: 農場把家禽養在穀倉後方乾淨的棚舍中。

pound.en: The recipe calls for about one pound of fresh vegetables.
pound.zh: 這份食譜需要大約一磅新鮮蔬菜。

pour.en: Please pour the water slowly so it does not spill.
pour.zh: 請慢慢倒水，以免灑出來。

poverty.en: The report examines how education can help reduce long-term poverty.
poverty.zh: 報告探討教育如何協助減少長期貧困。

powder.en: A fine powder covered the table after the art activity.
powder.zh: 美術活動後，桌面覆著一層細粉。

power.en: Solar panels can provide power for small buildings.
power.zh: 太陽能板可以為小型建築供電。

powerful.en: The documentary delivers a powerful message about protecting the ocean.
powerful.zh: 紀錄片傳達了保護海洋的強而有力訊息。

practical.en: The teacher gave practical advice for organizing notes before exams.
practical.zh: 老師提供考前整理筆記的實用建議。

practice.en: Regular practice is the best way to improve speaking skills.
practice.zh: 規律練習是提升口說能力的最佳方式。

practitioner.en: The experienced practitioner spoke about changes in the design profession.
practitioner.zh: 那位資深從業者談到設計產業的變化。

praise.en: The coach offered praise after the team showed strong cooperation.
praise.zh: 團隊展現良好合作後，教練給予稱讚。

pray.en: Some visitors pray quietly inside the historic place of worship.
pray.zh: 有些訪客在這座歷史宗教場所內安靜祈禱。

prayer.en: The museum display includes a written prayer from an earlier century.
prayer.zh: 博物館展品包含一篇來自較早世紀的祈禱文。

preach.en: The lesson explains how religious leaders may preach to their communities.
preach.zh: 課堂說明宗教領袖可能如何向其社群講道。

precaution.en: Checking the weather forecast is a sensible precaution before hiking.
precaution.zh: 健行前查看天氣預報是一項合理的預防措施。

precede.en: A short introduction should precede the detailed analysis in your report.
precede.zh: 報告中的詳細分析前應先有一段簡短介紹。

precedent.en: The court decision created a precedent discussed in our civics class.
precedent.zh: 那項法院判決形成了公民課討論的先例。

precious.en: Clean water is a precious resource that communities must protect.
precious.zh: 乾淨的水是社區必須保護的珍貴資源。

precise.en: Use precise measurements when recording the length of each sample.
precise.zh: 記錄每個樣本的長度時，請使用精確測量。

precision.en: The science experiment requires precision when recording each measurement.
precision.zh: 科學實驗在記錄每次測量時需要精確性。

predator.en: The owl is an important predator in many forest ecosystems.
predator.zh: 貓頭鷹在許多森林生態系中是重要掠食者。

predecessor.en: The new principal thanked her predecessor for years of service.
predecessor.zh: 新校長感謝前任多年來的服務。

predict.en: The model can predict changes in temperature with reasonable accuracy.
predict.zh: 這個模型能以合理準確度預測溫度變化。

prediction.en: Her prediction was based on patterns found in earlier data.
prediction.zh: 她的預測是根據先前資料中的模式做出的。

prefer.en: I prefer studying in the library because it is quieter.
prefer.zh: 我比較喜歡在圖書館讀書，因為那裡較安靜。

preference.en: Each student listed a preference for one of three project topics.
preference.zh: 每位學生列出三個專題主題中的一項偏好。

pregnancy.en: The textbook discusses pregnancy as part of human biology and health education.
pregnancy.zh: 課本把懷孕作為人體生物與健康教育的一部分來討論。

pregnant.en: The biology lesson explains changes that can occur when someone is pregnant.
pregnant.zh: 生物課說明懷孕時可能出現的身體變化。

prehistoric.en: The exhibit features prehistoric tools found near the ancient settlement.
prehistoric.zh: 展覽展示在古代聚落附近發現的史前工具。

prejudice.en: Education can challenge prejudice by encouraging people to examine assumptions.
prejudice.zh: 教育能鼓勵人們檢視成見，進而挑戰偏見。

preliminary.en: The preliminary results suggest that the new method may be effective.
preliminary.zh: 初步結果顯示新方法可能有效。

premature.en: A premature conclusion may change after more evidence becomes available.
premature.zh: 過早的結論可能在更多證據出現後改變。

premier.en: The festival invited a premier orchestra to perform on opening night.
premier.zh: 藝術節邀請一流管弦樂團在開幕夜演出。

premiere.en: The film premiere attracted students interested in local filmmaking.
premiere.zh: 電影首映吸引對在地電影製作有興趣的學生。

premise.en: The essay begins with the premise that access to information matters.
premise.zh: 這篇文章以取得資訊很重要這項前提開場。

premium.en: The company charges a premium for faster delivery during holidays.
premium.zh: 節日期間，公司對快速配送收取較高費用。

preparation.en: Careful preparation made the group presentation much smoother.
preparation.zh: 充分準備讓小組報告順利許多。

prepare.en: Students should prepare their notes before the discussion begins.
prepare.zh: 討論開始前，學生應先準備好筆記。

presence.en: The teacher's presence helped the nervous students feel more secure.
presence.zh: 老師在場讓緊張的學生感到更安心。

present.en: Each group will present its findings to the class tomorrow.
present.zh: 每個小組明天都要向全班報告研究結果。

presentation.en: Her presentation included clear charts and useful examples.
presentation.zh: 她的報告包含清楚的圖表與實用例子。

preservation.en: The project focuses on the preservation of historic buildings downtown.
preservation.zh: 這項計畫著重市中心歷史建築的保存。

preserve.en: The project aims to preserve historic buildings in the neighborhood.
preserve.zh: 這項計畫旨在保存社區中的歷史建築。

preside.en: A senior student will preside over the club meeting tomorrow.
preside.zh: 一位高年級學生明天將主持社團會議。

presidency.en: The history chapter examines several major events during his presidency.
presidency.zh: 歷史章節探討他擔任總統期間的幾項重大事件。

president.en: The club president opened the meeting with a short welcome.
president.zh: 社長以簡短歡迎詞開始會議。

presidential.en: The article compares different presidential systems in several countries.
presidential.zh: 文章比較數個國家的不同總統制。

press.en: The local press reported on the school's environmental project.
press.zh: 地方媒體報導了學校的環境專題。

pressure.en: Too much pressure can make it harder to concentrate.
pressure.zh: 過大的壓力會讓人更難專心。

prestige.en: The award brought international prestige to the small research institute.
prestige.zh: 這個獎項為小型研究機構帶來國際聲望。

presumably.en: The missing file was presumably moved to another folder by mistake.
presumably.zh: 那個遺失的檔案推測是誤移到另一個資料夾。

presume.en: Do not presume the answer before examining all the evidence.
presume.zh: 在檢視所有證據前，不要先假定答案。

pretend.en: Children often pretend that cardboard boxes are ships or castles.
pretend.zh: 孩子常假裝紙箱是船或城堡。

pretty.en: The sky looked pretty after the rain cleared near sunset.
pretty.zh: 傍晚雨停後，天空看起來很漂亮。

prevail.en: Calm discussion should prevail when group members disagree about a plan.
prevail.zh: 當組員對計畫有不同意見時，應以冷靜討論為主。

prevent.en: Good planning can prevent many common mistakes.
prevent.zh: 良好規劃可以避免許多常見錯誤。

prevention.en: The campaign focuses on prevention through education and early awareness.
prevention.zh: 這項活動著重透過教育與及早認識來進行預防。

preventive.en: The brochure describes preventive health measures in general terms.
preventive.zh: 這份手冊以一般方式介紹預防性的健康措施。

preview.en: We watched a short preview before choosing the documentary.
preview.zh: 我們選紀錄片前先看了一小段預告。

previous.en: The previous chapter explains the background needed for this discussion.
previous.zh: 前一章說明這次討論所需的背景。

prey.en: Small fish often become prey for larger animals in the lake.
prey.zh: 小魚常成為湖中較大型動物的獵物。

price.en: The price of the ticket includes admission to the museum.
price.zh: 票價包含博物館入場費。

priceless.en: The family considered the old letters priceless because of their history.
priceless.zh: 這家人因那些老信件的歷史意義而視其為無價之寶。

pride.en: She took pride in completing the difficult project with her team.
pride.zh: 她為和團隊完成困難專題感到自豪。

priest.en: A priest explained the history of the old church to visitors.
priest.zh: 一位神父向訪客介紹這座老教堂的歷史。

primary.en: Our primary goal is to improve reading comprehension.
primary.zh: 我們的主要目標是提升閱讀理解能力。

prime.en: The station's prime location makes it easy for students to visit.
prime.zh: 車站的絕佳位置讓學生很容易前往。

primitive.en: The exhibit compares primitive tools with later metal designs.
primitive.zh: 展覽比較早期簡單工具與後來的金屬設計。

prince.en: The story follows a prince who travels beyond the palace walls.
prince.zh: 故事描述一位王子走出宮牆旅行。

princess.en: The novel presents the princess as a curious and capable leader.
princess.zh: 小說把這位公主描寫成好奇且有能力的領導者。

principal.en: The principal reason for the delay was heavy rain.
principal.zh: 延誤的主要原因是大雨。

principle.en: The teacher explained the principle with a simple real-world example.
principle.zh: 老師用簡單的真實例子解釋這項原理。

print.en: Please print the report before the meeting begins.
print.zh: 會議開始前請把報告印出來。

printer.en: The classroom printer ran out of paper before lunch.
printer.zh: 教室印表機在午餐前用完紙張。

prior.en: Prior experience with the software can make the task easier.
prior.zh: 先前使用這套軟體的經驗可以讓任務更容易。

priority.en: Student safety should always remain the highest priority during experiments.
priority.zh: 學生安全在實驗中應永遠是最高優先事項。

prison.en: The documentary examines how prison systems differ across countries.
prison.zh: 紀錄片探討不同國家的監獄制度有何差異。

prisoner.en: The history book describes a prisoner who later became a writer.
prisoner.zh: 歷史書描述一名後來成為作家的囚犯。

privacy.en: Students should protect their privacy when using online services.
privacy.zh: 學生使用線上服務時應保護自己的隱私。

private.en: The website keeps each user's private information protected.
private.zh: 這個網站會保護每位使用者的私人資訊。

privatize.en: The article discusses whether governments should privatize certain public services.
privatize.zh: 文章討論政府是否應將某些公共服務民營化。

privilege.en: Access to a quiet study space can feel like a privilege.
privilege.zh: 能使用安靜的讀書空間有時像是一種難得的條件。

prize.en: Her science project won first prize at the school fair.
prize.zh: 她的科學專題在校內展覽獲得首獎。

probable.en: Rain is probable this afternoon according to the latest forecast.
probable.zh: 根據最新預報，今天下午很可能下雨。

probably.en: The bus will probably arrive within the next ten minutes.
probably.zh: 公車大概會在接下來十分鐘內抵達。

probe.en: The space probe sent new images back to scientists on Earth.
probe.zh: 太空探測器把新影像傳回地球給科學家。

problem.en: We solved the problem by checking each step carefully.
problem.zh: 我們透過仔細檢查每個步驟解決了問題。

procedure.en: Follow the procedure carefully so the results can be compared fairly.
procedure.zh: 請仔細遵循程序，讓結果可以公平比較。

proceed.en: The class will proceed to the next activity after a short break.
proceed.zh: 短暫休息後，全班會繼續進行下一個活動。

process.en: Learning a language is a gradual process that takes time.
process.zh: 學習語言是一個需要時間的漸進過程。

procession.en: A colorful procession moved slowly through the town during the festival.
procession.zh: 節慶期間，一支繽紛隊伍緩慢穿過城鎮。

proclaim.en: The organizers will proclaim the contest winners after the final performance.
proclaim.zh: 主辦單位會在最後演出後宣布比賽得獎者。

produce.en: The new method can produce more accurate results.
produce.zh: 這個新方法可以產生更準確的結果。

producer.en: The film producer visited our class to discuss documentary work.
producer.zh: 電影製作人到班上分享紀錄片工作。

product.en: The company tested the product before releasing it to customers.
product.zh: 公司在產品上市前先進行測試。

production.en: The factory reduced waste while increasing production this year.
production.zh: 工廠今年在提高產量的同時減少廢棄物。

productive.en: A quiet morning gave us several productive hours for group work.
productive.zh: 安靜的早晨讓我們有幾個有效率的小組工作時段。

productivity.en: Short breaks can improve productivity during long periods of study.
productivity.zh: 長時間讀書時，短暫休息能提升效率。

profession.en: Teaching is a profession that requires preparation, patience, and communication.
profession.zh: 教學是一項需要準備、耐心與溝通的專業。

professional.en: The speaker gave professional advice about preparing for future careers.
professional.zh: 講者提供了有關未來職涯準備的專業建議。

professor.en: The visiting professor answered student questions after the lecture.
professor.zh: 客座教授在演講後回答學生問題。

proficiency.en: Regular reading can improve proficiency in academic English over time.
proficiency.zh: 規律閱讀能逐漸提升學術英文能力。

profile.en: The website lets each student update a personal learning profile.
profile.zh: 網站讓每位學生更新自己的學習資料頁。

profit.en: The shop donated part of its profit to the community library.
profit.zh: 商店把部分利潤捐給社區圖書館。

profitable.en: The small business became profitable after improving its delivery service.
profitable.zh: 這家小企業改善配送服務後開始獲利。

profound.en: The invention had a profound effect on how people shared information.
profound.zh: 這項發明對人們分享資訊的方式產生深遠影響。

program.en: The school program helps students improve their reading skills.
program.zh: 這項學校計畫幫助學生提升閱讀能力。

progress.en: The teacher praised our progress after several weeks of practice.
progress.zh: 經過數週練習後，老師稱讚我們的進步。

progressive.en: The course uses a progressive series of tasks from simple to complex.
progressive.zh: 這門課使用由簡入繁的漸進式任務。

prohibit.en: School rules prohibit students from entering the laboratory without permission.
prohibit.zh: 校規禁止學生未經允許進入實驗室。

prohibition.en: The sign explains the prohibition of parking near the emergency entrance.
prohibition.zh: 標示說明緊急入口附近禁止停車。

project.en: Our project examines how sleep affects student learning.
project.zh: 我們的專題探討睡眠如何影響學生學習。

projection.en: The chart shows a projection of population growth over ten years.
projection.zh: 圖表顯示未來十年人口成長的預測。

prolong.en: Unnecessary delays may prolong the project beyond the original schedule.
prolong.zh: 不必要的延誤可能讓專題超出原定時程。

prominent.en: The chart highlights a prominent increase in energy use during winter.
prominent.zh: 這張圖表顯示冬季能源使用量有明顯增加。

promise.en: He made a promise to finish his part of the work.
promise.zh: 他答應會完成自己負責的工作。

promising.en: The early results look promising, but more testing is still needed.
promising.zh: 初步結果看來很有希望，但仍需要更多測試。

promote.en: The campaign aims to promote reading among younger students.
promote.zh: 這項活動旨在鼓勵年幼學生閱讀。

promotion.en: The bookstore offered a promotion on dictionaries during the school season.
promotion.zh: 書店在開學季推出字典促銷活動。

prompt.en: The warning message should prompt users to save their work immediately.
prompt.zh: 警告訊息應提醒使用者立刻儲存工作。

prone.en: This low area is prone to flooding after very heavy rain.
prone.zh: 這片低窪地區在大雨後容易淹水。

pronounce.en: The teacher showed us how to pronounce the unfamiliar name clearly.
pronounce.zh: 老師示範如何清楚念出那個陌生名字。

pronunciation.en: Listening carefully can improve pronunciation and speaking confidence over time.
pronunciation.zh: 仔細聆聽能逐漸改善發音與口說信心。

proof.en: The scientist asked for stronger proof before accepting the conclusion.
proof.zh: 科學家要求更有力的證據後才接受結論。

propaganda.en: The class learned to identify propaganda by checking sources and evidence.
propaganda.zh: 班上學習透過查核來源與證據來辨識宣傳資訊。

propel.en: A steady wind can propel a small sailboat across the lake.
propel.zh: 穩定的風能推動小帆船穿過湖面。

proper.en: Use proper equipment when conducting the science experiment.
proper.zh: 進行科學實驗時要使用適當設備。

property.en: The library asks visitors to respect public property and shared equipment.
property.zh: 圖書館請訪客愛惜公共財物與共用設備。

prophet.en: The course discusses the role of a prophet in several traditions.
prophet.zh: 這門課討論先知在不同傳統中的角色。

proportion.en: A large proportion of students preferred the shorter reading passage.
proportion.zh: 很大比例的學生比較喜歡較短的閱讀文章。

proposal.en: Our group submitted a proposal for a new recycling station.
proposal.zh: 我們小組提交設置新回收站的提案。

propose.en: I propose moving the meeting to Friday after school.
propose.zh: 我提議把會議改到星期五放學後。

prose.en: The author writes clear prose even when discussing complicated ideas.
prose.zh: 即使討論複雜觀念，作者的散文文字仍很清楚。

prosecute.en: The article explains when authorities may prosecute a case under the law.
prosecute.zh: 文章說明主管機關在法律下何時可能提起訴訟。

prosecution.en: The report summarizes the evidence presented during the prosecution of the case.
prosecution.zh: 報告摘要整理該案件起訴期間提出的證據。

prospect.en: The prospect of studying abroad encouraged her to improve her English.
prospect.zh: 出國留學的前景鼓勵她提升英文能力。

prospective.en: Prospective students toured the campus before choosing their programs.
prospective.zh: 準學生在選擇課程前參觀校園。

prosper.en: Local shops can prosper when the neighborhood attracts more visitors.
prosper.zh: 當社區吸引更多訪客時，在地商店可能蓬勃發展。

prosperity.en: The history lesson examines trade and prosperity in the coastal city.
prosperity.zh: 歷史課探討這座沿海城市的貿易與繁榮。

prosperous.en: The port grew into a prosperous trading center over several decades.
prosperous.zh: 這座港口在數十年間發展成繁榮的貿易中心。

protect.en: Trees can help protect the soil from heavy rain.
protect.zh: 樹木可以幫助保護土壤免受大雨侵蝕。

protection.en: Wetlands provide natural protection against flooding in some coastal areas.
protection.zh: 濕地能為某些沿海地區提供天然防洪保護。

protective.en: The lab requires protective goggles during certain science activities.
protective.zh: 進行某些科學活動時，實驗室要求配戴防護眼鏡。

protein.en: The nutrition lesson explained that protein supports normal growth and repair.
protein.zh: 營養課說明蛋白質有助於正常生長與修復。

protest.en: Students studied how peaceful protest has influenced social change in history.
protest.zh: 學生研究和平抗議在歷史上如何影響社會變遷。

prototype.en: The engineering club tested a prototype before building the final model.
prototype.zh: 工程社在製作最終模型前先測試原型。

proud.en: She felt proud after finishing the project through steady effort.
proud.zh: 她靠持續努力完成專題後感到自豪。

prove.en: One experiment cannot prove that a theory is always correct.
prove.zh: 單一實驗不能證明某個理論永遠正確。

proverb.en: The teacher used a proverb to begin a discussion about patience.
proverb.zh: 老師用一句諺語開啟關於耐心的討論。

provide.en: The library can provide quiet rooms for students working in groups.
provide.zh: 圖書館能提供安靜房間給小組合作的學生。

province.en: The map shows each province and its major cities clearly.
province.zh: 地圖清楚標示每個省份及其主要城市。

provincial.en: The museum preserves records from the former provincial administration.
provincial.zh: 博物館保存過去省級行政機關的紀錄。

provision.en: The agreement includes a provision for reviewing the plan each year.
provision.zh: 這份協議包含每年檢討計畫的條款。

provisional.en: The committee published a provisional schedule before confirming every speaker.
provisional.zh: 委員會在確認所有講者前公布暫定時程。

provoke.en: The surprising result may provoke further questions from the research team.
provoke.zh: 這項意外結果可能引發研究團隊更多問題。

psychiatry.en: The article introduces psychiatry as a field of medicine and research.
psychiatry.zh: 文章介紹精神醫學作為一個醫學與研究領域。

psychic.en: The novel includes a psychic character who claims to predict events.
psychic.zh: 小說中有一名自稱能預測事件的靈媒角色。

psychological.en: The study examines psychological factors that influence learning and memory.
psychological.zh: 這項研究探討影響學習與記憶的心理因素。

psychologist.en: A psychologist spoke to students about how researchers study human behavior.
psychologist.zh: 一位心理學家向學生介紹研究者如何研究人類行為。

psychology.en: Psychology examines how people think, feel, and behave in different situations.
psychology.zh: 心理學研究人們在不同情境下如何思考、感受與行動。

psychotherapy.en: The textbook defines psychotherapy as one form of professional mental health care.
psychotherapy.zh: 課本將心理治療定義為一種專業心理健康照護。

public.en: The new library is open to the public on weekends.
public.zh: 新圖書館週末對大眾開放。

publication.en: The article was accepted for publication in the school science magazine.
publication.zh: 這篇文章獲接受刊登在校內科學雜誌。

publicity.en: The event received more publicity after local newspapers reported it.
publicity.zh: 地方報紙報導後，活動獲得更多曝光。

publicize.en: The school will publicize the contest through its website and newsletter.
publicize.zh: 學校將透過網站與電子報宣傳比賽。

publish.en: The school plans to publish the winning essays next month.
publish.zh: 學校計畫下個月刊登得獎文章。

publisher.en: The publisher released a revised edition of the reference book.
publisher.zh: 出版社推出這本參考書的修訂版。

pudding.en: The cafeteria served fruit pudding as a small dessert after lunch.
pudding.zh: 學校餐廳午餐後提供水果布丁作為小甜點。

puff.en: A small puff of steam rose from the warm cup.
puff.zh: 一小股蒸氣從溫熱的杯子上升起。

pull.en: Please pull the door gently because the handle is loose.
pull.zh: 門把有點鬆，請輕輕拉門。

pulse.en: The science activity used a sensor to measure a steady pulse.
pulse.zh: 科學活動用感測器測量穩定的脈搏。

pump.en: A small pump moves water through the classroom aquarium filter.
pump.zh: 一個小幫浦讓水流經教室水族箱的過濾器。

pumpkin.en: The garden produced one large pumpkin near the end of summer.
pumpkin.zh: 花園在夏末長出一顆大南瓜。

punctual.en: Being punctual helps group meetings begin without unnecessary delays.
punctual.zh: 準時能讓小組會議避免不必要的延誤。

punish.en: The teacher prefers to explain mistakes rather than punish students immediately.
punish.zh: 老師偏好先解釋錯誤，而不是立刻處罰學生。

punishment.en: The teacher explained that punishment should be fair and related to behavior.
punishment.zh: 老師說明處罰應該公平，並與行為本身相關。

pupil.en: Each pupil received a worksheet before the science activity began.
pupil.zh: 科學活動開始前，每位學生都拿到一張學習單。

puppet.en: The drama club used a puppet to tell a traditional story.
puppet.zh: 戲劇社用布偶講述一個傳統故事。

puppy.en: The puppy slept beside its water bowl after playing outside.
puppy.zh: 小狗在戶外玩耍後睡在水碗旁。

purchase.en: The library will purchase more reference books for senior students.
purchase.zh: 圖書館將為高年級學生購買更多參考書。

pure.en: The experiment requires pure water so other substances do not interfere.
pure.zh: 實驗需要純水，以免其他物質造成干擾。

purify.en: Wetland plants can help purify water naturally in some environments.
purify.zh: 在某些環境中，濕地植物能自然幫助淨化水質。

purity.en: The lab checked the purity of the water sample carefully.
purity.zh: 實驗室仔細檢查水樣的純度。

purple.en: A purple flower grew beside the path after the spring rain.
purple.zh: 春雨後，小徑旁長出一朵紫色花。

purpose.en: The purpose of this activity is to practice critical thinking.
purpose.zh: 這項活動的目的是練習批判思考。

purse.en: She found her bus card inside a small purse.
purse.zh: 她在小錢包裡找到公車卡。

pursue.en: She hopes to pursue further study in environmental science someday.
pursue.zh: 她希望未來繼續深造環境科學。

pursuit.en: Curiosity can motivate the pursuit of knowledge across many subjects.
pursuit.zh: 好奇心能促使人們在各領域追求知識。

push.en: Please push the cart slowly through the narrow hallway.
push.zh: 請慢慢推著推車通過狹窄走廊。

put.en: Please put the finished worksheet in the tray by the door.
put.zh: 請把完成的學習單放進門邊的托盤。

puzzle.en: The logic puzzle took our group nearly twenty minutes to solve.
puzzle.zh: 這道邏輯謎題讓我們小組花了將近二十分鐘解開。

pyramid.en: The history book includes a diagram of an ancient pyramid.
pyramid.zh: 歷史課本收錄一張古代金字塔的圖解。

quake.en: The sudden quake caused books to fall from several shelves.
quake.zh: 突如其來的地震讓幾個書架上的書掉落。

qualification.en: The program lists each qualification required for new applicants.
qualification.zh: 這項計畫列出新申請者需要具備的各項資格。

qualify.en: Students must qualify through the first round before entering the final.
qualify.zh: 學生必須先通過第一輪資格才能進入決賽。

quality.en: The team checked the quality of the data before analysis.
quality.zh: 團隊在分析前先檢查資料品質。

quantity.en: The experiment compares how quantity affects the final result.
quantity.zh: 這項實驗比較數量如何影響最後結果。

quarrel.en: A small quarrel ended after both students explained their views calmly.
quarrel.zh: 兩位學生冷靜說明看法後，小爭執就結束了。

quarter.en: Only a quarter of the class chose the optional afternoon activity.
quarter.zh: 全班只有四分之一選擇下午的自由活動。

queen.en: The museum displayed a letter written during the queen's reign.
queen.zh: 博物館展示一封在女王統治期間寫的信。

quest.en: The novel follows a student's quest to uncover a family mystery.
quest.zh: 小說描述一名學生尋找家族謎團答案的旅程。

question.en: Please answer each question using evidence from the passage.
question.zh: 請使用文章中的證據回答每一題。

questionnaire.en: Each participant completed a short questionnaire after the workshop.
questionnaire.zh: 每位參與者在工作坊後填寫一份簡短問卷。

quick.en: A quick review before class can improve understanding.
quick.zh: 上課前快速複習能提升理解。

quiet.en: The library provides a quiet place for students to study.
quiet.zh: 圖書館提供學生一個安靜的讀書場所。

quilt.en: The handmade quilt displayed many patterns from different local traditions.
quilt.zh: 這條手工被子展示不同地方傳統的多種圖案。

quit.en: He decided to quit the club because his schedule became too busy.
quit.zh: 他因行程變得太忙而決定退出社團。

quite.en: The final question was quite difficult for most students.
quite.zh: 最後一題對大多數學生來說相當困難。

quiver.en: The thin leaves quiver whenever a strong breeze passes through.
quiver.zh: 強風吹過時，細薄的葉子就會顫動。

quiz.en: Our teacher gave a short quiz at the end of class.
quiz.zh: 老師在下課前出了一個小測驗。

quota.en: The program reached its enrollment quota earlier than expected this year.
quota.zh: 這項計畫今年比預期更早達到招生名額。

quotation.en: The essay begins with a short quotation from a historical speech.
quotation.zh: 這篇文章以一段歷史演說的短引文開頭。

quote.en: Please quote only the sentence that directly supports your argument.
quote.zh: 請只引用能直接支持你論點的句子。

rabbit.en: A rabbit appeared beside the trail early in the morning.
rabbit.zh: 清晨時，一隻兔子出現在步道旁。

race.en: Several teams entered the race despite the hot weather.
race.zh: 儘管天氣炎熱，仍有好幾支隊伍參加比賽。

racial.en: The lesson examines how racial discrimination has affected societies in history.
racial.zh: 課堂探討種族歧視在歷史上如何影響社會。

racism.en: The class discussed why racism harms fairness and equal treatment.
racism.zh: 班上討論為什麼種族主義會傷害公平與平等待遇。

rack.en: The bicycles were parked neatly in a rack beside the station.
rack.zh: 自行車整齊停在車站旁的停車架。

radar.en: Weather radar showed a band of heavy rain approaching the coast.
radar.zh: 氣象雷達顯示一帶大雨正接近海岸。

radiant.en: The radiant morning light filled the classroom through the large windows.
radiant.zh: 明亮的晨光透過大窗戶灑滿教室。

radiate.en: The diagram shows how waves radiate outward from a central source.
radiate.zh: 圖表顯示波如何從中央來源向外輻射。

radiation.en: The science lesson compares different forms of radiation in nature.
radiation.zh: 自然科學課比較自然界中不同形式的輻射。

radical.en: The proposal suggests a radical change to the current transportation system.
radical.zh: 這項提案建議對目前交通系統進行徹底改變。

radio.en: The radio reported heavy traffic on the highway this morning.
radio.zh: 收音機今早報導高速公路交通壅塞。

radioactive.en: The textbook explains what makes certain materials radioactive in scientific terms.
radioactive.zh: 課本以科學方式說明某些材料為何具有放射性。

radish.en: The class planted radish seeds in the school garden this spring.
radish.zh: 班上今年春天在校園花園種下蘿蔔種子。

radius.en: Measure the radius before calculating the area of the circle.
radius.zh: 計算圓面積前先量半徑。

rag.en: An old rag was used as a prop in the play.
rag.zh: 一塊舊布被當作戲劇道具使用。

rage.en: The novel shows how uncontrolled rage can damage important relationships.
rage.zh: 小說呈現失控的憤怒如何傷害重要關係。

ragged.en: The hikers followed a ragged path along the rocky hillside.
ragged.zh: 健行者沿著岩石山坡上一條崎嶇小徑前進。

raid.en: The history exhibit describes a raid without showing graphic details.
raid.zh: 歷史展覽描述一次突襲，但沒有呈現血腥細節。

rail.en: The train followed the rail along the edge of the valley.
rail.zh: 火車沿著山谷邊緣的鐵軌行駛。

railroad.en: The old railroad connected several small towns across the region.
railroad.zh: 這條老鐵路連接了該地區的幾個小鎮。

railway.en: A new railway station opened near the university last year.
railway.zh: 去年大學附近啟用了一座新的火車站。

rain.en: The rain became heavier just before we reached the station.
rain.zh: 就在我們抵達車站前，雨勢變得更大。

rainbow.en: A bright rainbow appeared after the afternoon shower ended.
rainbow.zh: 午後陣雨結束後出現了一道明亮的彩虹。

raincoat.en: She packed a raincoat because the forecast predicted showers.
raincoat.zh: 因為預報可能下雨，她帶了一件雨衣。

rainfall.en: Heavy rainfall raised the river level during the weekend.
rainfall.zh: 週末的大量降雨使河流水位上升。

rainy.en: The class moved indoors because the morning was rainy.
rainy.zh: 因為早上下雨，班級把活動移到室內。

raise.en: The school hopes to raise enough money for new library books.
raise.zh: 學校希望募到足夠的錢購買新的圖書館書籍。

raisin.en: He found a raisin inside the oatmeal cookie.
raisin.zh: 他在燕麥餅乾裡發現一顆葡萄乾。

rally.en: The team began a late rally and nearly tied the game.
rally.zh: 球隊在比賽後段展開反攻，幾乎追平比分。

ranch.en: The documentary followed a family living on a cattle ranch.
ranch.zh: 紀錄片跟拍了一戶住在牧場的家庭。

random.en: The researchers selected a random sample from the student population.
random.zh: 研究人員從學生族群中選取隨機樣本。

range.en: The survey included students from a wide range of backgrounds.
range.zh: 這項調查包含來自各種不同背景的學生。

rank.en: The survey asked students to rank their favorite study methods.
rank.zh: 調查請學生排列他們最喜歡的讀書方法。

rap.en: The music club performed a short rap during the school festival.
rap.zh: 音樂社在校慶時表演了一段短饒舌。

rapid.en: The city experienced rapid growth during the past decade.
rapid.zh: 這座城市在過去十年間快速成長。

rare.en: It is rare to see snow in this part of Taiwan.
rare.zh: 在台灣這個地區看到下雪很少見。

rash.en: The article warns against making a rash decision without enough information.
rash.zh: 文章提醒不要在資訊不足時草率做決定。

rat.en: A rat was spotted near the old storage building.
rat.zh: 有人在舊儲藏室附近看到一隻老鼠。

rate.en: The report shows that the recycling rate increased last year.
rate.zh: 報告顯示去年的回收率提高了。

rather.en: I would rather walk than wait twenty minutes for the bus.
rather.zh: 我寧願走路，也不想等二十分鐘的公車。

ratify.en: The council voted to ratify the agreement after a long debate.
ratify.zh: 經過長時間辯論後，議會投票批准了協議。

ratio.en: The teacher explained the ratio between distance and travel time.
ratio.zh: 老師解釋距離與旅行時間之間的比例。

rational.en: A rational decision should be based on evidence and clear reasoning.
rational.zh: 合理的決定應建立在證據與清楚推理之上。

rattle.en: Loose windows began to rattle when the wind became stronger.
rattle.zh: 風變強時，鬆動的窗戶開始喀喀作響。

raw.en: The graph displays the raw data before any calculations are applied.
raw.zh: 圖表呈現尚未進行計算前的原始資料。

ray.en: A ray of sunlight entered through the classroom window.
ray.zh: 一道陽光從教室窗戶照進來。

reach.en: We expect to reach the mountain shelter before sunset.
reach.zh: 我們預計在日落前抵達山屋。

react.en: Some materials react differently when they are exposed to heat.
react.zh: 有些材料接觸熱能時會有不同反應。

reaction.en: The chemical reaction released enough heat to change the temperature.
reaction.zh: 這個化學反應釋放了足以改變溫度的熱量。

read.en: Please read the passage carefully before answering the questions.
read.zh: 回答問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

ready.en: The students were ready to begin when the teacher arrived.
ready.zh: 老師到達時，學生已經準備好開始了。

real.en: The project asks students to solve a real problem in their community.
real.zh: 這項專題要求學生解決社區中的真實問題。

realism.en: The novel is known for its realism and detailed everyday scenes.
realism.zh: 這本小說以寫實風格和細緻的日常場景聞名。

realistic.en: The group set a realistic goal for finishing the project.
realistic.zh: 小組為完成專題設定了一個實際可行的目標。

reality.en: The experiment showed that reality differed from our first prediction.
reality.zh: 實驗顯示實際結果與我們最初的預測不同。

realization.en: She came to the realization that the schedule needed more time.
realization.zh: 她逐漸意識到這份時程需要更多時間。

realize.en: She began to realize how important regular review was.
realize.zh: 她開始了解到規律複習有多重要。

really.en: This example really helps explain the idea more clearly.
really.zh: 這個例子真的讓這個觀念更容易理解。

realm.en: The discovery opened a new realm of scientific research.
realm.zh: 這項發現開啟了新的科學研究領域。

reap.en: Students who practice regularly often reap benefits during final exams.
reap.zh: 規律練習的學生常能在期末考獲得成果。

rear.en: The emergency exit is located at the rear of the hall.
rear.zh: 緊急出口位於大廳後方。

reason.en: Please give one reason for choosing that answer.
reason.zh: 請說明你選擇那個答案的一個理由。

reasonable.en: The teacher gave us a reasonable amount of time to finish.
reasonable.zh: 老師給了我們合理的時間完成任務。

reassure.en: The teacher tried to reassure students before the difficult presentation.
reassure.zh: 老師在困難的發表前試著讓學生安心。

rebel.en: The history chapter describes why some citizens chose to rebel.
rebel.zh: 歷史章節描述部分人民為何選擇反抗。

rebellion.en: The museum exhibit explains the causes of the historical rebellion.
rebellion.zh: 博物館展覽說明那場歷史叛亂的成因。

recall.en: I can recall the main idea but not every detail.
recall.zh: 我記得主要概念，但不是每個細節。

receipt.en: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the item.
receipt.zh: 保留收據，以便需要退貨時使用。

receive.en: Students will receive their test results next Monday.
receive.zh: 學生會在下星期一收到考試結果。

receiver.en: The receiver checked the package before signing for delivery.
receiver.zh: 收件人在簽收前先檢查了包裹。

recent.en: A recent study examined how sleep affects student performance.
recent.zh: 最近一項研究探討睡眠如何影響學生表現。

reception.en: The hotel reception desk remained open throughout the evening.
reception.zh: 飯店接待櫃台整個晚上都保持開放。

recession.en: The article explains how a recession can affect employment and spending.
recession.zh: 文章說明經濟衰退如何影響就業與消費。

recipe.en: The recipe uses simple ingredients that are easy to find.
recipe.zh: 這份食譜使用容易取得的簡單材料。

recipient.en: Each scholarship recipient received a letter from the school.
recipient.zh: 每位獎學金受獎者都收到學校寄來的一封信。

recite.en: Students were asked to recite a short poem from memory.
recite.zh: 學生被要求背誦一首短詩。

reckless.en: The story shows how reckless choices can create unnecessary problems.
reckless.zh: 故事呈現魯莽的選擇如何造成不必要的問題。

reckon.en: I reckon the project will take another week to complete.
reckon.zh: 我想這個專題大概還需要一週才能完成。

recognition.en: Her research gained recognition after it was presented at the conference.
recognition.zh: 她的研究在會議發表後獲得肯定。

recognize.en: Students should learn to recognize common patterns in academic writing.
recognize.zh: 學生應學會辨識學術寫作中常見的模式。

recommend.en: Teachers often recommend regular reading to improve vocabulary.
recommend.zh: 老師常建議透過規律閱讀來增進字彙量。

recommendation.en: The librarian gave me a recommendation for a book about climate science.
recommendation.zh: 圖書館員推薦我一本關於氣候科學的書。

reconcile.en: The team tried to reconcile the two different sets of results.
reconcile.zh: 團隊試著調和兩組不同的結果。

record.en: Please record your observations immediately after the experiment.
record.zh: 實驗後請立即記錄你的觀察結果。

recorder.en: We used a digital recorder to capture the interview clearly.
recorder.zh: 我們用數位錄音機清楚錄下這次訪談。

recover.en: The local economy began to recover after several difficult months.
recover.zh: 經過幾個艱難月份後，當地經濟開始復甦。

recovery.en: The town's recovery after the storm took several months.
recovery.zh: 這座城鎮在暴風雨後花了數月復原。

recreation.en: The park provides space for exercise and outdoor recreation.
recreation.zh: 這座公園提供運動和戶外休閒的空間。

recreational.en: The center offers recreational activities for students after class.
recreational.zh: 這個中心提供學生課後休閒活動。

recruit.en: The club hopes to recruit new members during orientation week.
recruit.zh: 社團希望在新生週招募新成員。

rectangle.en: Draw a rectangle around the important part of the diagram.
rectangle.zh: 在圖表的重要部分外畫一個長方形。

recycle.en: Our class collects paper so students can recycle it properly.
recycle.zh: 班上收集紙張，讓學生能妥善回收。

red.en: A red folder contains the forms for tomorrow's meeting.
red.zh: 紅色資料夾裡放著明天會議要用的表格。

reduce.en: Turning off unused lights can reduce energy consumption.
reduce.zh: 關掉不用的燈可以減少能源消耗。

reduction.en: The new lights produced a noticeable reduction in electricity use.
reduction.zh: 新燈具讓用電量明顯降低。

redundancy.en: The editor removed redundancy to make the paragraph more concise.
redundancy.zh: 編輯刪除重複內容，讓段落更精簡。

reef.en: The documentary showed colorful fish swimming around a coral reef.
reef.zh: 紀錄片拍到彩色魚群在珊瑚礁周圍游動。

refer.en: Please refer to the chart when explaining the change in results.
refer.zh: 解釋結果變化時請參考圖表。

referee.en: The referee stopped the match briefly to check the score.
referee.zh: 裁判短暫停止比賽以確認比分。

reference.en: The report includes a reference to several earlier studies.
reference.zh: 這份報告引用了幾項早期研究。

referendum.en: The article explains how a referendum allows citizens to vote directly.
referendum.zh: 這篇文章說明公投如何讓公民直接投票。

refine.en: The team will refine the model after reviewing the test results.
refine.zh: 團隊檢視測試結果後會改良模型。

refinement.en: The final design was the result of repeated testing and refinement.
refinement.zh: 最終設計是多次測試與改良的成果。

reflect.en: The final score may reflect both effort and understanding.
reflect.zh: 最後成績可能同時反映努力與理解程度。

reflection.en: Writing a short reflection helped me understand what I learned.
reflection.zh: 寫一篇短心得幫助我了解自己學到了什麼。

reflective.en: The reflective surface made the room appear brighter in daylight.
reflective.zh: 反光表面讓房間在白天看起來更明亮。

reform.en: The report proposes reform of the outdated school policy.
reform.zh: 這份報告建議改革過時的校規。

refresh.en: A short walk outside can refresh your attention before studying again.
refresh.zh: 到外面短暫散步可以讓你在重新讀書前恢復專注。

refreshment.en: The organizers provided light refreshment during the afternoon break.
refreshment.zh: 主辦單位在下午休息時間提供簡單茶點。

refrigerator.en: Put the leftover soup in the refrigerator before it gets too warm.
refrigerator.zh: 剩下的湯在變得太溫之前要放進冰箱。

refuge.en: The hikers found refuge from the rain inside a shelter.
refuge.zh: 健行者在避難小屋裡躲雨。

refugee.en: The article describes how a refugee family rebuilt its life abroad.
refugee.zh: 文章描述一個難民家庭如何在海外重新建立生活。

refund.en: The store issued a refund after the damaged item was returned.
refund.zh: 商品損壞退回後，商店辦理了退款。

refusal.en: His refusal to explain the change confused the whole group.
refusal.zh: 他拒絕解釋這項改變，讓整個小組感到困惑。

refuse.en: Students may refuse to join an optional activity without penalty.
refuse.zh: 學生可以拒絕參加非必選活動，而不受處分。

refute.en: The researcher used new evidence to refute the earlier claim.
refute.zh: 研究者用新證據反駁先前的主張。

regard.en: Many students regard the library as their favorite study place.
regard.zh: 許多學生把圖書館視為最喜歡的讀書地點。

regarding.en: The teacher sent a message regarding tomorrow's schedule change.
regarding.zh: 老師傳了一則關於明日時程變更的訊息。

regardless.en: Everyone must follow the rule regardless of their grade level.
regardless.zh: 無論年級，每個人都必須遵守這項規定。

regime.en: The history class examined how the old regime maintained authority.
regime.zh: 歷史課探討舊政權如何維持統治。

region.en: This region receives heavy rain during the summer months.
region.zh: 這個地區夏季會有大量降雨。

regional.en: The regional competition brought together students from several cities.
regional.zh: 區域競賽讓來自多個城市的學生齊聚一堂。

register.en: Students must register online before joining the workshop.
register.zh: 學生參加工作坊前必須先在網路上登記。

registration.en: Registration for the science camp closes at the end of May.
registration.zh: 科學營報名將在五月底截止。

regret.en: She felt regret after missing the chance to apologize.
regret.zh: 錯過道歉的機會後，她感到後悔。

regular.en: Regular practice is important for building strong language skills.
regular.zh: 規律練習對建立扎實語言能力很重要。

regulate.en: The device can regulate temperature automatically during the experiment.
regulate.zh: 這個裝置能在實驗過程中自動調節溫度。

regulation.en: The new regulation requires clearer labels on school equipment.
regulation.zh: 新規定要求學校設備使用更清楚的標示。

rehabilitate.en: The city plans to rehabilitate the old riverside park.
rehabilitate.zh: 市府計畫整修老舊的河濱公園。

rehearsal.en: The cast attended a final rehearsal before opening night.
rehearsal.zh: 演員們在首演前參加最後一次彩排。

rehearse.en: The group stayed after school to rehearse its presentation.
rehearse.zh: 小組放學後留下來排練簡報。

reign.en: The museum exhibit covers the king's reign and major reforms.
reign.zh: 博物館展覽介紹那位國王的統治時期與重大改革。

reinforce.en: Regular review can reinforce what students learned in class.
reinforce.zh: 規律複習可以強化學生在課堂上學到的內容。

reject.en: The committee may reject a proposal that lacks supporting evidence.
reject.zh: 缺乏佐證的提案可能會被委員會否決。

rejection.en: The rejection encouraged her to improve the application and try again.
rejection.zh: 這次被拒反而鼓勵她改進申請內容並再次嘗試。

rejoice.en: Fans began to rejoice when the final result was announced.
rejoice.zh: 最終結果公布時，支持者開始歡呼慶祝。

relate.en: The teacher asked us to relate the story to our own experience.
relate.zh: 老師要我們把故事和自己的經驗連結起來。

relation.en: The study explores the relation between exercise and concentration.
relation.zh: 這項研究探討運動與專注力之間的關係。

relationship.en: A good relationship requires trust and clear communication.
relationship.zh: 良好的關係需要信任與清楚溝通。

relative.en: The relative importance of each factor depends on the situation.
relative.zh: 每個因素的相對重要性取決於情況。

relax.en: Listening to quiet music can help students relax after studying.
relax.zh: 讀書後聽安靜的音樂可以幫助學生放鬆。

relaxation.en: Reading quietly can be a form of relaxation after school.
relaxation.zh: 放學後安靜閱讀可以是一種放鬆方式。

relay.en: The team practiced passing the baton for the relay race.
relay.zh: 隊伍為接力賽練習交接棒。

release.en: The organization will release the final report next week.
release.zh: 這個組織會在下週發布最終報告。

relentless.en: The relentless rain continued throughout most of the afternoon.
relentless.zh: 持續不斷的雨幾乎下了一整個下午。

relevant.en: Include only relevant information when answering the reading question.
relevant.zh: 回答閱讀題時，只要包含相關資訊。

reliable.en: A reliable source explains its evidence and identifies where the information came from.
reliable.zh: 可靠的來源會說明證據，並指出資訊從何而來。

reliance.en: Too much reliance on one source can weaken a research report.
reliance.zh: 過度依賴單一來源可能削弱研究報告的可信度。

reliant.en: The system is reliant on a stable internet connection.
reliant.zh: 這套系統仰賴穩定的網路連線。

relic.en: The museum displayed a relic discovered near the ancient temple.
