relic.zh: 博物館展示一件在古寺附近發現的文物。

relief.en: Finishing the final exam brought a sense of relief.
relief.zh: 完成期末考讓人有種鬆一口氣的感覺。

relieve.en: A short break can relieve some pressure during a long study session.
relieve.zh: 長時間讀書時短暫休息可以減輕一些壓力。

religion.en: The course examines religion as part of history and culture.
religion.zh: 這門課把宗教視為歷史與文化的一部分來探討。

religious.en: The museum includes objects from several religious traditions.
religious.zh: 博物館收藏來自多種宗教傳統的物件。

reluctant.en: He was reluctant to change the design without testing it first.
reluctant.zh: 他不太願意在尚未測試前就更改設計。

rely.en: Good decisions should rely on evidence rather than guesswork.
rely.zh: 好的決定應該依靠證據，而不是猜測。

remain.en: Please remain seated until the teacher finishes the instructions.
remain.zh: 請保持坐著，直到老師說明完畢。

remainder.en: We used the first hour for discussion and the remainder for writing.
remainder.zh: 我們第一個小時用來討論，其餘時間用來寫作。

remark.en: Her thoughtful remark changed the direction of the discussion.
remark.zh: 她深思熟慮的一句話改變了討論方向。

remarkable.en: The scientist made remarkable progress despite limited equipment and funding.
remarkable.zh: 這位科學家在設備與經費有限的情況下仍取得卓越進展。

remedy.en: The simplest remedy for the printing error was to replace the page.
remedy.zh: 解決印刷錯誤最簡單的方法是更換那一頁。

remember.en: I use a short review to remember difficult vocabulary better.
remember.zh: 我用簡短複習來更牢記困難單字。

remind.en: Please remind me to bring the science worksheet tomorrow.
remind.zh: 請提醒我明天帶自然科學習單。

reminder.en: I set a reminder so I would not forget the deadline.
reminder.zh: 我設定了提醒，以免忘記截止日期。

reminiscent.en: The melody is reminiscent of traditional songs from the region.
reminiscent.zh: 這段旋律讓人想起該地區的傳統歌曲。

remote.en: The research team visited a remote village in the mountains.
remote.zh: 研究團隊造訪了一座偏遠山村。

removal.en: The removal of damaged branches made the path safer.
removal.zh: 移除受損樹枝後，步道變得更安全。

remove.en: Please remove unnecessary details before submitting the final report.
remove.zh: 提交最後報告前請刪除不必要的細節。

render.en: Poor lighting can render small text difficult to read.
render.zh: 光線不足可能讓小字變得難以閱讀。

renew.en: Students can renew borrowed books through the library website.
renew.zh: 學生可以透過圖書館網站續借書籍。

renowned.en: A renowned scientist gave a lecture at the university.
renowned.zh: 一位知名科學家在大學舉行演講。

rent.en: Visitors can rent bicycles near the park entrance.
rent.zh: 遊客可以在公園入口附近租借自行車。

rental.en: The rental fee includes basic equipment and a storage locker.
rental.zh: 租借費包含基本設備和置物櫃。

repair.en: The technician completed the repair before the computer class began.
repair.zh: 技術人員在電腦課開始前完成維修。

repay.en: He promised to repay the borrowed money by Friday.
repay.zh: 他答應在週五前歸還借來的錢。

repeat.en: The teacher asked us to repeat the sentence more clearly.
repeat.zh: 老師請我們把句子再清楚重複一次。

repetition.en: Careful repetition can help students remember new vocabulary more easily.
repetition.zh: 適度重複可以幫助學生更容易記住新單字。

replace.en: The school plans to replace several old computers this year.
replace.zh: 學校計畫今年汰換幾台老舊電腦。

replacement.en: The school ordered a replacement for the broken classroom projector.
replacement.zh: 學校為故障的教室投影機訂購了替代品。

reply.en: Please reply to the email before Friday afternoon.
reply.zh: 請在星期五下午前回覆這封電子郵件。

report.en: Each group must submit a short report after the experiment.
report.zh: 每個小組都必須在實驗後繳交一份簡短報告。

reporter.en: The reporter interviewed residents about changes in the neighborhood.
reporter.zh: 記者訪問居民，了解社區中的變化。

represent.en: These three examples represent the most common responses in the survey.
represent.zh: 這三個例子代表調查中最常見的回答。

representation.en: The chart gives a clear representation of changes over time.
representation.zh: 這張圖清楚呈現了隨時間發生的變化。

representative.en: Each class chose one representative to attend the student meeting.
representative.zh: 每班選出一名代表參加學生會議。

reproduce.en: Scientists must be able to reproduce results under similar conditions.
reproduce.zh: 科學家必須能在相似條件下重現結果。

reptile.en: The biology exhibit explains how a reptile regulates body temperature.
reptile.zh: 生物展覽說明爬蟲類如何調節體溫。

republic.en: The textbook explains how a republic chooses its political leaders.
republic.zh: 課本說明共和國如何選出政治領導人。

republican.en: In political theory, republican can describe ideas centered on a republic.
republican.zh: 在政治理論中，republican 可描述以共和國為核心的理念。

reputation.en: The school built a strong reputation for science education over many years.
reputation.zh: 這所學校多年來建立了良好的科學教育聲譽。

request.en: The office received a request for additional study materials.
request.zh: 辦公室收到一項要求提供額外學習材料的申請。

require.en: This experiment will require careful measurement and accurate records.
require.zh: 這項實驗需要仔細測量與準確記錄。

requirement.en: Regular attendance is a basic requirement for completing the course.
requirement.zh: 規律出席是完成這門課的基本要求。

rescue.en: The training video explains how a rescue team coordinates during emergencies.
rescue.zh: 訓練影片說明救援隊在緊急事件中如何協調。

research.en: The students conducted research on how noise affects learning.
research.zh: 學生進行了噪音如何影響學習的研究。

researcher.en: The researcher interviewed students from several different schools.
researcher.zh: 研究人員訪問了來自數所不同學校的學生。

resemblance.en: The two designs show a clear resemblance despite their different colors.
resemblance.zh: 這兩個設計雖然顏色不同，但有明顯相似之處。

resemble.en: These clouds resemble waves when viewed from a distance.
resemble.zh: 這些雲從遠處看很像波浪。

resent.en: People may resent rules that seem unfair or poorly explained.
resent.zh: 人們可能會對看似不公平或說明不清的規定感到不滿。

resentment.en: Open communication can prevent small disagreements from turning into resentment.
resentment.zh: 坦誠溝通可以避免小爭執演變成怨恨。

reservation.en: We made a reservation for the museum workshop before all seats filled.
reservation.zh: 我們在名額額滿前預約了博物館工作坊。

reserve.en: We need to reserve the meeting room before Friday.
reserve.zh: 我們需要在星期五前預訂會議室。

reservoir.en: The reservoir stores water that supports nearby communities during dry periods.
reservoir.zh: 這座水庫儲存供附近社區乾季使用的水。

reside.en: Many bird species reside in the wetlands throughout the year.
reside.zh: 許多鳥類全年棲息在這片濕地。

residence.en: The ambassador's official residence stands near the government district.
residence.zh: 大使的官邸位於政府區附近。

resident.en: Each resident received a notice about the neighborhood meeting.
resident.zh: 每位居民都收到一份關於社區會議的通知。

residential.en: The bus route passes through several quiet residential areas.
residential.zh: 這條公車路線會經過幾個安靜的住宅區。

resign.en: The manager decided to resign after completing the major project.
resign.zh: 經理在完成重大專案後決定辭職。

resignation.en: Her resignation surprised several members of the organization.
resignation.zh: 她的辭職讓組織中的幾位成員感到意外。

resist.en: Some materials can resist high temperatures better than others.
resist.zh: 有些材料比其他材料更能耐高溫。

resistance.en: The experiment measures air resistance at different speeds.
resistance.zh: 這項實驗測量不同速度下的空氣阻力。

resistant.en: This material is resistant to water under normal conditions.
resistant.zh: 這種材料在一般情況下具有防水性。

resolution.en: The image has enough resolution to show small details clearly.
resolution.zh: 這張影像有足夠解析度，可以清楚顯示小細節。

resolve.en: The group met after class to resolve the remaining disagreement.
resolve.zh: 小組下課後開會解決剩下的分歧。

resort.en: The family stayed at a mountain resort during the holiday.
resort.zh: 這個家庭假期住在一間山區度假村。

resource.en: The website provides a useful resource for students reviewing vocabulary.
resource.zh: 這個網站為複習單字的學生提供有用資源。

respect.en: Students should respect different opinions during class discussions.
respect.zh: 學生在課堂討論時應尊重不同意見。

respectable.en: She earned a respectable score after months of careful preparation.
respectable.zh: 經過數月認真準備後，她取得相當不錯的成績。

respectful.en: The discussion remained respectful even when opinions strongly differed.
respectful.zh: 即使意見差異很大，討論仍保持尊重。

respective.en: The two teams returned to their respective classrooms after the meeting.
respective.zh: 兩個小組在會議後回到各自的教室。

respond.en: Students should respond clearly to each question on the worksheet.
respond.zh: 學生應清楚回答學習單上的每個問題。

respondent.en: Each survey respondent answered the same set of questions.
respondent.zh: 每位問卷受訪者都回答同一組問題。

response.en: Her response showed that she understood the main idea.
response.zh: 她的回答顯示她理解了主要概念。

responsibility.en: Keeping the classroom clean is everyone's responsibility.
responsibility.zh: 維持教室整潔是每個人的責任。

responsible.en: Students are responsible for bringing their own materials to class.
responsible.zh: 學生有責任自行攜帶上課材料。

rest.en: A short rest can help you concentrate better afterward.
rest.zh: 短暫休息可以幫助你之後更專心。

restaurant.en: The restaurant uses local vegetables in many of its dishes.
restaurant.zh: 這家餐廳在許多料理中使用當地蔬菜。

restoration.en: The restoration of the old theater took nearly two years.
restoration.zh: 這座老劇院的修復工程花了將近兩年。

restore.en: Technicians worked to restore the network after the unexpected outage.
restore.zh: 技術人員在突發斷線後努力恢復網路。

restrain.en: The barrier helps restrain water during periods of heavy rainfall.
restrain.zh: 這道屏障有助於在豪雨期間控制水流。

restraint.en: The debate required patience and restraint from both sides.
restraint.zh: 這場辯論需要雙方都保持耐心與克制。

restrict.en: The school may restrict access to the laboratory after hours.
restrict.zh: 學校可能限制放學後進入實驗室。

restriction.en: The park introduced a temporary restriction during the repair work.
restriction.zh: 公園在維修期間實施一項臨時限制。

restroom.en: The nearest restroom is beside the main entrance.
restroom.zh: 最近的洗手間就在主要入口旁。

result.en: The result was different from what we had expected.
result.zh: 結果和我們原本預期的不一樣。

resume.en: Classes will resume after the public holiday ends.
resume.zh: 國定假日結束後將恢復上課。

retail.en: The report compares retail sales across several shopping districts.
retail.zh: 這份報告比較數個商圈的零售銷售。

retain.en: Students retain information better when they review it regularly.
retain.zh: 學生規律複習時能更好地保留資訊。

retire.en: The coach plans to retire after working at the school for thirty years.
retire.zh: 這位教練在學校工作三十年後打算退休。

retirement.en: She hopes to travel more often after her retirement next year.
retirement.zh: 她希望明年退休後能更常旅行。

retort.en: His quick retort made the audience laugh during the friendly debate.
retort.zh: 他在友善辯論中的機智回應逗笑了觀眾。

retreat.en: The team held a weekend retreat to plan next year's activities.
retreat.zh: 團隊舉辦週末研習活動，規劃明年的行程。

retrieve.en: Students can retrieve saved files from the school computer system.
retrieve.zh: 學生可以從學校電腦系統取回已儲存的檔案。

return.en: Please return the borrowed book by next Monday.
return.zh: 請在下星期一前歸還借閱的書。

reunion.en: Former classmates organized a reunion at their old school.
reunion.zh: 昔日同學在母校舉辦了一場同學會。

reveal.en: The survey results reveal a change in students' study habits.
reveal.zh: 調查結果顯示學生的讀書習慣出現變化。

revelation.en: The final chapter contains a surprising revelation about the main character.
revelation.zh: 最後一章揭露了關於主角的一個驚人真相。

revenge.en: The novel suggests that revenge can keep a conflict going longer.
revenge.zh: 小說暗示報復可能讓衝突延續更久。

revenue.en: Ticket sales provide an important source of revenue for the museum.
revenue.zh: 門票收入是博物館的重要收入來源。

reverse.en: Press this button to reverse the direction of the animation.
reverse.zh: 按下這個按鈕可以反轉動畫方向。

review.en: A quick review before class can improve your understanding.
review.zh: 上課前快速複習可以提升理解。

revise.en: Please revise the paragraph after reading the teacher's comments.
revise.zh: 閱讀老師的評語後，請修改這一段。

revision.en: The final revision made the argument clearer and more convincing.
revision.zh: 最後一次修改讓論點更清楚、更有說服力。

revival.en: The town saw a revival of interest in traditional crafts.
revival.zh: 這個城鎮重新興起對傳統工藝的興趣。

revive.en: The festival helped revive an old local tradition.
revive.zh: 這場節慶幫助復興一項古老的地方傳統。

revolt.en: The history lesson examines the causes of a nineteenth-century revolt.
revolt.zh: 歷史課探討一場十九世紀起義的成因。

revolution.en: The industrial revolution changed production, transportation, and daily life.
revolution.zh: 工業革命改變了生產、交通與日常生活。

revolutionary.en: The invention introduced a revolutionary way to store information.
revolutionary.zh: 這項發明帶來一種革命性的資訊儲存方式。

revolve.en: Several planets revolve around the star in this model.
revolve.zh: 在這個模型中，數顆行星繞著恆星運行。

reward.en: The teacher gave a small reward to the winning team.
reward.zh: 老師給優勝隊伍一個小獎勵。

rhetoric.en: The class analyzed the rhetoric used in a historical speech.
rhetoric.zh: 班上分析了一篇歷史演說中使用的修辭。

rhyme.en: The poem uses rhyme to make several lines more memorable.
rhyme.zh: 這首詩運用押韻讓幾行文字更容易記住。

rhythm.en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the performance.
rhythm.zh: 鼓手在整場表演中維持穩定節奏。

rib.en: The biology model shows the position of each rib clearly.
rib.zh: 生物模型清楚顯示每根肋骨的位置。

ribbon.en: She tied a blue ribbon around the gift box.
ribbon.zh: 她在禮物盒上綁了一條藍色緞帶。

rice.en: Rice is an important food in many parts of Asia.
rice.zh: 米飯是亞洲許多地區的重要食物。

rich.en: The soil is rich enough to support many kinds of plants.
rich.zh: 這片土壤很肥沃，足以讓多種植物生長。

riches.en: The story warns that riches do not guarantee lasting happiness.
riches.zh: 故事提醒財富並不能保證長久的幸福。

rid.en: The editor helped rid the paragraph of repeated phrases.
rid.zh: 編輯幫忙刪除段落中重複的片語。

riddle.en: The teacher began class with a short logic riddle.
riddle.zh: 老師用一則簡短的邏輯謎題開始上課。

ride.en: We decided to ride our bicycles along the river.
ride.zh: 我們決定騎腳踏車沿著河邊前進。

ridge.en: The hikers followed the ridge until sunset approached.
ridge.zh: 健行者沿著山脊前進，直到接近日落。

ridiculous.en: The rumor sounded ridiculous after the facts became clear.
ridiculous.zh: 事實釐清後，那則謠言聽起來很荒謬。

right.en: Make sure you choose the right file before uploading it.
right.zh: 上傳前要確認你選的是正確檔案。

rigid.en: A rigid schedule may be difficult to follow during a busy week.
rigid.zh: 在忙碌的一週裡，過於僵化的行程可能很難遵守。

rigorous.en: The research team followed a rigorous process before publishing its results.
rigorous.zh: 研究團隊在發表結果前遵循嚴謹的流程。

rim.en: A thin line of frost formed around the rim of the window.
rim.zh: 窗框邊緣形成了一圈薄霜。

ring.en: The school bell will ring at eight o'clock.
ring.zh: 學校鐘聲會在八點響起。

rip.en: Be careful not to rip the paper while opening the envelope.
rip.zh: 打開信封時小心不要撕破紙張。

ripe.en: The mango is ripe enough to eat this afternoon.
ripe.zh: 這顆芒果已經熟到今天下午可以吃了。

ripple.en: A small stone created a ripple across the quiet pond.
ripple.zh: 一顆小石頭在平靜的池塘上激起漣漪。

rise.en: Temperatures often rise quickly after the sun comes out.
rise.zh: 太陽出來後，氣溫通常會快速上升。

risk.en: Sharing passwords online creates a serious security risk.
risk.zh: 在網路上分享密碼會造成嚴重的安全風險。

risky.en: Relying on one source alone can be risky for research.
risky.zh: 研究只依賴單一來源可能有風險。

ritual.en: Morning assembly became a familiar ritual for the students.
ritual.zh: 晨會成了學生熟悉的例行活動。

rival.en: The two schools are friendly rival teams in the annual tournament.
rival.zh: 這兩所學校是年度賽事中的友好競爭對手。

rivalry.en: Their rivalry became stronger after several close matches.
rivalry.zh: 幾場勢均力敵的比賽後，他們的競爭更加激烈。

river.en: The river becomes wider as it approaches the sea.
river.zh: 這條河接近海洋時會變得更寬。

roach.en: A roach appeared near the storage room after heavy rain.
roach.zh: 大雨過後，儲藏室附近出現了一隻蟑螂。

road.en: The road was closed because of a landslide after heavy rain.
road.zh: 大雨後發生土石滑落，因此道路封閉。

roam.en: Visitors can roam through the garden during opening hours.
roam.zh: 開放時間內，遊客可以在花園裡自由走動。

roar.en: We could hear the roar of the waterfall from far away.
roar.zh: 我們從很遠的地方就能聽見瀑布的轟鳴聲。

roast.en: The café serves a dark roast coffee in the morning.
roast.zh: 這間咖啡館早上供應深度烘焙咖啡。

rob.en: The novel describes a plan to rob a bank but gives no practical details.
rob.zh: 小說描述一個搶銀行的計畫，但沒有提供實際做法細節。

robber.en: The detective story follows the search for a robber after the crime.
robber.zh: 這則偵探故事描述犯罪後追查一名搶匪的過程。

robbery.en: The news report discussed the robbery without showing graphic scenes.
robbery.zh: 新聞報導討論那起搶案，但沒有呈現血腥畫面。

robe.en: The actor wore a long robe in the historical play.
robe.zh: 演員在歷史劇中穿著一件長袍。

robot.en: The student-built robot moved across the classroom floor successfully.
robot.zh: 學生製作的機器人成功在教室地板上移動。

robust.en: The researchers need robust evidence before changing their conclusion.
robust.zh: 研究人員需要有力的證據，才會改變結論。

rock.en: A large rock blocked part of the mountain trail.
rock.zh: 一塊大石頭擋住了部分山路。

rocket.en: The science museum displayed a model rocket near the entrance.
rocket.zh: 科學博物館在入口附近展示了一枚模型火箭。

rocky.en: The trail became rocky as we climbed higher into the hills.
rocky.zh: 我們爬得越高，步道就變得越多岩石。

rod.en: The experiment used a metal rod to support the structure.
rod.zh: 這項實驗用一根金屬棒支撐結構。

role.en: Technology plays an important role in modern education.
role.zh: 科技在現代教育中扮演重要角色。

roll.en: Please roll the poster carefully before placing it in the tube.
roll.zh: 把海報放入紙筒前請小心捲起來。

roof.en: Rainwater collected on the roof after the afternoon storm.
roof.zh: 午後暴雨後，雨水積在屋頂上。

room.en: The room was quiet enough for everyone to study.
room.zh: 房間很安靜，大家都能讀書。

rooster.en: A rooster crowed loudly just before sunrise on the farm.
rooster.zh: 農場上的公雞在日出前大聲啼叫。

root.en: The tree's root system helps keep the soil in place.
root.zh: 樹木的根系有助於固定土壤。

rope.en: The guide used a rope to mark the edge of the trail.
rope.zh: 嚮導用繩子標示步道邊界。

rose.en: A red rose bloomed beside the school garden fence.
rose.zh: 一朵紅玫瑰在校園花圃的籬笆旁盛開。

rot.en: Fruit can rot quickly when stored in a warm place.
rot.zh: 水果放在溫暖的地方時可能很快腐爛。

rotate.en: Students rotate roles so everyone can practice each task.
rotate.zh: 學生輪流更換角色，讓每個人都能練習各項任務。

rotation.en: The club uses a weekly rotation for cleaning shared equipment.
rotation.zh: 社團採用每週輪替制度清潔共用設備。

rotten.en: The gardener removed a rotten apple from the basket.
rotten.zh: 園丁從籃子裡拿走一顆腐爛的蘋果。

rough.en: The rough surface created more friction during the experiment.
rough.zh: 粗糙的表面在實驗中產生更多摩擦力。

roughly.en: The trip takes roughly two hours by train from here.
roughly.zh: 從這裡搭火車大約需要兩個小時。

round.en: We sat around a round table for the discussion.
round.zh: 我們圍著一張圓桌進行討論。

route.en: This bus route connects the station with the university.
route.zh: 這條公車路線連接車站與大學。

routine.en: A regular study routine can make exam preparation less stressful.
routine.zh: 規律的讀書習慣能讓考試準備更不焦慮。

row.en: We sat in the second row during the school performance.
row.zh: 我們在學校表演時坐在第二排。

royal.en: The museum displayed clothing once worn by the royal family.
royal.zh: 博物館展示了王室成員曾穿過的服飾。

royalty.en: The exhibit explores how royalty influenced art and architecture.
royalty.zh: 展覽探討王室如何影響藝術與建築。

rub.en: Do not rub the page because the ink is still wet.
rub.zh: 墨水還沒乾，請不要摩擦紙面。

rubber.en: The wheels are made from durable rubber for better grip.
rubber.zh: 輪子由耐用橡膠製成，以增加抓地力。

rubbish.en: Volunteers collected rubbish along the riverbank on Saturday morning.
rubbish.zh: 志工週六早上沿河岸撿拾垃圾。

rude.en: Interrupting someone repeatedly can seem rude during a discussion.
rude.zh: 討論時一再打斷別人可能顯得沒禮貌。

rug.en: A small rug covered the floor beside the reading chair.
rug.zh: 閱讀椅旁的地板鋪著一張小地毯。

rugged.en: The hikers crossed rugged terrain during the mountain trip.
rugged.zh: 健行者在山區行程中穿越崎嶇地形。

ruin.en: One careless mistake could ruin the final presentation file.
ruin.zh: 一次粗心的錯誤可能毀掉最後的簡報檔。

rule.en: Every student must follow the same safety rule in the laboratory.
rule.zh: 每位學生在實驗室都必須遵守相同的安全規定。

ruler.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line across the page.
ruler.zh: 用尺在紙上畫一條直線。

rumor.en: The principal asked students not to spread an unconfirmed rumor.
rumor.zh: 校長請學生不要散播未經證實的謠言。

run.en: The program will run automatically after you press the button.
run.zh: 按下按鈕後，程式會自動執行。

runner.en: The fastest runner finished the final lap in strong form.
runner.zh: 最快的跑者以良好狀態完成最後一圈。

rural.en: The documentary compares rural schools with schools in large cities.
rural.zh: 紀錄片比較鄉村學校與大城市學校。

rush.en: There is no need to rush when checking your answers.
rush.zh: 檢查答案時沒有必要匆忙。

rust.en: The old gate showed signs of rust after many rainy seasons.
rust.zh: 經過多個雨季後，舊鐵門出現鏽蝕痕跡。

rusty.en: The bicycle chain became rusty after being left outside.
rusty.zh: 自行車鏈條放在戶外後生鏽了。

ruthless.en: The novel portrays the ruler as ruthless and unwilling to compromise.
ruthless.zh: 小說把那位統治者描寫成冷酷且不願妥協。

sack.en: The farmer carried a sack of rice into the storage room.
sack.zh: 農夫把一袋米搬進儲藏室。

sacred.en: The temple is considered a sacred place by local residents.
sacred.zh: 當地居民把這座寺廟視為神聖之地。

sacrifice.en: Finishing the project required some sacrifice of free time.
sacrifice.zh: 完成這個專題需要犧牲一些休閒時間。

sad.en: She felt sad when the class trip was cancelled.
sad.zh: 班級旅行取消時，她感到難過。

saddle.en: The rider checked the saddle before entering the training area.
saddle.zh: 騎手進入訓練區前檢查了馬鞍。

safe.en: Keep the chemicals in a safe place away from children.
safe.zh: 請把化學物品放在遠離孩童的安全位置。

safety.en: Safety should always come first during laboratory activities.
safety.zh: 進行實驗室活動時，安全永遠應放在第一位。

sail.en: Small boats sail across the bay on calm mornings.
sail.zh: 天氣平靜的早晨，小船會航行穿過海灣。

sailor.en: The sailor described life at sea during the museum talk.
sailor.zh: 水手在博物館講座中描述海上生活。

saint.en: The painting depicts a saint from a medieval story.
saint.zh: 這幅畫描繪一位中世紀故事中的聖人。

sake.en: For the sake of accuracy, check the data one more time.
sake.zh: 為了準確起見，再檢查一次資料。

salad.en: The lunch set includes soup, salad, and fresh fruit.
salad.zh: 午餐套餐包含湯、沙拉和新鮮水果。

salary.en: The article compares salary levels across several different professions.
salary.zh: 文章比較幾種不同職業的薪資水準。

sale.en: The bookstore announced a weekend sale on selected notebooks.
sale.zh: 書店宣布週末部分筆記本特價。

salesman.en: The salesman explained the product features without pressuring customers.
salesman.zh: 男銷售員在不施壓顧客的情況下說明產品功能。

salesperson.en: A salesperson helped us compare two models in the store.
salesperson.zh: 一名銷售人員在店裡幫我們比較兩種型號。

saleswoman.en: The saleswoman answered questions about the warranty and return policy.
saleswoman.zh: 女銷售員回答了保固與退貨政策的問題。

salmon.en: The biology lesson explained how salmon migrate between rivers and oceans.
salmon.zh: 生物課說明鮭魚如何在河川與海洋之間洄游。

salon.en: The old building once served as an art salon for local painters.
salon.zh: 這棟老建築曾是當地畫家的藝術沙龍。

salt.en: The experiment compared fresh water with water containing salt.
salt.zh: 實驗比較淡水和含鹽的水。

salty.en: The soup tasted too salty, so the cook adjusted the recipe.
salty.zh: 湯太鹹，因此廚師調整了食譜。

salute.en: The ceremony ended with a formal salute to the visiting guests.
salute.zh: 典禮以向來賓致意的正式敬禮作結。

salvage.en: Workers managed to salvage useful materials from the damaged building.
salvage.zh: 工作人員成功從受損建築中搶救出可用材料。

same.en: The two experiments used the same amount of water.
same.zh: 這兩個實驗使用了相同的水量。

sample.en: The students examined a small sample under the microscope.
sample.zh: 學生在顯微鏡下觀察一小份樣本。

sand.en: Fine sand covered the path near the beach entrance.
sand.zh: 海灘入口附近的小徑覆蓋著細沙。

sandal.en: One sandal was left beside the swimming pool.
sandal.zh: 游泳池旁留著一隻涼鞋。

sandwich.en: He packed a sandwich and fruit for the field trip.
sandwich.zh: 他為校外教學準備了三明治和水果。

sanitation.en: The report examines sanitation conditions in rapidly growing cities.
sanitation.zh: 報告探討快速成長城市中的衛生條件。

satellite.en: The satellite sends weather data back to scientists on Earth.
satellite.zh: 衛星把氣象資料傳回地球上的科學家。

satisfaction.en: Finishing the difficult project gave the team great satisfaction.
satisfaction.zh: 完成困難的專題讓團隊很有成就感。

satisfactory.en: The first test produced a satisfactory result for the research team.
satisfactory.zh: 第一次測試為研究團隊帶來令人滿意的結果。

satisfy.en: The revised plan should satisfy the main requirements of the assignment.
satisfy.zh: 修訂後的計畫應能符合這份作業的主要要求。

sauce.en: She added a mild tomato sauce to the pasta.
sauce.zh: 她在義大利麵中加入溫和的番茄醬。

saucer.en: The cup rested on a small white saucer.
saucer.zh: 杯子放在一個白色小碟子上。

sausage.en: The breakfast plate included bread, eggs, and one sausage.
sausage.zh: 早餐盤裡有麵包、蛋和一根香腸。

savage.en: The old text uses savage as a dated and potentially offensive term.
savage.zh: 這篇舊文本把 savage 當作一個過時且可能冒犯人的詞。

save.en: Remember to save your document before closing the program.
save.zh: 關閉程式前記得儲存文件。

saving.en: Saving a little money each month can build a useful reserve.
saving.zh: 每個月存一點錢可以累積實用的備用金。

saw.en: The museum displayed an old saw used by early carpenters.
saw.zh: 博物館展示早期木匠使用的舊鋸子。

say.en: Please say your answer clearly so everyone can hear it.
say.zh: 請清楚說出答案，讓大家都聽得到。

scale.en: The map uses a simple scale to show distance.
scale.zh: 這張地圖使用簡單比例尺來表示距離。

scan.en: Please scan the document before uploading it to the class folder.
scan.zh: 請先掃描文件，再上傳到班級資料夾。

scandal.en: The newspaper reported the scandal without repeating unverified claims.
scandal.zh: 報紙報導這起醜聞時沒有重複未經證實的說法。

scar.en: The tree trunk still has a scar from an old storm.
scar.zh: 樹幹上仍留有多年前暴風雨造成的痕跡。

scarce.en: Clean water becomes scarce in some regions during long droughts.
scarce.zh: 長期乾旱期間，有些地區的乾淨用水會變得稀缺。

scarcely.en: There was scarcely enough time to finish the final question.
scarcely.zh: 幾乎沒有足夠時間完成最後一題。

scare.en: The sudden noise was enough to scare the birds away.
scare.zh: 突然的聲響足以把鳥群嚇走。

scared.en: The puppy looked scared during the loud thunderstorm.
scared.zh: 大雷雨時，那隻小狗看起來很害怕。

scarf.en: She wore a warm scarf during the cold morning commute.
scarf.zh: 寒冷的早晨通勤時，她圍著一條保暖圍巾。

scary.en: The movie looked scary, but the ending was actually funny.
scary.zh: 那部電影看起來很可怕，但結局其實很好笑。

scatter.en: Strong wind can scatter dry leaves across the playground.
scatter.zh: 強風會把乾葉吹散到操場各處。

scenario.en: The class discussed a scenario involving a sudden schedule change.
scenario.zh: 班上討論了一個突然更改行程的情境。

scene.en: The final scene takes place beside a quiet river.
scene.zh: 最後一幕發生在一條安靜的河邊。

scenery.en: The mountain scenery attracted many visitors during autumn.
scenery.zh: 秋天的山景吸引許多遊客。

scenic.en: The bus route follows a scenic road along the coast.
scenic.zh: 這條公車路線沿著景色優美的海岸道路行駛。

scent.en: A fresh citrus scent filled the room after cleaning.
scent.zh: 打掃後，房間裡充滿清新的柑橘香氣。

schedule.en: The teacher posted the revised schedule on the classroom wall.
schedule.zh: 老師把修訂後的時程貼在教室牆上。

scheme.en: The city introduced a recycling scheme for local schools.
scheme.zh: 市府為當地學校推出一項回收計畫。

scholar.en: A visiting scholar gave a lecture about ancient trade routes.
scholar.zh: 一位訪問學者舉辦了關於古代貿易路線的講座。

scholarship.en: She applied for a scholarship to support her future studies.
scholarship.zh: 她申請獎學金以支持未來的學習。

school.en: Our school will hold a science fair next month.
school.zh: 我們學校下個月會舉辦科展。

science.en: Science helps us explain many patterns in the natural world.
science.zh: 科學幫助我們解釋自然界中的許多現象。

scientific.en: A scientific explanation should be supported by clear evidence.
scientific.zh: 科學解釋應該由明確證據支持。

scientist.en: The scientist repeated the experiment to confirm the result.
scientist.zh: 科學家重複實驗以確認結果。

scissors.en: Use the scissors carefully when cutting the poster paper.
scissors.zh: 裁剪海報紙時請小心使用剪刀。

scold.en: The teacher chose to explain the mistake rather than scold anyone.
scold.zh: 老師選擇解釋錯誤，而不是責罵任何人。

scoop.en: The reporter published a major scoop before the other newspapers.
scoop.zh: 那名記者比其他報紙更早刊出一則重大獨家新聞。

scooter.en: She parked her scooter beside the bicycle rack.
scooter.zh: 她把機車停在腳踏車架旁。

scope.en: The project expanded its scope to include students from three schools.
scope.zh: 這項專題擴大範圍，納入三所學校的學生。

score.en: Her score improved after several weeks of regular practice.
score.zh: 經過幾週規律練習後，她的分數提高了。

scout.en: A scout recorded bird species during the nature activity.
scout.zh: 一名童軍在自然活動中記錄鳥類種類。

scramble.en: Students had to scramble to finish before the deadline.
scramble.zh: 學生們得趕緊完成，才能在截止時間前交件。

scrap.en: The art club reused each scrap of paper for collage work.
scrap.zh: 美術社把每張紙屑都重新利用來做拼貼。

scrape.en: Be careful not to scrape the table while moving the box.
scrape.zh: 搬箱子時小心不要刮到桌子。

scratch.en: The glass has a small scratch near one corner.
scratch.zh: 玻璃靠近一個角落的地方有一道小刮痕。

screen.en: The answer will appear on the screen after you submit.
screen.zh: 提交後答案會出現在螢幕上。

screw.en: A loose screw caused the chair leg to wobble slightly.
screw.zh: 一顆鬆動的螺絲讓椅腳有些搖晃。

screwdriver.en: The toolbox contains a screwdriver for basic maintenance tasks.
screwdriver.zh: 工具箱裡有一支用於基本維修的螺絲起子。

script.en: The drama club revised the script before the final rehearsal.
script.zh: 戲劇社在最後彩排前修改了劇本。

scroll.en: Scroll down the page to find the homework instructions.
scroll.zh: 往下捲動頁面就能找到作業說明。

scrub.en: Volunteers helped scrub the old tables before the event.
scrub.zh: 志工在活動前幫忙刷洗舊桌子。

scrutiny.en: The proposal came under close scrutiny during the committee meeting.
scrutiny.zh: 這項提案在委員會議中受到仔細審查。

sculptor.en: The sculptor explained how the stone artwork was designed.
sculptor.zh: 雕刻家說明了這件石雕作品的設計方式。

sculpture.en: A large sculpture stands in front of the city museum.
sculpture.zh: 市立博物館前矗立著一座大型雕塑。

sea.en: The class studied how plastic waste affects the sea.
sea.zh: 班上研究塑膠垃圾如何影響海洋。

seafood.en: The market sells fresh seafood from nearby fishing ports.
seafood.zh: 市場販售來自附近漁港的新鮮海鮮。

seagull.en: A seagull circled above the pier during our field trip.
seagull.zh: 校外教學時，一隻海鷗在碼頭上空盤旋。

seal.en: The aquarium has a rescued seal in its marine exhibit.
seal.zh: 水族館的海洋展區有一隻獲救的海豹。

search.en: Students can search the library database for useful sources.
search.zh: 學生可以搜尋圖書館資料庫來找有用來源。

season.en: Spring is my favorite season because the weather is mild.
season.zh: 春天是我最喜歡的季節，因為天氣溫和。

seat.en: Please take your seat before the presentation begins.

second.en: The second experiment produced a more accurate result.
second.zh: 第二次實驗得到更準確的結果。

secondary.en: The report lists several secondary causes of the problem.
secondary.zh: 報告列出了這個問題的幾個次要原因。

secret.en: She kept the surprise party a secret until Friday.
secret.zh: 她一直把驚喜派對保密到星期五。

secretary.en: The club secretary recorded the decisions from the meeting.
secretary.zh: 社團秘書記錄了會議中的決定。

section.en: Read the final section before answering the last question.
section.zh: 回答最後一題前請閱讀最後一節。

sector.en: The report describes growth in the renewable energy sector.
sector.zh: 報告描述再生能源產業的成長。

secure.en: The team used a secure system to store research data.
secure.zh: 團隊使用安全的系統儲存研究資料。

security.en: The school improved security around the main entrance this year.
security.zh: 學校今年加強了正門附近的安全措施。

see.en: We can see a clear pattern in the final graph.
see.zh: 我們可以在最後的圖表中看出明顯模式。

seed.en: Each group planted a seed and recorded its growth.
seed.zh: 每組種下一顆種子並記錄它的生長。

seek.en: Students should seek help when an assignment becomes confusing.
seek.zh: 作業讓人困惑時，學生應主動尋求協助。

seem.en: The task may seem difficult at first, but practice helps.
seem.zh: 這項任務一開始可能看起來很難，但練習會有幫助。

seesaw.en: Two children took turns riding the seesaw in the playground.
seesaw.zh: 兩個孩子在遊樂場輪流玩翹翹板。

segment.en: The documentary includes a short segment about coral reef conservation.
segment.zh: 這部紀錄片有一小段介紹珊瑚礁保育。

seize.en: Officials may seize illegal goods found during a border inspection.
seize.zh: 官員在邊境檢查時可能扣押查獲的違法物品。

seldom.en: He seldom misses class unless he is truly unwell.
seldom.zh: 除非真的不舒服，他很少缺課。

select.en: Please select one topic for your final presentation.
select.zh: 請為期末報告選擇一個主題。

selection.en: The library has a wide selection of English novels.
selection.zh: 圖書館有多樣的英文小說可供選擇。

selective.en: Readers should be selective when choosing sources for research.
selective.zh: 做研究時，讀者應謹慎挑選資料來源。

self.en: The essay asks students to reflect on their sense of self.
self.zh: 這篇作文要求學生反思自己的自我認同。

selfish.en: It would be selfish to ignore everyone's needs in the group.
selfish.zh: 在小組中忽略所有人的需求會顯得自私。

sell.en: The school club will sell snacks to raise money.
sell.zh: 學校社團會賣點心來募款。

semester.en: Our science project will continue throughout the spring semester.
semester.zh: 我們的科學專題會持續整個春季學期。

seminar.en: The university hosted a seminar about climate and technology.
seminar.zh: 大學舉辦了一場關於氣候與科技的研討會。

senator.en: The textbook explains the role of a senator in government.
senator.zh: 課本說明參議員在政府中的角色。

send.en: Please send the completed file to your teacher by Friday.
send.zh: 請在星期五前把完成的檔案寄給老師。

senior.en: A senior student helped guide new students around campus.
senior.zh: 一名高年級學生協助帶新生參觀校園。

sensation.en: The cold wind created a sharp sensation on my face.
sensation.zh: 冷風讓我的臉產生明顯的感覺。

sense.en: The explanation makes more sense after seeing the diagram.
sense.zh: 看過圖示後，這個解釋就更容易理解。

sensible.en: Choosing a realistic schedule is a sensible study strategy.
sensible.zh: 安排實際可行的時間表是合理的讀書策略。

sensitive.en: This instrument is sensitive to small changes in temperature.
sensitive.zh: 這個儀器對微小的溫度變化很敏感。

sensitivity.en: The sensor's sensitivity allows it to detect tiny movements.
sensitivity.zh: 感應器的靈敏度讓它能偵測微小移動。

sensor.en: A temperature sensor records changes inside the greenhouse every minute.
sensor.zh: 溫度感測器每分鐘記錄溫室內的變化。

sentence.en: Write one sentence using each of the new vocabulary words.
sentence.zh: 請用每個新單字各寫一句話。

sentiment.en: Public sentiment changed after new evidence became available.
sentiment.zh: 新證據出現後，民意有所改變。

sentimental.en: The old photograph has sentimental value because it belonged to my grandmother.
sentimental.zh: 這張老照片因屬於祖母而具有情感價值。

separate.en: Please separate the paper from the plastic before recycling.
separate.zh: 回收前請把紙類和塑膠分開。

separation.en: The glass wall creates a clear separation between the two study areas.
separation.zh: 玻璃牆在兩個學習區之間形成清楚分隔。

sequence.en: Put the events in the correct sequence before answering the question.
sequence.zh: 回答問題前，先把事件按正確順序排列。

serene.en: The lake looked serene in the early morning light.
serene.zh: 清晨的光線下，湖面看起來十分寧靜。

sergeant.en: The novel includes a sergeant who trains new recruits.
sergeant.zh: 小說中有一名負責訓練新人的中士。

serial.en: The magazine published the story as a monthly serial.
serial.zh: 雜誌把這個故事以每月連載形式刊登。

series.en: The teacher showed a series of images to explain the process.
series.zh: 老師展示一系列圖片來說明這個過程。

serious.en: Air pollution is a serious problem in many large cities.
serious.zh: 空氣污染是許多大城市的嚴重問題。

sermon.en: The history class analyzed a sermon from the nineteenth century.
sermon.zh: 歷史課分析了一篇十九世紀的講道文。

servant.en: The historical novel describes the life of a palace servant.
servant.zh: 這本歷史小說描述一名宮廷僕人的生活。

serve.en: This chart can serve as a useful summary of the results.
serve.zh: 這張圖表可以作為結果的實用摘要。

server.en: The website became slow because the server was overloaded.
server.zh: 網站因伺服器負載過高而變慢。

service.en: The library provides an online service for renewing borrowed books.
service.zh: 圖書館提供線上續借服務。

serving.en: One serving of the soup was enough for lunch.
serving.zh: 一份湯就足夠當作午餐。

session.en: The study session lasted about an hour after school.
session.zh: 放學後的讀書時間大約持續了一小時。

set.en: The teacher set a clear deadline for the final project.
set.zh: 老師為期末專題設定了明確期限。

setback.en: The delay was a setback, but the team adjusted quickly.
setback.zh: 延誤是一項挫折，但團隊很快做出調整。

setting.en: The mountain village provides the setting for the novel.
setting.zh: 這座山村是小說的故事背景。

settle.en: The two groups met to settle their disagreement through discussion.
settle.zh: 兩組人透過討論見面解決彼此的歧見。

settlement.en: The ancient settlement grew beside a river that provided fresh water.
settlement.zh: 這個古代聚落在能提供淡水的河流旁發展。

settler.en: The diary describes a settler building a small farm near the coast.
settler.zh: 日記描述一名移民在海岸附近建立小農場。

several.en: Several students volunteered to help with the school event.
several.zh: 有幾位學生自願協助學校活動。

severe.en: Severe weather forced the outdoor event to move indoors.
severe.zh: 惡劣天候迫使戶外活動移到室內。

sew.en: She learned to sew a simple cloth bag in class.
sew.zh: 她在課堂上學會縫製一個簡單布袋。

shabby.en: The old classroom looked shabby before it was renovated.
shabby.zh: 整修前，那間舊教室看起來相當破舊。

shade.en: We sat in the shade during the warm afternoon.
shade.zh: 溫暖的午後，我們坐在陰涼處。

shadow.en: The tree cast a long shadow across the playground.
shadow.zh: 那棵樹在操場上投下長長的影子。

shady.en: The students rested in a shady area beside the trail.
shady.zh: 學生在步道旁一處陰涼的地方休息。

shake.en: Please shake the bottle gently before the science demonstration.
shake.zh: 科學示範前請輕輕搖動瓶子。

shall.en: We shall meet again after everyone finishes the assignment.
shall.zh: 等大家完成作業後，我們會再見面。

shallow.en: The stream is shallow enough to see the stones below.
shallow.zh: 這條小溪很淺，可以看見底下的石頭。

shame.en: He felt shame after realizing that he had blamed the wrong person.
shame.zh: 他發現自己錯怪別人後感到羞愧。

shameful.en: The article describes the unfair treatment as a shameful chapter in history.
shameful.zh: 文章把那段不公平待遇形容為歷史上可恥的一頁。

shampoo.en: The travel bag contained a small bottle of shampoo.
shampoo.zh: 旅行袋裡有一小瓶洗髮精。

shape.en: The clouds changed shape as the wind moved across the sky.
shape.zh: 風吹過天空時，雲朵不斷改變形狀。

share.en: Students should share useful ideas during group discussions.
share.zh: 學生應在小組討論中分享有用想法。

shareholder.en: Each shareholder received a copy of the annual report.
shareholder.zh: 每位股東都收到一份年度報告。

shark.en: The documentary explains how a shark senses movement in water.
shark.zh: 紀錄片說明鯊魚如何感知水中的動靜。

sharp.en: The mountain path makes a sharp turn near the bridge.
sharp.zh: 山路在橋附近有一個急轉彎。

sharpen.en: Reading different viewpoints can sharpen your critical thinking skills.
sharpen.zh: 閱讀不同觀點可以提升你的批判思考能力。

shatter.en: The unexpected result may shatter our original assumption about the experiment.
shatter.zh: 出乎意料的結果可能打破我們對實驗原本的假設。

she.en: She presented the group's findings clearly to the whole class.
she.zh: 她向全班清楚說明小組的研究結果。

shed.en: The tools were stored in a small shed behind the garden.
shed.zh: 工具被放在花園後方的小棚子裡。

sheep.en: A flock of sheep moved slowly across the hillside.
sheep.zh: 一群綿羊慢慢走過山坡。

sheer.en: The sheer size of the building surprised the visitors.
sheer.zh: 建築物巨大的規模讓訪客感到驚訝。

sheet.en: Write your answers on the separate sheet provided by the teacher.
sheet.zh: 請把答案寫在老師提供的另一張紙上。

shelf.en: The dictionary is on the top shelf beside the window.
shelf.zh: 字典放在窗邊最上層的書架上。

shell.en: The class examined a shell collected from the beach.
shell.zh: 班上觀察了一個從海灘撿來的貝殼。

shelter.en: We waited inside a shelter until the heavy rain stopped.
shelter.zh: 我們在遮蔽處等到大雨停止。

shepherd.en: The story follows a young shepherd living in the mountains.
shepherd.zh: 故事描寫一名住在山區的年輕牧羊人。

sheriff.en: The western novel features a sheriff trying to keep order in town.
sheriff.zh: 這本西部小說描寫一名維持小鎮秩序的警長。

shield.en: Thick clouds can shield the ground from strong sunlight.
shield.zh: 厚重的雲層可以遮擋強烈陽光。

shift.en: There was a clear shift in public opinion after the debate.
shift.zh: 辯論後，大眾意見出現明顯轉變。

shine.en: The stars began to shine after the clouds disappeared.
shine.zh: 雲散去後，星星開始閃耀。

shiny.en: The new metal surface looked shiny under the bright lights.
shiny.zh: 新的金屬表面在強光下看起來很有光澤。

ship.en: The cargo ship entered the harbor early in the morning.

shirt.en: He wore a clean white shirt for the school ceremony.
shirt.zh: 他穿著乾淨的白襯衫參加學校典禮。

shiver.en: The cold wind made everyone shiver while waiting outside.
shiver.zh: 大家在外面等待時被冷風吹得發抖。

shock.en: The sudden announcement came as a shock to the entire class.
shock.zh: 突如其來的公告讓全班都很震驚。

shoe.en: One shoe was left beside the gym entrance after practice.
shoe.zh: 練習後，有一隻鞋被留在體育館入口旁。

shop.en: A small shop near the station sells school supplies.
shop.zh: 車站附近有一家小店販售文具用品。

shopkeeper.en: The shopkeeper helped us find the correct size quickly.
shopkeeper.zh: 店主很快幫我們找到正確尺寸。

shore.en: We walked along the shore and collected interesting stones.
shore.zh: 我們沿著岸邊散步並撿了一些有趣的石頭。

short.en: The teacher gave us a short quiz at the end of class.
short.zh: 老師在下課前給我們一份簡短小考。

shortage.en: The report warns of a possible water shortage during summer.
shortage.zh: 報告警告夏季可能出現缺水問題。

shortcoming.en: Every plan has a shortcoming that should be considered carefully.
shortcoming.zh: 每個計畫都有需要仔細考量的缺點。

shorten.en: The teacher decided to shorten the test by five questions.
shorten.zh: 老師決定把考試減少五題。

shortly.en: The bus arrived shortly after the rain began.
shortly.zh: 下雨後不久，公車就到了。

shorts.en: He wore sports shorts during the afternoon practice session.
shorts.zh: 下午練習時，他穿著運動短褲。

shortsighted.en: Ignoring long-term costs would be a shortsighted decision.
shortsighted.zh: 忽略長期成本會是一個短視的決定。

shoulder.en: She carried the bag over one shoulder on the way home.
shoulder.zh: 她回家路上把包包背在一邊肩膀上。

shout.en: Please do not shout while other groups are presenting.
shout.zh: 其他小組報告時請不要大喊。

shovel.en: A shovel was leaning against the wall near the garden.
shovel.zh: 花園旁的牆邊靠著一把鏟子。

show.en: The graph can show how attendance changed over several months.
show.zh: 這張圖可以顯示出席率在數個月中的變化。

shower.en: A brief shower cooled the air before the afternoon event.
shower.zh: 午後活動前的一場短暫陣雨讓空氣涼了下來。

shred.en: A small shred of paper remained on the classroom floor.
shred.zh: 教室地板上還留著一小片紙屑。

shriek.en: A sudden shriek from a bird startled the hikers.
shriek.zh: 鳥兒突然的一聲尖叫嚇了健行者一跳。

shrimp.en: The biology class observed a shrimp in the aquarium tank.
shrimp.zh: 生物課觀察了水族箱裡的一隻蝦。

shrink.en: Some materials shrink slightly when the temperature becomes very low.
shrink.zh: 有些材料在溫度很低時會稍微收縮。

shrub.en: A flowering shrub grows beside the path to the library.
shrub.zh: 通往圖書館的小徑旁長著一叢開花灌木。

shrug.en: He gave a shrug when nobody knew the correct answer.
shrug.zh: 沒有人知道正確答案時，他聳了聳肩。

shuffle.en: Please shuffle the cards before starting the vocabulary game.
shuffle.zh: 開始單字遊戲前請先洗牌。

shut.en: Please shut the window before leaving the classroom.
shut.zh: 離開教室前請把窗戶關上。

shutter.en: The photographer pressed the shutter just as the bird landed.
shutter.zh: 那隻鳥剛落下時，攝影師按下了快門。

shuttle.en: A free shuttle carries visitors between the station and museum.
shuttle.zh: 免費接駁車往返車站與博物館之間。

shy.en: The shy student gradually became more comfortable speaking in class.
shy.zh: 那位害羞的學生逐漸更自在地在課堂上發言。

sibling.en: Each sibling chose a different book from the library.
sibling.zh: 每位兄弟姊妹都從圖書館選了不同的書。

sick.en: He stayed home because he felt sick in the morning.
sick.zh: 他早上覺得不舒服，所以留在家裡。

side.en: Please write your name on the left side of the page.
side.zh: 請把名字寫在頁面的左側。

sidewalk.en: The city repaired the sidewalk outside the school entrance.
sidewalk.zh: 市府修復了學校入口外的人行道。

sigh.en: She gave a quiet sigh after finishing the difficult test.
sigh.zh: 做完困難的考試後，她輕輕嘆了一口氣。

sight.en: The mountain became a beautiful sight after the clouds cleared.
sight.zh: 雲散後，那座山成為一幅美麗景象。

sightseeing.en: We spent the morning sightseeing in the old part of town.
sightseeing.zh: 我們上午在老城區觀光。

sign.en: The sign clearly explains where visitors should wait.
sign.zh: 這個標誌清楚說明訪客應在哪裡等候。

signal.en: The red signal means that the machine should stop.
signal.zh: 紅色訊號表示機器應停止運作。

signature.en: Please add your signature at the bottom of the form.

significance.en: The teacher explained the historical significance of the discovery.
significance.zh: 老師說明這項發現的歷史意義。

significant.en: The study found a significant difference between the two groups.
significant.zh: 這項研究發現兩組之間有顯著差異。

silence.en: A moment of silence followed the final announcement.
silence.zh: 最後公告後，全場安靜了片刻。

silent.en: The classroom became silent when the presentation began.
silent.zh: 簡報開始時，教室變得安靜。

silk.en: The museum displayed a silk robe from the nineteenth century.
silk.zh: 博物館展示了一件十九世紀的絲質長袍。

silly.en: The silly mistake made everyone laugh during rehearsal.
silly.zh: 彩排時，那個小失誤逗得大家發笑。

silver.en: A silver medal was displayed beside the old team photograph.
silver.zh: 一面銀牌陳列在舊隊照旁。

similar.en: The two solutions are similar, but one is much cheaper.
similar.zh: 這兩個解決方案很相似，但其中一個便宜很多。

similarity.en: The teacher asked us to identify one similarity between the two poems.
similarity.zh: 老師要我們找出兩首詩的一項相似之處。

simple.en: A simple example can make a difficult concept easier to understand.
simple.zh: 簡單例子能讓困難概念更容易理解。

simplicity.en: The simplicity of the design makes the website easy to use.
simplicity.zh: 簡潔的設計讓網站容易使用。

simplify.en: The diagram helps simplify a complicated scientific process.
simplify.zh: 這張圖有助於簡化複雜的科學過程。

simply.en: The teacher simply asked us to explain our reasoning clearly.
simply.zh: 老師只是要求我們清楚說明推理過程。

simultaneous.en: The system recorded simultaneous changes in temperature and pressure.
simultaneous.zh: 系統記錄了溫度與壓力同時發生的變化。

sin.en: The literature class discussed the idea of sin in an old novel.
sin.zh: 文學課討論了一本舊小說中的罪惡概念。

since.en: The school has changed a lot since I first arrived.
since.zh: 自從我剛來時起，學校已經改變很多。

sincere.en: She gave a sincere apology for arriving late to the meeting.
sincere.zh: 她為會議遲到真誠地道歉。

sincerity.en: His sincerity made the apology feel more meaningful.
sincerity.zh: 他的真誠讓這次道歉更有意義。

sing.en: The choir will sing two songs at the school ceremony.
sing.zh: 合唱團會在學校典禮唱兩首歌。

singer.en: The singer thanked the audience after the final song.
singer.zh: 最後一首歌結束後，歌手向觀眾致謝。

single.en: A single mistake can affect the final calculation.
single.zh: 一個小錯誤就可能影響最後計算。

singular.en: The teacher explained when to use a singular noun in English.
singular.zh: 老師說明英文中何時使用單數名詞。

sink.en: The small boat began to sink after taking in water.

sip.en: She took a sip of water before continuing her speech.
sip.zh: 她喝了一小口水後繼續演講。

sir.en: The student politely said sir when addressing the guest speaker.
sir.zh: 學生稱呼來賓講者時禮貌地說先生。

sister.en: My sister borrowed the novel after I finished reading it.
sister.zh: 我讀完小說後，姊姊借去看了。

sit.en: Please sit near the front if you cannot see the screen.
sit.zh: 如果看不清楚螢幕，請坐到前面。

site.en: The new school building site is near the sports field.
site.zh: 新校舍的工地位於運動場附近。

situation.en: The teacher explained how to respond calmly in an emergency situation.
situation.zh: 老師說明在緊急情況下如何冷靜應對。

size.en: The class compared the size of several planets using a model.
size.zh: 班上用模型比較了幾顆行星的大小。

skate.en: They learned to skate at the indoor rink during winter break.
skate.zh: 寒假時，他們在室內冰場學滑冰。

skeleton.en: The biology room contains a model of the human skeleton.
skeleton.zh: 生物教室裡有一具人體骨骼模型。

skeptical.en: Students should remain skeptical of claims that lack clear evidence.
skeptical.zh: 學生應對缺乏明確證據的主張保持懷疑。

sketch.en: She made a quick sketch before starting the final painting.
sketch.zh: 開始正式作畫前，她先畫了一張速寫。

ski.en: The club plans to ski during the winter training trip.
ski.zh: 社團計畫在冬季訓練旅行中滑雪。

skill.en: Reading comprehension is a skill that improves with regular practice.
skill.zh: 閱讀理解是一項會隨規律練習而進步的能力。

skilled.en: A skilled technician repaired the projector before class began.
skilled.zh: 一位熟練的技術人員在上課前修好投影機。

skillful.en: Her skillful explanation made the difficult idea easier to understand.
skillful.zh: 她熟練的解說讓困難的概念更容易理解。

skim.en: Skim the article first to understand its main idea.
skim.zh: 先快速瀏覽文章以了解主要概念。

skip.en: Do not skip the instructions at the top of the page.
skip.zh: 不要略過頁面頂端的說明。

skirt.en: The costume included a long skirt for the stage performance.
skirt.zh: 舞台表演的服裝包含一件長裙。

sky.en: The evening sky turned orange just before sunset.
sky.zh: 日落前，傍晚天空變成橘色。

skyscraper.en: The new skyscraper can be seen from across the river.
skyscraper.zh: 隔著河就能看見那棟新的摩天大樓。

slang.en: The teacher explained that slang is common in casual conversation.
slang.zh: 老師說明俚語在日常對話中很常見。

sleep.en: Enough sleep is important for memory and concentration.
sleep.zh: 充足睡眠對記憶力和專注力很重要。

sleepy.en: He felt sleepy after staying up late to finish homework.
sleepy.zh: 他熬夜完成作業後覺得很想睡。

sleeve.en: A small patch was sewn onto the jacket sleeve.
sleeve.zh: 外套袖子上縫了一個小布章。

slice.en: She placed a slice of apple beside the sandwich.
slice.zh: 她在三明治旁放了一片蘋果。

slide.en: The final slide summarizes the main points of the presentation.
slide.zh: 最後一張投影片整理了簡報重點。

slight.en: There was a slight improvement in the second test score.
slight.zh: 第二次測驗的成績有些微進步。

slip.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor near the entrance.
slip.zh: 入口附近地板濕滑，小心不要滑倒。

slipper.en: One slipper was left beside the bed in the guest room.
slipper.zh: 客房床邊留著一隻拖鞋。

slippery.en: The path becomes slippery after heavy rain, so signs warn visitors.
slippery.zh: 大雨後步道會變滑，因此有標示提醒遊客。

slogan.en: The campaign used a short slogan that students could remember easily.
slogan.zh: 這項活動使用一句學生容易記住的簡短口號。

slope.en: The bicycle path follows a gentle slope toward the river.
slope.zh: 自行車道沿著緩坡通往河邊。

sloppy.en: The teacher asked him to revise the sloppy first draft.
sloppy.zh: 老師要他修改那份草率的初稿。

slot.en: Each group received a ten-minute slot for its presentation.
slot.zh: 每組都分配到十分鐘的報告時段。

slow.en: A slow internet connection delayed the online lesson this morning.
slow.zh: 今天早上網路速度慢，延誤了線上課程。

slum.en: The documentary examines housing conditions in an urban slum.
slum.zh: 紀錄片探討都市貧民區的居住條件。

slump.en: Sales entered a slump after demand dropped during winter.
slump.zh: 冬季需求下降後，銷售陷入低迷。

sly.en: The fox in the story is clever and slightly sly.
sly.zh: 故事中的狐狸聰明又有點狡猾。

small.en: A small change in temperature affected the final result.
small.zh: 溫度的一點小變化影響了最後結果。

smart.en: Using a checklist is a smart way to avoid missing tasks.
smart.zh: 使用檢查表是避免漏掉任務的好方法。

smash.en: A falling branch could smash the window during a strong storm.
smash.zh: 強風暴中掉落的樹枝可能砸破窗戶。

smell.en: The smell of fresh bread filled the bakery early in the morning.
smell.zh: 清晨時，新鮮麵包的香味充滿整間麵包店。

smile.en: Her friendly smile made the new student feel more welcome.
smile.zh: 她友善的微笑讓新同學感到更受歡迎。

smog.en: Heavy smog reduced visibility across the city that morning.
smog.zh: 那天早上濃霧霾使城市能見度降低。

smoke.en: Smoke from a distant fire drifted across the valley.
smoke.zh: 遠處火災的煙飄過山谷。

smooth.en: The polished stone has a smooth surface that reflects light.
smooth.zh: 拋光石頭表面光滑，會反射光線。

snack.en: She packed a healthy snack for the afternoon study session.
snack.zh: 她為下午讀書時間準備了一份健康點心。

snail.en: A small snail moved slowly across the garden path.
snail.zh: 一隻小蝸牛慢慢爬過花園小徑。

snake.en: The biology book explains how a snake senses its surroundings.
snake.zh: 生物課本說明蛇如何感知周遭環境。

snap.en: The photographer waited for the right moment to snap the picture.
snap.zh: 攝影師等到適當時機才拍下照片。

sneak.en: The cat tried to sneak past the open classroom door.
sneak.zh: 那隻貓試著悄悄溜過開著的教室門。

sneaker.en: A wet sneaker was drying beside the locker after practice.
sneaker.zh: 練習後，一隻濕球鞋放在置物櫃旁晾乾。

sneaky.en: The character uses a sneaky trick to avoid doing his chores.
sneaky.zh: 那個角色用狡猾的小把戲逃避做家事。

sneeze.en: A sudden sneeze interrupted the quiet reading period.
sneeze.zh: 突然一聲噴嚏打斷了安靜閱讀時間。

sniff.en: The dog began to sniff around the new backpack.
sniff.zh: 那隻狗開始在新背包周圍聞來聞去。

snore.en: The comedy scene shows a character beginning to snore on the bus.
snore.zh: 喜劇場景中，一名角色在公車上開始打呼。

snow.en: Fresh snow covered the mountain trail overnight.
snow.zh: 新下的雪一夜之間覆蓋了山間步道。

snowy.en: The snowy landscape looked bright under the morning sun.
snowy.zh: 白雪覆蓋的景色在晨光下看起來很明亮。

so.en: The room was noisy, so we moved the discussion outside.
so.zh: 房間太吵，所以我們把討論移到外面。

soak.en: The rain began to soak our bags before we reached shelter.
soak.zh: 我們到達遮蔽處前，雨已開始把背包淋濕。

soap.en: The sink has soap beside it for washing hands.
soap.zh: 洗手台旁放有肥皂供洗手使用。

soar.en: Eagles can soar high above the valley on warm air currents.
soar.zh: 老鷹可以乘著暖氣流高高翱翔在山谷上空。

soccer.en: The students played soccer on the field after class.
soccer.zh: 學生下課後在球場踢足球。

sociable.en: Her sociable nature helped new classmates feel welcome.
sociable.zh: 她合群的個性讓新同學感到受到歡迎。

social.en: Social media can spread information very quickly.
social.zh: 社群媒體可以非常快速地傳播資訊。

socialism.en: The history course introduces socialism as one major political idea.
socialism.zh: 歷史課把社會主義介紹為一種重要政治思想。

socialist.en: The textbook compares a socialist party with other historical movements.
socialist.zh: 課本比較一個社會主義政黨與其他歷史運動。

socialize.en: The club gives students a chance to socialize after school.
socialize.zh: 社團讓學生放學後有機會與人互動。

society.en: Technology has changed many aspects of modern society.
society.zh: 科技改變了現代社會的許多面向。

sociology.en: Sociology examines how people and groups interact in society.
sociology.zh: 社會學研究人們與群體如何在社會中互動。

sock.en: One clean sock was missing from the laundry basket.
sock.zh: 洗衣籃裡少了一隻乾淨襪子。

socket.en: The lamp would not work because the socket was loose.
socket.zh: 檯燈無法使用，因為插座鬆了。

soda.en: The café offers juice, tea, and soda with lunch.
soda.zh: 這間咖啡館午餐時供應果汁、茶和汽水。

sofa.en: We moved the sofa closer to the living room window.
sofa.zh: 我們把沙發移得更靠近客廳窗戶。

soft.en: The blanket felt soft and warm on the cold night.
soft.zh: 寒冷的夜裡，那條毯子摸起來柔軟又溫暖。

soften.en: A kind explanation can soften criticism during a difficult conversation.
soften.zh: 在困難的對話中，友善的說明可以讓批評較不尖銳。

software.en: The school installed new software on every library computer.
software.zh: 學校在每台圖書館電腦上安裝了新軟體。

soil.en: Healthy soil helps vegetables grow well in the school garden.
soil.zh: 健康的土壤有助於校園菜園裡的蔬菜良好生長。

solar.en: The science club built a small solar car for the fair.
solar.zh: 科學社為科展製作了一輛小型太陽能車。

soldier.en: The museum displays letters written by a soldier during wartime.
soldier.zh: 博物館展示一名士兵在戰時寫下的信件。

sole.en: Cost should not be the sole reason for choosing a solution.
sole.zh: 成本不應該是選擇解決方案的唯一理由。

solemn.en: The ceremony became solemn when everyone observed a moment of silence.
solemn.zh: 大家默哀時，典禮氣氛變得莊重。

solid.en: The table has a solid wooden frame that feels very sturdy.
solid.zh: 這張桌子有堅固的木製框架，感覺很牢靠。

solidarity.en: Students showed solidarity by helping classmates after the flood.
solidarity.zh: 學生透過協助水災後的同學展現團結。

solitary.en: A solitary tree stood in the middle of the wide field.
solitary.zh: 一棵孤單的樹立在寬廣田野中央。

solitude.en: She enjoyed the solitude of the library before classes began.
solitude.zh: 上課前，她享受圖書館裡的寧靜獨處。

solo.en: He performed a short piano solo at the school concert.
solo.zh: 他在學校音樂會上演奏了一段鋼琴獨奏。

solution.en: The team proposed a practical solution to the traffic problem.
solution.zh: 團隊提出了一個實際的交通問題解決方案。

solve.en: Students worked together to solve the difficult problem.
solve.zh: 學生合作解決這個困難問題。

some.en: Some students prefer studying alone, while others like groups.
some.zh: 有些學生喜歡自己讀書，其他人則喜歡小組學習。

somebody.en: Somebody left a blue notebook on the library table after lunch.
somebody.zh: 午餐後，有人把一本藍色筆記本留在圖書館桌上。

someday.en: She hopes to study marine biology abroad someday.
someday.zh: 她希望有一天能到國外學習海洋生物學。

somehow.en: We somehow finished the project before the final deadline.
somehow.zh: 我們不知怎地在最後期限前完成了專題。

someone.en: Someone left a notebook on the desk after class.
someone.zh: 下課後有人把筆記本留在桌上。

something.en: There is something unusual about the final result.
something.zh: 最後結果有一些不尋常的地方。

sometime.en: We should visit the new science museum sometime this month.
sometime.zh: 這個月我們找個時間去新科學博物館吧。

sometimes.en: Students sometimes need extra time to understand difficult ideas.
sometimes.zh: 學生有時需要更多時間理解困難觀念。

somewhat.en: The second chapter was somewhat harder than the first one.
somewhat.zh: 第二章比第一章稍微難一些。

somewhere.en: I left my notebook somewhere near the reading area.
somewhere.zh: 我把筆記本忘在閱讀區附近的某個地方。

son.en: The farmer taught his son how to care for the orchard.
son.zh: 農夫教兒子如何照顧果園。

song.en: The choir practiced the same song several times after school.
song.zh: 合唱團放學後把同一首歌練習了好幾次。

soon.en: The rain stopped, and the sky soon became bright again.
soon.zh: 雨停後，天空很快又亮了起來。

soothe.en: Quiet music can soothe nervous students before a performance.
soothe.zh: 安靜的音樂可以讓表演前緊張的學生平靜下來。

sophisticated.en: The sophisticated model can analyze several variables at the same time.
sophisticated.zh: 這個精密模型可以同時分析數個變數。

sophomore.en: As a sophomore, she joined the school's debate team.
sophomore.zh: 高二時，她加入了學校辯論隊。

sore.en: His shoulders felt sore after carrying books all afternoon.
sore.zh: 搬了一下午的書後，他的肩膀感到痠痛。

sorrow.en: The novel explores sorrow after a family leaves its hometown.
sorrow.zh: 這本小說探討一個家庭離開故鄉後的悲傷。

sorrowful.en: The final scene has a sorrowful mood but ends with hope.
sorrowful.zh: 最後一幕氣氛哀傷，但以希望作結。

sorry.en: She said sorry after realizing that her comment was unfair.
sorry.zh: 她發現自己的話不公平後說了對不起。

sort.en: Please sort the worksheets by class before placing them away.
sort.zh: 收起講義前，請先按照班級分類。

soul.en: The poem uses the word soul to express a person's inner life.
soul.zh: 這首詩用 soul 一詞表達一個人的內在世界。

sound.en: A strange sound came from the old air conditioner.
sound.zh: 舊冷氣機傳出一個奇怪的聲音。

soup.en: The cafeteria served warm soup on the rainy afternoon.
soup.zh: 下雨的下午，學校餐廳供應熱湯。

sour.en: The lemon tasted sour even after we added some water.
sour.zh: 即使加了些水，檸檬喝起來仍然很酸。

source.en: Always check the source before using information in a report.
source.zh: 在報告中使用資訊前，一定要先檢查來源。

south.en: The train travels south along the coast before turning inland.
south.zh: 火車沿海岸向南行駛，之後才轉往內陸。

southern.en: The southern part of the island receives warmer weather in winter.
southern.zh: 這座島的南部在冬季天氣較溫暖。

souvenir.en: She bought a small souvenir from the museum gift shop.
souvenir.zh: 她在博物館禮品店買了一個小紀念品。

sovereign.en: The textbook explains how a sovereign state manages its own affairs.
sovereign.zh: 課本說明主權國家如何管理自己的事務。

sovereignty.en: The lesson introduces sovereignty as an important idea in international relations.
sovereignty.zh: 課堂把主權介紹為國際關係中的重要概念。

sow.en: Farmers sow seeds in spring when the soil becomes warmer.
sow.zh: 春天土壤變暖時，農民會播種。

soybean.en: The farm grows soybean plants beside fields of corn.
soybean.zh: 這座農場在玉米田旁種植大豆。

space.en: The new library has more space for quiet study.
space.zh: 新圖書館有更多安靜讀書的空間。

spacecraft.en: The spacecraft sent new images back to scientists on Earth.
spacecraft.zh: 太空船把新的影像傳回地球給科學家。

spaceship.en: The story follows a spaceship traveling toward a distant planet.
spaceship.zh: 故事描述一艘太空船前往遙遠行星。

spacious.en: The new library is spacious enough for several study areas.
spacious.zh: 新圖書館很寬敞，可以容納好幾個學習區。

spade.en: The gardener used a spade to turn the soil carefully.

spaghetti.en: The cafeteria served spaghetti with vegetables for lunch today.
spaghetti.zh: 學校餐廳今天午餐供應蔬菜義大利麵。

span.en: The bridge has a long span across the wide river.
span.zh: 這座橋有一段很長的跨度跨越寬廣河面。

spare.en: I keep a spare notebook in my backpack for emergencies.
spare.zh: 我在背包裡放一本備用筆記本以防萬一。

spark.en: One interesting question can spark a lively classroom discussion.
spark.zh: 一個有趣的問題可以引發熱烈的課堂討論。

sparkle.en: Raindrops began to sparkle when the sun came out.
sparkle.zh: 太陽出來時，雨滴開始閃閃發亮。

sparrow.en: A sparrow built a nest beneath the school roof.
sparrow.zh: 一隻麻雀在校舍屋簷下築巢。

speak.en: Please speak slowly so everyone can understand you.
speak.zh: 請說慢一點，讓每個人都能理解。

speaker.en: The guest speaker answered questions after the science lecture.
speaker.zh: 科學演講後，受邀講者回答了問題。

special.en: The school organized a special event for graduating students.
special.zh: 學校為畢業生舉辦了一場特別活動。

specialist.en: The museum invited a specialist to examine the ancient painting.
specialist.zh: 博物館邀請一位專家檢查那幅古畫。

specialize.en: Some engineers specialize in designing energy-efficient buildings.
specialize.zh: 有些工程師專門設計節能建築。

specialty.en: Fresh bread is the bakery's most popular specialty.
specialty.zh: 新鮮麵包是這間麵包店最受歡迎的招牌。

species.en: The island is home to several rare species of birds.
species.zh: 這座島是數種稀有鳥類的棲地。

specific.en: Please give a specific example to support your main point.
specific.zh: 請舉一個具體例子來支持你的主要觀點。

specify.en: Please specify which source you used for each important claim.
specify.zh: 請註明每項重要主張使用了哪個來源。

specimen.en: The scientist placed the specimen under a microscope for study.
specimen.zh: 科學家把標本放到顯微鏡下研究。

spectacle.en: The fireworks created a colorful spectacle above the river.
spectacle.zh: 煙火在河面上方形成繽紛壯觀的景象。

spectacular.en: We enjoyed a spectacular view from the mountain lookout.
spectacular.zh: 我們從山上的觀景台欣賞到壯麗景色。

spectator.en: Every spectator remained seated until the performance ended.
spectator.zh: 每位觀眾都坐到表演結束為止。

spectrum.en: The chart shows a broad spectrum of student opinions.
spectrum.zh: 這張圖表呈現廣泛的學生意見。

speculate.en: Researchers will not speculate until they have enough evidence.
speculate.zh: 研究人員在有足夠證據前不會任意推測。

speech.en: She practiced her speech several times before the competition.
speech.zh: 比賽前她把演講練習了好幾次。

speed.en: The train reduced its speed as it entered the station.
speed.zh: 火車進站時降低了速度。

spell.en: Can you spell your name clearly for the registration form?
spell.zh: 你可以把名字清楚拼出來填在報名表上嗎？

spelling.en: She checked the spelling of every difficult word before submitting.
spelling.zh: 她提交前檢查了每個難字的拼字。

spend.en: I spend about an hour reviewing English every evening.
spend.zh: 我每天晚上大約花一小時複習英文。

sphere.en: The teacher used a sphere to explain three-dimensional shapes.
sphere.zh: 老師用球體說明三維形狀。

spice.en: This spice gives the soup a warm and distinctive flavor.
spice.zh: 這種香料讓湯帶有溫暖而獨特的風味。

spicy.en: The noodles were spicy, so he ate them slowly.
spicy.zh: 這碗麵很辣，所以他慢慢吃。

spider.en: A small spider built a web beside the window.
spider.zh: 一隻小蜘蛛在窗邊結了網。

spill.en: Be careful not to spill water on the library books.
spill.zh: 小心不要把水灑到圖書館的書上。

spin.en: The wheels spin faster when the bicycle moves downhill.
spin.zh: 自行車下坡時輪子轉得更快。

spinach.en: The school lunch included spinach with rice and vegetables.
spinach.zh: 學校午餐有菠菜、米飯和蔬菜。

spine.en: The model shows how the spine supports the upper body.
spine.zh: 模型顯示脊椎如何支撐上半身。

spiral.en: The staircase forms a spiral around the central column.
spiral.zh: 樓梯繞著中央柱形成螺旋。

spirit.en: The team showed strong spirit after falling behind early.
spirit.zh: 球隊在早早落後後仍展現強烈鬥志。

spiritual.en: The museum explains the spiritual meaning of the ancient symbol.
spiritual.zh: 博物館說明這個古老符號的精神意涵。

spit.en: The sign asks visitors not to spit on the ground.
spit.zh: 標示提醒訪客不要隨地吐痰。

spite.en: In spite of the rain, the event continued indoors.
spite.zh: 儘管下雨，活動仍在室內繼續。

splash.en: A passing bus made water splash across the roadside.
splash.zh: 一輛經過的公車讓積水濺到路邊。

splendid.en: The class gave a splendid performance at the school festival.
splendid.zh: 班級在校慶上帶來精彩的演出。

splendor.en: Visitors admired the splendor of the restored historic hall.
splendor.zh: 遊客欣賞修復後歷史大廳的壯麗。

split.en: The class decided to split into four smaller discussion groups.
split.zh: 班上決定分成四個較小的討論組。

spoil.en: Leaving food in the heat can spoil it quickly.
spoil.zh: 把食物放在高溫處可能很快就會壞掉。

spokesman.en: A company spokesman answered questions at the press conference.
spokesman.zh: 公司發言人在記者會上回答問題。

spokesperson.en: The school spokesperson announced the schedule change this morning.
spokesperson.zh: 校方發言人今天早上宣布了時程變更。

spokeswoman.en: The organization spokeswoman explained the new volunteer program.
spokeswoman.zh: 該組織女發言人說明了新的志工計畫。

sponge.en: She used a sponge to wipe the classroom table clean.
sponge.zh: 她用海綿把教室桌面擦乾淨。

sponsor.en: A local company agreed to sponsor the school science fair.
sponsor.zh: 一家當地公司同意贊助學校科展。

sponsorship.en: The event received sponsorship from several community organizations.
sponsorship.zh: 這項活動獲得數個社區組織的贊助。

spontaneous.en: A spontaneous discussion began after the class watched the short film.
spontaneous.zh: 全班看完短片後，自發展開了一場討論。

spoon.en: She used a spoon to stir the soup before lunch.
spoon.zh: 午餐前，她用湯匙攪拌湯。

sport.en: Swimming is the sport he enjoys most during summer.
sport.zh: 游泳是他夏天最喜歡的運動。

sportsman.en: The biography describes him as a dedicated sportsman and coach.
sportsman.zh: 這本傳記把他描述為投入的運動員與教練。

sportsmanship.en: Good sportsmanship matters even when a team loses a close game.
sportsmanship.zh: 即使球隊在激烈比賽中落敗，良好運動精神仍很重要。

sportswoman.en: The article profiles a sportswoman who represented her school nationally.
sportswoman.zh: 文章介紹一位代表學校參加全國賽的女運動員。

spot.en: We found a quiet spot beside the window for reading.
spot.zh: 我們在窗邊找到一個安靜的閱讀位置。

spotlight.en: The student stepped into the spotlight before beginning her speech.
spotlight.zh: 那位學生走到聚光燈下後開始演講。

spouse.en: The form includes space for a spouse's contact information.
spouse.zh: 這張表格有填寫配偶聯絡資料的欄位。

spray.en: Ocean waves sent a fine spray over the harbor wall.
spray.zh: 海浪把細小水霧濺過港口堤牆。

spread.en: Clear communication can spread useful information quickly through a school.
spread.zh: 清楚溝通可以讓有用資訊迅速傳遍校園。

spring.en: The garden becomes colorful when spring arrives each year.
spring.zh: 每年春天到來時，花園就變得色彩繽紛。

sprinkle.en: The baker began to sprinkle sugar over the finished bread.
sprinkle.zh: 麵包師開始在完成的麵包上灑糖。

spur.en: The encouraging feedback may spur students to keep improving.
spur.zh: 鼓勵性的回饋可能促使學生持續進步。

spy.en: The novel follows a spy trying to uncover hidden information.
spy.zh: 這本小說描寫一名間諜試圖揭開隱藏資訊。

squad.en: The rescue squad arrived quickly after the emergency call.
squad.zh: 救援小隊在接到緊急通報後很快抵達。

square.en: Draw a square around the correct answer on the worksheet.
square.zh: 在學習單的正確答案外畫一個正方形。

squash.en: The cafeteria served roasted squash with lunch today.
squash.zh: 學校餐廳今天午餐供應烤南瓜。

squat.en: The coach demonstrated a proper squat during fitness class.
squat.zh: 教練在體能課示範了正確的深蹲動作。

squeeze.en: Please squeeze the wet cloth gently before hanging it up.
squeeze.zh: 掛起濕布前請輕輕擰乾。

squirrel.en: A squirrel ran across the path and climbed a tree.
squirrel.zh: 一隻松鼠跑過小徑並爬上樹。

stability.en: The wide base gives the structure greater stability in wind.
stability.zh: 寬大的底座讓結構在風中更加穩定。

stabilize.en: Engineers added supports to stabilize the temporary platform.
stabilize.zh: 工程師加裝支架來穩定臨時平台。

stable.en: The temperature remained stable throughout the entire experiment.
stable.zh: 整個實驗期間，溫度都維持穩定。

stack.en: Please place each stack of books beside the shelf.
stack.zh: 請把每疊書放在書架旁。

stadium.en: Thousands of fans entered the stadium before the game began.
stadium.zh: 比賽開始前，數千名球迷進入體育場。

staff.en: Library staff helped students find the reference materials.
staff.zh: 圖書館工作人員協助學生找到參考資料。

stage.en: The actors waited quietly behind the stage before performing.
stage.zh: 演員表演前安靜地在舞台後等待。

stagger.en: The school will stagger lunch times to reduce crowding.
stagger.zh: 學校會錯開午餐時間以減少擁擠。

stain.en: A small ink stain remained on the corner of the page.
stain.zh: 頁面角落留下了一小塊墨水污漬。

stair.en: One stair near the entrance was marked for repair.
stair.zh: 入口附近有一階樓梯被標記等待維修。

stake.en: Everyone understood what was at stake before the final vote.
stake.zh: 最後表決前，每個人都了解事情的重要性。

stale.en: The bread became stale after being left uncovered overnight.
stale.zh: 麵包整晚沒有覆蓋，隔天變得不新鮮。

stall.en: A fruit stall opened near the station every morning.
stall.zh: 每天早上車站附近都會有一個水果攤。

stamp.en: She placed a stamp on the envelope before mailing it.
stamp.zh: 她寄信前在信封上貼了一張郵票。

stance.en: The article explains the committee's stance on the proposal.
stance.zh: 文章說明委員會對這項提案的立場。

stand.en: Please stand behind the line until the bus arrives.
stand.zh: 公車到站前請站在線後方。

standard.en: The school follows a standard procedure for laboratory safety checks.
standard.zh: 學校遵循標準程序進行實驗室安全檢查。

staple.en: Rice is a staple food in many parts of Asia.
staple.zh: 米飯是亞洲許多地區的主食。

star.en: A bright star appeared above the mountain after sunset.
star.zh: 日落後，一顆明亮的星星出現在山上方。

stare.en: It is impolite to stare at people for a long time.
stare.zh: 長時間盯著別人看是不禮貌的。

start.en: Please start the experiment only after reading the instructions.
start.zh: 請在看完說明後才開始實驗。

startle.en: The sudden bell may startle anyone standing near the speaker.
startle.zh: 突然的鈴聲可能會嚇到站在喇叭附近的人。

state.en: The report describes the current state of the local environment.
state.zh: 這份報告描述當地環境目前的狀況。

statement.en: The statement is supported by evidence from several studies.
statement.zh: 這項陳述有多項研究證據支持。

statesman.en: The biography describes the statesman as an influential public figure.
statesman.zh: 這本傳記把那位政治家描述為有影響力的公眾人物。

station.en: We met outside the station before taking the train.
station.zh: 我們搭火車前在車站外碰面。

stationary.en: The bicycle remained stationary while the rider adjusted the seat.
stationary.zh: 騎士調整座椅時，自行車保持靜止。

stationery.en: The school store sells notebooks and other stationery supplies.
stationery.zh: 學校商店販售筆記本和其他文具用品。

statistic.en: One statistic alone cannot explain the whole social issue.
statistic.zh: 單一統計數字無法解釋整個社會議題。

statistical.en: The report includes statistical evidence from several recent surveys.
statistical.zh: 報告包含數份近期調查的統計證據。

statue.en: A stone statue stands in the center of the garden.
statue.zh: 花園中央矗立著一座石雕像。

stature.en: The scientist gained international stature through decades of research.
stature.zh: 這位科學家經過數十年研究獲得國際聲望。

status.en: You can check the application status on the school website.
status.zh: 你可以在學校網站查詢申請狀態。

statute.en: The class examined an old statute during the law lesson.
statute.zh: 班上在法律課中研究了一條舊法規。

stay.en: We decided to stay indoors because of the heavy rain.
stay.zh: 因為大雨，我們決定待在室內。

steady.en: She made steady progress by practicing a little every day.
steady.zh: 她每天練習一點，因此穩定進步。

steak.en: The restaurant menu lists steak with several side dishes.
steak.zh: 餐廳菜單列有牛排和幾種配菜。

steal.en: The story shows why it is wrong to steal someone else's property.
steal.zh: 這個故事說明偷竊他人財物是不對的。

steam.en: Steam rose from the hot soup on the table.

steel.en: The bridge uses steel beams to support its main structure.
steel.zh: 這座橋使用鋼樑支撐主要結構。

steep.en: The trail becomes steep near the top of the hill.
steep.zh: 步道接近山頂時變得陡峭。

steer.en: The guide helped steer the discussion back to the main topic.
steer.zh: 主持人協助把討論帶回主要議題。

stem.en: The flower's stem bent slightly in the strong wind.
stem.zh: 花莖在強風中微微彎曲。

step.en: Follow each step carefully to avoid making mistakes.
step.zh: 請仔細按照每個步驟，以避免犯錯。

stepchild.en: The novel follows a stepchild adjusting to a new household.
stepchild.zh: 小說描寫一名繼子女適應新家庭的過程。

stepfather.en: Her stepfather attended the school concert with the family.
stepfather.zh: 她的繼父和家人一起參加學校音樂會。

stepmother.en: The character's stepmother encourages her to continue studying.
stepmother.zh: 故事中的繼母鼓勵她繼續讀書。

stereo.en: The old stereo still works well in the music room.
stereo.zh: 音樂教室裡的舊音響仍然運作良好。

stereotype.en: The lesson asks students to question a common stereotype.
stereotype.zh: 這堂課要求學生質疑一個常見刻板印象。

stew.en: The cafeteria served vegetable stew on the cold afternoon.
stew.zh: 寒冷的午後，學校餐廳供應蔬菜燉湯。

stick.en: A small stick blocked the wheel of the cart.
stick.zh: 一根小木棍卡住了推車的輪子。

sticky.en: The table felt sticky after the juice was spilled.
sticky.zh: 果汁灑出後，桌面摸起來黏黏的。

stiff.en: The new shoes felt stiff during the first few days.
stiff.zh: 新鞋前幾天穿起來有些僵硬。

still.en: The room was still quiet even after the class ended.
still.zh: 即使下課後，房間仍然很安靜。

stimulate.en: Good questions can stimulate deeper thinking during class discussions.
stimulate.zh: 好的問題可以在課堂討論中激發更深入的思考。

stimulation.en: The activity provides mental stimulation through puzzles and discussion.
stimulation.zh: 這項活動透過謎題與討論提供腦力刺激。

stimulus.en: The bell acted as a stimulus for the experiment response.
stimulus.zh: 鈴聲在實驗中作為引發反應的刺激。

sting.en: A bee sting can cause temporary pain and swelling.
sting.zh: 蜜蜂螫傷可能造成短暫疼痛與腫脹。

stingy.en: The character seems stingy because he refuses to share anything.
stingy.zh: 這個角色因為什麼都不願分享而顯得小氣。

stink.en: The trash began to stink after sitting outside all day.
stink.zh: 垃圾在外面放了一整天後開始發臭。

stir.en: Please stir the soup gently before serving it.

stitch.en: One stitch came loose along the edge of the bag.
stitch.zh: 袋子邊緣有一針線鬆開了。

stock.en: The store keeps extra stock in a room behind the counter.
stock.zh: 商店把額外庫存放在櫃台後方的房間。

stocking.en: A red stocking hung beside the classroom holiday display.
stocking.zh: 教室節慶布置旁掛著一隻紅色長襪。

stomach.en: The diagram shows where the stomach is located in the body.
stomach.zh: 圖表顯示胃在身體中的位置。

stomachache.en: He told the teacher he had a stomachache during class.
stomachache.zh: 他上課時告訴老師自己肚子痛。

stone.en: A smooth stone lay beside the river path.
stone.zh: 河邊小徑旁有一顆光滑的石頭。

stool.en: A wooden stool stood beside the art room table.
stool.zh: 美術教室桌旁放著一張木凳。

stop.en: The bus will stop beside the library after school.
stop.zh: 放學後，公車會停在圖書館旁。

storage.en: The school added more storage space for sports equipment.
storage.zh: 學校增加了更多運動器材的收納空間。

store.en: The small store near school sells notebooks and snacks.
store.zh: 學校附近的小店販售筆記本和點心。

storm.en: The storm passed overnight without damaging the school buildings.
storm.zh: 暴風雨在夜間通過，沒有損壞校舍。

stormy.en: The ferry was delayed because the sea became stormy.
stormy.zh: 海況變得風浪很大，因此渡輪延誤。

story.en: The story shows how one decision can change a person's life.
story.zh: 這個故事顯示一個決定如何改變一個人的人生。

stove.en: A small stove warmed the cabin during the winter trip.
stove.zh: 冬季旅行時，一座小火爐讓小屋保持溫暖。

straight.en: Walk straight down the hall and turn left at the stairs.
straight.zh: 沿著走廊直走，到樓梯處左轉。

straighten.en: Please straighten the chairs before the meeting begins.
straighten.zh: 會議開始前請把椅子排整齊。

straightforward.en: The teacher gave a straightforward explanation of the new rule.
straightforward.zh: 老師對新規則做了簡單明確的說明。

strain.en: The long delay placed extra strain on the project schedule.
strain.zh: 漫長延誤讓專題時程承受更多壓力。

strait.en: The map shows a narrow strait between the two islands.
strait.zh: 地圖顯示兩座島之間有一條狹窄海峽。

strand.en: A single strand of thread hung from the sleeve.

strange.en: We heard a strange noise coming from the empty classroom.
strange.zh: 我們聽到空教室傳來奇怪的聲音。

stranger.en: The traveler asked a stranger for directions near the station.
stranger.zh: 旅客在車站附近向一位陌生人問路。

strap.en: She adjusted the backpack strap before starting the hike.
strap.zh: 她開始健行前調整了背包肩帶。

strategic.en: The team chose a strategic location for the information booth.
strategic.zh: 團隊為服務台選了一個有利的位置。

strategy.en: A clear study strategy can help you use your time better.
strategy.zh: 清楚的讀書策略可以幫助你更有效運用時間。

straw.en: The café provides a paper straw with each cold drink.
straw.zh: 咖啡館為每杯冷飲提供紙吸管。

strawberry.en: She added fresh strawberry slices to her breakfast yogurt.
strawberry.zh: 她把新鮮草莓片加進早餐優格。

stray.en: A stray dog rested beneath a tree near the park.
stray.zh: 一隻流浪狗在公園附近的樹下休息。

stream.en: A clear stream runs beside the mountain trail.
stream.zh: 一條清澈小溪沿著山徑流過。

street.en: The market fills the main street every Saturday morning.
street.zh: 每週六早上，市場會擺滿主要街道。

strength.en: Regular practice helped improve her strength and balance.
strength.zh: 規律練習幫助她提升力量和平衡感。

strengthen.en: Group projects can strengthen communication among classmates.
strengthen.zh: 小組專題可以增進同學之間的溝通。

stress.en: A clear schedule can reduce stress before major exams.
stress.zh: 清楚的時程可以減少大考前的壓力。

stretch.en: We took a short break to stretch after studying for an hour.
stretch.zh: 讀了一小時後，我們短暫休息伸展一下。

strict.en: The laboratory has strict rules about keeping work areas clean.
strict.zh: 實驗室對維持工作區整潔有嚴格規定。

stride.en: She crossed the stage with a confident stride.
stride.zh: 她以自信的步伐走過舞台。

strike.en: Workers may strike when negotiations fail to reach an agreement.
strike.zh: 談判無法達成協議時，勞工可能罷工。

striking.en: The painting has a striking contrast between light and shadow.
striking.zh: 這幅畫的明暗對比十分鮮明。

string.en: He tied the package with a piece of string.
string.zh: 他用一條細繩把包裹綁好。

strip.en: A narrow strip of land separates the road from the river.
strip.zh: 一條狹長土地把道路和河流隔開。

stripe.en: Each team shirt has a blue stripe across the front.
stripe.zh: 每件隊服正面都有一道藍色條紋。

strive.en: Students should strive to improve rather than compare themselves with others.
strive.zh: 學生應努力進步，而不是一直和別人比較。

stroll.en: We took a quiet stroll around the lake after lunch.
stroll.zh: 午餐後，我們悠閒地繞湖散步。

strong.en: A strong argument needs clear reasons and reliable evidence.
strong.zh: 有力的論點需要清楚理由和可靠證據。

structural.en: Engineers found a structural problem in the old bridge.
structural.zh: 工程師在舊橋上發現結構問題。

structure.en: The essay has a clear structure with an introduction and conclusion.
structure.zh: 這篇文章有清楚的結構，包含前言與結論。

struggle.en: Many students struggle at first when learning a new skill.
struggle.zh: 許多學生剛開始學新技能時會感到吃力。

stubborn.en: The stain was stubborn and remained after several washes.
stubborn.zh: 那個污漬很頑固，洗了好幾次仍留著。

student.en: Each student must complete the survey before Friday.
student.zh: 每位學生都必須在星期五前完成問卷。

studio.en: The art club meets in a bright studio after school.
studio.zh: 美術社放學後在一間明亮的工作室聚會。

study.en: Regular study habits can improve performance over time.
study.zh: 規律的讀書習慣能逐漸提升表現。

stuff.en: Please put your stuff in the locker before class begins.
stuff.zh: 上課前請把你的東西放進置物櫃。

stumble.en: He began to stumble over difficult words during the speech.
stumble.zh: 演講時，他開始在較難的字上說得不順。

sturdy.en: The new desk is sturdy enough to hold several heavy books.
sturdy.zh: 新書桌很堅固，可以放好幾本厚重的書。

style.en: Her writing style became clearer after several rounds of revision.
style.zh: 經過多次修改後，她的寫作風格變得更清楚。

subject.en: Math is the subject I find most challenging this year.
subject.zh: 數學是我今年覺得最有挑戰的科目。

subjective.en: The review is partly subjective because it reflects personal taste.
subjective.zh: 這篇評論有部分主觀，因為反映個人喜好。

submarine.en: The museum displays a model submarine in its naval history section.
submarine.zh: 博物館的海軍歷史展區展示了一艘潛水艇模型。

submit.en: Please submit your assignment before noon on Friday.
submit.zh: 請在星期五中午以前繳交作業。

subordinate.en: The report treats design details as subordinate to safety requirements.
subordinate.zh: 這份報告把設計細節放在安全要求之後。

subscribe.en: Students can subscribe to the school newsletter by email.
subscribe.zh: 學生可以透過電子郵件訂閱校刊。

subscription.en: The library renewed its digital magazine subscription this month.
subscription.zh: 圖書館這個月續訂了數位雜誌。

subsequent.en: Subsequent tests confirmed the pattern found in the first experiment.
subsequent.zh: 後續測試確認了第一次實驗中發現的模式。

subsidize.en: The city may subsidize public transportation for certain community programs.
subsidize.zh: 市政府可能補助部分社區計畫的公共交通費用。

subsidy.en: The government subsidy helped the community replace old equipment.
subsidy.zh: 政府補助幫助社區汰換老舊設備。

substance.en: The science class identified an unknown substance by observing its properties.
substance.zh: 自然科學課透過觀察性質來辨識一種未知物質。

substantial.en: The project required a substantial amount of planning and teamwork.
substantial.zh: 這項專題需要大量的規劃與團隊合作。

substitute.en: You can substitute water for milk in this simple experiment.
substitute.zh: 在這個簡單實驗中，你可以用水代替牛奶。

subtle.en: The two pictures contain a subtle difference in the background.
subtle.zh: 這兩張圖片的背景中有一個細微差異。

subtract.en: Remember to subtract the smaller number from the larger one.
subtract.zh: 記得用較大的數減去較小的數。

suburb.en: The family moved to a quiet suburb near the city.
suburb.zh: 這家人搬到城市附近安靜的郊區。

suburban.en: The train connects several suburban neighborhoods with downtown.
suburban.zh: 這班火車連接數個郊區社區和市中心。

subway.en: We took the subway to the museum during the class trip.
subway.zh: 班級旅行時，我們搭地鐵前往博物館。

succeed.en: Students often succeed when they practice consistently and ask questions.
succeed.zh: 學生持續練習並主動提問時，往往更容易成功。

success.en: Careful preparation played an important role in the team's success.
success.zh: 仔細準備在團隊成功中扮演重要角色。

successful.en: The project was successful because everyone completed their tasks.
successful.zh: 這項專題很成功，因為每個人都完成了自己的工作。

succession.en: Three rainy days occurred in succession during the holiday.
succession.zh: 假日期間連續三天下雨。

successive.en: Each successive test produced a slightly more accurate result.
successive.zh: 每次接續進行的測試都產生稍微更準確的結果。

successor.en: The new principal was introduced as the successor to the retiring leader.
successor.zh: 新校長被介紹為退休校長的接任者。

such.en: Such examples can help students understand abstract ideas more easily.
such.zh: 這類例子能幫助學生更容易理解抽象觀念。

sudden.en: A sudden change in weather forced us to leave early.
sudden.zh: 天氣突然改變，迫使我們提早離開。

sue.en: The article explains why a company may sue over a contract dispute.
sue.zh: 文章說明公司為何可能因合約爭議提起訴訟。

suffer.en: Plants may suffer when they receive too little sunlight.
suffer.zh: 植物日照不足時可能生長不良。

sufficient.en: The available evidence was sufficient to support the final conclusion.
sufficient.zh: 現有證據足以支持最後的結論。

sugar.en: The recipe uses less sugar than the original version.
sugar.zh: 這份食譜比原版使用更少的糖。

suggest.en: The results suggest that regular review improves long-term memory.
suggest.zh: 結果顯示規律複習能改善長期記憶。

suggestion.en: Her suggestion helped the group finish the project more efficiently.
suggestion.zh: 她的建議幫助小組更有效率地完成專題。

suit.en: This quiet room will suit students who need to concentrate.
suit.zh: 這間安靜的房間很適合需要專心的學生。

suitable.en: The teacher chose a suitable article for the class discussion.
suitable.zh: 老師選了一篇適合課堂討論的文章。

suitcase.en: He packed his books carefully inside a small suitcase.
suitcase.zh: 他把書仔細收進一個小行李箱。

suite.en: The hotel suite includes a bedroom and a small sitting area.
suite.zh: 這間飯店套房包含臥室和一個小客廳。

sum.en: The final sum includes the cost of materials and transportation.
sum.zh: 最後總額包含材料費和交通費。

summarize.en: Please summarize the main argument in two or three sentences.
summarize.zh: 請用兩到三句話總結主要論點。

summary.en: Write a short summary after reading the article carefully.
summary.zh: 仔細讀完文章後，寫一段簡短摘要。

summit.en: The hikers reached the summit just before the clouds arrived.
summit.zh: 健行者在雲層抵達前登上山頂。

summon.en: The principal may summon the committee for an urgent meeting.
summon.zh: 校長可能召集委員會召開緊急會議。

sun.en: The sun appeared again after the morning rain stopped.
sun.zh: 早上的雨停後，太陽又出現了。

sunny.en: We moved the activity outdoors because the afternoon was sunny.
sunny.zh: 因為下午天氣晴朗，我們把活動移到戶外。
