super.en: The new computer is super fast compared with the old one.
super.zh: 和舊電腦相比，新電腦速度超快。

superb.en: Her superb presentation earned praise from the judges.
superb.zh: 她出色的簡報獲得評審稱讚。

superficial.en: A superficial reading may miss the article's main argument.
superficial.zh: 只做表面閱讀可能會錯過文章的主要論點。

superintendent.en: The school superintendent visited several campuses during the week.
superintendent.zh: 學區主管這週造訪了好幾所學校。

superior.en: The newer material proved superior in strength and durability.
superior.zh: 較新的材料在強度和耐用性方面表現更好。

superiority.en: The report found no clear superiority between the two study methods.
superiority.zh: 報告發現這兩種讀書方法之間沒有明顯優劣。

supermarket.en: The supermarket added more self-checkout machines near the entrance.
supermarket.zh: 超市在入口附近增設更多自助結帳機。

superstition.en: The lesson examines how superstition can develop in different cultures.
superstition.zh: 課堂探討迷信如何在不同文化中形成。

superstitious.en: The character is superstitious and avoids certain numbers for luck.
superstitious.zh: 那個角色很迷信，會避開某些數字求好運。

supervise.en: A teacher will supervise the laboratory activity this afternoon.
supervise.zh: 今天下午會有老師監督實驗活動。

supervision.en: The younger students completed the activity under teacher supervision.
supervision.zh: 年幼學生在老師監督下完成活動。

supervisor.en: The project supervisor reviewed our schedule before the presentation.
supervisor.zh: 專題指導老師在發表前檢查了我們的時程。

supper.en: The family ate a simple supper after returning home late.
supper.zh: 一家人晚歸後吃了一頓簡單晚餐。

supplement.en: The teacher provided extra readings to supplement the textbook.
supplement.zh: 老師提供額外閱讀資料來補充課本內容。

supply.en: The school keeps an extra supply of paper in the office.
supply.zh: 學校在辦公室備有額外紙張。

support.en: Use evidence from the passage to support your answer.
support.zh: 請用文章中的證據支持你的答案。

suppose.en: I suppose the meeting will end before six o'clock.
suppose.zh: 我想會議應該會在六點前結束。

supposedly.en: The old building is supposedly more than a century old.
supposedly.zh: 據說這棟老建築已有一百多年歷史。

suppress.en: Thick curtains can suppress some outside noise during the recording.
suppress.zh: 厚窗簾可以在錄音時減少部分外部噪音。

supreme.en: The court serves as the supreme legal authority in the system.
supreme.zh: 這座法院是該制度中的最高司法機關。

sure.en: Make sure the file is saved before closing the program.
sure.zh: 關閉程式前要確認檔案已經儲存。

surf.en: Visitors can surf safely only in areas marked for the activity.
surf.zh: 遊客只能在標示可進行活動的區域衝浪。

surface.en: The table has a smooth surface that is easy to clean.

surge.en: The station saw a surge in passengers after the concert ended.
surge.zh: 演唱會結束後，車站旅客人數突然增加。

surgeon.en: The documentary follows a surgeon discussing teamwork in a hospital.
surgeon.zh: 紀錄片跟拍一位外科醫師談醫院中的團隊合作。

surgery.en: The article explains surgery as one type of medical treatment.
surgery.zh: 文章說明手術是醫療處置的一種類型。

surgical.en: The museum displays historical surgical instruments for educational purposes.
surgical.zh: 博物館為教育用途展示歷史外科器械。

surname.en: Please write your surname in the final box on the form.
surname.zh: 請在表格最後一格填寫你的姓氏。

surpass.en: This year's attendance may surpass the record set last year.
surpass.zh: 今年的出席人數可能超越去年的紀錄。

surplus.en: The school donated its surplus books to a community center.
surplus.zh: 學校把多餘的書捐給社區中心。

surprise.en: The class prepared a surprise for their teacher after the ceremony.
surprise.zh: 典禮後，全班為老師準備了一個驚喜。

surprised.en: We were surprised by how quickly the experiment produced results.
surprised.zh: 我們對實驗這麼快得到結果感到驚訝。

surrender.en: The history lesson describes when the army chose to surrender.
surrender.zh: 歷史課描述那支軍隊何時選擇投降。

surround.en: Tall trees surround the small lake behind the school.
surround.zh: 高大的樹木環繞著學校後方的小湖。

surroundings.en: The hikers stopped to observe their surroundings before choosing a path.
surroundings.zh: 健行者先停下觀察周遭環境，再選擇路線。

surveillance.en: The debate examined privacy concerns related to public surveillance systems.
surveillance.zh: 辯論探討公共監視系統所涉及的隱私問題。

survey.en: The class conducted a survey about students' reading habits.
survey.zh: 全班進行了一項關於學生閱讀習慣的調查。

survival.en: The documentary explains how desert plants adapt for survival.
survival.zh: 紀錄片說明沙漠植物如何適應環境以生存。

survive.en: Some seeds can survive cold winters and grow in spring.
survive.zh: 有些種子可以熬過寒冬並在春天生長。

survivor.en: The documentary lets a survivor describe the event in non-graphic terms.
survivor.zh: 紀錄片讓一位倖存者以非血腥方式描述事件。

suspect.en: Police identified a suspect, but the investigation was still continuing.
suspect.zh: 警方確認一名嫌疑人，但調查仍在進行。

suspend.en: The school may suspend an activity when safety conditions are uncertain.
suspend.zh: 當安全情況不明時，學校可能暫停活動。

suspense.en: The mystery novel builds suspense before revealing the final clue.
suspense.zh: 這本推理小說在揭曉最後線索前營造懸念。

suspension.en: The bridge uses a suspension design across the wide river.
suspension.zh: 這座橋採用懸吊式設計跨越寬廣河面。

suspicion.en: His sudden change in behavior raised suspicion among the group.
suspicion.zh: 他突然改變行為，引起了小組的懷疑。

suspicious.en: The teacher found the repeated identical answers suspicious.
suspicious.zh: 老師覺得反覆出現完全相同的答案很可疑。

sustain.en: Regular maintenance can help sustain the system's performance over time.
sustain.zh: 定期維護有助於長期維持系統效能。

sustainable.en: The project focuses on sustainable ways to reduce school waste.
sustainable.zh: 這項專題著重於永續減少校園垃圾的方法。

swallow.en: A swallow flew across the field just before sunset.
swallow.zh: 日落前，一隻燕子飛過田野。

swamp.en: The wetland trail passes beside a large swamp area.
swamp.zh: 濕地步道經過一大片沼澤區。

swan.en: A white swan moved slowly across the quiet lake.
swan.zh: 一隻白天鵝緩緩游過安靜的湖面。

swap.en: The students agreed to swap seats for the group activity.
swap.zh: 學生同意為小組活動交換座位。

swarm.en: A swarm of bees gathered near the flowering tree.
swarm.zh: 一群蜜蜂聚集在開花的樹附近。

sway.en: The tall grass began to sway in the evening wind.
sway.zh: 高草在晚風中開始搖曳。

swear.en: He had to swear that his statement was truthful.
swear.zh: 他必須宣誓自己的陳述是真實的。

sweat.en: Sweat helps the body cool down during physical activity.
sweat.zh: 運動時流汗有助於身體降溫。

sweater.en: She brought a sweater because the classroom felt cold.
sweater.zh: 因為教室很冷，她帶了一件毛衣。

sweep.en: Volunteers stayed after the event to sweep the floor.
sweep.zh: 活動結束後，志工留下來掃地。

sweet.en: The ripe mango had a naturally sweet flavor.
sweet.zh: 成熟芒果帶有天然的甜味。

swell.en: The river began to swell after several days of rain.
swell.zh: 連續下雨數日後，河水開始上漲。

swift.en: The committee made a swift decision after reviewing the evidence.
swift.zh: 委員會審查證據後迅速做出決定。

swim.en: Students can swim only during supervised pool sessions.
swim.zh: 學生只能在有人監督的泳池時段游泳。

swimsuit.en: She packed a swimsuit for the school swimming lesson.
swimsuit.zh: 她為學校游泳課帶了泳衣。

swing.en: The empty swing moved gently in the afternoon breeze.
swing.zh: 空蕩的鞦韆在午後微風中輕輕擺動。

switch.en: Press the switch to turn on the classroom projector.
switch.zh: 按下開關即可開啟教室投影機。

syllable.en: The teacher asked us to clap once for each syllable.
syllable.zh: 老師要我們每個音節拍一次手。

symbol.en: A red circle can serve as a symbol of warning.
symbol.zh: 紅色圓圈可以作為警告的象徵。

symbolic.en: The dove has symbolic meaning in many works of art.
symbolic.zh: 鴿子在許多藝術作品中具有象徵意義。

symbolize.en: In the poem, changing seasons symbolize the passage of time.
symbolize.zh: 在這首詩裡，季節變化象徵時間流逝。

symmetry.en: The butterfly's wings show clear symmetry in their pattern.
symmetry.zh: 蝴蝶翅膀的圖案呈現明顯對稱。

sympathetic.en: The teacher was sympathetic when the student explained the problem.
sympathetic.zh: 學生說明問題後，老師表示理解與同情。

sympathize.en: It is easy to sympathize with someone facing a difficult situation.
sympathize.zh: 面對困難處境的人很容易讓人產生同理心。

sympathy.en: The class sent a card expressing sympathy to the family.
sympathy.zh: 班上寄出卡片向那個家庭表達慰問。

symphony.en: The orchestra performed a famous symphony at the concert hall.
symphony.zh: 管弦樂團在音樂廳演奏了一首著名交響曲。

symptom.en: The textbook defines symptom as a change noticed during illness.
symptom.zh: 課本將 symptom 定義為生病時注意到的身體變化。

syndrome.en: The article introduces syndrome as a medical term for a group of signs.
syndrome.zh: 文章介紹 syndrome 是描述一組徵象的醫學用語。

synonym.en: The dictionary lists a synonym beside the unfamiliar word.
synonym.zh: 字典在這個陌生單字旁列出一個同義詞。

synthetic.en: The experiment compares natural fibers with synthetic materials.
synthetic.zh: 實驗比較天然纖維與合成材料。

syrup.en: She poured a little syrup over the pancakes at breakfast.
syrup.zh: 早餐時，她在鬆餅上淋了一點糖漿。

system.en: The new system makes it easier to track student progress.
system.zh: 新系統讓追蹤學生進度變得更容易。

systematic.en: A systematic review helped the group organize its research notes.
systematic.zh: 有系統的複習幫助小組整理研究筆記。

t-shirt.en: He wore a school t-shirt during the sports day event.
t-shirt.zh: 運動會時他穿著學校的 T 恤。

table.en: The results are organized in a table for easy comparison.
table.zh: 結果整理在表格中，方便比較。

tablet.en: Students used a tablet to record observations during the field trip.
tablet.zh: 學生在校外教學時使用平板記錄觀察結果。

tackle.en: The team met after class to tackle the hardest problem together.
tackle.zh: 小組放學後一起處理最困難的問題。

tactic.en: Changing the order of questions was a useful test tactic.
tactic.zh: 改變答題順序是一個實用的考試策略。

tag.en: Each bag has a tag showing the owner's name.
tag.zh: 每個袋子都有標籤寫著主人的名字。

tail.en: The dog wagged its tail when the students approached.
tail.zh: 學生靠近時，那隻狗搖了搖尾巴。

tailor.en: The tailor adjusted the jacket so it fit more comfortably.
tailor.zh: 裁縫調整了外套，讓穿著更舒適。

take.en: Please take notes while you listen to the presentation.

tale.en: The teacher read a traditional tale from the local region.
tale.zh: 老師讀了一則當地的傳統故事。

talent.en: The festival gave students a chance to show their talent.
talent.zh: 校慶讓學生有機會展現才華。

talk.en: We need to talk about how to divide the work fairly.
talk.zh: 我們需要討論如何公平分配工作。

talkative.en: The talkative student became quiet once the test began.
talkative.zh: 那位健談的學生一開始考試就安靜下來。

tall.en: A tall tree provides shade beside the playground.
tall.zh: 操場旁有一棵高大的樹提供遮蔭。

tame.en: The rescued bird remained calm because it had become tame.
tame.zh: 那隻獲救的鳥因已被馴養而保持平靜。

tangerine.en: She packed a tangerine in her lunch box today.
tangerine.zh: 她今天在午餐盒裡放了一顆橘子。

tangle.en: The cables formed a tangle behind the computer desk.
tangle.zh: 電腦桌後方的電線纏成一團。

tank.en: The aquarium tank contains several colorful tropical fish.
tank.zh: 水族箱裡有幾條色彩鮮豔的熱帶魚。

tap.en: Give the screen a light tap to open the menu.
tap.zh: 輕點螢幕即可開啟選單。

tape.en: She used tape to attach the notice to the wall.
tape.zh: 她用膠帶把公告貼在牆上。

target.en: Our target is to finish all three tasks before lunch.
target.zh: 我們的目標是在午餐前完成三項任務。

task.en: Each student received a different task for the group project.
task.zh: 每位學生在小組專題中都分到不同任務。

taste.en: The soup has a mild taste that most students enjoy.
taste.zh: 這碗湯味道清淡，多數學生都喜歡。

tasty.en: The cafeteria served a tasty vegetable dish for lunch.
tasty.zh: 學校餐廳午餐供應一道美味的蔬菜料理。

tax.en: The lesson explains how tax revenue supports public services.
tax.zh: 課堂說明稅收如何支持公共服務。

taxi.en: They took a taxi from the station to the hotel.
taxi.zh: 他們從車站搭計程車前往飯店。

taxicab.en: An old taxicab appears in the historical photograph.
taxicab.zh: 一輛老式計程車出現在歷史照片中。

tea.en: She drank warm tea while reviewing her notes.
tea.zh: 她一邊複習筆記一邊喝溫茶。

teach.en: Good examples can teach difficult ideas more effectively than definitions alone.
teach.zh: 好的例子往往比單靠定義更能教會困難觀念。

teacher.en: The teacher explained the instructions before the activity began.
teacher.zh: 活動開始前，老師先說明了指示。

team.en: The team worked together to solve the problem before class ended.
team.zh: 團隊合作在下課前解決了問題。

teapot.en: A ceramic teapot sat in the center of the table.
teapot.zh: 桌子中央放著一只陶瓷茶壺。

tear.en: Be careful not to tear the map while unfolding it.
tear.zh: 展開地圖時小心不要撕破。

tease.en: Classmates should not tease someone for making a mistake.
tease.zh: 同學不應因別人犯錯而取笑對方。

technical.en: The manual provides technical details about the new equipment.
technical.zh: 手冊提供新設備的技術細節。

technician.en: A technician checked the projector before the presentation began.
technician.zh: 簡報開始前，技術人員檢查了投影機。

technique.en: This technique helps students organize complex information more clearly.
technique.zh: 這種技巧能幫助學生更清楚整理複雜資訊。

technological.en: Technological change has transformed how students access information.
technological.zh: 科技變化已改變學生取得資訊的方式。

technology.en: Technology has changed how students access information and communicate.
technology.zh: 科技改變了學生取得資訊與溝通的方式。

tedious.en: Entering hundreds of records by hand was a tedious task.
tedious.zh: 手動輸入數百筆資料是一項繁瑣工作。

teenage.en: The novel follows a teenage student adjusting to a new school.
teenage.zh: 這本小說描寫一名青少年學生適應新學校。

teenager.en: Every teenager in the program receives a study guide.
teenager.zh: 計畫中的每位青少年都會拿到一份學習指南。

teens.en: The survey asks teens about their preferred study habits.
teens.zh: 這份調查詢問青少年偏好的讀書習慣。

telecommunications.en: Modern telecommunications allow information to travel around the world quickly.
telecommunications.zh: 現代電信技術讓資訊能快速傳遍世界。

telegraph.en: The museum displays an early telegraph used for long-distance messages.
telegraph.zh: 博物館展示一部早期用於遠距傳訊的電報機。

telephone.en: The office telephone rang several times during the meeting.
telephone.zh: 會議期間辦公室電話響了好幾次。

telescope.en: The astronomy club used a telescope to observe the moon.
telescope.zh: 天文社用望遠鏡觀察月球。

television.en: The documentary was shown on national television last night.
television.zh: 這部紀錄片昨晚在全國電視台播出。

tell.en: Please tell the group what you observed during the experiment.
tell.zh: 請告訴小組你在實驗中觀察到的現象。

teller.en: The bank teller explained the form to the customer.
teller.zh: 銀行櫃員向顧客說明這份表格。

temper.en: He learned to control his temper during stressful situations.
temper.zh: 他學會在壓力情境中控制脾氣。

temperature.en: The temperature dropped quickly after the sun went down.
temperature.zh: 太陽下山後，氣溫快速下降。

temple.en: The old temple attracts visitors interested in local history.
temple.zh: 這座古老寺廟吸引對地方歷史有興趣的訪客。

tempo.en: The conductor increased the tempo during the final section.
tempo.zh: 指揮在最後一段提高了速度。

temporary.en: The library is using a temporary entrance during the renovation.
temporary.zh: 圖書館整修期間使用臨時入口。

tempt.en: Bright advertisements can tempt shoppers to buy unnecessary items.
tempt.zh: 鮮明的廣告可能誘使消費者購買不必要的物品。

temptation.en: She resisted the temptation to check her phone while studying.
temptation.zh: 讀書時，她忍住查看手機的誘惑。

tenant.en: Each tenant received a notice about the building repairs.
tenant.zh: 每位房客都收到大樓維修通知。

tend.en: Students tend to remember ideas better when they practice regularly.
tend.zh: 學生規律練習時通常更容易記住概念。

tendency.en: The data shows a tendency toward higher attendance in spring.
tendency.zh: 資料顯示春季出席率有較高的趨勢。

tender.en: The young leaves were tender after the spring rain.
tender.zh: 春雨過後，嫩葉顯得柔軟。

tennis.en: The school tennis team practiced after class on Tuesday.
tennis.zh: 學校網球隊週二放學後練習。

tense.en: The room became tense while everyone waited for the results.
tense.zh: 大家等待結果時，房間氣氛變得緊張。

tension.en: Clear communication helped reduce tension within the group.
tension.zh: 清楚溝通有助於減少小組內的緊張氣氛。

tent.en: The campers placed their tent on level ground.
tent.zh: 露營者把帳篷搭在平坦地面上。

tentative.en: The team made a tentative schedule before confirming all dates.
tentative.zh: 團隊在確認所有日期前先擬定暫定時程。

term.en: The teacher defined the new term before using it in discussion.
term.zh: 老師在討論中使用新術語前先加以定義。

terminal.en: The airport terminal became crowded before the holiday weekend.
terminal.zh: 連假前，機場航廈變得很擁擠。

terrace.en: Students ate lunch on the terrace outside the library.
terrace.zh: 學生在圖書館外的露台吃午餐。

terrible.en: The weather was terrible, so the game was postponed.
terrible.zh: 天氣很糟，因此比賽延期。

terrific.en: The class did a terrific job on the science exhibition.
terrific.zh: 班上在科學展覽中表現得非常出色。

terrify.en: Loud thunder can terrify some animals during a storm.
terrify.zh: 暴風雨中的巨大雷聲可能嚇到一些動物。

territory.en: The map shows how the territory changed over several centuries.
territory.zh: 地圖顯示這片領土在數個世紀中的變化。

test.en: The test includes reading, vocabulary, and short writing questions.
test.zh: 這份測驗包含閱讀、單字和短文寫作題。

testify.en: The witness agreed to testify about what was observed.
testify.zh: 目擊者同意就所見情況作證。

text.en: Read the text carefully before answering the questions below.
text.zh: 回答下方問題前請仔細閱讀文章。

textbook.en: The textbook includes practice questions at the end of each chapter.
textbook.zh: 課本每章最後都有練習題。

textile.en: The exhibition explains how textile production changed over time.
textile.zh: 展覽說明紡織生產如何隨時間改變。

texture.en: The artist used thick paint to create a rough texture.
texture.zh: 藝術家用厚重顏料創造粗糙質感。

than.en: This method is faster than the one we used yesterday.
than.zh: 這個方法比我們昨天使用的方法更快。

thank.en: We should thank the volunteers for helping with the event.
thank.zh: 我們應該感謝志工協助這場活動。

thankful.en: We were thankful for the volunteers who helped after school.
thankful.zh: 我們很感謝放學後前來幫忙的志工。

that.en: The evidence shows that the new method is more effective.
that.zh: 證據顯示新方法更有效。

the.en: The students entered the classroom quietly before the test.
the.zh: 學生在考試前安靜地進入教室。

theater.en: The class visited a theater to watch a student performance.
theater.zh: 班上到劇院觀看學生演出。

theft.en: The school reviewed its security policy after a reported theft.
theft.zh: 學校在接獲失竊通報後重新檢視安全政策。

their.en: The students presented their findings to the whole class.
their.zh: 學生向全班報告他們的研究結果。

theirs.en: Our project is about climate, while theirs focuses on energy.
theirs.zh: 我們的專題是氣候，他們的則著重能源。

them.en: The teacher gave them extra time to finish the assignment.
them.zh: 老師給他們更多時間完成作業。

theme.en: The main theme of the novel is friendship during change.
theme.zh: 這本小說的主要主題是在變動中的友誼。

themselves.en: The students introduced themselves before the group activity began.
themselves.zh: 小組活動開始前，學生先自我介紹。

then.en: Read the instructions first, then begin the experiment.
then.zh: 先閱讀說明，接著再開始實驗。

theology.en: The university course introduces theology through historical texts and cultural discussion.
theology.zh: 這門大學課程透過歷史文本與文化討論介紹神學。

theoretical.en: The lesson connects theoretical ideas with simple real-world examples.
theoretical.zh: 這堂課把理論概念和簡單的生活實例連結起來。

theory.en: The experiment was designed to test a simple scientific theory.
theory.zh: 這個實驗是為了檢驗一項簡單的科學理論。

therapist.en: The article explains the professional role of a therapist in general terms.
therapist.zh: 文章以一般性的方式說明治療師的專業角色。

therapy.en: The textbook describes therapy as one form of professional support.
therapy.zh: 課本把治療描述為一種專業支持方式。

there.en: There are several possible answers to this question.
there.zh: 這個問題有好幾種可能的答案。

thereafter.en: The team revised the plan and thereafter followed the new schedule.
thereafter.zh: 團隊修改計畫後，之後都依照新時程進行。

thereby.en: The school reduced paper use, thereby lowering printing costs.
thereby.zh: 學校減少用紙，因此降低了列印成本。

therefore.en: The road was closed; therefore, we had to choose another route.
therefore.zh: 道路封閉了，因此我們必須選擇另一條路。

thermometer.en: The science class used a thermometer to record the water temperature.
thermometer.zh: 自然課使用溫度計記錄水溫。

these.en: These examples show how the rule works in different situations.
these.zh: 這些例子顯示這項規則在不同情況下如何運作。

thesis.en: Her thesis presents a clear argument about urban transportation.
thesis.zh: 她的論文提出一個關於都市交通的清楚論點。

they.en: They reviewed the report together before submitting it.
they.zh: 他們在提交報告前一起檢查內容。

thick.en: The book has a thick cover that protects the pages well.
thick.zh: 這本書有厚實的封面，能很好地保護書頁。

thief.en: The novel follows a thief who later returns what he stole.
thief.zh: 小說描寫一名小偷後來歸還偷走物品的故事。

thin.en: A thin layer of ice formed on the water overnight.
thin.zh: 夜裡水面形成了一層薄冰。

thing.en: The most important thing is to understand why the answer is correct.
thing.zh: 最重要的是理解答案為什麼正確。

think.en: Take a moment to think before choosing your final answer.
think.zh: 選擇最後答案前先花一點時間思考。

third.en: The team finished third in the regional competition.
third.zh: 這支隊伍在地區比賽中獲得第三名。

thirst.en: After the long walk, everyone felt strong thirst.
thirst.zh: 長途步行後，每個人都感到非常口渴。

thirsty.en: The hikers became thirsty after walking under the afternoon sun.
thirsty.zh: 健行者在午後陽光下走了一段路後感到口渴。

this.en: This chart compares the results from three different classes.
this.zh: 這張圖表比較三個不同班級的結果。

thorough.en: The teacher gave every report a thorough review before grading.
thorough.zh: 老師在評分前仔細審閱了每份報告。

those.en: Those students volunteered to help clean the school grounds.
those.zh: 那些學生自願幫忙清理校園。

though.en: Though the task was difficult, everyone completed it on time.
though.zh: 雖然任務很難，每個人仍準時完成。

thought.en: She gave careful thought to each option before deciding.
thought.zh: 她在做決定前仔細考慮了每個選項。

thoughtful.en: Her thoughtful question led to a deeper classroom discussion.
thoughtful.zh: 她深思熟慮的問題帶來更深入的課堂討論。

thousand.en: More than a thousand people attended the festival this year.
thousand.zh: 今年有超過一千人參加這場節慶活動。

thread.en: A loose thread was hanging from the edge of the bag.
thread.zh: 包包邊緣垂著一根鬆掉的線。

threat.en: Flooding is a serious threat to homes near the river.
threat.zh: 洪水對河邊住家構成嚴重威脅。

threaten.en: Rising temperatures threaten some species in mountain environments.
threaten.zh: 升高的氣溫威脅部分山區物種。

threshold.en: The sensor activates when the temperature passes a set threshold.
threshold.zh: 溫度超過設定門檻時，感應器就會啟動。

thrill.en: The roller coaster gave visitors a brief thrill at the amusement park.
thrill.zh: 雲霄飛車讓遊樂園的遊客感受到短暫刺激。

thriller.en: She borrowed a mystery thriller from the school library.
thriller.zh: 她從學校圖書館借了一本懸疑驚悚小說。

thrive.en: These plants thrive in warm weather with plenty of sunlight.
thrive.zh: 這些植物在溫暖且日照充足的環境中生長良好。

throat.en: The biology diagram labels the throat and nearby structures clearly.
throat.zh: 生物圖表清楚標示喉嚨及附近構造。

throne.en: The old painting shows a king seated on a throne.
throne.zh: 這幅老畫描繪一位國王坐在王座上。

through.en: We walked through the park on our way to the station.
through.zh: 我們前往車站途中穿過了公園。

throughout.en: The weather remained cool throughout the entire weekend.
throughout.zh: 整個週末天氣都維持涼爽。

throw.en: Please do not throw paper into the wrong recycling bin.
throw.zh: 請不要把紙丟進錯誤的回收桶。

thrust.en: The engine creates enough thrust to move the model aircraft forward.
thrust.zh: 引擎產生足夠推力讓模型飛機向前移動。

thumb.en: He used his thumb to scroll through the presentation slides.
thumb.zh: 他用拇指滑動簡報投影片。

thunder.en: Loud thunder followed the flash of lightning during the storm.
thunder.zh: 暴風雨中閃電之後傳來響亮雷聲。

thus.en: The road was closed, thus the bus took another route.
thus.zh: 道路封閉，因此公車改走另一條路線。

tick.en: The clock made a soft tick in the quiet classroom.
tick.zh: 安靜的教室裡，時鐘發出輕微滴答聲。

ticket.en: Keep your ticket until you leave the station.
ticket.zh: 離開車站前請保留車票。

tickle.en: The feather began to tickle his nose during the experiment.
tickle.zh: 實驗時那根羽毛開始搔得他的鼻子發癢。

tide.en: The class measured how the tide changed throughout the day.
tide.zh: 班上測量潮汐一整天的變化。

tidy.en: Please keep your desk tidy before the next class begins.
tidy.zh: 下一堂課開始前請保持桌面整潔。

tie.en: The final goal created a tie between the two teams.
tie.zh: 最後一球讓兩隊形成平手。

tiger.en: The documentary follows a tiger moving through a forest reserve.
tiger.zh: 紀錄片跟拍一隻老虎穿越森林保護區。

tight.en: The jar lid was too tight for him to open easily.
tight.zh: 罐子的蓋子太緊，他不容易打開。

tighten.en: Please tighten the loose strap before carrying the backpack.
tighten.zh: 背背包前請把鬆掉的背帶拉緊。

tile.en: A cracked tile near the doorway was replaced yesterday.
tile.zh: 門口附近一塊裂掉的磁磚昨天被換掉了。

till.en: The library stays open till nine on weekdays.
till.zh: 圖書館平日開放到晚上九點。

tilt.en: Tilt the screen slightly to reduce the glare from the window.
tilt.zh: 把螢幕稍微傾斜，可以減少窗戶反光。

timber.en: The old bridge was built mainly from local timber.
timber.zh: 這座老橋主要以當地木材建造。

time.en: Good time management can reduce stress before major exams.
time.zh: 良好的時間管理能減少大考前的壓力。

timetable.en: The new timetable gives students more time between classes.
timetable.zh: 新的課表讓學生在課與課之間有更多時間。

timid.en: The timid cat slowly approached the food near the doorway.
timid.zh: 那隻膽小的貓慢慢靠近門邊的食物。

tin.en: The exhibit includes a small tin box from the early twentieth century.
tin.zh: 展覽中有一個二十世紀初的小鐵盒。

tiny.en: A tiny crack appeared near the edge of the glass.
tiny.zh: 玻璃邊緣出現了一道很小的裂痕。

tip.en: The teacher gave us a useful tip for remembering the formula.
tip.zh: 老師給了我們一個記住公式的實用技巧。

tiptoe.en: She began to tiptoe across the room while everyone was reading.
tiptoe.zh: 大家閱讀時，她開始踮著腳走過房間。

tire.en: The bicycle needs a new tire before the next trip.
tire.zh: 下次出遊前，這輛自行車需要換一條新輪胎。

tired.en: He felt tired after finishing several hours of practice.
tired.zh: 完成幾個小時的練習後，他感到疲倦。

tiresome.en: Repeating the same task all afternoon became tiresome.
tiresome.zh: 整個下午重複同一項工作變得很令人厭倦。

tissue.en: She used a tissue to wipe water from the desk.
tissue.zh: 她用面紙擦掉桌上的水。

title.en: Choose a clear title that matches the main idea of your report.
title.zh: 請選一個符合報告主旨的清楚標題。

to.en: Students went to the library to prepare for the exam.
to.zh: 學生去圖書館準備考試。

toast.en: He ate toast with fruit before leaving for school.
toast.zh: 他上學前吃了吐司和水果。

today.en: We will review the most important vocabulary today.
today.zh: 我們今天會複習最重要的單字。

toe.en: The shoe felt tight around my big toe.
toe.zh: 這雙鞋在我的大拇趾附近感覺很緊。

tofu.en: The lunch box included tofu, vegetables, and rice.
tofu.zh: 便當裡有豆腐、蔬菜和白飯。

together.en: The two groups worked together to complete the final presentation.
together.zh: 兩個小組合作完成了最後報告。

toilet.en: The station has a public toilet beside the waiting area.
toilet.zh: 車站候車區旁有公共廁所。

token.en: Each participant received a small token after the workshop.
token.zh: 每位參與者在工作坊後都收到一個小紀念品。

tolerable.en: The noise became tolerable after the windows were closed.
tolerable.zh: 窗戶關上後，噪音變得可以忍受。

tolerance.en: The lesson emphasizes tolerance for people with different backgrounds.
tolerance.zh: 課堂強調對不同背景的人保持包容。

tolerant.en: A tolerant classroom allows students to express different opinions respectfully.
tolerant.zh: 包容的課堂讓學生能尊重地表達不同意見。

tolerate.en: This plant can tolerate dry conditions better than the other species.
tolerate.zh: 這種植物比其他種類更能耐受乾燥環境。

toll.en: The bridge toll is collected electronically at the entrance.
toll.zh: 這座橋的通行費在入口以電子方式收取。

tomato.en: She sliced a tomato and added it to the sandwich.
tomato.zh: 她切了一顆番茄放進三明治。

tomb.en: Archaeologists studied an ancient tomb discovered near the ruins.
tomb.zh: 考古學家研究在遺址附近發現的一座古墓。

tomorrow.en: Please bring your completed worksheet to class tomorrow.
tomorrow.zh: 明天上課請帶完成的學習單。

ton.en: The truck can carry more than one ton of equipment.
ton.zh: 這輛卡車可以載超過一公噸的設備。

tone.en: The writer uses a calm tone throughout the article.
tone.zh: 作者整篇文章都使用平靜的語氣。

tongue.en: The diagram labels the tongue as part of the human mouth.
tongue.zh: 圖表把舌頭標示為人口腔的一部分。

tonight.en: I plan to review the chapter again tonight.
tonight.zh: 我今晚打算再複習一次這一章。

too.en: The box is too heavy for one person to carry safely.
too.zh: 這個箱子太重，一個人搬並不安全。

tool.en: A calculator is a useful tool for checking numerical results.
tool.zh: 計算機是檢查數值結果的實用工具。

tooth.en: The model shows the structure of a human tooth.
tooth.zh: 這個模型展示人類牙齒的構造。

toothache.en: The health lesson explains common reasons for a toothache.
toothache.zh: 健康課說明牙痛的常見原因。

toothbrush.en: He packed a toothbrush in his bag for the overnight trip.
toothbrush.zh: 他為過夜旅行在包包裡放了一支牙刷。

top.en: The book was placed on the top shelf of the cabinet.
top.zh: 那本書被放在櫃子的最上層。

topic.en: Each group selected a different topic for the final presentation.
topic.zh: 每組為期末簡報選擇了不同主題。

tornado.en: The documentary explains how a tornado forms during severe storms.
tornado.zh: 紀錄片說明龍捲風如何在強烈暴風雨中形成。

torrent.en: Heavy rain turned the small stream into a fast torrent.
torrent.zh: 大雨把小溪變成湍急水流。

tortoise.en: A tortoise moved slowly across the dry path in the zoo.
tortoise.zh: 動物園裡一隻陸龜慢慢走過乾燥小徑。

toss.en: She gave the ball a gentle toss across the yard.

total.en: The total cost was lower than our original estimate.

touch.en: Do not touch the equipment until the teacher gives permission.
touch.zh: 在老師允許前不要碰設備。

tough.en: The final question was tough, but most students kept trying.
tough.zh: 最後一題很難，但大多數學生仍繼續嘗試。

tour.en: The museum tour lasted about ninety minutes.
tour.zh: 博物館導覽大約持續九十分鐘。

tourism.en: The report examines how tourism affects small coastal towns.
tourism.zh: 報告探討觀光如何影響沿海小鎮。

tourist.en: A tourist asked the guide where the museum entrance was.
tourist.zh: 一名遊客詢問導遊博物館入口在哪裡。

tournament.en: Our school hosted a basketball tournament during the summer break.
tournament.zh: 學校在暑假期間舉辦了一場籃球錦標賽。

tow.en: A service vehicle arrived to tow the broken bus away.
tow.zh: 一輛服務車前來拖走故障的公車。

toward.en: The students walked toward the gym after lunch.
toward.zh: 午餐後學生朝體育館走去。

towards.en: The hikers walked towards the visitor center before sunset.
towards.zh: 健行者在日落前朝遊客中心走去。

towel.en: He packed a towel in his bag before swimming practice.
towel.zh: 游泳練習前，他在袋子裡放了一條毛巾。

tower.en: The observation tower offers a wide view of the valley.
tower.zh: 觀景塔可以俯瞰整座山谷。

town.en: The small town is famous for its old streets and local food.
town.zh: 這座小鎮以老街和在地美食聞名。

toy.en: The museum displayed a wooden toy from the early twentieth century.
toy.zh: 博物館展示了一件二十世紀初的木製玩具。

trace.en: Students trace the development of the idea across the passage.
trace.zh: 學生追蹤這個觀點在文章中的發展。

track.en: The app can track your study progress over time.
track.zh: 這個應用程式可以追蹤你的學習進度。

trade.en: International trade allows countries to exchange goods and services.
trade.zh: 國際貿易讓各國能交換商品與服務。

trademark.en: The company registered its logo as a trademark several years ago.
trademark.zh: 那家公司幾年前將標誌註冊為商標。

trader.en: The market trader arranged fruit neatly before opening the stall.
trader.zh: 市場攤販在開攤前把水果整齊排好。

tradition.en: The festival continues a tradition that began generations ago.
tradition.zh: 這個節慶延續了數代以前開始的傳統。

traditional.en: The festival includes traditional music, food, and local performances.
traditional.zh: 這個節慶包含傳統音樂、食物和地方表演。

traffic.en: Heavy traffic caused many students to arrive late.
traffic.zh: 交通壅塞造成許多學生遲到。

tragedy.en: The novel describes a family tragedy without graphic detail.
tragedy.zh: 這本小說在不描寫血腥細節的情況下描述一場家庭悲劇。

tragic.en: The article discusses the tragic loss in a respectful historical context.
tragic.zh: 文章以尊重的歷史脈絡討論這場悲劇性的損失。

trail.en: The forest trail leads to a waterfall near the mountain village.
trail.zh: 森林步道通往山村附近的一座瀑布。

train.en: We took the train because it was faster than driving.
train.zh: 我們搭火車，因為比開車快。

trait.en: Patience is a useful trait when working on difficult projects.
trait.zh: 進行困難專題時，耐心是一項有用的特質。

transaction.en: The receipt records each transaction made at the school store.
transaction.zh: 收據記錄學校商店裡的每筆交易。

transcript.en: The student requested an official transcript for the application.
transcript.zh: 學生為申請用途申請正式成績單。

transfer.en: You can transfer the file from your phone to the computer.
transfer.zh: 你可以把檔案從手機傳到電腦。

transform.en: Heat can transform ice into liquid water.
transform.zh: 熱能可以把冰轉變成液態水。

transformation.en: The photos show the transformation of the old station over time.
transformation.zh: 這些照片呈現老車站隨時間的轉變。

transit.en: The city improved public transit around the new train station.
transit.zh: 城市改善了新火車站周邊的大眾運輸。

transition.en: The transition from junior high to senior high can take time.
transition.zh: 從國中過渡到高中需要一些時間。

translate.en: Students worked in pairs to translate the short paragraph accurately.
translate.zh: 學生兩人一組，準確翻譯那段短文。

translation.en: Her translation keeps the original meaning while using natural Chinese.
translation.zh: 她的翻譯保留原意，同時使用自然中文。

translator.en: The translator checked several terms before finishing the document.
translator.zh: 翻譯者在完成文件前查核了幾個詞語。

transmission.en: The lesson explains how radio transmission carries information across distance.
transmission.zh: 課堂說明無線電傳輸如何把資訊送到遠方。

transmit.en: The sensor can transmit temperature data to the computer wirelessly.
transmit.zh: 這個感測器可以無線傳送溫度資料到電腦。

transparent.en: A transparent process makes it easier for everyone to understand how decisions were made.
transparent.zh: 透明的流程讓每個人更容易理解決策是如何形成的。

transplant.en: The health article discusses transplant medicine at a general educational level.
transplant.zh: 健康文章以一般教育程度介紹移植醫學。

transport.en: Public transport makes it easier for students to reach the museum.
transport.zh: 大眾運輸讓學生更容易前往博物館。

transportation.en: Public transportation can reduce the number of cars on busy roads.
transportation.zh: 大眾運輸能減少繁忙道路上的汽車數量。

trap.en: The story uses a hidden trap as part of the adventure plot.
trap.zh: 故事把一個隱藏陷阱當作冒險情節的一部分。

trash.en: Please put recyclable items in the correct bin instead of the trash.
trash.zh: 請把可回收物放進正確的桶子，不要丟進一般垃圾。

trauma.en: The course discusses trauma in a general psychological context.
trauma.zh: 這門課以一般心理學脈絡討論創傷。

travel.en: Many students travel during vacation to experience different cultures.
travel.zh: 許多學生在假期旅行，體驗不同文化。

traveler.en: Each traveler received a map at the information desk.
traveler.zh: 每位旅客都在服務台拿到一張地圖。

tray.en: She placed the cups carefully on a wooden tray.
tray.zh: 她小心地把杯子放在木托盤上。

treasure.en: The museum treats the ancient manuscript as a cultural treasure.
treasure.zh: 博物館把這份古老手稿視為文化珍寶。

treasury.en: The article explains how the national treasury manages public funds.
treasury.zh: 文章說明國庫如何管理公共資金。

treat.en: Doctors treat different illnesses with different methods.
treat.zh: 醫師使用不同方法治療不同疾病。

treatment.en: The patient responded well to the new treatment.
treatment.zh: 這位病人對新的治療反應良好。

treaty.en: The history class examined a treaty signed between neighboring countries.
treaty.zh: 歷史課研究鄰國之間簽署的一項條約。

tree.en: The old tree provides shade beside the school playground.
tree.zh: 這棵老樹在學校操場旁提供樹蔭。

trek.en: The class completed a short trek through the forest reserve.
trek.zh: 班上完成了一段穿越森林保護區的短程健行。

tremble.en: The windows began to tremble slightly during the strong wind.
tremble.zh: 強風吹來時，窗戶開始微微震動。

tremendous.en: The project showed tremendous improvement after several careful revisions.
tremendous.zh: 經過幾次仔細修改後，這個專題有了極大進步。

trend.en: The graph shows a steady upward trend over five years.
trend.zh: 這張圖表顯示五年間持續上升的趨勢。

trial.en: The first trial produced unexpected results, so we repeated the test.
trial.zh: 第一次試驗出現意外結果，因此我們重做測試。

triangle.en: Draw a triangle around the three important points on the map.
triangle.zh: 在地圖上的三個重要位置外畫一個三角形。

tribal.en: The museum exhibit presents tribal art with historical background and context.
tribal.zh: 博物館展覽以歷史背景介紹部落藝術。

tribe.en: The lesson discusses how a tribe organized daily life historically.
tribe.zh: 課堂討論一個部落在歷史上如何組織日常生活。

tribute.en: The concert ended with a tribute to the retired music teacher.
tribute.zh: 音樂會最後以一段致敬表演向退休音樂老師致意。

trick.en: The puzzle uses a clever trick that becomes obvious afterward.
trick.zh: 這個謎題用了巧妙的小技巧，事後看就很明顯。

tricky.en: The final question was tricky but still possible to solve.
tricky.zh: 最後一題很棘手，但仍然可以解出來。

trifle.en: The disagreement began over a trifle and quickly disappeared.
trifle.zh: 這場爭執起因於小事，很快就平息了。

trigger.en: A sudden temperature change can trigger an automatic safety response.
trigger.zh: 突然的溫度變化可能觸發自動安全反應。

trillion.en: The science article explains what one trillion means in numbers.
trillion.zh: 科學文章說明一兆在數字上的意義。

trim.en: The editor decided to trim a few sentences from the introduction.
trim.zh: 編輯決定從前言刪減幾個句子。

trip.en: The class trip helped students learn outside the classroom.
trip.zh: 班級旅行幫助學生在課堂外學習。

triple.en: Attendance nearly reached triple the number from last year's event.
triple.zh: 參加人數幾乎達到去年活動的三倍。

triumph.en: Finishing the difficult project felt like a personal triumph.
triumph.zh: 完成這個困難專題讓人感到像是一場個人的勝利。

trivial.en: The teacher reminded us not to focus on trivial details first.
trivial.zh: 老師提醒我們不要先把注意力放在瑣碎細節上。

troop.en: The history display shows a troop returning from a long journey.
troop.zh: 歷史展覽描繪一支隊伍結束長途旅程後歸來。

trophy.en: The winning team placed its trophy in the school display case.
trophy.zh: 獲勝隊伍把獎盃放進學校展示櫃。

tropic.en: The lesson compares weather patterns near each tropic on Earth.
tropic.zh: 課堂比較地球兩條回歸線附近的天氣型態。

tropical.en: The greenhouse contains several tropical plants from warm regions.
tropical.zh: 溫室裡種有幾種來自溫暖地區的熱帶植物。

trouble.en: Please ask for help if you have trouble understanding the instructions.
trouble.zh: 如果你在理解說明上遇到困難，請尋求幫助。

troublesome.en: A troublesome software bug delayed the class presentation briefly.
troublesome.zh: 一個麻煩的軟體錯誤短暫延誤了課堂發表。

trout.en: The river supports a healthy trout population in colder sections.
trout.zh: 這條河較冷的河段有健康的鱒魚族群。

truck.en: A delivery truck stopped beside the school gate this morning.
truck.zh: 今天早上一輛送貨卡車停在校門旁。

true.en: The statement is true only under certain conditions.
true.zh: 這個敘述只有在特定條件下才成立。

trumpet.en: He practiced the trumpet after school for the concert.
trumpet.zh: 他放學後為音樂會練習小號。

trunk.en: The elephant used its trunk to pick up a branch.
trunk.zh: 大象用鼻子撿起一根樹枝。

trust.en: Good teamwork depends on communication and mutual trust.
trust.zh: 良好的團隊合作仰賴溝通與彼此信任。

trustee.en: A school trustee attended the meeting to discuss the budget.
trustee.zh: 一名學校董事出席會議討論預算。

truth.en: The investigation tried to discover the truth behind the report.
truth.zh: 調查試圖找出這份報告背後的真相。

truthful.en: A truthful report should clearly separate facts from guesses.
truthful.zh: 誠實的報告應清楚區分事實與猜測。

try.en: If the first method fails, try a different approach.
try.zh: 如果第一種方法失敗，就試試不同方式。

tub.en: The art room keeps brushes in a plastic tub.
tub.zh: 美術教室把畫筆放在塑膠盆裡。

tube.en: The experiment used a clear tube to carry water between containers.
tube.zh: 實驗使用透明管子在容器之間輸送水。

tuck.en: She used a clip to tuck the loose paper into the folder.
tuck.zh: 她用夾子把鬆散的紙張收進資料夾。

tug.en: The puppy gave the rope a playful tug during training.
tug.zh: 訓練時，小狗玩耍地拉了一下繩子。

tuition.en: The university website lists tuition and other required fees clearly.
tuition.zh: 大學網站清楚列出學費與其他必要費用。

tumble.en: Several leaves began to tumble across the yard in the wind.
tumble.zh: 風中有幾片葉子開始翻滾著掠過院子。

tumor.en: The biology textbook explains tumor growth without giving personal medical advice.
tumor.zh: 生物課本說明腫瘤生長，但不提供個人醫療建議。

tuna.en: The cafeteria served a tuna sandwich as one lunch option.
tuna.zh: 餐廳把鮪魚三明治列為其中一種午餐選擇。

tune.en: The musician played a familiar tune during the school festival.
tune.zh: 音樂家在校慶時演奏了一段熟悉的旋律。

tunnel.en: The train passed through a long tunnel beneath the mountain.
tunnel.zh: 火車穿過山下的一條長隧道。

turmoil.en: The novel is set during a period of social turmoil.
turmoil.zh: 這本小說的背景設定在一段社會動盪時期。

turn.en: Please turn the page and read the next paragraph.

turtle.en: A turtle rested on a rock beside the pond.
turtle.zh: 一隻烏龜在池塘旁的石頭上休息。

tutor.en: The tutor helped the student review difficult grammar points.
tutor.zh: 家教協助學生複習困難的文法重點。

tv.en: The old tv in the lounge was replaced last month.
tv.zh: 休息室裡的舊電視上個月已經更換。

twice.en: We checked the calculation twice before submitting the answer.
twice.zh: 我們在交答案前把計算檢查了兩次。

twig.en: A small twig fell from the tree after the wind picked up.
twig.zh: 風變強後，一根小樹枝從樹上掉下來。

twilight.en: The mountains became purple and gray in the evening twilight.
twilight.zh: 傍晚暮色中，群山呈現紫灰色。

twin.en: Her twin studies at the same school but in another class.
twin.zh: 她的雙胞胎手足讀同一所學校，但不同班。

twinkle.en: We watched distant lights twinkle across the harbor at night.
twinkle.zh: 夜裡我們看著遠方港口的燈光閃爍。

twist.en: The story includes an unexpected twist near the final chapter.
twist.zh: 故事在最後幾章附近出現意想不到的轉折。

type.en: This type of question requires careful reading of the passage.
type.zh: 這種類型的題目需要仔細閱讀文章。

typhoon.en: The weather report tracked the typhoon as it moved northward.
typhoon.zh: 氣象報告追蹤颱風向北移動的情況。

typical.en: This is a typical example of how the pattern appears.
typical.zh: 這是這種模式如何出現的典型例子。

ultimate.en: The team's ultimate goal is to finish the project before June.
ultimate.zh: 團隊的最終目標是在六月前完成專題。

umbrella.en: She carried an umbrella because rain was expected after school.
umbrella.zh: 因為放學後可能下雨，她帶了一把雨傘。

unanimous.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision after a short discussion.
unanimous.zh: 委員會在短暫討論後達成一致決定。

uncle.en: His uncle showed us old photographs from the family album.
uncle.zh: 他的叔叔給我們看家庭相簿裡的老照片。

unconditional.en: The scholarship offers unconditional support for students who meet the requirements.
unconditional.zh: 這項獎學金對符合資格的學生提供無條件支持。

uncover.en: Researchers hope to uncover more details through further study.
uncover.zh: 研究人員希望透過進一步研究揭露更多細節。

under.en: The books are stored under the desk near the window.

underestimate.en: Do not underestimate how much time a careful revision can take.
underestimate.zh: 不要低估仔細修改可能需要的時間。

undergo.en: The building will undergo major repairs during the summer vacation.
undergo.zh: 這棟建築將在暑假期間進行大規模修繕。

undergraduate.en: The university offers several research opportunities for each undergraduate student.
undergraduate.zh: 這所大學為大學生提供多種研究機會。

underground.en: The city built an underground passage beneath the busy intersection.
underground.zh: 城市在繁忙路口下方興建地下通道。

underline.en: Please underline the main idea in each paragraph.
underline.zh: 請在每一段的主旨下畫線。

underlying.en: The teacher asked us to identify the underlying cause of the problem.
underlying.zh: 老師要我們找出問題背後的根本原因。

undermine.en: Unreliable data can undermine confidence in the final conclusion.
undermine.zh: 不可靠的資料可能削弱大家對最終結論的信心。

underneath.en: The keys were hidden underneath a stack of notebooks.
underneath.zh: 鑰匙藏在一疊筆記本下面。

underpass.en: Pedestrians used the underpass to cross the wide road safely.
underpass.zh: 行人利用地下道安全穿越寬廣道路。

understand.en: It is easier to remember a word when you understand its meaning.
understand.zh: 理解單字意思後會比較容易記住。

undertake.en: The class will undertake a small research project this semester.
undertake.zh: 全班這學期將進行一項小型研究專題。

underway.en: The renovation is already underway and should finish this semester.
underway.zh: 整修工程已經展開，預計本學期完成。

undo.en: The software lets users undo the last change with one command.
undo.zh: 這套軟體讓使用者用一個指令復原上一個變更。

undoubtedly.en: The new library is undoubtedly quieter than the temporary study room.
undoubtedly.zh: 新圖書館無疑比臨時自習室安靜。

unemployment.en: The economics lesson examines how unemployment affects household spending.
unemployment.zh: 經濟課探討失業如何影響家庭支出。

unfold.en: The story begins slowly, then several surprising events unfold.
unfold.zh: 故事一開始進展緩慢，接著幾件意外事件逐漸展開。

unification.en: The chapter explains the historical process of national unification.
unification.zh: 這一章說明國家統一的歷史過程。

uniform.en: All samples were kept under uniform conditions during the experiment.
uniform.zh: 所有樣本在實驗期間都維持一致的條件。

unify.en: A clear theme can unify the different sections of an essay.
unify.zh: 清楚的主題可以把文章不同部分統整起來。

union.en: The article describes how a workers' union represents its members.
union.zh: 文章描述工會如何代表其會員。

unique.en: Each culture has unique traditions that reflect its history.
unique.zh: 每種文化都有反映自身歷史的獨特傳統。

unit.en: The next unit focuses on environmental problems and solutions.
unit.zh: 下一單元著重環境問題與解決方法。

unite.en: A shared goal can unite people from different backgrounds.
unite.zh: 共同目標可以團結來自不同背景的人。

unity.en: The festival emphasized community unity through music and shared activities.
unity.zh: 這項節慶透過音樂與共同活動強調社區團結。

universal.en: Access to clean water is a universal human need.
universal.zh: 取得乾淨用水是普遍的人類需求。

universe.en: Astronomy helps us understand the scale and history of the universe.
universe.zh: 天文學幫助我們理解宇宙的尺度與歷史。

university.en: She hopes to study engineering at university in the future.
university.zh: 她希望未來在大學就讀工程相關科系。

unless.en: You cannot enter the laboratory unless a teacher is present.
unless.zh: 除非有老師在場，否則不能進入實驗室。

unlock.en: The correct password will unlock the protected document.
unlock.zh: 正確密碼可以解鎖受保護的文件。

unprecedented.en: The city recorded unprecedented attendance at the science festival this year.
unprecedented.zh: 這座城市今年科學節的參加人數創下前所未有的紀錄。

until.en: We stayed in the library until it closed.
until.zh: 我們待在圖書館直到關門。

unveil.en: The museum will unveil its new exhibition next Friday.
unveil.zh: 博物館將在下週五揭幕新展覽。

up.en: Please look up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
up.zh: 請在字典中查這個不熟悉的單字。

update.en: The website will update the information automatically every morning.
update.zh: 網站每天早上會自動更新資訊。

upgrade.en: The school plans to upgrade the computer lab this summer.
upgrade.zh: 學校計畫今年夏天升級電腦教室。

upload.en: Please upload the final report before the deadline.
upload.zh: 請在截止時間前上傳最終報告。

upon.en: Upon arrival, students must report to the main office.
upon.zh: 抵達後，學生必須先到總務辦公室報到。

upper.en: The upper floor of the library is reserved for quiet study.
upper.zh: 圖書館樓上樓層保留作安靜自習使用。

upright.en: Keep the bottle upright while carrying it to the table.
upright.zh: 把瓶子拿到桌上時請保持直立。

upset.en: He felt upset when the event was canceled unexpectedly.
upset.zh: 活動突然取消時，他感到難過。

upstairs.en: The art classroom is upstairs beside the music room.
upstairs.zh: 美術教室在樓上，位於音樂教室旁。

upward.en: The graph shows a steady upward trend in library visits.
upward.zh: 圖表顯示圖書館造訪人次穩定上升。

upwards.en: The balloon drifted upwards until it disappeared behind the clouds.
upwards.zh: 氣球向上飄，直到消失在雲後。

urban.en: Urban areas often face challenges related to traffic and housing.
urban.zh: 都市地區常面臨交通和住房相關挑戰。

urge.en: Teachers urge students to check reliable sources before sharing information.
urge.zh: 老師敦促學生分享資訊前先查核可靠來源。

urgency.en: The broken water pipe added urgency to the repair request.
urgency.zh: 破裂的水管讓維修需求變得更加迫切。

urgent.en: The office sent an urgent notice about the schedule change.
urgent.zh: 辦公室發出一則關於時程變更的緊急通知。

us.en: The guide showed us where the exhibition begins.
us.zh: 導覽員告訴我們展覽從哪裡開始。

usage.en: The dictionary explains the usage of the word with clear examples.
usage.zh: 字典用清楚例句說明這個字的用法。

use.en: Students can use this website to review vocabulary at home.
use.zh: 學生可以在家使用這個網站複習單字。

used.en: The old classroom is now used as a study room.
used.zh: 那間舊教室現在被用作自習室。

useful.en: The chart provides useful information for comparing the two groups.
useful.zh: 這張圖表提供比較兩組時很有用的資訊。

user.en: Each user must create an account before saving progress.
user.zh: 每位使用者都必須先建立帳號才能儲存進度。

usher.en: An usher showed visitors to their seats before the concert.
usher.zh: 音樂會開始前，帶位員引導訪客入座。

usual.en: The library is quieter than usual during the school holiday.
usual.zh: 學校放假期間圖書館比平常安靜。

usually.en: I usually review new vocabulary before going to bed.
usually.zh: 我通常在睡前複習新單字。

utensil.en: Each cooking utensil was cleaned and returned to its drawer.
utensil.zh: 每件烹飪器具都清洗後放回抽屜。

utility.en: The tool's utility becomes clear during large group projects.
utility.zh: 在大型小組專題中，這個工具的實用性變得很明顯。

utilize.en: Students can utilize online databases to find reliable research sources.
utilize.zh: 學生可以利用線上資料庫尋找可靠的研究來源。

utter.en: The room fell into utter silence before the announcement began.
utter.zh: 公告開始前，房間陷入完全寂靜。

vacancy.en: The hotel website showed one remaining vacancy for Saturday night.
vacancy.zh: 飯店網站顯示週六晚間還有一個空房。

vacant.en: A vacant classroom was available for the afternoon meeting.
vacant.zh: 有一間空教室可供下午開會使用。

vacation.en: We spent part of the summer vacation visiting relatives in the south.
vacation.zh: 我們暑假的一部分時間到南部探望親戚。

vaccine.en: The article explains how a vaccine is tested before public use.
vaccine.zh: 文章說明疫苗在公開使用前如何接受測試。

vacuum.en: The science lesson explains why sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
vacuum.zh: 科學課說明聲音為何無法在真空中傳播。

vague.en: The first instruction was too vague, so the teacher clarified it.
vague.zh: 第一個指示太模糊，因此老師進一步說明。

vain.en: Their search was in vain because the file had been renamed.
vain.zh: 他們的搜尋徒勞無功，因為檔案已被重新命名。

valid.en: The conclusion is valid only if the measurements were collected correctly.
valid.zh: 只有在測量資料蒐集正確時，這個結論才有效。

valley.en: Morning fog covered the valley below the mountain trail.
valley.zh: 晨霧籠罩山徑下方的山谷。

valuable.en: The teacher gave us valuable advice about preparing for the exam.
valuable.zh: 老師給了我們一些準備考試的寶貴建議。

value.en: The survey asked students to rank each value by importance.
value.zh: 這份調查請學生依重要程度排列各項價值。

van.en: The school van carried equipment to the sports field.
van.zh: 校車小巴把器材運到運動場。

vanilla.en: The café offered vanilla yogurt as a simple dessert option.
vanilla.zh: 咖啡店提供香草優格作為簡單甜點選擇。

vanish.en: The rainbow began to vanish as the clouds moved away.
vanish.zh: 雲層散去時，彩虹開始消失。

vapor.en: Water vapor formed on the cool classroom window.
vapor.zh: 水蒸氣在冰涼的教室窗戶上凝結。

variable.en: Temperature was the only variable changed during the experiment.
variable.zh: 溫度是這項實驗中唯一被改變的變因。

variation.en: The experiment found a small variation between the two measurements.
variation.zh: 實驗發現兩次測量之間有小幅差異。

variety.en: The school library offers a wide variety of books and magazines.
variety.zh: 學校圖書館提供種類豐富的書籍和雜誌。

various.en: Students used various sources to complete the research project.
various.zh: 學生使用各種資料來源完成研究專題。

vary.en: The results may vary depending on temperature and humidity.
vary.zh: 結果可能會依溫度和濕度而有所不同。

vase.en: A blue vase stood on the table near the window.
vase.zh: 窗邊桌上放著一個藍色花瓶。

vast.en: The desert covers a vast area beyond the mountain range.
vast.zh: 沙漠覆蓋了山脈另一側的廣大區域。

vegetable.en: Each vegetable in the garden was labeled for the science project.
vegetable.zh: 花園裡的每種蔬菜都為科學專題標上名稱。

vegetarian.en: The cafeteria provides a vegetarian option at lunch each day.
vegetarian.zh: 學校餐廳每天午餐都提供素食選項。

vehicle.en: Every vehicle must stop before entering the school gate.
vehicle.zh: 每一輛車進入校門前都必須停下來。

veil.en: A thin veil of mist covered the lake at sunrise.
veil.zh: 日出時，一層薄霧籠罩湖面。

vein.en: The diagram shows a major vein carrying blood toward the heart.
vein.zh: 圖表顯示一條將血液帶回心臟的主要靜脈。

velvet.en: The museum displayed a velvet jacket from the nineteenth century.
velvet.zh: 博物館展示了一件十九世紀的天鵝絨外套。

vendor.en: A food vendor opened a small stall near the festival entrance.
vendor.zh: 一名食品攤販在節慶入口附近開了小攤位。

venture.en: The students began a new venture selling handmade cards for charity.
venture.zh: 學生開始一項販售手工卡片做公益的新計畫。

venue.en: The school gym was chosen as the venue for the ceremony.
venue.zh: 學校體育館被選為典禮場地。

verbal.en: The teacher gave verbal instructions before handing out the worksheet.
verbal.zh: 老師在發下學習單前先口頭說明。

verdict.en: The debate judges announced their verdict after reviewing every argument.
verdict.zh: 辯論評審檢視所有論點後公布評決。

versatile.en: A versatile tool can perform several different tasks efficiently.
versatile.zh: 多功能的工具可以有效完成多種不同任務。

verse.en: The class read one verse from the poem and discussed its imagery.
verse.zh: 班上讀了一節詩，並討論其中的意象。

version.en: Please make sure you are using the latest version of the file.
version.zh: 請確認你使用的是這份檔案的最新版本。

versus.en: The chart compares studying alone versus studying in a group.
versus.zh: 圖表比較獨自讀書與小組讀書。

vertical.en: Draw a vertical line through the center of the graph.
vertical.zh: 在圖表中央畫一條垂直線。

very.en: The final question was very difficult for most students.
very.zh: 最後一題對大多數學生來說非常困難。

vessel.en: The research vessel returned to port after collecting ocean samples.
vessel.zh: 研究船採集海洋樣本後返回港口。

vest.en: The volunteer wore a bright vest so visitors could find help easily.
vest.zh: 志工穿著醒目的背心，讓訪客容易找到協助。

vet.en: The vet examined the rescued dog at the animal center.
vet.zh: 獸醫在動物中心檢查那隻獲救的狗。

veteran.en: The interview features a veteran teacher reflecting on thirty years of education.
veteran.zh: 訪談邀請一位資深教師回顧三十年的教育經驗。

veterinarian.en: A veterinarian explained basic animal care during the school visit.
veterinarian.zh: 一位獸醫在到校活動中說明基本動物照護。

veto.en: The textbook explains how a veto can affect the lawmaking process.
veto.zh: 課本說明否決權如何影響立法程序。

via.en: The files were shared via the school's online learning system.
via.zh: 這些檔案透過學校的線上學習系統分享。

viable.en: The team selected the most viable solution after comparing costs.
viable.zh: 團隊比較成本後，選出最可行的解決方案。

vibrate.en: The phone began to vibrate quietly during the meeting.
vibrate.zh: 會議期間，手機開始安靜地震動。

vibration.en: The sensor detected a small vibration from the moving machine.
vibration.zh: 感應器偵測到運轉中機器產生的輕微震動。

victim.en: The news report focused on support available to each victim.
victim.zh: 新聞報導聚焦於每位受害者可以獲得的支援。

victor.en: The final match decided which team would emerge as the victor.
victor.zh: 決賽決定哪支隊伍會成為勝者。

victory.en: The team celebrated its victory after a close final match.
victory.zh: 球隊在一場勢均力敵的決賽後慶祝勝利。

video.en: The teacher showed a short video to introduce the topic.
video.zh: 老師播放了一段短影片來介紹主題。

view.en: The mountain offers a beautiful view of the entire valley.
view.zh: 這座山可以看到整個山谷的美麗景色。

viewer.en: Each viewer can choose subtitles from the video settings menu.
viewer.zh: 每位觀看者都能從影片設定選單選擇字幕。

viewpoint.en: The essay presents more than one viewpoint on the issue.
viewpoint.zh: 這篇文章呈現對該議題不只一種觀點。

vigor.en: The team returned to the project with renewed vigor after the break.
vigor.zh: 休息後，團隊重新充滿活力投入專題。

vigorous.en: The plants showed vigorous growth after moving closer to the window.
vigorous.zh: 植物移到窗邊後呈現旺盛生長。

villa.en: The old villa now serves as a small local museum.
villa.zh: 那棟老別墅現在作為地方小型博物館使用。

village.en: The small village is surrounded by farms and low hills.
village.zh: 這個小村莊周圍是農田和低矮山丘。

villain.en: The villain in the story is revealed near the final chapter.
villain.zh: 故事中的反派在最後幾章附近揭曉。

vine.en: A green vine climbed slowly along the garden wall.
vine.zh: 一株綠色藤蔓沿著花園牆面慢慢攀爬。

vinegar.en: The science activity compared vinegar with several other common liquids.
vinegar.zh: 科學活動比較醋與其他幾種常見液體。

vineyard.en: The documentary follows seasonal work at a hillside vineyard.
vineyard.zh: 紀錄片記錄山坡葡萄園的季節性工作。

violate.en: Copying another person's work can violate the school's academic rules.
violate.zh: 抄襲他人作品可能違反學校的學術規範。

violation.en: The referee explained the rule violation before restarting the game.
violation.zh: 裁判在比賽重新開始前說明了違規情況。

violence.en: The class discussed ways to prevent violence and improve school safety.
violence.zh: 全班討論如何預防暴力並提升校園安全。

violent.en: The movie contains some violent scenes and is not suitable for young children.
violent.zh: 這部電影有一些暴力場景，不適合年幼兒童。

violet.en: A small violet flower grew beside the garden path.
violet.zh: 花園小徑旁長著一朵小紫羅蘭。

violin.en: She practiced the violin every afternoon before the school concert.
violin.zh: 學校音樂會前，她每天下午練習小提琴。

violinist.en: The violinist performed a short piece for the music class.
violinist.zh: 那位小提琴家為音樂課演奏了一首短曲。

virtual.en: The museum created a virtual tour for students studying from home.
virtual.zh: 博物館為在家學習的學生製作了虛擬導覽。

virtue.en: Patience is a virtue that can help during difficult group projects.
virtue.zh: 耐心是一種在困難小組專題中很有幫助的美德。

virus.en: The science lesson explains how a virus differs from a bacterium.
virus.zh: 自然科學課說明病毒和細菌有何不同。

visa.en: She checked whether her visa was valid before the trip.
visa.zh: 她在旅行前確認簽證是否仍有效。

visible.en: The small crack became visible under bright light.
visible.zh: 在強光下，那條小裂縫變得看得見。

vision.en: The organization published its long-term vision for improving education.
vision.zh: 該組織公布改善教育的長期願景。

visit.en: Our class will visit the science museum next month.
visit.zh: 我們班下個月將參觀科學博物館。

visitor.en: Each visitor must register at the front desk before entering.
visitor.zh: 每位訪客進入前都必須在櫃檯登記。

visual.en: A visual chart can make complicated data easier to understand.
visual.zh: 視覺化圖表可以讓複雜資料更容易理解。

vital.en: Clean water is vital for healthy communities and ecosystems.
vital.zh: 乾淨的水對健康社區與生態系都非常重要。

vitality.en: The lively market gives the neighborhood a sense of vitality.
vitality.zh: 熱鬧的市場讓這個社區充滿活力。

vitamin.en: The nutrition lesson explains the role of each vitamin in general terms.
vitamin.zh: 營養課以一般方式說明各種維生素的作用。

vivid.en: The writer used vivid details to describe the changing landscape.
vivid.zh: 作者用生動的細節描寫正在改變的景觀。

vocabulary.en: Reading widely can help students expand their English vocabulary.
vocabulary.zh: 廣泛閱讀可以幫助學生擴充英文單字量。

vocal.en: She became vocal about the need for more study space.
vocal.zh: 她開始明確表達需要更多讀書空間的看法。

vocation.en: He viewed teaching as both a career and a vocation.
vocation.zh: 他把教學視為職業，也視為一種志業。

vocational.en: The school offers vocational courses in design and technology.
vocational.zh: 學校提供設計與科技方面的職業課程。

voice.en: Her voice was clear enough for everyone to hear.
voice.zh: 她的聲音很清楚，大家都聽得見。

volcano.en: The class built a model to show the shape of a volcano.
volcano.zh: 班上做了一個模型來展示火山的形狀。

volleyball.en: The students played volleyball during the afternoon sports period.
volleyball.zh: 學生在下午體育課打排球。

volume.en: The container can hold a large volume of water.
volume.zh: 這個容器可以裝下大量的水。

voluntary.en: Participation in the after-school survey is completely voluntary.
voluntary.zh: 參加課後問卷完全是自願的。

volunteer.en: Many students volunteer at community events during the weekend.
volunteer.zh: 許多學生週末會在社區活動中擔任志工。

vomit.en: The health textbook lists vomit as a word used in medical descriptions.
vomit.zh: 健康課本將 vomit 列為醫療描述中使用的字詞。

vote.en: Students will vote for a new class representative tomorrow.
vote.zh: 學生明天將投票選出新的班級代表。

voter.en: Each voter in the mock election received one ballot.
voter.zh: 模擬選舉中的每位選民都拿到一張選票。

voucher.en: The library gave each winner a bookstore voucher.
voucher.zh: 圖書館給每位得獎者一張書店禮券。

vow.en: She made a vow to finish the project responsibly.
vow.zh: 她立下承諾，要負責任地完成這個專題。

vowel.en: The teacher asked students to identify each vowel in the word.
vowel.zh: 老師請學生找出單字中的每個母音。

voyage.en: The novel follows a long voyage across the Pacific Ocean.
voyage.zh: 小說描寫一次橫越太平洋的長途航行。

vulnerable.en: Young plants are vulnerable to sudden changes in temperature.
vulnerable.zh: 幼苗容易受到突然溫度變化的影響。

wag.en: The dog began to wag its tail when the family returned.
wag.zh: 家人回來時，那隻狗開始搖尾巴。

wage.en: The report compares the average wage across several industries.
wage.zh: 報告比較數個產業的平均工資。

wagon.en: The old wagon is now displayed inside the local museum.
wagon.zh: 那輛老馬車現在展示在地方博物館裡。

wait.en: Please wait outside until the teacher calls your name.
wait.zh: 請在外面等到老師叫你的名字。

waiter.en: The waiter brought the menu and answered questions about the dishes.
waiter.zh: 服務生送上菜單並回答關於餐點的問題。

waitress.en: The waitress brought our meals and checked the table again later.
waitress.zh: 女服務生送上餐點，稍後又來確認桌邊需求。

wake.en: I usually wake before the alarm on school days.
wake.zh: 上學日我通常在鬧鐘響前就醒來。

waken.en: Birdsong can waken people early on quiet summer mornings.
waken.zh: 安靜的夏日清晨，鳥鳴可能會讓人提早醒來。

walk.en: We decided to walk to the station instead of taking a bus.
walk.zh: 我們決定走路去車站，不搭公車。

wall.en: The class posted its project posters on the back wall.
wall.zh: 全班把專題海報貼在後面的牆上。

wallet.en: He found his wallet inside the backpack after searching everywhere.
wallet.zh: 到處找過後，他在背包裡找到了皮夾。

walnut.en: She added a chopped walnut to the bowl of oatmeal.
walnut.zh: 她在燕麥粥裡加入了一顆切碎的核桃。

wander.en: Visitors sometimes wander through the old streets without a fixed route.
wander.zh: 遊客有時會沒有固定路線地漫步在老街上。

want.en: Many students want more time to prepare for major tests.
want.zh: 許多學生希望有更多時間準備重要考試。

war.en: The history lesson explained how the war changed daily life.
war.zh: 歷史課說明了戰爭如何改變日常生活。

ward.en: The hospital ward was quiet during the afternoon visiting period.
ward.zh: 下午探視時段，醫院病房很安靜。

wardrobe.en: The costume wardrobe contains clothes from several historical periods.
wardrobe.zh: 戲服衣櫃裡有來自不同歷史時期的服裝。

warehouse.en: The company stores extra supplies in a large warehouse nearby.
warehouse.zh: 公司把額外物資存放在附近的大型倉庫。

warm.en: The classroom stayed warm even though it was cold outside.
warm.zh: 即使外面很冷，教室裡仍然很溫暖。

warmth.en: The sunlight brought welcome warmth into the classroom that morning.
warmth.zh: 那天早上，陽光為教室帶來令人舒服的暖意。

warn.en: Teachers warn students when weather conditions may affect outdoor activities.
warn.zh: 天候可能影響戶外活動時，老師會提醒學生。

warrant.en: The article explains when a legal warrant may be required.
warrant.zh: 文章說明在何種情況下可能需要法律令狀。

warranty.en: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty for hardware problems.
warranty.zh: 這台筆電附有兩年的硬體保固。

warrior.en: The museum displayed a painting of an ancient warrior.
warrior.zh: 博物館展示了一幅古代戰士的畫作。

wary.en: Hikers should remain wary of sudden weather changes in the mountains.
wary.zh: 登山者應留意山區突然的天氣變化。

wash.en: Remember to wash your hands before preparing food.

waste.en: The school is trying to reduce food waste in the cafeteria.
waste.zh: 學校正努力減少餐廳的食物浪費。

watch.en: We stayed after class to watch a short documentary.
watch.zh: 我們下課後留下來看一部短紀錄片。

water.en: Plants need enough water and sunlight to grow well.
water.zh: 植物需要足夠的水和陽光才能好好生長。

waterfall.en: The trail ends beside a waterfall hidden deep in the forest.
waterfall.zh: 這條步道終點在森林深處一座瀑布旁。

watermelon.en: We cut the watermelon into slices for the summer picnic.
watermelon.zh: 我們把西瓜切成片，帶去夏日野餐。

waterproof.en: This waterproof jacket kept me dry during the sudden rainstorm.
waterproof.zh: 這件防水外套讓我在突如其來的暴雨中保持乾燥。

wave.en: A large wave reached the rocks near the shore.
wave.zh: 一個大浪打到了岸邊的岩石。

wax.en: The museum displayed an old wax model behind glass.
wax.zh: 博物館在玻璃櫃後展示了一座舊蠟像。

way.en: There is more than one way to solve this problem.
way.zh: 這個問題不只一種解法。

we.en: We reviewed the key points before the test began.
we.zh: 考試開始前，我們複習了重點。

weak.en: The bridge model collapsed because one support was too weak.
weak.zh: 這座橋梁模型因其中一個支撐太脆弱而倒塌。

weaken.en: Long periods without rain can weaken young plants in the field.
weaken.zh: 長時間缺雨可能使田裡的幼苗變得衰弱。

wealth.en: The article examines how wealth is distributed across different regions.
wealth.zh: 這篇文章探討財富如何分布在不同地區。

wealthy.en: The novel follows a wealthy family facing unexpected changes.
wealthy.zh: 這本小說描述一個富裕家庭面對意外變化。

wear.en: Students must wear safety glasses during this experiment.
wear.zh: 學生進行這項實驗時必須戴護目鏡。

weary.en: The hikers felt weary after walking for several hours.
weary.zh: 走了幾個小時後，健行者感到疲憊。

weather.en: The weather changed quickly as dark clouds moved in.
weather.zh: 烏雲移入後，天氣很快發生變化。

weave.en: Local artists weave colorful patterns into traditional baskets.
weave.zh: 當地藝術家把繽紛圖案編進傳統籃子裡。

web.en: A spider built a web between two branches overnight.
web.zh: 一隻蜘蛛一夜之間在兩根樹枝間結了網。

website.en: The school website provides updated information about upcoming events.
website.zh: 學校網站提供即將舉行活動的最新資訊。

wed.en: The historical records say the couple planned to wed in spring.
wed.zh: 歷史紀錄顯示這對伴侶計畫在春天結婚。

wedding.en: The family gathered for a small wedding at the town hall.
wedding.zh: 家人聚在市政廳參加一場小型婚禮。

weed.en: Gardeners removed each weed before planting the new flowers.
weed.zh: 園丁在種新花前先拔除每株雜草。

week.en: We have a science quiz at the end of this week.
week.zh: 這週結束前我們有一場自然科小考。

weekday.en: The library stays open later on each weekday during exams.
weekday.zh: 考試期間，圖書館每個平日都會延長開放時間。

weekend.en: She plans to finish the project over the weekend.
weekend.zh: 她計畫利用週末完成專題。

weekly.en: Our class holds a weekly discussion about current science topics.
weekly.zh: 我們班每週都會討論近期的科學主題。

weep.en: The character begins to weep after reading the final letter.
weep.zh: 那個角色讀完最後一封信後開始落淚。

weigh.en: Students weigh each sample before recording the experiment results.
weigh.zh: 學生在記錄實驗結果前會先秤量每個樣本。

weight.en: The students measured the weight of each object carefully.
weight.zh: 學生仔細測量每個物體的重量。

weird.en: A weird sound came from the old fan during class.
weird.zh: 上課時，舊風扇傳出一個奇怪的聲音。

welcome.en: New students are always welcome to join the club.
welcome.zh: 新生隨時都歡迎加入這個社團。

welfare.en: The policy aims to improve the welfare of local families.
welfare.zh: 這項政策旨在改善當地家庭的福祉。

well.en: She explained the difficult idea very well during the presentation.
well.zh: 她在報告中把困難的概念解釋得很好。

west.en: The sun was setting in the west behind the mountains.
west.zh: 太陽正在山後的西方落下。

western.en: The course compares several eastern and western cultural traditions.
western.zh: 這門課比較數種東西方文化傳統。

wet.en: The floor was wet after students came in from the rain.
wet.zh: 學生淋雨進來後，地板變得濕濕的。

whale.en: The documentary followed a whale migrating across the ocean.
whale.zh: 紀錄片跟拍一頭鯨魚橫越海洋遷徙。

wharf.en: Fishing boats returned to the wharf before sunset.
wharf.zh: 漁船在日落前回到碼頭。

what.en: Please explain what you learned from the experiment.
what.zh: 請說明你從這個實驗中學到了什麼。

whatever.en: Whatever method you choose, make sure you can explain it clearly.
whatever.zh: 無論你選擇哪種方法，都要確保能清楚說明。

whatsoever.en: There was no evidence whatsoever that the rumor was true.
whatsoever.zh: 完全沒有任何證據顯示那則傳聞是真的。

wheat.en: Farmers harvested the wheat after several weeks of dry weather.
wheat.zh: 經過數週乾燥天氣後，農民收割了小麥。

wheel.en: One wheel on the cart became loose during transport.
wheel.zh: 運送途中，推車的一個輪子鬆了。

wheelchair.en: The new entrance includes a ramp for wheelchair access.
wheelchair.zh: 新入口設有坡道，方便輪椅通行。

when.en: Tell me when you are ready to begin the presentation.
when.zh: 你準備好開始報告時告訴我。

whenever.en: You may review the recording whenever you need extra practice.
whenever.zh: 需要額外練習時，你隨時都可以重看錄影。

where.en: The map shows where each station is located.
where.zh: 這張地圖顯示每個車站的位置。

whereabouts.en: The guide asked about the whereabouts of the missing equipment.
whereabouts.zh: 嚮導詢問遺失設備目前可能的位置。

whereas.en: The first method is faster, whereas the second is more accurate.
whereas.zh: 第一種方法較快，而第二種方法更準確。

wherever.en: She carries a notebook wherever she goes for new ideas.
wherever.zh: 她走到哪裡都帶著筆記本記錄新想法。

whether.en: We need to decide whether the plan is practical enough.
whether.zh: 我們需要決定這個計畫是否夠實際。

which.en: Please choose which topic you want to research first.
which.zh: 請選擇你想先研究哪個主題。

while.en: She listened to music while organizing her notes.
while.zh: 她一邊整理筆記，一邊聽音樂。

whine.en: The old motor began to whine when the machine started.
whine.zh: 機器啟動時，舊馬達開始發出尖細聲。

whisper.en: Please whisper if you need to speak inside the reading room.
whisper.zh: 如果在閱覽室裡需要說話，請小聲耳語。

whistle.en: The referee blew a whistle to signal the end of play.
whistle.zh: 裁判吹哨表示比賽結束。

white.en: The teacher used a white card to cover the answer.
white.zh: 老師用一張白色卡片遮住答案。

who.en: The teacher asked who wanted to present first.
who.zh: 老師問誰想第一個上台報告。

whoever.en: Whoever finishes first can help organize the remaining materials.
whoever.zh: 無論誰先完成，都可以幫忙整理剩下的材料。

whole.en: The whole class worked together to prepare the exhibition.
whole.zh: 全班一起合作準備展覽。

wholesale.en: The report compares wholesale prices with prices in local shops.
wholesale.zh: 報告比較批發價格與當地商店的售價。

wholesome.en: The cafeteria offers a wholesome lunch with vegetables and fruit.
wholesome.zh: 餐廳提供包含蔬菜和水果的健康午餐。

whom.en: The teacher asked whom we had chosen to interview.
whom.zh: 老師問我們選擇訪問誰。

whose.en: We found a notebook whose cover had no name.
whose.zh: 我們找到一本封面沒有名字的筆記本。

why.en: Please explain why you chose this answer.
why.zh: 請說明你為什麼選這個答案。

wicked.en: The fairy tale features a wicked ruler who abuses power.
wicked.zh: 這則童話描寫一位濫用權力的邪惡統治者。

wide.en: The river is too wide to cross without a bridge.
wide.zh: 這條河太寬，沒有橋就無法渡過。

widen.en: The city plans to widen the sidewalk near the station.
widen.zh: 市府計畫拓寬車站附近的人行道。

widespread.en: Online learning became widespread in many schools during that period.
widespread.zh: 在那段期間，線上學習在許多學校變得很普遍。

widow.en: The novel follows a widow rebuilding her family business.
widow.zh: 小說描述一位寡婦重新經營家族事業。

widower.en: The story centers on a widower raising two children alone.
widower.zh: 故事以一位獨自撫養兩個孩子的鰥夫為中心。

width.en: Measure the width of the table before choosing a shelf.
width.zh: 挑選架子前先量桌子的寬度。

wife.en: The writer thanked his wife for supporting his work.
wife.zh: 這位作家感謝妻子支持他的工作。

wig.en: The actor wore a wig for the historical stage performance.
wig.zh: 演員在歷史舞台劇中戴了一頂假髮。

wild.en: Several wild birds gather near the lake every winter.
wild.zh: 每年冬天都有幾種野鳥聚集在湖邊。

wilderness.en: The park protects a large wilderness area with native plants.
wilderness.zh: 這座公園保護一大片擁有原生植物的荒野地區。

wildlife.en: The park protects wildlife by limiting access to sensitive areas.
wildlife.zh: 公園透過限制進入敏感區域來保護野生動物。

will.en: Regular practice will improve your reading speed over time.
will.zh: 規律練習會逐漸提升你的閱讀速度。

willing.en: She was willing to revise the report after receiving feedback.
willing.zh: 收到回饋後，她願意修改報告。

win.en: The team hopes to win the final match this weekend.
win.zh: 球隊希望這個週末贏得決賽。

wind.en: Strong wind made it difficult to hold the umbrella.
wind.zh: 強風讓人很難撐穩雨傘。

window.en: Please open the window to let fresh air into the room.
window.zh: 請打開窗戶讓新鮮空氣進入房間。

windshield.en: Rain covered the windshield during the afternoon drive.
windshield.zh: 下午開車時，雨水覆滿了擋風玻璃。

windy.en: It was too windy to hold the outdoor poster display.
windy.zh: 風太大，不適合舉辦戶外海報展示。

wing.en: The bird stretched one wing before taking off.
wing.zh: 那隻鳥起飛前伸展了一側翅膀。

wink.en: She gave a quick wink after solving the puzzle.
wink.zh: 她解開謎題後眨了一下眼。

wipe.en: Please wipe the whiteboard clean after the group discussion.
wipe.zh: 小組討論後請把白板擦乾淨。

wire.en: A loose wire caused the classroom speaker to stop working.
wire.zh: 一條鬆脫的電線讓教室喇叭停止運作。

wisdom.en: The story suggests that wisdom grows through experience and reflection.
wisdom.zh: 故事暗示智慧會隨經驗與反思而增長。

wise.en: It is wise to check the facts before sharing information online.
wise.zh: 在網路分享資訊前先查證事實是明智的做法。

wish.en: I wish we had more time to discuss the final question.
wish.zh: 我希望我們有更多時間討論最後一題。

wit.en: Her quick wit made the class discussion more lively.
wit.zh: 她機智的反應讓課堂討論更活潑。

witch.en: The children read a fairy tale about a mysterious witch.
witch.zh: 孩子們讀了一則關於神祕女巫的童話。

with.en: She solved the problem with help from her classmate.
with.zh: 她在同學協助下解決了這個問題。

withdraw.en: Students may withdraw from the activity before the final registration date.
withdraw.zh: 學生可以在最後報名日前退出這項活動。

wither.en: Plants may wither when they receive too little water.
wither.zh: 植物水分不足時可能會枯萎。

withhold.en: The editor decided to withhold the article until facts were verified.
withhold.zh: 編輯決定在查證事實前暫不刊登文章。

within.en: Please submit the form within three days of receiving it.
within.zh: 請在收到表格後三天內繳交。

without.en: We finished the task without using a calculator.
without.zh: 我們沒有使用計算機就完成了這項任務。

witness.en: A witness described what happened during the minor traffic accident.
witness.zh: 一名目擊者描述了那起輕微交通事故的經過。

witty.en: Her witty comment made the whole class laugh during the discussion.
witty.zh: 她機智的評論讓全班在討論時笑了出來。

wizard.en: The fantasy novel follows a young wizard learning ancient magic.
wizard.zh: 這本奇幻小說描述一位年輕巫師學習古老魔法。

woe.en: The poem uses the word woe to express deep sadness.
woe.zh: 這首詩用 woe 這個字表達深沉悲傷。

wolf.en: The documentary shows a wolf traveling across a snowy forest.
wolf.zh: 紀錄片拍到一隻狼穿越雪地森林。

woman.en: The woman gave a short talk about her research experience.
woman.zh: 那位女性分享了一場關於研究經驗的短講。

wonder.en: I wonder how the results would change with a larger sample.
wonder.zh: 我想知道樣本更大時結果會如何改變。

wonderful.en: The students did a wonderful job on their final presentations.
wonderful.zh: 學生的期末報告表現得非常好。

wood.en: The model was built from thin pieces of wood.
wood.zh: 這個模型由薄木片製成。

wooden.en: A wooden bridge crosses the narrow stream behind the school.
wooden.zh: 學校後方有一座木橋跨過狹窄溪流。

woodpecker.en: A woodpecker tapped repeatedly on the tree outside our classroom.
woodpecker.zh: 一隻啄木鳥反覆啄著教室外的樹。

wool.en: The exhibit explains how wool is turned into fabric.
wool.zh: 展覽說明羊毛如何製成布料。

word.en: Try to understand each word from its context before using a dictionary.
word.zh: 查字典前，先試著從語境理解每個單字。

work.en: Group work can be effective when everyone has a clear role.
work.zh: 當每個人都有明確角色時，小組合作會很有效。

workbook.en: Please complete page twenty in the grammar workbook tonight.
workbook.zh: 今晚請完成文法練習簿第二十頁。

worker.en: Each worker received safety training before entering the site.
worker.zh: 每位工作人員進入現場前都接受了安全訓練。

workforce.en: The report examines changes in the local workforce over ten years.
workforce.zh: 報告分析當地勞動人口十年來的變化。

workout.en: A short workout can be part of a balanced daily routine.
workout.zh: 短時間運動可以成為均衡日常作息的一部分。

workplace.en: Clear communication helps prevent confusion in any workplace.
workplace.zh: 清楚溝通有助於避免任何工作場所中的混亂。

workshop.en: The school hosted a writing workshop for interested students.
workshop.zh: 學校為有興趣的學生舉辦寫作工作坊。

world.en: The internet connects people from many parts of the world.
world.zh: 網路連結了世界各地的人。

worm.en: A worm moved slowly across the wet garden soil.
worm.zh: 一條蚯蚓慢慢爬過潮濕的花園土壤。

worry.en: Try not to worry before you know the final result.
worry.zh: 在知道最後結果前，盡量不要擔心。

worse.en: The traffic became worse after the heavy rain began.
worse.zh: 大雨開始後，交通狀況變得更糟。

worship.en: The course examines how different cultures worship in varied traditions.
worship.zh: 這門課探討不同文化如何以各自傳統進行敬拜。

worst.en: The worst delay occurred during the evening rush hour.
worst.zh: 最嚴重的延誤發生在晚間尖峰時段。

worth.en: The book is worth reading because it explains the topic clearly.
worth.zh: 這本書值得一讀，因為它把主題解釋得很清楚。

worthwhile.en: The extra practice was difficult but ultimately worthwhile.
worthwhile.zh: 額外練習雖然困難，但最後證明很值得。

worthy.en: The judges considered the project worthy of special recognition.
worthy.zh: 評審認為這項專題值得特別表揚。

wound.en: The story mentions a minor wound without giving graphic details.
wound.zh: 故事提到一處輕微傷口，但沒有描述血腥細節。

wrap.en: Please wrap the fragile model carefully before carrying it home.
wrap.zh: 把易碎模型帶回家前，請仔細包好。

wreck.en: The storm left an old boat wreck near the shore.
wreck.zh: 暴風雨在岸邊留下了一艘舊船殘骸。

wrestle.en: The students wrestle with a difficult question during discussion.
wrestle.zh: 學生在討論中努力思考一個困難問題。

wrinkle.en: One wrinkle appeared in the paper after it got wet.
wrinkle.zh: 紙張弄濕後出現了一道皺褶。

wrist.en: She wore a simple watch around her wrist at school.
wrist.zh: 她上學時在手腕上戴著一只簡單的手錶。

write.en: Please write a short summary after reading the article.
write.zh: 讀完文章後請寫一篇簡短摘要。

writer.en: The writer uses simple examples to explain complex ideas.
writer.zh: 這位作家用簡單例子解釋複雜概念。

wrong.en: The answer was wrong because one important step was missing.
wrong.zh: 這個答案錯了，因為少了一個重要步驟。

yacht.en: A white yacht moved slowly across the quiet harbor.
yacht.zh: 一艘白色遊艇緩緩駛過平靜的港灣。

yam.en: The market sold roasted yam during the cool evening.
yam.zh: 市場在涼爽的晚上販售烤地瓜。

yard.en: The children played in the yard after finishing their homework.
yard.zh: 孩子們做完功課後在院子裡玩。

yawn.en: A long yawn escaped him during the early lecture.
yawn.zh: 清早的講座中，他忍不住打了一個大哈欠。

yeah.en: Yeah, I remember where we placed the extra notebooks.
yeah.zh: 對，我記得我們把多的筆記本放在哪裡。

year.en: The school adds several new courses every year.
year.zh: 學校每年都會新增幾門課。

yearly.en: The club holds a yearly meeting to review its goals.
yearly.zh: 社團每年舉行一次會議檢視目標。

yearn.en: Many students yearn for more time to explore their interests.
yearn.zh: 許多學生渴望有更多時間探索自己的興趣。

yell.en: There is no need to yell across the quiet library.
yell.zh: 在安靜的圖書館裡沒有必要大聲喊叫。

yellow.en: The yellow sign marks the entrance to the hiking trail.
yellow.zh: 黃色標誌標示了健行步道入口。

yes.en: She answered yes after thinking about the question carefully.
yes.zh: 她仔細思考問題後回答了是。

yesterday.en: We finished the first part of the project yesterday.
yesterday.zh: 我們昨天完成了專題的第一部分。

yet.en: The final results are not available yet.
yet.zh: 最終結果目前還沒有公布。

yield.en: The new method can yield more accurate results with less time.
yield.zh: 這種新方法可以用更少時間得到更準確的結果。

yoga.en: The community center offers a beginner yoga class on weekends.
yoga.zh: 社區中心週末開設初學者瑜伽課。

yogurt.en: She added fresh fruit to plain yogurt for breakfast.
yogurt.zh: 她早餐把新鮮水果加入原味優格。

yolk.en: The egg yolk remained bright yellow after cooking.
yolk.zh: 蛋黃煮熟後仍呈現鮮黃色。

you.en: You should review the instructions before starting the test.
you.zh: 你應該在開始考試前先複習說明。

young.en: Young learners often improve quickly when they practice every day.
young.zh: 年輕學習者每天練習時通常進步得很快。

youngster.en: The museum designed a science corner for every curious youngster.
youngster.zh: 博物館為每位好奇的孩子設計了科學角落。

your.en: Please write your student number at the top of the page.
your.zh: 請在頁面上方寫上你的學號。

yours.en: This blue notebook is yours, not mine.
yours.zh: 這本藍色筆記本是你的，不是我的。

yourself.en: Give yourself enough time to check the final answer.
yourself.zh: 給自己足夠時間檢查最後答案。

yourselves.en: Please introduce yourselves before the group discussion begins.
yourselves.zh: 小組討論開始前，請先自我介紹。

youth.en: The community center offers several programs for local youth.
youth.zh: 社區中心為當地青少年提供數項活動。

youthful.en: The design has a youthful style that suits the school event.
youthful.zh: 這個設計帶有年輕活潑的風格，很適合校園活動。

zebra.en: The zoo introduced a young zebra in its grassland exhibit.
zebra.zh: 動物園在草原展區介紹了一隻年輕斑馬。

zero.en: The temperature fell close to zero during the night.
zero.zh: 夜間氣溫降到接近零度。

zipper.en: The zipper on my backpack broke during the field trip.
zipper.zh: 校外教學時，我背包上的拉鍊壞了。

zone.en: This area is a quiet zone during examination periods.
zone.zh: 考試期間這個區域是安靜區。

zoo.en: Our class visited the zoo to study animal behavior.
zoo.zh: 我們班參觀動物園研究動物行為。

zoom.en: Use the controls to zoom in on the map details.
zoom.zh: 使用控制按鈕放大地圖細節。

abbey.en: The guide explained the history of the old abbey.
abbey.zh: 導遊說明了這座古老修道院的歷史。

abbreviation.en: NASA is an abbreviation formed from several English words.
abbreviation.zh: NASA 是由幾個英文單字組成的縮寫。

abolition.en: The lesson discussed the abolition of an outdated legal practice.
abolition.zh: 課堂討論了一項過時法律制度的廢除。

absorbing.en: The documentary was absorbing enough to hold everyone's attention.
absorbing.zh: 這部紀錄片很引人入勝，吸引了所有人的注意。

acceleration.en: The graph shows the car's acceleration over several seconds.
acceleration.zh: 圖表顯示汽車數秒內的加速度變化。

accomplished.en: She is an accomplished pianist who also teaches younger students.
accomplished.zh: 她是一位有成就的鋼琴家，也教導年幼學生。

ace.en: He hopes to ace the quiz after a week of review.
ace.zh: 複習一週後，他希望能把小考考得很好。

acreage.en: The report lists the farm acreage used for vegetables.
acreage.zh: 報告列出農場用來種植蔬菜的面積。

adequately.en: The report adequately explains how the data were collected and checked.
adequately.zh: 這份報告充分說明資料如何被蒐集與檢查。

adjoin.en: Two classrooms adjoin the new science laboratory.
adjoin.zh: 兩間教室與新的科學實驗室相連。

advancement.en: The invention represented a major advancement in communication technology.
advancement.zh: 這項發明代表通訊科技的一大進步。

advert.en: The magazine placed an advert beside the travel article.
advert.zh: 雜誌在旅遊文章旁放了一則廣告。

advertising.en: The course examines how advertising influences consumer choices.
advertising.zh: 這門課探討廣告如何影響消費者選擇。

aerospace.en: The university opened a new aerospace research laboratory.
aerospace.zh: 大學新設了一間航太研究實驗室。

affiliated.en: The school is affiliated with several international education groups.
affiliated.zh: 這所學校與數個國際教育團體有合作關係。

aftermath.en: The town repaired roads in the aftermath of the storm.
aftermath.zh: 暴風雨過後，城鎮修復了道路。

aggregate.en: The report presents aggregate data from all participating schools.
aggregate.zh: 這份報告呈現所有參與學校的彙總資料。

aging.en: The article discusses challenges created by an aging population.
aging.zh: 文章討論人口老化帶來的挑戰。

aide.en: The teacher's aide prepared materials before the science activity.
aide.zh: 教學助理在科學活動前準備教材。

airforce.en: The history book includes a chapter about the national airforce.
airforce.zh: 歷史課本有一章介紹國家空軍。

airmail.en: The old letter was originally sent overseas by airmail.
airmail.zh: 這封老信最初是用航空郵件寄到海外。

akin.en: Her idea is akin to one discussed in yesterday's lesson.
akin.zh: 她的想法與昨天課堂討論的一個觀點相似。

alarming.en: The report showed an alarming rise in plastic waste.
alarming.zh: 報告顯示塑膠垃圾出現令人擔憂的增加。

alas.en: Alas, the outdoor concert was canceled because of heavy rain.
alas.zh: 唉，戶外音樂會因大雨而取消。

albeit.en: The task was useful, albeit more difficult than expected.
albeit.zh: 這項任務很有幫助，雖然比預期更困難。

alienation.en: The novel explores feelings of alienation in a changing city.
alienation.zh: 小說探討人在變動城市中的疏離感。

allegation.en: The report treated each allegation carefully before drawing conclusions.
allegation.zh: 報告在下結論前仔細處理每項指控。

allied.en: The two research teams became allied through a shared project.
allied.zh: 兩個研究團隊因共同專題而結盟合作。

allocation.en: The committee reviewed the allocation of funds for student activities.
allocation.zh: 委員會檢視學生活動經費的分配。

allot.en: Teachers allot extra time for students who need clarification.
allot.zh: 老師會分配額外時間給需要說明的學生。

alteration.en: One small alteration made the poster easier to read.
alteration.zh: 一個小修改讓海報更容易閱讀。

alternatively.en: Alternatively, you can submit the assignment through the school website.
alternatively.zh: 或者，你可以透過學校網站繳交作業。

amazing.en: The telescope gave us an amazing view of the night sky.
amazing.zh: 望遠鏡讓我們看到令人驚嘆的夜空景象。

amnesty.en: The history lesson explained why the government announced an amnesty.
amnesty.zh: 歷史課說明政府為何宣布特赦。

analects.en: The class read selections from the analects during the philosophy unit.
analects.zh: 哲學單元中，班上閱讀《論語》的選文。

ancestral.en: The museum preserves records connected to the community's ancestral traditions.
ancestral.zh: 博物館保存與社區祖先傳統有關的紀錄。

anecdote.en: The speaker opened the lecture with a short personal anecdote.
anecdote.zh: 講者以一則簡短的個人軼事開場。
